  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGAdjunction.h0_whiskerLeft_counit
statement:
theorem h0_whiskerLeft_counit {E : Type u''} [DGCategory.{v} E]
    (A : DGAdjunction L R) (P : DGFunctor E D) :
    (DGFunctor.h0CompIso (P.comp R) L).inv ≫
        DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0
          (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeft P A.counit)
          (A.counit_isClosed.whiskerLeft P) =
      Functor.whiskerRight (DGFunctor.h0CompIso P R).hom L.h0 ≫
        (Functor.associator P.h0 R.h0 L.h0).hom ≫
          Functor.whiskerLeft P.h0 A.h0Counit ≫
            (Functor.rightUnitor P.h0).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hwhisk := DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0_whiskerLeft
    P A.counit A.counit_isClosed
  calc
    _ = (DGFunctor.h0CompIso (P.comp R) L).inv ≫
        ((DGFunctor.h0CompIso P (R.comp L)).hom ≫
          Functor.whiskerLeft P.h0
            (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0 A.counit A.counit_isClosed) ≫
          (DGFunctor.h0CompIso P (DGFunctor.id D)).inv) :=
      congrArg (fun τ => (DGFunctor.h0CompIso (P.comp R) L).inv ≫ τ) hwhisk
    _ = _ := by
      have hcounit :
          DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0 A.counit A.counit_isClosed =
            (DGFunctor.h0CompIso R L).hom ≫ A.h0Counit ≫
              (DGFunctor.h0IdIso (C := D)).inv := by
        unfold h0Counit
        simp
      rw [hcounit, Functor.whiskerLeft_comp, Functor.whiskerLeft_comp]
      have hassoc :
          (DGFunctor.h0CompIso (P.comp R) L).hom ≫
              Functor.whiskerRight (DGFunctor.h0CompIso P R).hom L.h0 ≫
                (Functor.associator P.h0 R.h0 L.h0).hom =
            (DGFunctor.h0CompIso P (R.comp L)).hom ≫
              Functor.whiskerLeft P.h0 (DGFunctor.h0CompIso R L).hom := by
        simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.isoWhiskerRight_hom,
          Functor.isoWhiskerLeft_hom] using
            congrArg Iso.hom (DGFunctor.h0CompIso_assoc P R L)
      have hassoc' :
          (DGFunctor.h0CompIso (P.comp R) L).inv ≫
              (DGFunctor.h0CompIso P (R.comp L)).hom ≫
                Functor.whiskerLeft P.h0 (DGFunctor.h0CompIso R L).hom =
            Functor.whiskerRight (DGFunctor.h0CompIso P R).hom L.h0 ≫
              (Functor.associator P.h0 R.h0 L.h0).hom := by
        rw [← cancel_epi (DGFunctor.h0CompIso (P.comp R) L).hom]
        simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
        convert hassoc.symm using 1
        all_goals rfl
      have hunit :
          Functor.whiskerLeft P.h0 (DGFunctor.h0IdIso (C := D)).inv ≫
              (DGFunctor.h0CompIso P (DGFunctor.id D)).inv =
            (Functor.rightUnitor P.h0).hom := by
        have h := congrArg
          (fun e => (Functor.rightUnitor P.h0).hom ≫ e.inv)
          (DGFunctor.h0CompIso_comp_id P)
        simpa [Category.assoc] using h
      have h₁ := congrArg
        (fun τ => τ ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft P.h0 A.h0Counit ≫
          Functor.whiskerLeft P.h0 (DGFunctor.h0IdIso (C := D)).inv ≫
            (DGFunctor.h0CompIso P (DGFunctor.id D)).inv) hassoc'
      have h₂ := congrArg
        (fun τ =>
          Functor.whiskerRight (DGFunctor.h0CompIso P R).hom L.h0 ≫
            (Functor.associator P.h0 R.h0 L.h0).hom ≫
              Functor.whiskerLeft P.h0 A.h0Counit ≫ τ) hunit
      calc
        _ = Functor.whiskerRight (DGFunctor.h0CompIso P R).hom L.h0 ≫
              (Functor.associator P.h0 R.h0 L.h0).hom ≫
                Functor.whiskerLeft P.h0 A.h0Counit ≫
                  Functor.whiskerLeft P.h0
                    (DGFunctor.h0IdIso (C := D)).inv ≫
                    (DGFunctor.h0CompIso P (DGFunctor.id D)).inv := by
          simpa only [Category.assoc] using h₁
        _ = _ := by
          convert h₂ using 1
          all_goals simp only [DGFunctor.comp_id]

name: CategoryTheory.DGAdjunction.h0_whiskerRight_unit
statement:
theorem h0_whiskerRight_unit {E : Type u''} [DGCategory.{v} E]
    (A : DGAdjunction L R) (P : DGFunctor C E) :
    DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0
          (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight A.unit P)
          (A.unit_isClosed.whiskerRight P) ≫
        (DGFunctor.h0CompIso L (R.comp P)).hom =
      (Functor.leftUnitor P.h0).inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight A.h0Unit P.h0 ≫
            (Functor.associator L.h0 R.h0 P.h0).hom ≫
            Functor.whiskerLeft L.h0 (DGFunctor.h0CompIso R P).inv
proof:
:= by
  let cAssoc : ((L.comp R).comp P).h0 ≅ L.h0 ⋙ (R.comp P).h0 :=
    DGFunctor.h0CompIso L (R.comp P)
  change DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0
      (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight A.unit P)
      (A.unit_isClosed.whiskerRight P) ≫ cAssoc.hom = _
  have hwhisk := DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0_whiskerRight
    A.unit A.unit_isClosed P
  calc
    _ = ((DGFunctor.h0CompIso (DGFunctor.id C) P).hom ≫
          Functor.whiskerRight
            (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0 A.unit A.unit_isClosed) P.h0 ≫
          (DGFunctor.h0CompIso (L.comp R) P).inv) ≫
        cAssoc.hom :=
      congrArg
        (fun τ => τ ≫ cAssoc.hom) hwhisk
    _ = _ := by
      have hunit :
          DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0 A.unit A.unit_isClosed =
            (DGFunctor.h0IdIso (C := C)).hom ≫ A.h0Unit ≫
              (DGFunctor.h0CompIso L R).inv := by
        unfold h0Unit
        simp
      rw [hunit, Functor.whiskerRight_comp, Functor.whiskerRight_comp]
      have hleftUnit :
          (DGFunctor.h0CompIso (DGFunctor.id C) P).hom ≫
              Functor.whiskerRight (DGFunctor.h0IdIso (C := C)).hom P.h0 =
            (Functor.leftUnitor P.h0).inv := by
        have h := congrArg Iso.hom (DGFunctor.h0CompIso_id_comp P)
        rw [← cancel_mono (Functor.leftUnitor P.h0).hom]
        simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.isoWhiskerRight_hom,
          Iso.refl_hom] at h
        convert h using 1
        all_goals simp
      have hassocInv :
          (Functor.associator L.h0 R.h0 P.h0).inv ≫
              Functor.whiskerRight (DGFunctor.h0CompIso L R).inv P.h0 ≫
                (DGFunctor.h0CompIso (L.comp R) P).inv =
            Functor.whiskerLeft L.h0 (DGFunctor.h0CompIso R P).inv ≫
              cAssoc.inv := by
        have h := congrArg Iso.inv (DGFunctor.h0CompIso_assoc L R P)
        simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Functor.isoWhiskerRight_inv,
          Functor.isoWhiskerLeft_inv, Category.assoc] at h
        convert h using 1
        all_goals rfl
      have hassoc' :
          Functor.whiskerRight (DGFunctor.h0CompIso L R).inv P.h0 ≫
              (DGFunctor.h0CompIso (L.comp R) P).inv ≫
                cAssoc.hom =
            (Functor.associator L.h0 R.h0 P.h0).hom ≫
              Functor.whiskerLeft L.h0 (DGFunctor.h0CompIso R P).inv := by
        ext X
        simp only [NatTrans.comp_app]
        have hX := congrArg (fun τ => τ.app X) hassocInv
        simp only [NatTrans.comp_app] at hX
        calc
          _ = (Functor.associator L.h0 R.h0 P.h0).hom.app X ≫
                ((Functor.associator L.h0 R.h0 P.h0).inv.app X ≫
                  (Functor.whiskerRight
                    (DGFunctor.h0CompIso L R).inv P.h0).app X ≫
                  (DGFunctor.h0CompIso (L.comp R) P).inv.app X) ≫
                cAssoc.hom.app X := by
            symm
            rw [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc]
            exact Category.assoc _ _ _
          _ = (Functor.associator L.h0 R.h0 P.h0).hom.app X ≫
                ((Functor.whiskerLeft L.h0
                    (DGFunctor.h0CompIso R P).inv).app X ≫
                  cAssoc.inv.app X) ≫
                cAssoc.hom.app X :=
            congrArg
              (fun f => (Functor.associator L.h0 R.h0 P.h0).hom.app X ≫
                f ≫ cAssoc.hom.app X) hX
          _ = _ := by
            simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app,
              Category.comp_id]
      have h₁ := congrArg
        (fun τ => τ ≫ Functor.whiskerRight A.h0Unit P.h0 ≫
          Functor.whiskerRight (DGFunctor.h0CompIso L R).inv P.h0 ≫
            (DGFunctor.h0CompIso (L.comp R) P).inv ≫
              cAssoc.hom) hleftUnit
      have h₂ := congrArg
        (fun τ => (Functor.leftUnitor P.h0).inv ≫
          Functor.whiskerRight A.h0Unit P.h0 ≫ τ) hassoc'
      calc
        _ = (Functor.leftUnitor P.h0).inv ≫
              Functor.whiskerRight A.h0Unit P.h0 ≫
                Functor.whiskerRight (DGFunctor.h0CompIso L R).inv P.h0 ≫
                  (DGFunctor.h0CompIso (L.comp R) P).inv ≫
                    cAssoc.hom := by
          simpa only [DGFunctor.id_comp, Category.assoc] using h₁
        _ = _ := h₂

name: CategoryTheory.DGLinear.homComplex_d_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homComplex_d_apply (X Y : C) (p q : ℤ) (f : (dgHom X Y).X p) :
    ((homComplex k X Y).d p q).hom f = ((dgHom X Y).d p q).hom f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGLinear.postcompCochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma postcompCochain_apply (X : C) {Y Z : C} (p : ℤ)
    (f : (dgHom Y Z).X p) (i j : ℤ) (h : i + p = j)
    (g : (dgHom X Y).X i) :
    ((postcompCochain k X p f).v i j h).hom g = dgComp i p j h g f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGLinear.postcompCochain_d
statement:
lemma postcompCochain_d (X : C) {Y Z : C} (p q : ℤ)
    (f : (dgHom Y Z).X p) :
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ p q (postcompCochain k X p f) =
      postcompCochain k X q (((dgHom Y Z).d p q).hom f)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpq : p + 1 = q
  · subst q
    apply CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ext
    intro i j hij
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro g
    rw [CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ_v p (p + 1) rfl
      (postcompCochain k X p f) i j hij (i + p) (i + 1) (by omega) rfl]
    change ((dgHom X Z).d (i + p) j).hom
          (dgComp i p (i + p) rfl g f) +
        (p + 1).negOnePow •
          dgComp (i + 1) p j (by omega)
            (((dgHom X Y).d i (i + 1)).hom g) f =
      dgComp i (p + 1) j hij g (((dgHom Y Z).d p (p + 1)).hom f)
    have hleib := dgComp_leibniz (C := C) i p (i + p) j (by omega) (by omega) g f
    rw [hleib, Int.negOnePow_succ, Units.neg_smul]
    abel
  · have hshape : ¬(ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel p q := by
      simpa [ComplexShape.up, ComplexShape.up'] using hpq
    have hd : ((dgHom Y Z).d p q).hom f = 0 :=
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom ((dgHom Y Z).shape p q hshape) f
    rw [CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ_shape p q hpq, hd, map_zero]

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.map_smul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma map_smul [F.Linear k] {X Y : C} (p : ℤ) (c : k) (f : (dgHom X Y).X p) :
    F.map p (c • f) = c • F.map p f
proof:
:=
  Linear.map_smul _ _ _

name: CategoryTheory.prodComp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma prodComp_apply (c₁ : A₁ →+ B₁ →+ M₁) (c₂ : A₂ →+ B₂ →+ M₂)
    (a : A₁ × A₂) (b : B₁ × B₂) :
    prodComp c₁ c₂ a b = (c₁ a.1 b.1, c₂ a.2 b.2)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.prod_d_apply

@[simp]
lemma prod_d_apply {X Y : C × D} (p q : ℤ)
    (f : ((dgHom X.1 Y.1).X p) × ((dgHom X.2 Y.2).X p)) :
    ((dgHom (C := C × D) X Y).d p q).hom f =
      ((((dgHom X.1 Y.1).d p q).hom f.1), (((dgHom X.2 Y.2).d p q).hom f.2))
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.dgProd_fst_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dgProd_fst_add {X Y : C × D} {p : ℤ} (a b : (dgHom (C := C × D) X Y).X p) :

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.dgProd_fst_units_smul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dgProd_fst_units_smul {X Y : C × D} {p : ℤ} (c : ℤˣ)

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.dgProd_snd_units_smul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dgProd_snd_units_smul {X Y : C × D} {p : ℤ} (c : ℤˣ)

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.prod_dgId
statement:
@[simp]
lemma prod_dgId (X : C × D) :
    dgId (C := C × D) X = (dgId X.1, dgId X.2)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.prod_dgComp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma prod_dgComp_apply {X Y Z : C × D} (p q r : ℤ) (h : p + q = r)
    (f : ((dgHom X.1 Y.1).X p) × ((dgHom X.2 Y.2).X p))
    (g : ((dgHom Y.1 Z.1).X q) × ((dgHom Y.2 Z.2).X q)) :
    dgComp (C := C × D) p q r h f g =
      (dgComp p q r h f.1 g.1, dgComp p q r h f.2 g.2)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGLinear.homFunctor_obj

name: CategoryTheory.DGFullSubcategory.prop
statement: lemma prop (X : DGFullSubcategory P) : P X.obj

name: CategoryTheory.DGFullSubcategory.obj_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma obj_mk (X : C) (hX : P X) : (mk X hX).obj = X
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFullSubcategory.ext
statement:
@[ext]
lemma ext {X Y : DGFullSubcategory P} (h : X.obj = Y.obj) : X = Y
proof: := Subtype.ext h

name: CategoryTheory.DGFullSubcategory.dgHom_eq
statement:
lemma dgHom_eq (X Y : DGFullSubcategory P) :
    dgHom X Y = dgHom X.obj Y.obj
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFullSubcategory.dgId_eq
statement:
lemma dgId_eq (X : DGFullSubcategory P) :
    dgId X = dgId X.obj
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFullSubcategory.dgComp_eq
statement:
lemma dgComp_eq {X Y Z : DGFullSubcategory P} (p q r : ℤ) (h : p + q = r)
    (f : (dgHom X Y).X p) (g : (dgHom Y Z).X q) :
    dgComp p q r h f g =
      dgComp (X := X.obj) (Y := Y.obj) (Z := Z.obj) p q r h f g
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFullSubcategory.dgId_comp_eq
statement:
lemma dgId_comp_eq {X Y : DGFullSubcategory P} (p : ℤ) (f : (dgHom X Y).X p) :
    dgComp 0 p p (zero_add p) (dgId X) f = f
proof:
:=
  DGCategory.dgId_comp p f

name: CategoryTheory.DGFullSubcategory.dgComp_id_eq
statement:
lemma dgComp_id_eq {X Y : DGFullSubcategory P} (p : ℤ) (f : (dgHom X Y).X p) :
    dgComp p 0 p (add_zero p) f (dgId Y) = f
proof:
:=
  DGCategory.dgComp_id p f

name: CategoryTheory.DGFullSubcategory.iota_obj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma iota_obj (X : DGFullSubcategory P) : (iota P).obj X = X.obj

name: CategoryTheory.DGFullSubcategory.iota_map_apply
statement:
lemma iota_map_apply {X Y : DGFullSubcategory P} (p : ℤ) (f : (dgHom X Y).X p) :

proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFullSubcategory.iota_map_smul
statement:
lemma iota_map_smul {X Y : DGFullSubcategory P} (p : ℤ) (c : k)
    (f : (dgHom X Y).X p) :
    (iota P).map p (c • f) = c • (iota P).map p f
proof:
:=
  DGFunctor.map_smul (F := iota P) p c f

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.linearCopowerCochain_d
statement:
lemma linearCopowerCochain_d
    (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK) (W : C) (p q : ℤ)
    (f : (dgHom ZK W).X p) :
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ p q
        (linearCopowerCochain k tK.univ p f) =
      linearCopowerCochain k tK.univ q
        (((dgHom ZK W).d p q).hom f)
proof:
:= by
  change CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ p q
      ((CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom tK.univ).comp
        (DGLinear.postcompCochain k X p f) (zero_add p)) = _
  rw [CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ_ofHom_comp,
    DGLinear.postcompCochain_d]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.homComplexIso_hom_f_apply
statement:
lemma homComplexIso_hom_f_apply
    (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK) (W : C) (p : ℤ)
    (f : (dgHom ZK W).X p) :
    ((tK.homComplexIso W).hom.f p).hom f =
      linearCopowerCochain k tK.univ p f
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.homComplexIso_inv_f_apply
statement:
lemma homComplexIso_inv_f_apply
    (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK) (W : C) (p : ℤ)
    (γ : CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain K
      (DGLinear.homComplex k X W) p) :
    ((tK.homComplexIso W).inv.f p).hom γ = tK.lift p γ
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.lift_d
statement:
lemma lift_d (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK) {W : C} (p q : ℤ)
    (γ : CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain
      K (DGLinear.homComplex k X W) p) :
    tK.lift q (CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ p q γ) =
      ((dgHom ZK W).d p q).hom (tK.lift p γ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (tK.cochainLinearEquiv W q).injective
  change (tK.cochainLinearEquiv W q)
      ((tK.cochainLinearEquiv W q).symm
        (CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ p q γ)) =
    (tK.cochainLinearEquiv W q)
      (((dgHom ZK W).d p q).hom
        ((tK.cochainLinearEquiv W p).symm γ))
  rw [(tK.cochainLinearEquiv W q).apply_symm_apply]
  change CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ p q γ =
    linearCopowerCochain k tK.univ q
      (((dgHom ZK W).d p q).hom
        ((tK.cochainLinearEquiv W p).symm γ))
  rw [← tK.linearCopowerCochain_d W p q]
  have h := (tK.cochainLinearEquiv W p).apply_symm_apply γ
  change linearCopowerCochain k tK.univ p
    ((tK.cochainLinearEquiv W p).symm γ) = γ at h
  rw [h]

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.univ_comp_coefficientMap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma univ_comp_coefficientMap
    (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK)
    (tL : IsLinearCopowerOf k L X ZL) (p : ℤ)
    (γ : CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain K L p)
    (i j : ℤ) (hij : i + p = j) (x : K.X i) :
    dgComp i p j hij (tK.univ.f i x) (tK.coefficientMap tL p γ) =
      tL.univ.f j ((γ.v i j hij).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  change dgComp i p j hij (tK.univ.f i x)
      (tK.lift p (γ.comp
        (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom tL.univ) (add_zero p))) = _
  rw [tK.univ_comp_lift,
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.comp_zero_cochain_v,
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom_v]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.coefficientMap_d
statement:
lemma coefficientMap_d
    (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK)
    (tL : IsLinearCopowerOf k L X ZL) (p q : ℤ)
    (γ : CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain K L p) :
    tK.coefficientMap tL q (CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ p q γ) =
      ((dgHom ZK ZL).d p q).hom (tK.coefficientMap tL p γ)
proof:
:= by
  change tK.lift q
      ((CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ p q γ).comp
        (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom tL.univ) (add_zero q)) =
    ((dgHom ZK ZL).d p q).hom
      (tK.lift p (γ.comp
        (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom tL.univ) (add_zero p)))
  rw [← tK.lift_d p q (γ.comp
    (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom tL.univ) (add_zero p))]
  apply congrArg (tK.lift q)
  by_cases hpq : p + 1 = q
  · rw [CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ_comp_zero_cochain γ
      (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom tL.univ) q hpq,
      CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ_ofHom, CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.comp_zero,
      zero_add]
  · rw [CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ_shape p q hpq,
      CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ_shape p q hpq,
      CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.zero_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.coefficientMap_comp
statement:
lemma coefficientMap_comp
    (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK)
    (tL : IsLinearCopowerOf k L X ZL)
    (tM : IsLinearCopowerOf k M X ZM)
    (p q r : ℤ) (h : p + q = r)
    (γ : CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain K L p)
    (η : CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain L M q) :
    dgComp p q r h (tK.coefficientMap tL p γ) (tL.coefficientMap tM q η) =
      tK.coefficientMap tM r (γ.comp η h)
proof:
:= by
  refine tK.lift_unique (fun i j hij x => ?_)
  rw [← dgComp_assoc i p q (i + p) r j rfl h (by omega),
    tK.univ_comp_coefficientMap tL, tL.univ_comp_coefficientMap tM,
    tK.univ_comp_coefficientMap tM,
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.comp_v γ η h i (i + p) j rfl (by omega)]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.coefficientMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coefficientMap_id (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK) :
    tK.coefficientMap tK 0
      (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom (𝟙 K)) = dgId ZK
proof:
:= by
  refine tK.lift_unique (fun i j hij x => ?_)
  have hji : j = i := by omega
  cases hji
  rw [tK.univ_comp_coefficientMap tK,
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom_v, dgComp_id]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.coefficientMap_id_eq_compare
statement:
lemma coefficientMap_id_eq_compare
    (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK)
    (tK' : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZL) :
    tK.coefficientMap tK' 0
      (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom (𝟙 K)) = tK.compare tK'
proof:
:= by
  refine tK.lift_unique (fun i j hij x => ?_)
  have hji : j = i := by omega
  cases hji
  rw [tK.univ_comp_coefficientMap tK', tK.univ_comp_compare tK',
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom_v]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.univ_comp_coefficientMapOfHom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma univ_comp_coefficientMapOfHom
    (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK)
    (tL : IsLinearCopowerOf k L X ZL) (f : K ⟶ L)
    (i : ℤ) (x : K.X i) :
    dgComp i 0 i (by omega) (tK.univ.f i x) (tK.coefficientMapOfHom tL f) =
      tL.univ.f i (f.f i x)
proof:
:= by
  change dgComp i 0 i (by omega) (tK.univ.f i x)
      (tK.coefficientMap tL 0
        (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom f)) = _
  rw [tK.univ_comp_coefficientMap tL,
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom_v]

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.coefficientMapOfHom_mem_cocycles
statement:
lemma coefficientMapOfHom_mem_cocycles
    (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK)
    (tL : IsLinearCopowerOf k L X ZL) (f : K ⟶ L) :
    tK.coefficientMapOfHom tL f ∈ cocycles ZK ZL
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_cocycles_iff]
  change ((dgHom ZK ZL).d 0 1).hom
      (tK.coefficientMap tL 0
        (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom f)) = 0
  rw [← tK.coefficientMap_d tL 0 1
    (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom f),
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ_ofHom, map_zero]

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.coefficientMapOfHom_id_eq_compare
statement:
lemma coefficientMapOfHom_id_eq_compare
    (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK)
    (tK' : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZL) :
    tK.coefficientMapOfHom tK' (𝟙 K) = tK.compare tK'
proof:
:= by
  change tK.coefficientMap tK' 0
    (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom (𝟙 K)) = tK.compare tK'
  exact tK.coefficientMap_id_eq_compare tK'

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.coefficientMapOfHom_comp
statement:
lemma coefficientMapOfHom_comp
    (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK)
    (tL : IsLinearCopowerOf k L X ZL)
    (tM : IsLinearCopowerOf k M X ZM) (f : K ⟶ L) (g : L ⟶ M) :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) (tK.coefficientMapOfHom tL f)
        (tL.coefficientMapOfHom tM g) =
      tK.coefficientMapOfHom tM (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  change dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega)
      (tK.coefficientMap tL 0 (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom f))
      (tL.coefficientMap tM 0 (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom g)) =
    tK.coefficientMap tM 0
      (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom (f ≫ g))
  rw [tK.coefficientMap_comp tL tM 0 0 0 (by omega),
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.coefficientMapOfHom_sub_mem_coboundaries
statement:
lemma coefficientMapOfHom_sub_mem_coboundaries
    (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK)
    (tL : IsLinearCopowerOf k L X ZL) {f g : K ⟶ L}
    (h : Homotopy f g) :
    tK.coefficientMapOfHom tL f - tK.coefficientMapOfHom tL g ∈
      coboundaries ZK ZL
proof:
:= by
  change tK.coefficientMap tL 0
      (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom f) -
    tK.coefficientMap tL 0
      (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom g) ∈ coboundaries ZK ZL
  refine ⟨tK.coefficientMap tL (-1)
    (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHomotopy h), ?_⟩
  rw [← tK.coefficientMap_d tL (-1) 0
      (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHomotopy h),
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ_ofHomotopy, map_sub]

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.coefficientHom_eq_of_homotopy
statement:
lemma coefficientHom_eq_of_homotopy
    (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK)
    (tL : IsLinearCopowerOf k L X ZL) {f g : K ⟶ L}
    (h : Homotopy f g) :
    tK.coefficientHom tL f = tK.coefficientHom tL g
proof:
:=
  H0.homMk_eq_homMk (tK.coefficientMapOfHom_sub_mem_coboundaries tL h)

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.coefficientHom_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coefficientHom_id (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK) :
    tK.coefficientHom tK (𝟙 K) = 𝟙 (show H0 C from ZK)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    tK.coefficientHom tK (𝟙 K) =
        H0.homMk (⟨dgId ZK, dgId_cocycle ZK⟩ : cocycles ZK ZK) := by
      apply congrArg H0.homMk
      apply Subtype.ext
      change tK.coefficientMap tK 0
        (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom (𝟙 K)) = dgId ZK
      exact tK.coefficientMap_id
    _ = 𝟙 (show H0 C from ZK) := H0.homMk_id ZK

name: CategoryTheory.IsLinearCopowerOf.coefficientHom_comp
statement:
lemma coefficientHom_comp
    (tK : IsLinearCopowerOf k K X ZK)
    (tL : IsLinearCopowerOf k L X ZL)
    (tM : IsLinearCopowerOf k M X ZM) (f : K ⟶ L) (g : L ⟶ M) :
    tK.coefficientHom tL f ≫ tL.coefficientHom tM g =
      tK.coefficientHom tM (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficientHom, coefficientHom, H0.homMk_comp]
  apply congrArg H0.homMk
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact tK.coefficientMapOfHom_comp tL tM f g

name: CategoryTheory.linearCopowerFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma linearCopowerFunctor_obj (X : C) (K : Cdg (ModuleCat.{v} k)) :
    (linearCopowerFunctor k X).obj K =
      linearCopowerObj (Cdg.of _ K) X
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.linearCopowerFunctor_map
statement:
lemma linearCopowerFunctor_map (X : C)
    {K L : Cdg (ModuleCat.{v} k)} (p : ℤ) (f : (dgHom K L).X p) :
    (linearCopowerFunctor k X).map p f =
      (linearCopowerIsLinearCopower (Cdg.of _ K) X).coefficientMap
    (linearCopowerIsLinearCopower (Cdg.of _ L) X) p f
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.H0.boundaries_map_cyclesLinearEquiv
statement:
private lemma boundaries_map_cyclesLinearEquiv (X Y : C) :
    (LinearMap.range
        ((DGLinear.homComplex k X Y).sc' (-1) 0 1).moduleCatToCycles).map
        (cyclesLinearEquiv (k := k) X Y : _ →ₗ[k] _) =
      coboundariesSubmodule (k := k) X Y
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨g, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨g, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    refine ⟨⟨((DGLinear.homComplex k X Y).d (-1) 0).hom g, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        ((DGLinear.homComplex k X Y).d_comp_d (-1) 0 1) g
    · exact ⟨g, rfl⟩
    · exact Subtype.ext hg

name: CategoryTheory.H0.bijective_quotientToH0LinearMap
statement:
private lemma bijective_quotientToH0LinearMap (X Y : C) :
    Function.Bijective (quotientToH0LinearMap (k := k) X Y)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    induction a using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
    | _ a =>
      induction b using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
      | _ b =>
        apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).2
        exact QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mp hab
  · intro z
    induction z using Quotient.ind with
    | _ z => exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk z, rfl⟩

name: CategoryTheory.H0.homologyZeroLinearEquiv_homologyπ_cyclesMk
statement:
lemma homologyZeroLinearEquiv_homologyπ_cyclesMk (X Y : C)
    (f : (dgHom X Y).X 0)
    (hf : ((dgHom X Y).d 0 1).hom f = 0) :
    homologyZeroLinearEquiv (k := k) X Y
        (((DGLinear.homComplex k X Y).homologyπ 0).hom
          ((DGLinear.homComplex k X Y).cyclesMk f 1 (by simp) hf)) =
      H0.homMk ⟨f, hf⟩
proof:
:= by
  let K := DGLinear.homComplex k X Y
  let S := K.sc' (-1) 0 1
  let z := K.cyclesMk f 1 (by simp) hf
  have hhomology :
      ((K.homologyIsoSc' (-1) 0 1 (by simp) (by simp)).hom).hom
          ((K.homologyπ 0).hom z) =
        (S.homologyπ).hom
          (((K.cyclesIsoSc' (-1) 0 1 (by simp) (by simp)).hom).hom z) := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (K.π_homologyIsoSc'_hom (-1) 0 1 (by simp) (by simp)) z
  have hmodule (z' : S.cycles) :
      S.moduleCatHomologyIso.hom.hom (S.homologyπ.hom z') =
        S.moduleCatLeftHomologyData.π.hom
          (S.moduleCatCyclesIso.hom.hom z') := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom S.π_moduleCatCyclesIso_hom z'
  have hcycles :
      S.moduleCatCyclesIso.hom.hom
          ((K.cyclesIsoSc' (-1) 0 1 (by simp) (by simp)).hom.hom z) =
        ⟨f, hf⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change S.moduleCatLeftHomologyData.i.hom
        (S.moduleCatCyclesIso.hom.hom
          ((K.cyclesIsoSc' (-1) 0 1 (by simp) (by simp)).hom.hom z)) = f
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, S.moduleCatCyclesIso_hom_i,
      ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
      K.cyclesIsoSc'_hom_iCycles (-1) 0 1 (by simp) (by simp)]
    exact K.i_cyclesMk f 1 (by simp) hf
  simp only [homologyZeroLinearEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    Iso.toLinearEquiv_apply]
  rw [hhomology]
  simp only [scHomologyLinearEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    Iso.toLinearEquiv_apply]
  rw [hmodule, hcycles]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.range_abToCycles
statement:
lemma range_abToCycles (X Y : C) :
    AddMonoidHom.range (homSc X Y).abToCycles = H0.coboundariesIn X Y
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨z, hz⟩
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    exact ⟨w, congrArg Subtype.val hw⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    exact ⟨w, Subtype.ext hw⟩

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.h0_map_eq_mapH0Hom
statement:
lemma h0_map_eq_mapH0Hom (F : DGFunctor C D) (X Y : H0 C) :
    (F.h0.map (X := X) (Y := Y)) = F.mapH0Hom (H0.of C X) (H0.of C Y)
proof:
:= by
  funext f
  induction f using Quotient.ind with
  | _ f => rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.mapH0Hom_comp_homologyQuotientEquiv
statement:
lemma mapH0Hom_comp_homologyQuotientEquiv (F : DGFunctor C D) (X Y : C)
    (z : (homSc X Y).abLeftHomologyData.H) :
    homologyQuotientEquiv (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) ((F.mapHomScData X Y).φH.hom z) =
      F.mapH0Hom X Y (homologyQuotientEquiv X Y z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | _ z => rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.bijective_mapH0Hom
statement:
theorem bijective_mapH0Hom (F : DGFunctor C D) (hF : F.IsQuasiEquivalence)
    (X Y : C) : Function.Bijective (F.mapH0Hom X Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : QuasiIsoAt (F.mapComplex X Y) 0 := (hF.quasiIso X Y).quasiIsoAt 0
  rw [quasiIsoAt_iff' _ (-1) 0 1 (by simp) (by simp)] at hq
  have hiso : IsIso (F.mapHomScData X Y).φH :=
    (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyMapData.quasiIso_iff (F.mapHomScData X Y)).1 hq
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (F.mapHomScData X Y).φH.hom :=
    ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (F.mapHomScData X Y).φH
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (homologyQuotientEquiv X Y).surjective a
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := (homologyQuotientEquiv X Y).surjective b
    rw [← mapH0Hom_comp_homologyQuotientEquiv, ←
      mapH0Hom_comp_homologyQuotientEquiv] at hab
    exact congrArg _ (hbij.injective
      ((homologyQuotientEquiv (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)).injective hab))
  · intro c
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := (homologyQuotientEquiv (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)).surjective c
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hbij.surjective c
    exact ⟨homologyQuotientEquiv X Y z, by
      rw [← mapH0Hom_comp_homologyQuotientEquiv, hz]⟩

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.faithful_h0
proof:
:= by
    rw [h0_map_eq_mapH0Hom]
    exact (F.bijective_mapH0Hom hF _ _).injective

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.full_h0
statement:
theorem full_h0 (F : DGFunctor C D) (hF : F.IsQuasiEquivalence) : F.h0.Full where
  map_surjective {X Y} g
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (F.bijective_mapH0Hom hF (H0.of C X) (H0.of C Y)).surjective g
    exact ⟨f, by rw [h0_map_eq_mapH0Hom]; exact hf⟩

name: CategoryTheory.copowerCochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma copowerCochain_apply {K : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{v} ℤ} {X Z : C}
    (univ : ∀ i : ℤ, K.X i →+ (dgHom X Z).X i) {W : C} (p : ℤ)
    (g : (dgHom Z W).X p) (i j : ℤ) (h : i + p = j) (x : K.X i) :
    copowerCochain univ p g i j h x = dgComp i p j h (univ i x) g
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsCopowerOf.lift_unique
proof:
:= by
  refine (t.bijective W p).injective ?_
  funext i j hij

name: CategoryTheory.IsCopowerOf.univ_comp_lift
statement:
@[simp]
lemma univ_comp_lift (t : IsCopowerOf K X Z) {W : C} (p : ℤ)
    (c : ∀ i j : ℤ, i + p = j → (K.X i →+ (dgHom X W).X j))
    (i j : ℤ) (hij : i + p = j) (x : K.X i) :
    dgComp i p j hij (t.univ i x) (t.lift p c) = c i j hij x
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((t.bijective W p).surjective c).choose_spec
  exact congrArg (fun z => z i j hij x) h

name: CategoryTheory.IsCopowerOf.univ_comp_compare
statement:
@[simp]
lemma univ_comp_compare (t : IsCopowerOf K X Z) (t' : IsCopowerOf K X Z')
    (i : ℤ) (x : K.X i) :
    dgComp i 0 i (by omega) (t.univ i x) (t.compare t') = t'.univ i x
proof:
:=
  t.univ_comp_lift 0 _ i i (by omega) x

name: CategoryTheory.IsCopowerOf.compare_mem_cocycles
statement:
lemma compare_mem_cocycles (t : IsCopowerOf K X Z) (t' : IsCopowerOf K X Z') :
    t.compare t' ∈ cocycles Z Z'
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_cocycles_iff]
  refine t.lift_unique (fun i j hij x => ?_)
  have hji : j = i + 1 := by omega
  cases hji
  have hleib := dgComp_leibniz (C := C) i 0 i (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    (t.univ i x) (t.compare t')
  rw [t.univ_comp_compare t', ← t'.univ_d i (i + 1),
    ← t.univ_d i (i + 1), t.univ_comp_compare t'] at hleib
  simp only [Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul, _root_.map_zero] at hleib ⊢
  exact add_right_cancel (hleib.symm.trans (zero_add _).symm)

name: CategoryTheory.IsCopowerOf.compare_comp_compare
statement:
lemma compare_comp_compare (t : IsCopowerOf K X Z) (t' : IsCopowerOf K X Z') :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) (t.compare t') (t'.compare t) = dgId Z
proof:
:= by
  refine t.lift_unique (fun i j hij x => ?_)
  have hji : j = i := by omega
  cases hji
  rw [← dgComp_assoc i 0 0 i 0 i (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    t.univ_comp_compare t', t'.univ_comp_compare t, dgComp_id]

name: CategoryTheory.IsCopowerOf.compare_trans
statement:
lemma compare_trans {Z'' : C} (t : IsCopowerOf K X Z) (t' : IsCopowerOf K X Z')
    (t'' : IsCopowerOf K X Z'') :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) (t.compare t') (t'.compare t'') = t.compare t''
proof:
:= by
  refine t.lift_unique (fun i j hij x => ?_)
  have hji : j = i := by omega
  cases hji
  rw [← dgComp_assoc i 0 0 i 0 i (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    t.univ_comp_compare t', t'.univ_comp_compare t'', t.univ_comp_compare t'']

name: CategoryTheory.IsCopowerOf.compare_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compare_self (t : IsCopowerOf K X Z) : t.compare t = dgId Z
proof:
:= by
  refine t.lift_unique (fun i j hij x => ?_)
  have hji : j = i := by omega
  cases hji
  rw [t.univ_comp_compare t, dgComp_id]

name: CategoryTheory.EvaluationData.univ_comp_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma univ_comp_map (V : EvaluationData E) {X Y : C} (p : ℤ)
    (f : (dgHom X Y).X p) (i j : ℤ) (hij : i + p = j) (k : (dgHom E X).X i) :
    dgComp i p j hij ((V.isCopower X).univ i k) (V.map p f) =
      (V.isCopower Y).univ j (dgComp i p j hij k f)
proof:
:=
  (V.isCopower X).univ_comp_lift p _ i j hij k

name: CategoryTheory.EvaluationData.map_zero

lemma map_zero {X Y : C} (p : ℤ) : V.map (X := X) (Y := Y) p 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (V.isCopower X).lift_unique (fun i j hij k => ?_)
  rw [univ_comp_map, _root_.map_zero, _root_.map_zero, _root_.map_zero]

name: CategoryTheory.EvaluationData.map_add

lemma map_add {X Y : C} (p : ℤ) (f f' : (dgHom X Y).X p) :

proof:
:= by
  refine (V.isCopower X).lift_unique (fun i j hij k => ?_)

lemma univ_comp_evalHom (X : C) (i : ℤ) (k : (dgHom E X).X i) :

proof:

name: CategoryTheory.EvaluationData.evaluation_isClosed
statement:
lemma evaluation_isClosed :
    DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.IsClosed V.evaluation
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  show ((dgHom (V.obj X) X).d 0 1).hom (V.evalHom X) = 0
  refine (V.isCopower X).lift_unique (fun i j hij k => ?_)
  have hji : j = i + 1 := by omega
  cases hji
  have hleib := dgComp_leibniz (C := C) i 0 i (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ((V.isCopower X).univ i k) (V.evalHom X)
  rw [V.univ_comp_evalHom, ← (V.isCopower X).univ_d i (i + 1),
    V.univ_comp_evalHom] at hleib
  simp only [Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul, _root_.map_zero] at hleib ⊢
  exact add_right_cancel (hleib.symm.trans (zero_add _).symm)

:= by

  intro Y
  rw [DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.composition_apply_app,
    compare_app, compare_app, compare_app]

name: CategoryTheory.EvaluationData.compare_comp_evaluation
statement:
lemma compare_comp_evaluation (V W : EvaluationData E) :
    DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.composition _ _ _ 0 0 0 (by omega)
        (compare V W) W.evaluation = V.evaluation
proof:
:= by
  apply DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.ext
  intro Y
  rw [DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.composition_apply_app, compare_app]
  change dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega)
      ((V.isCopower Y).compare (W.isCopower Y)) (W.evalHom Y) = V.evalHom Y
  refine (V.isCopower Y).lift_unique (fun i j hij k => ?_)
  have hji : j = i := by omega
  cases hji
  rw [← dgComp_assoc i 0 0 i 0 i (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    (V.isCopower Y).univ_comp_compare (W.isCopower Y), W.univ_comp_evalHom,
    V.univ_comp_evalHom]

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.univ_comp_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma univ_comp_map {X Y : C} (p : ℤ) (f : (dgHom X Y).X p)
    (i j : ℤ) (hij : i + p = j) (g : (dgHom E X).X i) :
    dgComp i p j hij ((V.isLinearCopower X).univ.f i g) (V.map p f) =
      (V.isLinearCopower Y).univ.f j (dgComp i p j hij g f)
proof:
:= by
  change dgComp i p j hij ((V.isLinearCopower X).univ.f i g)
      ((V.isLinearCopower X).lift p (V.mapCochain p f)) = _
  rw [(V.isLinearCopower X).univ_comp_lift]
  change (((((DGLinear.postcompCochain k E p f).comp
      (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom
        (V.isLinearCopower Y).univ) (add_zero p)).v i j hij).hom g)) = _
  rw [CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.comp_zero_cochain_v,
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom_v]
  rfl

    (W.isLinearCopower Y) (U.isLinearCopower Y)

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.compare_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compare_self (V : LinearEvaluationData k E) :
    compare V V = DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id V.functor
proof:
:= by
  apply DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.ext
  intro Y
  rw [compare_app, DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id_app]
  exact IsLinearCopowerOf.compare_self _

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.compareIso_hom_val
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compareIso_hom_val (V W : LinearEvaluationData k E) :
    (compareIso V W).hom.val = compare V W
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.compareIso_inv_val
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compareIso_inv_val (V W : LinearEvaluationData k E) :
    (compareIso V W).inv.val = compare W V
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.compareIso_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compareIso_self (V : LinearEvaluationData k E) :
    compareIso V V = Iso.refl _
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact compare_self V

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.compareIso_trans
statement:
lemma compareIso_trans (V W U : LinearEvaluationData k E) :
    (compareIso V W).trans (compareIso W U) = compareIso V U
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact compare_comp V W U

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.compare_comp_evaluation
statement:
lemma compare_comp_evaluation (V W : LinearEvaluationData k E) :
    DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.composition _ _ _ 0 0 0 (by omega)
        (compare V W) W.evaluation = V.evaluation
proof:
:= by
  apply DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.ext
  intro Y
  rw [DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.composition_apply_app, compare_app]
  change dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega)
      ((V.isLinearCopower Y).compare (W.isLinearCopower Y))
        (W.evalHom Y) = V.evalHom Y
  refine (V.isLinearCopower Y).lift_unique (fun i j hij g => ?_)
  have hji : j = i := by omega
  cases hji
  rw [← dgComp_assoc i 0 0 i 0 i (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    (V.isLinearCopower Y).univ_comp_compare (W.isLinearCopower Y),
    W.univ_comp_evalHom, V.univ_comp_evalHom]

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftD_apply
statement:
lemma shiftD_apply (m : ℤ) {X Y : C} (a b : ℤ) (f : (dgHom X Y).X a) :
    shiftD m a b f = m.negOnePow • ((dgHom X Y).d a b).hom f
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftComp_apply
statement:
lemma shiftComp_apply (m n : ℤ) {X Y Z : C} (a b c : ℤ) (h : a + b = c)
    (f : (dgHom X Y).X a) (g : (dgHom Y Z).X b) :
    shiftComp m n a b c h f g = ((b - n) * m).negOnePow • dgComp a b c h f g
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftComp_zero_zero
statement:
lemma shiftComp_zero_zero {X Y Z : C} (a b c : ℤ) (h : a + b = c) :
    shiftComp (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) 0 0 a b c h = dgComp a b c h
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftComp]

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftD_zero
statement:
lemma shiftD_zero {X Y : C} (a b : ℤ) :
    shiftD (C := C) (X := X) (Y := Y) 0 a b = ((dgHom X Y).d a b).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftD]

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftFunctor_dgHom_X
statement:
lemma shiftFunctor_dgHom_X (m : ℤ) {X Y : C} (p : ℤ) :
    (((dgHom X Y))⟦m⟧).X p = (dgHom X Y).X (p + m)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftFunctor_dgHom_d
statement:
lemma shiftFunctor_dgHom_d (m : ℤ) {X Y : C} (p p' : ℤ) :
    ((((dgHom X Y))⟦m⟧).d p p').hom = shiftD m (p + m) (p' + m)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.hom_units_smul'
statement:
private lemma hom_units_smul' {M N : AddCommGrpCat.{v}} (φ : M ⟶ N) (u : ℤˣ) (x : M) :
    φ.hom (u • x) = u • φ.hom x
proof:
:= by
  simp [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.dgComp_units_smul_left'
proof:
:= by
  simp [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.dgComp_units_smul_right'
proof:
:= by
  simp [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftComp_leibniz
statement:
lemma shiftComp_leibniz (m n : ℤ) {X Y Z : C} (a b c c' : ℤ) (h : a + b = c) (hc : c + 1 = c')
    (f : (dgHom X Y).X a) (g : (dgHom Y Z).X b) :
    shiftD (m + n) c c' (shiftComp m n a b c h f g) =
      shiftComp m n a (b + 1) c' (by omega) f (shiftD n b (b + 1) g) +
        (b - n).negOnePow • shiftComp m n (a + 1) b c' (by omega) (shiftD m a (a + 1) f) g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shiftD_apply, shiftComp_apply, hom_units_smul',
    dgComp_units_smul_left', dgComp_units_smul_right', smul_smul, ← Int.negOnePow_add]
  rw [dgComp_leibniz a b c c' h hc f g, smul_add, smul_smul, ← Int.negOnePow_add]
  congr 1
  · rw [show ((b + 1 - n) * m + n) = (m + n + (b - n) * m) by ring]
  · rw [show (m + n + (b - n) * m + b) = (b - n + ((b - n) * m + m)) + 2 * n by ring,
      Int.negOnePow_add, Int.negOnePow_two_mul, mul_one]

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftComp_assoc
statement:
lemma shiftComp_assoc (m n l : ℤ) {W X Y Z : C} (a b d ab bd abd : ℤ)
    (hab : a + b = ab) (hbd : b + d = bd) (habd : ab + d = abd)
    (f : (dgHom W X).X a) (g : (dgHom X Y).X b) (k : (dgHom Y Z).X d) :
    shiftComp (m + n) l ab d abd habd (shiftComp m n a b ab hab f g) k =
      shiftComp m (n + l) a bd abd (by omega) f (shiftComp n l b d bd hbd g k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shiftComp_apply, dgComp_units_smul_left', dgComp_units_smul_right',
    smul_smul, ← Int.negOnePow_add]
  rw [dgComp_assoc a b d ab bd abd hab hbd habd f g k,
    show ((d - l) * (m + n) + (b - n) * m) = ((bd - (n + l)) * m + (d - l) * n) by
      subst hbd; ring]

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftComp_dgId_left
statement:
lemma shiftComp_dgId_left (n : ℤ) {X Y : C} (b : ℤ) (g : (dgHom X Y).X b) :
    shiftComp 0 n 0 b b (zero_add b) (dgId X) g = g
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftComp_apply, dgId_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftComp_dgId_right
statement:
lemma shiftComp_dgId_right (m : ℤ) {X Y : C} (a : ℤ) (f : (dgHom X Y).X a) :
    shiftComp m 0 a 0 a (add_zero a) f (dgId Y) = f
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftComp_apply, dgComp_id]

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.shiftD_shiftD
statement:
lemma shiftD_shiftD (m : ℤ) {X Y : C} (a b c : ℤ) (f : (dgHom X Y).X a) :
    shiftD m b c (shiftD m a b f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd : ((dgHom X Y).d a b) ≫ ((dgHom X Y).d b c) = 0 :=
    (dgHom X Y).d_comp_d a b c
  simp only [shiftD_apply, hom_units_smul', smul_smul, ← Int.negOnePow_add]
  rw [show (m + m) = 2 * m by ring, Int.negOnePow_two_mul]
  have : ((dgHom X Y).d b c).hom (((dgHom X Y).d a b).hom f) = 0 := by
    rw [← AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply, hd]
    simp
  rw [this, smul_zero]

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeft_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem whiskerLeft_app (η : HomogeneousNatTrans G H n) (X : C) :
    app (whiskerLeft F η) X = app η (F.obj X)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeft_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem whiskerLeft_zero :
    whiskerLeft F (0 : HomogeneousNatTrans G H n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeft_add
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_add (η θ : HomogeneousNatTrans G H n) :
    whiskerLeft F (η + θ) = whiskerLeft F η + whiskerLeft F θ
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeftHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem whiskerLeftHom_apply (η : HomogeneousNatTrans G H n) :
    whiskerLeftHom F G H n η = whiskerLeft F η
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeft_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem whiskerLeft_id (G : DGFunctor D E) :
    whiskerLeft F (id G) = id (F.comp G)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeft_composition
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_composition (η : HomogeneousNatTrans G H n)
    (θ : HomogeneousNatTrans H I m) (r : ℤ) (h : n + m = r) :
    whiskerLeft F (composition G H I n m r h η θ) =
      composition (F.comp G) (F.comp H) (F.comp I) n m r h
        (whiskerLeft F η) (whiskerLeft F θ)
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  rw [whiskerLeft_app, composition_apply_app, composition_apply_app,
    whiskerLeft_app, whiskerLeft_app]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeft_differential
statement:
@[simp]
theorem whiskerLeft_differential (η : HomogeneousNatTrans G H n) :
    differential (whiskerLeft F η) = whiskerLeft F (differential η)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.IsClosed.whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem IsClosed.whiskerLeft {η : HomogeneousNatTrans G H n} (hη : IsClosed η) :
    IsClosed (HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeft F η)
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  rw [whiskerLeft_differential, whiskerLeft_app, zero_app]
  exact congrArg (fun σ => app σ (F.obj X)) hη

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem whiskerRight_app (η : HomogeneousNatTrans F G n) (K : DGFunctor D E)
    (X : C) :
    app (whiskerRight η K) X = K.map n (app η X)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem whiskerRight_zero (K : DGFunctor D E) :
    whiskerRight (0 : HomogeneousNatTrans F G n) K = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  exact map_zero (K.map n)

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight_add
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_add (η θ : HomogeneousNatTrans F G n)
    (K : DGFunctor D E) :
    whiskerRight (η + θ) K = whiskerRight η K + whiskerRight θ K
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  exact map_add (K.map n) (app η X) (app θ X)

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRightHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem whiskerRightHom_apply (η : HomogeneousNatTrans F G n)
    (K : DGFunctor D E) :
    whiskerRightHom F G n K η = whiskerRight η K
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem whiskerRight_id (F : DGFunctor C D) (K : DGFunctor D E) :
    whiskerRight (id F) K = id (F.comp K)
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  exact K.map_id (F.obj X)

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight_composition
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_composition (η : HomogeneousNatTrans F G n)
    (θ : HomogeneousNatTrans G H m) (r : ℤ) (h : n + m = r)
    (K : DGFunctor D E) :
    whiskerRight (composition F G H n m r h η θ) K =
      composition (F.comp K) (G.comp K) (H.comp K) n m r h
        (whiskerRight η K) (whiskerRight θ K)
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  rw [whiskerRight_app, composition_apply_app, composition_apply_app,
    whiskerRight_app, whiskerRight_app, K.map_comp n m r h]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight_differential
statement:
@[simp]
theorem whiskerRight_differential (η : HomogeneousNatTrans F G n)
    (K : DGFunctor D E) :
    differential (whiskerRight η K) = whiskerRight (differential η) K
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  rw [differential_app, whiskerRight_app, whiskerRight_app, differential_app,
    K.map_d n (n + 1)]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.IsClosed.whiskerRight
statement:
theorem IsClosed.whiskerRight {η : HomogeneousNatTrans F G n} (hη : IsClosed η)
    (K : DGFunctor D E) :
    IsClosed (HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight η K)
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  rw [whiskerRight_differential, whiskerRight_app, zero_app]
  have h := congrArg (fun σ => app σ X) hη
  simp only [zero_app] at h
  rw [h, map_zero]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_whiskerRight (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n)
    (G : DGFunctor D E) (K : DGFunctor E B) :
    whiskerRight (whiskerRight α G) K = whiskerRight α (G.comp K)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeft_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_whiskerLeft (F : DGFunctor C D) (G : DGFunctor D E)
    {K K' : DGFunctor E B} (β : HomogeneousNatTrans K K' n) :
    whiskerLeft F (whiskerLeft G β) = whiskerLeft (F.comp G) β
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_whiskerLeft (F : DGFunctor C D)
    (β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) (K : DGFunctor E B) :
    whiskerRight (whiskerLeft F β) K = whiskerLeft F (whiskerRight β K)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.interchange_app
statement:
theorem interchange_app (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n)
    (β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) (r : ℤ) (hnm : n + m = r)
    (hmn : m + n = r) (X : C) :
    dgComp n m r hnm (G.map n (app α X)) (app β (F'.obj X)) =
      (m * n).negOnePow •
        dgComp m n r hmn (app β (F.obj X)) (G'.map n (app α X))
proof:
:=
  naturality β n r hnm hmn (app α X)

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.interchange
statement:
theorem interchange (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' n)
    (β : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' m) (r : ℤ) (hnm : n + m = r)
    (hmn : m + n = r) :
    composition (F.comp G) (F'.comp G) (F'.comp G') n m r hnm
        (whiskerRight α G) (whiskerLeft F' β) =
      (m * n).negOnePow •
        composition (F.comp G) (F.comp G') (F'.comp G') m n r hmn
          (whiskerLeft F β) (whiskerRight α G')
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  rw [composition_apply_app, whiskerRight_app, whiskerLeft_app,
    units_smul_app, composition_apply_app, whiskerLeft_app, whiskerRight_app]
  exact interchange_app α β r hnm hmn X

name: CategoryTheory.cochain_ofHom_linearCopowerUnitUniv
statement:
lemma cochain_ofHom_linearCopowerUnitUniv (X : C) :
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom
        (linearCopowerUnitUniv (k := k) X) =
      CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.fromSingleMk
        (ModuleCat.ofHom
          ((LinearMap.ringLmapEquivSelf k k ((dgHom X X).X 0)).symm
            (dgId X))) (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  simp [linearCopowerUnitUniv, linearCopowerUnitCocycle,
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cocycle.equivHom]

name: CategoryTheory.mem_cocycles_iff
statement:
lemma mem_cocycles_iff {X Y : C} (f : (dgHom X Y).X 0) :
    f ∈ cocycles X Y ↔ ((dgHom X Y).d 0 1).hom f = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: CategoryTheory.mem_coboundaries_iff
statement:
lemma mem_coboundaries_iff {X Y : C} (f : (dgHom X Y).X 0) :
    f ∈ coboundaries X Y ↔ ∃ h, ((dgHom X Y).d (-1) 0).hom h = f
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: CategoryTheory.coboundaries_le_cocycles
statement: lemma coboundaries_le_cocycles (X Y : C) : coboundaries X Y ≤ cocycles X Y
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨h, rfl⟩
  rw [mem_cocycles_iff, ← AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply, (dgHom X Y).d_comp_d]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.comp_coboundary_mem
statement:
lemma comp_coboundary_mem {X Y Z : C} {f : (dgHom X Y).X 0} (hf : f ∈ cocycles X Y)
    {b : (dgHom Y Z).X 0} (hb : b ∈ coboundaries Y Z) :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) f b ∈ coboundaries X Z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨dgComp 0 (-1) (-1) (by omega) f h, ?_⟩
  have hf' : ((dgHom X Y).d 0 (0 + 1)).hom f = 0 := hf
  have key := dgComp_leibniz (C := C) 0 (-1) (-1) 0 (by omega) (by omega) f h
  rw [key]
  simp only [hf', map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, smul_zero, add_zero]
  
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.coboundary_comp_mem
statement:
lemma coboundary_comp_mem {X Y Z : C} {b : (dgHom X Y).X 0} (hb : b ∈ coboundaries X Y)
    {g : (dgHom Y Z).X 0} (hg : g ∈ cocycles Y Z) :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) b g ∈ coboundaries X Z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨dgComp (-1) 0 (-1) (by omega) h g, ?_⟩
  have hg' : ((dgHom Y Z).d 0 (0 + 1)).hom g = 0 := hg
  have key := dgComp_leibniz (C := C) (-1) 0 (-1) 0 (by omega) (by omega) h g
  rw [key]
  simp only [hg', map_zero, zero_add, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Z0.comp_mem
statement:
lemma comp_mem {X Y Z : C} {f : (dgHom X Y).X 0} (hf : f ∈ cocycles X Y)
    {g : (dgHom Y Z).X 0} (hg : g ∈ cocycles Y Z) :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) f g ∈ cocycles X Z
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : ((dgHom X Y).d 0 (0 + 1)).hom f = 0 := hf
  have hg' : ((dgHom Y Z).d 0 (0 + 1)).hom g = 0 := hg
  have key := dgComp_leibniz (C := C) 0 0 0 1 (by omega) (by omega) f g
  
  
  rw [mem_cocycles_iff, key, hf', hg', map_zero, map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply,
    smul_zero, add_zero]

name: CategoryTheory.Z0.id_val
statement:
@[simp]
lemma id_val (X : Z0 C) :
    ((𝟙 X : X ⟶ X) : cocycles (of C X) (of C X)).val = dgId (of C X)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Z0.comp_val
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_val {X Y Z : Z0 C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    ((f ≫ g : X ⟶ Z) : cocycles (of C X) (of C Z)).val =
      dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega)
        ((f : cocycles (of C X) (of C Y)).val) ((g : cocycles (of C Y) (of C Z)).val)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.comp_sub_mem
statement:
lemma comp_sub_mem {X Y Z : C} {f₁ f₂ : (dgHom X Y).X 0} {g₁ g₂ : (dgHom Y Z).X 0}
    (hf₂ : f₂ ∈ cocycles X Y) (hg₁ : g₁ ∈ cocycles Y Z)
    (hf : f₁ - f₂ ∈ coboundaries X Y) (hg : g₁ - g₂ ∈ coboundaries Y Z) :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) f₁ g₁ - dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) f₂ g₂ ∈ coboundaries X Z
proof:
:= by
  have expand :
      dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) f₁ g₁ - dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) f₂ g₂ =
        dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) (f₁ - f₂) g₁ + dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) f₂ (g₁ - g₂) := by
    simp [map_sub, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply]
  rw [expand]
  exact AddSubgroup.add_mem _ (coboundary_comp_mem hf hg₁)
    (comp_coboundary_mem hf₂ hg)

name: CategoryTheory.H0.of_self
statement: lemma of_self (X : H0 C) : of C X = X
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.H0.homMk_eq_homMk
proof:
:= by
  refine QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.2 ?_
  show ((a - b : cocycles X Y) : (dgHom X Y).X 0) ∈ coboundaries X Y
  rw [AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub]
  exact h

name: CategoryTheory.H0.homMk_neg
statement: lemma homMk_neg {X Y : C} (a : cocycles X Y) : homMk (-a) = -homMk a
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.H0.homMk_comp
statement:
lemma homMk_comp {X Y Z : C} (a : cocycles X Y) (b : cocycles Y Z) :
    homMk a ≫ homMk b =
      homMk ⟨dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) (a : (dgHom X Y).X 0) (b : (dgHom Y Z).X 0),
        Z0.comp_mem a.2 b.2⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.H0.homMk_id
statement:
lemma homMk_id (X : C) :
    homMk (⟨dgId X, dgId_cocycle X⟩ : cocycles X X) =
      𝟙 (show H0 C from X)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.map_mem_cocycles
statement:
lemma map_mem_cocycles (F : DGFunctor C D) {X Y : C} {f : (dgHom X Y).X 0}
    (hf : f ∈ cocycles X Y) : F.map 0 f ∈ cocycles (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : ((dgHom X Y).d 0 1).hom f = 0 := hf
  rw [mem_cocycles_iff, ← F.map_d 0 1 f, hf', map_zero]

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.map_mem_coboundaries
statement:
lemma map_mem_coboundaries (F : DGFunctor C D) {X Y : C} {f : (dgHom X Y).X 0}
    (hf : f ∈ coboundaries X Y) : F.map 0 f ∈ coboundaries (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hf
  exact ⟨F.map (-1) h, (F.map_d (-1) 0 h).symm⟩

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.h0_obj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma h0_obj (F : DGFunctor C D) (X : H0 C) : F.h0.obj X = F.obj (H0.of C X)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.h0_map_mk
statement:

lemma h0_map_mk (F : DGFunctor C D) {X Y : H0 C} (f : cocycles (H0.of C X) (H0.of C Y)) :
    F.h0.map (QuotientAddGroup.mk f) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk ⟨F.map 0 f.1, F.map_mem_cocycles f.2⟩
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.h0CompIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem h0CompIso_hom_app (F : DGFunctor C D) (G : DGFunctor D E) (X : H0 C) :

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.h0CompIso_inv_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem h0CompIso_inv_app (F : DGFunctor C D) (G : DGFunctor D E) (X : H0 C) :
    (h0CompIso F G).inv.app X = 𝟙 _
proof:
