    DGCategory.shiftComp m n a b c h f g = ((b - n) * m).negOnePow • Cochain.comp f g h

lemma compare_evaluation_square (W : LinearEvaluationData k E) :
    DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.composition V.functor (DGFunctor.id C)
        (DGFunctor.id C) 0 0 0 (by omega) V.evaluation
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C)) =
      DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.composition V.functor W.functor
        (DGFunctor.id C) 0 0 0 (by omega) (compare V W) W.evaluation
proof:
:=
  (dgComp_id (C := DGFunctor C C) 0 V.evaluation).trans
    (compare_comp_evaluation V W).symm

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.TwistConeData.compareIso_hom_val
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compareIso_hom_val {W : LinearEvaluationData k E}
    (L : W.TwistConeData k) :
    (K.compareIso L).hom.val =
      K.isConeOf.lift L.isConeOf (LinearEvaluationData.compare V W)
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C)) 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.TwistConeData.compareIso_inv_val
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compareIso_inv_val {W : LinearEvaluationData k E}
    (L : W.TwistConeData k) :
    (K.compareIso L).inv.val =
      L.isConeOf.lift K.isConeOf (LinearEvaluationData.compare W V)
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C)) 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.TwistConeData.inclusion_comp_compareIso_hom_val
statement:
lemma inclusion_comp_compareIso_hom_val {W : LinearEvaluationData k E}
    (L : W.TwistConeData k) :
    DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.composition (DGFunctor.id C) K.twist L.twist
        0 0 0 (by omega) K.inr (K.compareIso L).hom.val =
      L.inr
proof:
:= by
  rw [compareIso]
  refine (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.ConeData.inr_comp_isoOfStrictSquare_hom
    K L (LinearEvaluationData.compareIso V W)
      (Iso.refl (show Z0 (DGFunctor C C) from DGFunctor.id C))
      (V.compare_evaluation_square k W)).trans ?_
  exact dgId_comp (C := DGFunctor C C) 0 L.inr

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.TwistConeData.compareIso_self_hom_val
statement:
lemma compareIso_self_hom_val :
    (K.compareIso K).hom.val =
      DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id K.twist
proof:
:= by
  rw [compareIso_hom_val, LinearEvaluationData.compare_self]
  exact K.isConeOf.homogeneousLift_id

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.TwistConeData.compareIso_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compareIso_self : K.compareIso K = Iso.refl _
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact K.compareIso_self_hom_val

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.TwistConeData.compareIso_hom_val_comp
statement:
lemma compareIso_hom_val_comp {W X : LinearEvaluationData k E}
    (L : W.TwistConeData k) (M : X.TwistConeData k) :
    DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.composition K.twist L.twist M.twist
        0 0 0 (by omega) (K.compareIso L).hom.val
        (L.compareIso M).hom.val =
      (K.compareIso M).hom.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [compareIso_hom_val, compareIso_hom_val, compareIso_hom_val]
  change DGCategoryStruct.dgComp 0 0 (0 + 0) (by omega)
      (K.isConeOf.homogeneousLift L.isConeOf 0
        (LinearEvaluationData.compare V W)
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C)) 0)
      (L.isConeOf.homogeneousLift M.isConeOf 0
        (LinearEvaluationData.compare W X)
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C)) 0) =
    K.isConeOf.homogeneousLift M.isConeOf 0
      (LinearEvaluationData.compare V X)
      (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C)) 0
  rw [K.isConeOf.homogeneousLift_strict_comp L.isConeOf M.isConeOf 0 0]
  change K.isConeOf.homogeneousLift M.isConeOf 0
      (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.composition V.functor W.functor X.functor
        0 0 0 (by omega) (LinearEvaluationData.compare V W)
        (LinearEvaluationData.compare W X))
      (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.composition (DGFunctor.id C)
        (DGFunctor.id C) (DGFunctor.id C) 0 0 0 (by omega)
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C))
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C))) 0 =
    K.isConeOf.homogeneousLift M.isConeOf 0
      (LinearEvaluationData.compare V X)
      (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C)) 0
  rw [LinearEvaluationData.compare_comp]
  change K.isConeOf.homogeneousLift M.isConeOf 0
      (LinearEvaluationData.compare V X)
      (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.composition (DGFunctor.id C)
        (DGFunctor.id C) (DGFunctor.id C) 0 0 0 (by omega)
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C))
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C))) 0 =
    K.isConeOf.homogeneousLift M.isConeOf 0
      (LinearEvaluationData.compare V X)
      (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C)) 0
  have hid :
      DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.composition (DGFunctor.id C)
        (DGFunctor.id C) (DGFunctor.id C) 0 0 0 (by omega)
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C))
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C)) =
      DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.id (DGFunctor.id C) := by
    exact dgId_comp (C := DGFunctor C C) 0 _
  rw [hid]

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.TwistConeData.compareIso_trans
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact K.compareIso_hom_val_comp L M

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.HomogeneousSquare.strict_homotopy
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.hom_units_smul
proof:
:= by
  simp [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.dgComp_units_smul_left
statement:
private lemma dgComp_units_smul_left {W X Y : C}
    (p q r : ℤ) (h : p + q = r) (c : ℤˣ)
    (f : (dgHom W X).X p) (g : (dgHom X Y).X q) :
    dgComp p q r h (c • f) g = c • dgComp p q r h f g
proof:
:= by
  simp [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.dgComp_units_smul_right
statement:
private lemma dgComp_units_smul_right {W X Y : C}
    (p q r : ℤ) (h : p + q = r) (c : ℤˣ)
    (f : (dgHom W X).X p) (g : (dgHom X Y).X q) :
    dgComp p q r h f (c • g) = c • dgComp p q r h f g
proof:
:= by
  simp [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.dgComp_leibniz_general
statement:
private lemma dgComp_leibniz_general {W X Y : C}
    (p q p' q' r r' : ℤ) (hp : p + 1 = p') (hq : q + 1 = q')
    (h : p + q = r) (hr : r + 1 = r')
    (f : (dgHom W X).X p) (g : (dgHom X Y).X q) :
    ((dgHom W Y).d r r').hom (dgComp p q r h f g) =
      dgComp p q' r' (by omega) f (((dgHom X Y).d q q').hom g) +
        q.negOnePow • dgComp p' q r' (by omega)
          (((dgHom W X).d p p').hom f) g
proof:
:= by
  cases hp
  cases hq
  exact DGCategory.dgComp_leibniz p q r r' h hr f g

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.inr_comp_homogeneousLift
statement:
lemma inr_comp_homogeneousLift (p : ℤ)
    (a : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X p) (b : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X p)
    (k : (dgHom X₁ Y₂).X (p - 1)) :
    dgComp 0 p p (by omega) hc₁.inr (hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p a b k) =
      dgComp p 0 p (by omega) b hc₂.inr
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogeneousLift, map_add, map_add]
  simp only [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]
  rw [← dgComp_assoc 0 1 (p - 1) 1 p p (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hc₁.inr_comp_fst,
    ← dgComp_assoc 0 0 p 0 p p (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hc₁.inr_comp_snd, dgId_comp,
    ← dgComp_assoc 0 1 (p - 1) 1 p p (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hc₁.inr_comp_fst]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.inr_comp_homogeneousLift_general
statement:
lemma inr_comp_homogeneousLift_general (p r : ℤ)
    (h0p : 0 + p = r) (hp0 : p + 0 = r)
    (a : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X p) (b : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X p)
    (k : (dgHom X₁ Y₂).X (p - 1)) :
    dgComp 0 p r h0p hc₁.inr (hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p a b k) =
      dgComp p 0 r hp0 b hc₂.inr
proof:
:= by
  have hr : r = p := by omega
  cases hr
  exact hc₁.inr_comp_homogeneousLift hc₂ p a b k

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.inl_comp_homogeneousLift_strict
statement:
lemma inl_comp_homogeneousLift_strict (p : ℤ)
    (a : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X p) (b : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X p) :
    dgComp (-1) p (p - 1) (by omega) hc₁.inl
        (hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p a b 0) =
      p.negOnePow • dgComp p (-1) (p - 1) (by omega) a hc₂.inl
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogeneousLift, map_add, map_add]
  simp only [map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply,
    add_zero, dgComp_units_smul_right]
  rw [← DGCategory.dgComp_assoc (-1) 1 (p - 1) 0 p (p - 1)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hc₁.inl_comp_fst, DGCategory.dgId_comp,
    ← DGCategory.dgComp_assoc (-1) 0 p (-1) p (p - 1)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hc₁.inl_comp_snd]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.inl_comp_homogeneousLift_strict_general
statement:
lemma inl_comp_homogeneousLift_strict_general (p r : ℤ)
    (hm1p : -1 + p = r) (hpm1 : p + -1 = r)
    (a : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X p) (b : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X p) :
    dgComp (-1) p r hm1p hc₁.inl
        (hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p a b 0) =
      p.negOnePow • dgComp p (-1) r hpm1 a hc₂.inl
proof:
:= by
  have hr : r = p - 1 := by omega
  cases hr
  exact hc₁.inl_comp_homogeneousLift_strict hc₂ p a b

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneousLift_id_aux
statement:
private lemma homogeneousLift_id_aux (t : ℤ) (ht : t = -1)
    (h₁ : 1 + t = 0) (h₂ : 0 + (-1) = t) (h₃ : t + 0 = t) :
    dgComp 1 t 0 h₁ hc₁.fst
          (dgComp 0 (-1) t h₂ (dgId X₁) hc₁.inl) +
        dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) hc₁.snd
          (dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) (dgId Y₁) hc₁.inr) +
      dgComp 1 t 0 h₁ hc₁.fst
        (dgComp t 0 t h₃ 0 hc₁.inr) = dgId Z₁
proof:
:= by
  cases ht
  rw [DGCategory.dgId_comp (-1) hc₁.inl,
    DGCategory.dgId_comp 0 hc₁.inr]
  simp only [map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, add_zero]
  exact hc₁.fst_inl_add_snd_inr

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneousLift_id
statement:
lemma homogeneousLift_id :
    hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₁ 0 (dgId X₁) (dgId Y₁) 0 = dgId Z₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogeneousLift, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]
  exact homogeneousLift_id_aux hc₁ (0 - 1) (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneousLift_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma homogeneousLift_zero (p : ℤ) :
    hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p 0 0 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [homogeneousLift]

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneousLift_strict_add
statement:
lemma homogeneousLift_strict_add (p : ℤ)
    (a a' : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X p) (b b' : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X p) :
    hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p (a + a') (b + b') 0 =
      hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p a b 0 +
        hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p a' b' 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [homogeneousLift, map_add, smul_add]
  abel

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneousLift_comp_fst
statement:
lemma homogeneousLift_comp_fst (p : ℤ)
    (a : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X p) (b : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X p)
    (k : (dgHom X₁ Y₂).X (p - 1)) :
    dgComp p 1 (p + 1) (by omega)
        (hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p a b k) hc₂.fst =
      p.negOnePow • dgComp 1 p (p + 1) (by omega) hc₁.fst a
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogeneousLift, map_add, map_add]
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
  rw [dgComp_units_smul_left]
  rw [DGCategory.dgComp_assoc 1 (p - 1) 1 p p (p + 1)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    DGCategory.dgComp_assoc p (-1) 1 (p - 1) 0 p
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hc₂.inl_comp_fst, DGCategory.dgComp_id,
    DGCategory.dgComp_assoc 0 p 1 p (p + 1) (p + 1)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    DGCategory.dgComp_assoc p 0 1 p 1 (p + 1)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hc₂.inr_comp_fst,
    DGCategory.dgComp_assoc 1 (p - 1) 1 p p (p + 1)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    DGCategory.dgComp_assoc (p - 1) 0 1 (p - 1) 1 p
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hc₂.inr_comp_fst]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneousLift_comp_snd
statement:
lemma homogeneousLift_comp_snd (p : ℤ)
    (a : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X p) (b : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X p) :
    dgComp p 0 p (by omega)
        (hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p a b 0) hc₂.snd =
      dgComp 0 p p (by omega) hc₁.snd b
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogeneousLift, map_add, map_add]
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
  rw [dgComp_units_smul_left]
  simp only [map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
  rw [DGCategory.dgComp_assoc 1 (p - 1) 0 p (p - 1) p
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    DGCategory.dgComp_assoc p (-1) 0 (p - 1) (-1) (p - 1)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hc₂.inl_comp_snd,
    DGCategory.dgComp_assoc 0 p 0 p p p
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    DGCategory.dgComp_assoc p 0 0 p 0 p
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hc₂.inr_comp_snd, DGCategory.dgComp_id]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneousLift_comp_fst_general
statement:
lemma homogeneousLift_comp_fst_general (p r : ℤ)
    (hp1 : p + 1 = r) (h1p : 1 + p = r)
    (a : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X p) (b : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X p)
    (k : (dgHom X₁ Y₂).X (p - 1)) :
    dgComp p 1 r hp1 (hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p a b k) hc₂.fst =
      p.negOnePow • dgComp 1 p r h1p hc₁.fst a
proof:
:= by
  have hr : r = p + 1 := by omega
  cases hr
  exact hc₁.homogeneousLift_comp_fst hc₂ p a b k

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneousLift_comp_snd_general
statement:
lemma homogeneousLift_comp_snd_general (p r : ℤ)
    (hp0 : p + 0 = r) (h0p : 0 + p = r)
    (a : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X p) (b : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X p) :
    dgComp p 0 r hp0 (hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p a b 0) hc₂.snd =
      dgComp 0 p r h0p hc₁.snd b
proof:
:= by
  have hr : r = p := by omega
  cases hr
  exact hc₁.homogeneousLift_comp_snd hc₂ p a b

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneous_ext
statement:
lemma homogeneous_ext (p : ℤ) {u v : (dgHom Z₁ Z₂).X p}
    (hfst : dgComp p 1 (p + 1) (by omega) u hc₂.fst =
      dgComp p 1 (p + 1) (by omega) v hc₂.fst)
    (hsnd : dgComp p 0 p (by omega) u hc₂.snd =
      dgComp p 0 p (by omega) v hc₂.snd) :
    u = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← DGCategory.dgComp_id p u, ← DGCategory.dgComp_id p v,
    ← hc₂.fst_inl_add_snd_inr, map_add, map_add]
  rw [← DGCategory.dgComp_assoc p 1 (-1) (p + 1) 0 p
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    ← DGCategory.dgComp_assoc p 0 0 p 0 p
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hfst, hsnd,
    DGCategory.dgComp_assoc p 1 (-1) (p + 1) 0 p
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    DGCategory.dgComp_assoc p 0 0 p 0 p
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)]

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneousLift_strict_comp
statement:
lemma homogeneousLift_strict_comp (p q : ℤ)
    (a : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X p) (b : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X p)
    (c : (dgHom X₂ X₃).X q) (d : (dgHom Y₂ Y₃).X q) :
    dgComp p q (p + q) (by omega)
        (hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p a b 0)
        (hc₂.homogeneousLift hc₃ q c d 0) =
      hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₃ (p + q)
        (dgComp p q (p + q) (by omega) a c)
        (dgComp p q (p + q) (by omega) b d) 0
proof:
:= by
  apply hc₃.homogeneous_ext (p + q)
  · rw [DGCategory.dgComp_assoc p q 1 (p + q) (q + 1) (p + q + 1)
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      hc₂.homogeneousLift_comp_fst hc₃ q c d,
      dgComp_units_smul_right,
      ← DGCategory.dgComp_assoc p 1 q (p + 1) (q + 1) (p + q + 1)
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      hc₁.homogeneousLift_comp_fst hc₂ p a b,
      dgComp_units_smul_left, smul_smul,
      DGCategory.dgComp_assoc 1 p q (p + 1) (p + q) (p + q + 1)
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      hc₁.homogeneousLift_comp_fst hc₃ (p + q)
        (dgComp p q (p + q) (by omega) a c)
        (dgComp p q (p + q) (by omega) b d),
      Int.negOnePow_add]
    simp [mul_comm]
  · rw [DGCategory.dgComp_assoc p q 0 (p + q) q (p + q)
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      hc₂.homogeneousLift_comp_snd hc₃ q c d,
      ← DGCategory.dgComp_assoc p 0 q p q (p + q)
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      hc₁.homogeneousLift_comp_snd hc₂ p a b,
      DGCategory.dgComp_assoc 0 p q p (p + q) (p + q)
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      hc₁.homogeneousLift_comp_snd hc₃ (p + q)
        (dgComp p q (p + q) (by omega) a c)
        (dgComp p q (p + q) (by omega) b d)]

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneousLift_succ_aux
statement:
private lemma homogeneousLift_succ_aux (p t : ℤ) (ht : t = p)
    (h₁ : 1 + t = p + 1) (h₂ : p + 1 + -1 = t)
    (a : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X (p + 1)) (b : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X (p + 1)) :
    (p + 1).negOnePow •
          dgComp 1 t (p + 1) h₁ hc₁.fst
            (dgComp (p + 1) (-1) t h₂ a hc₂.inl) +
        dgComp 0 (p + 1) (p + 1) (by omega) hc₁.snd
          (dgComp (p + 1) 0 (p + 1) (by omega) b hc₂.inr) =
      (p + 1).negOnePow •
          dgComp 1 p (p + 1) (by omega) hc₁.fst
            (dgComp (p + 1) (-1) p (by omega) a hc₂.inl) +
        dgComp 0 (p + 1) (p + 1) (by omega) hc₁.snd
          (dgComp (p + 1) 0 (p + 1) (by omega) b hc₂.inr)
proof:
:= by
  cases ht
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneousLift_succ
statement:
private lemma homogeneousLift_succ (p : ℤ)
    (a : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X (p + 1)) (b : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X (p + 1)) :
    hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ (p + 1) a b 0 =
      (p + 1).negOnePow •
          dgComp 1 p (p + 1) (by omega) hc₁.fst
            (dgComp (p + 1) (-1) p (by omega) a hc₂.inl) +
        dgComp 0 (p + 1) (p + 1) (by omega) hc₁.snd
          (dgComp (p + 1) 0 (p + 1) (by omega) b hc₂.inr)
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogeneousLift]
  simp only [map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, add_zero]
  exact homogeneousLift_succ_aux hc₁ hc₂ p (p + 1 - 1)
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) a b

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneousLift_d
statement:
lemma homogeneousLift_d (p : ℤ)
    (a : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X p) (b : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X p)
    (s : DGCategory.HomogeneousSquare f₁ f₂ p a b) :
    ((dgHom Z₁ Z₂).d p (p + 1)).hom
        (hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p a b s.homotopy) =
      hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ (p + 1)
        (((dgHom X₁ X₂).d p (p + 1)).hom a)
        (((dgHom Y₁ Y₂).d p (p + 1)).hom b) 0
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : (-1 : ℤ).negOnePow = -1 := by decide
  have hA : ((dgHom X₁ Z₂).d (p - 1) p).hom
        (dgComp p (-1) (p - 1) (by omega) a hc₂.inl) =
      dgComp p 0 p (by omega) a
          (dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) f₂ hc₂.inr) -
        dgComp (p + 1) (-1) p (by omega)
          (((dgHom X₁ X₂).d p (p + 1)).hom a) hc₂.inl := by
    have h := dgComp_leibniz_general p (-1) (p + 1) 0 (p - 1) p
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) a hc₂.inl
    rw [hc₂.δ_inl] at h
    simpa only [hneg, Units.neg_smul, one_smul, sub_eq_add_neg] using h
  have hB : ((dgHom Y₁ Z₂).d p (p + 1)).hom
        (dgComp p 0 p (by omega) b hc₂.inr) =
      dgComp (p + 1) 0 (p + 1) (by omega)
        (((dgHom Y₁ Y₂).d p (p + 1)).hom b) hc₂.inr := by
    have h := dgComp_leibniz_general p 0 (p + 1) 1 p (p + 1)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) b hc₂.inr
    rw [hc₂.inr_closed] at h
    simpa using h
  have hK : ((dgHom X₁ Z₂).d (p - 1) p).hom
        (dgComp (p - 1) 0 (p - 1) (by omega) s.homotopy hc₂.inr) =
      dgComp p 0 p (by omega)
        (((dgHom X₁ Y₂).d (p - 1) p).hom s.homotopy) hc₂.inr := by
    have h := dgComp_leibniz_general (p - 1) 0 p 1 (p - 1) p
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) s.homotopy hc₂.inr
    rw [hc₂.inr_closed] at h
    simpa using h
  have hT₁ : ((dgHom Z₁ Z₂).d p (p + 1)).hom
        (p.negOnePow •
          dgComp 1 (p - 1) p (by omega) hc₁.fst
            (dgComp p (-1) (p - 1) (by omega) a hc₂.inl)) =
      p.negOnePow •
        dgComp 1 p (p + 1) (by omega) hc₁.fst
          (dgComp p 0 p (by omega) a
              (dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) f₂ hc₂.inr) -
            dgComp (p + 1) (-1) p (by omega)
              (((dgHom X₁ X₂).d p (p + 1)).hom a) hc₂.inl) := by
    rw [hom_units_smul]
    have h := dgComp_leibniz_general 1 (p - 1) 2 p p (p + 1)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hc₁.fst
        (dgComp p (-1) (p - 1) (by omega) a hc₂.inl)
    rw [h, hA, hc₁.delta_fst]
    simp
  have hT₂ : ((dgHom Z₁ Z₂).d p (p + 1)).hom
        (dgComp 0 p p (by omega) hc₁.snd
          (dgComp p 0 p (by omega) b hc₂.inr)) =
      dgComp 0 (p + 1) (p + 1) (by omega) hc₁.snd
          (dgComp (p + 1) 0 (p + 1) (by omega)
            (((dgHom Y₁ Y₂).d p (p + 1)).hom b) hc₂.inr) +
        p.negOnePow •
          dgComp 1 p (p + 1) (by omega)
            (-dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) hc₁.fst f₁)
            (dgComp p 0 p (by omega) b hc₂.inr) := by
    have h := dgComp_leibniz_general 0 p 1 (p + 1) p (p + 1)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hc₁.snd
        (dgComp p 0 p (by omega) b hc₂.inr)
    rw [h, hB, hc₁.delta_snd]
  have hT₃ : ((dgHom Z₁ Z₂).d p (p + 1)).hom
        (dgComp 1 (p - 1) p (by omega) hc₁.fst
          (dgComp (p - 1) 0 (p - 1) (by omega) s.homotopy hc₂.inr)) =
      p.negOnePow •
        dgComp 1 p (p + 1) (by omega) hc₁.fst
          (dgComp p 0 p (by omega)
            (dgComp 0 p p (by omega) f₁ b - dgComp p 0 p (by omega) a f₂)
            hc₂.inr) := by
    have h := dgComp_leibniz_general 1 (p - 1) 2 p p (p + 1)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hc₁.fst
        (dgComp (p - 1) 0 (p - 1) (by omega) s.homotopy hc₂.inr)
    rw [h, hK, s.homotopy_boundary, hc₁.delta_fst,
      dgComp_units_smul_left, dgComp_units_smul_right]
    simp
  have hfb :
      dgComp 1 p (p + 1) (by omega)
          (-dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) hc₁.fst f₁)
          (dgComp p 0 p (by omega) b hc₂.inr) =
        -dgComp 1 p (p + 1) (by omega) hc₁.fst
          (dgComp p 0 p (by omega)
            (dgComp 0 p p (by omega) f₁ b) hc₂.inr) := by
    rw [map_neg, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply,
      DGCategory.dgComp_assoc 1 0 p 1 p (p + 1)
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      ← DGCategory.dgComp_assoc 0 p 0 p p p
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)]
  have hfa :
      dgComp 1 p (p + 1) (by omega) hc₁.fst
          (dgComp p 0 p (by omega) a
            (dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) f₂ hc₂.inr)) =
        dgComp 1 p (p + 1) (by omega) hc₁.fst
          (dgComp p 0 p (by omega)
            (dgComp p 0 p (by omega) a f₂) hc₂.inr) := by
    rw [← DGCategory.dgComp_assoc p 0 0 p 0 p
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)]
  rw [homogeneousLift, map_add, map_add, hT₁, hT₂, hT₃, hfb,
    homogeneousLift_succ]
  simp only [smul_sub, map_sub, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, Int.negOnePow_succ,
    Units.neg_smul, smul_neg, hfa]
  abel

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneousLift_strict_d
statement:
lemma homogeneousLift_strict_d (p : ℤ)
    (a : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X p) (b : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X p)
    (hsquare : dgComp 0 p p (by omega) f₁ b =
      dgComp p 0 p (by omega) a f₂) :
    ((dgHom Z₁ Z₂).d p (p + 1)).hom
        (hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p a b 0) =
      hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ (p + 1)
        (((dgHom X₁ X₂).d p (p + 1)).hom a)
        (((dgHom Y₁ Y₂).d p (p + 1)).hom b) 0
proof:
:=
  hc₁.homogeneousLift_d hc₂ p a b (DGCategory.HomogeneousSquare.strict hsquare)

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.homogeneousLift_strict_map_d
statement:
lemma homogeneousLift_strict_map_d (p q : ℤ)
    (a : (dgHom X₁ X₂).X p) (b : (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).X p)
    (hsquare : dgComp 0 p p (by omega) f₁ b =
      dgComp p 0 p (by omega) a f₂) :
    ((dgHom Z₁ Z₂).d p q).hom
        (hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ p a b 0) =
      hc₁.homogeneousLift hc₂ q
        (((dgHom X₁ X₂).d p q).hom a)
        (((dgHom Y₁ Y₂).d p q).hom b) 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpq : p + 1 = q
  · subst q
    exact hc₁.homogeneousLift_strict_d hc₂ p a b hsquare
  · have hshape : ¬(ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel p q := by
      simpa [ComplexShape.up, ComplexShape.up'] using hpq
    rw [(dgHom Z₁ Z₂).shape p q hshape,
      (dgHom X₁ X₂).shape p q hshape,
      (dgHom Y₁ Y₂).shape p q hshape]
    simp [homogeneousLift]

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.shiftedFunctorWitness_inv_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftedFunctorWitness_inv_app (F : DGFunctor C D) (n : ℤ) (X : C) :
    HomogeneousNatTrans.app (F.shiftedFunctorWitness n).inv X =
      (F.shiftWitness n X).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply ((F.shiftWitness n X).bijective (F.shiftObj n X) n 0 (by omega)).injective
  change dgComp n (-n) 0 (by omega)
      (HomogeneousNatTrans.app (F.shiftedFunctorWitness n).inv X)
        (F.shiftWitness n X).hom =
    dgComp n (-n) 0 (by omega)
      (F.shiftWitness n X).inv (F.shiftWitness n X).hom
  calc
    _ = HomogeneousNatTrans.app (dgComp n (-n) 0 (by omega)
        (F.shiftedFunctorWitness n).inv (F.shiftHom n)) X :=
      (HomogeneousNatTrans.composition_apply_app (F.shiftedFunctorWitness n).inv
        (F.shiftHom n) 0 (by omega) X).symm
    _ = HomogeneousNatTrans.app (dgId (F.shiftedFunctor n)) X :=
      congrArg (fun θ => HomogeneousNatTrans.app θ X)
        (F.shiftedFunctorWitness n).inv_hom
    _ = dgId (F.shiftObj n X) := rfl
    _ = _ := (F.shiftWitness n X).inv_hom.symm

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.sourceShiftEquiv_apply_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sourceShiftEquiv_apply_app (F G : DGFunctor C D)
    (n p q : ℤ) (h : n + p = q)
    (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F G p) (X : C) :
    app (sourceShiftEquiv F G n p q h α) X =
      dgComp n p q h (F.shiftWitness n X).inv (app α X)
proof:
:= by
  change app (HomogeneousNatTrans.composition
      (F.shiftedFunctor n) F G n p q h
        (F.shiftedFunctorWitness n).inv α) X = _
  rw [composition_apply_app, shiftedFunctorWitness_inv_app]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.sourceShiftEquiv_symm_apply_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sourceShiftEquiv_symm_apply_app (F G : DGFunctor C D)
    (n p q : ℤ) (h : n + p = q)
    (β : HomogeneousNatTrans (F.shiftedFunctor n) G q) (X : C) :
    app ((sourceShiftEquiv F G n p q h).symm β) X =
      dgComp (-n) q p (by omega) (F.shiftWitness n X).hom (app β X)
proof:
:= by
  change app (HomogeneousNatTrans.composition F (F.shiftedFunctor n) G
      (-n) q p (by omega) (F.shiftHom n) β) X = _
  rw [composition_apply_app, F.shiftHom_app]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.differential_sourceShiftEquiv
statement:
theorem differential_sourceShiftEquiv (F G : DGFunctor C D)
    (n p q : ℤ) (h : n + p = q)
    (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F G p) :
    differential (sourceShiftEquiv F G n p q h α) =
      sourceShiftEquiv F G n (p + 1) (q + 1) (by omega)
        (differential α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← complex_d_apply (sourceShiftEquiv F G n p q h α),
    ← complex_d_apply α]
  exact (F.shiftedFunctorWitness n).precompEquiv_d G p q h α

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.sourceShiftEquiv_isClosed_iff
statement:
theorem sourceShiftEquiv_isClosed_iff (F G : DGFunctor C D)
    (n p q : ℤ) (h : n + p = q)
    (α : HomogeneousNatTrans F G p) :
    IsClosed (sourceShiftEquiv F G n p q h α) ↔ IsClosed α
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsClosed, IsClosed, differential_sourceShiftEquiv]
  exact (sourceShiftEquiv F G n (p + 1) (q + 1) (by omega)).map_eq_zero_iff

name: CategoryTheory.DGAdjunction.CounitConeData.twistAdjointComparison_app
statement:
theorem twistAdjointComparison_app (X : B) :
    DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.app
        (twistAdjointComparison (rightAdj := rightAdj) leftAdj K) X =
      dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega)
        (L.map 0 (dgComp (-1) 1 0 (by omega)
          (K.twist.shiftWitness (-1 : ℤ) X).inv
          (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.app K.fst X)))
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.app leftAdj.counit (R.obj X))
proof:
:= by
  change dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega)
      (L.map 0 (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.app
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.sourceShiftEquiv K.twist (R.comp S)
          (-1 : ℤ) 1 0 (by omega) K.fst) X))
      (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.app leftAdj.counit (R.obj X)) = _
  rw [DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.sourceShiftEquiv_apply_app]
  congr

name: CategoryTheory.DGAdjunction.CounitConeData.twistAdjointComparison_isClosed
statement:
theorem twistAdjointComparison_isClosed :
    DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.IsClosed
      (twistAdjointComparison (rightAdj := rightAdj) leftAdj K)
proof:
:= by
  apply DGFunctor.isClosed_of_mem_cocycles
  apply Z0.comp_mem
  · apply DGFunctor.mem_cocycles_of_isClosed
    apply DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.IsClosed.whiskerRight
    exact (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.sourceShiftEquiv_isClosed_iff
      K.twist (R.comp S) (-1 : ℤ) 1 0 (by omega) K.fst).2 K.fst_isClosed
  · apply DGFunctor.mem_cocycles_of_isClosed
    exact leftAdj.counit_isClosed.whiskerLeft R

name: CategoryTheory.DGAdjunction.UnitConeData.cotwistAdjointComparison_app
statement:
theorem cotwistAdjointComparison_app (X : B) :
    DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.app
        (cotwistAdjointComparison (rightAdj := rightAdj) leftAdj K) X =
      dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega)
        (R.map 0 (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.app leftAdj.unit X))
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.app K.inr (L.obj X))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGAdjunction.UnitConeData.cotwistAdjointComparison_isClosed
statement:
theorem cotwistAdjointComparison_isClosed :
    DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.IsClosed
      (cotwistAdjointComparison (rightAdj := rightAdj) leftAdj K)
proof:
:= by
  apply DGFunctor.isClosed_of_mem_cocycles
  apply Z0.comp_mem
  · apply DGFunctor.mem_cocycles_of_isClosed
    exact leftAdj.unit_isClosed.whiskerRight R
  · apply DGFunctor.mem_cocycles_of_isClosed
    exact K.inr_isClosed.whiskerLeft L

name: CategoryTheory.DGAdjunction.UnitConeData.cotwistAdjointComparisonH0_eq_h0Unit_comp_inrH0
statement:
theorem cotwistAdjointComparisonH0_eq_h0Unit_comp_inrH0 :
    cotwistAdjointComparisonH0 (rightAdj := rightAdj) leftAdj K =
      (Functor.leftUnitor R.h0).inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight leftAdj.h0Unit R.h0 ≫
          (Functor.associator L.h0 S.h0 R.h0).hom ≫
            Functor.whiskerLeft L.h0 (DGFunctor.h0CompIso S R).inv ≫
              Functor.whiskerLeft L.h0
                (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0 K.inr K.inr_isClosed) ≫
                (DGFunctor.h0CompIso L K.unitCone).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hη := leftAdj.unit_isClosed.whiskerRight R
  have hι := K.inr_isClosed.whiskerLeft L
  change DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0
      (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.comp
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight leftAdj.unit R)
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeft L K.inr)) _ = _
  rw [DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0_comp'
    (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight leftAdj.unit R)
    (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeft L K.inr) hη hι]
  let unitWhiskerH0 : R.h0 ⟶ ((L.comp S).comp R).h0 :=
    DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0
      (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerRight leftAdj.unit R) hη
  let inrWhiskerH0 : ((L.comp S).comp R).h0 ⟶
      (L.comp K.unitCone).h0 :=
    DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0
      (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.whiskerLeft L K.inr) hι
  let cAssoc : ((L.comp S).comp R).h0 ≅ L.h0 ⋙ (S.comp R).h0 :=
    DGFunctor.h0CompIso L (S.comp R)
  change unitWhiskerH0 ≫ inrWhiskerH0 = _
  have hinr := DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0_whiskerLeft
    L K.inr K.inr_isClosed
  change inrWhiskerH0 = cAssoc.hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft L.h0
        (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0 K.inr K.inr_isClosed) ≫
      (DGFunctor.h0CompIso L K.unitCone).inv at hinr
  have hunit := leftAdj.h0_whiskerRight_unit R
  change unitWhiskerH0 ≫ cAssoc.hom =
      (Functor.leftUnitor R.h0).inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight leftAdj.h0Unit R.h0 ≫
          (Functor.associator L.h0 S.h0 R.h0).hom ≫
            Functor.whiskerLeft L.h0 (DGFunctor.h0CompIso S R).inv at hunit
  calc
    _ = unitWhiskerH0 ≫
        (cAssoc.hom ≫
          Functor.whiskerLeft L.h0
            (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0 K.inr K.inr_isClosed) ≫
          (DGFunctor.h0CompIso L K.unitCone).inv) :=
      congrArg (fun τ => unitWhiskerH0 ≫ τ) hinr
    _ = _ := by
      have h := congrArg
        (fun τ => τ ≫
          Functor.whiskerLeft L.h0
            (DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.h0 K.inr K.inr_isClosed) ≫
          (DGFunctor.h0CompIso L K.unitCone).inv) hunit
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using h

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.linearHomMap_f_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma linearHomMap_f_apply {X Y : C} {n : ℤ}
    (h : IsShiftBy X n Y) (W : C) (p : ℤ)
    (f : (dgHom W X).X p) :
    (@ModuleCat.Hom.hom k _
      (ModuleCat.of k ((dgHom W X).X p))
      (ModuleCat.of k ((dgHom W Y).X (p + -n)))
      ((h.linearHomMap (k := k) W).f p)) f =
      dgComp p (-n) (p + -n) rfl f h.hom
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.bijective_linearHomMap
proof:
:=
  h.bijective W p (p + -n) rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.linearHomIso_hom_f_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma linearHomIso_hom_f_apply {X Y : C} {n : ℤ}
    (h : IsShiftBy X n Y) (W : C) (p : ℤ)
    (f : (dgHom W X).X p) :
    (@ModuleCat.Hom.hom k _
      (ModuleCat.of k ((dgHom W X).X p))
      (ModuleCat.of k ((dgHom W Y).X (p + -n)))
      ((h.linearHomIso (k := k) W).hom.f p)) f =
      dgComp p (-n) (p + -n) rfl f h.hom
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.ConePresentation.Hom.ext
statement:
@[ext]
lemma ext {m n : Hom A B}
    (hsource : m.source = n.source)
    (htarget : m.target = n.target)
    (hhomotopy : m.coneMorphism.homotopy = n.coneMorphism.homotopy)
    (hcone : m.coneMorphism.hom.1 = n.coneMorphism.hom.1) :
    m = n
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | mk ms mt mm =>
    cases n with
    | mk ns nt nm =>
      dsimp at hsource htarget hhomotopy hcone
      cases hsource
      cases htarget
      congr 1
      apply IsConeOf.Morphism.ext
      · apply HomotopySquare.ext
        exact hhomotopy
      · exact Subtype.ext hcone

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.ConePresentation.id_source
statement:
@[simp]
lemma id_source (A : ConePresentation C) :
    (CategoryStruct.id A : Hom A A).source = dgId A.source
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.ConePresentation.id_target
statement:
@[simp]
lemma id_target (A : ConePresentation C) :
    (CategoryStruct.id A : Hom A A).target = dgId A.target
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.ConePresentation.comp_source
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_source
    {A B D : ConePresentation C} (m : A ⟶ B) (n : B ⟶ D) :
    (m ≫ n).source = dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) m.source n.source
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.DGCategory.ConePresentation.comp_target
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_target
    {A B D : ConePresentation C} (m : A ⟶ B) (n : B ⟶ D) :
    (m ≫ n).target = dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) m.target n.target
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.fst_inl_add_snd_inr
statement:
lemma fst_inl_add_snd_inr :
    dgComp 1 (-1) 0 (by omega) hc.fst hc.inl +
      dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) hc.snd hc.inr = dgId Z
proof:
:=
  ((hc.bijective Z 0 1 (by omega)).surjective (dgId Z)).choose_spec

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.splitId_unique
proof:
:= by
  have hpair := (hc.bijective Z 0 1 (by omega)).injective
    (a₁ := (a, b)) (a₂ := (hc.fst, hc.snd)) ?_
  · exact ⟨congrArg (fun ab => ab.1) hpair, congrArg (fun ab => ab.2) hpair⟩
  · show dgComp 1 (-1) 0 (by omega) a hc.inl + dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) b hc.inr =
      dgComp 1 (-1) 0 (by omega) hc.fst hc.inl + dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) hc.snd hc.inr
    rw [h, hc.fst_inl_add_snd_inr]

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.delta_splitId_key
statement:
lemma delta_splitId_key :
    dgComp 2 (-1) 1 (by omega) (((dgHom Z X).d 1 2).hom hc.fst) hc.inl =
      dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) (dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) hc.fst f) hc.inr +
        dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) (((dgHom Z Y).d 0 1).hom hc.snd) hc.inr
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg ((dgHom Z Z).d 0 1).hom hc.fst_inl_add_snd_inr
  rw [map_add, dgId_cocycle,
    dgComp_leibniz 1 (-1) 0 1 (by omega) (by omega),
    dgComp_leibniz 0 0 0 1 (by omega) (by omega)] at h
  
  
  
  
  have h' : dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) hc.fst (((dgHom X Z).d (-1) 0).hom hc.inl) +
        (-1 : ℤ).negOnePow •
          dgComp 2 (-1) 1 (by omega) (((dgHom Z X).d 1 2).hom hc.fst) hc.inl +
      (dgComp 0 1 1 (by omega) hc.snd (((dgHom Y Z).d 0 1).hom hc.inr) +
        (0 : ℤ).negOnePow •
          dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) (((dgHom Z Y).d 0 1).hom hc.snd) hc.inr) = 0 := h
  rw [hc.δ_inl, hc.inr_closed,
    ← dgComp_assoc 1 0 0 1 0 1 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)] at h'
  have hneg : (-1 : ℤ).negOnePow = -1 := by decide
  rw [hneg, Int.negOnePow_zero] at h'
  simp only [map_zero, Units.neg_smul, one_smul] at h'
  
  
  have hrw : dgComp 2 (-1) 1 (by omega) (((dgHom Z X).d 1 2).hom hc.fst) hc.inl -
      (dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) (dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) hc.fst f) hc.inr +
        dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) (((dgHom Z Y).d 0 1).hom hc.snd) hc.inr) =
      -(dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) (dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) hc.fst f) hc.inr -
          dgComp 2 (-1) 1 (by omega) (((dgHom Z X).d 1 2).hom hc.fst) hc.inl +
        dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) (((dgHom Z Y).d 0 1).hom hc.snd) hc.inr) := by
    abel
  refine sub_eq_zero.mp ?_
  rw [hrw, neg_eq_zero]
  abel_nf
  abel_nf at h'
  exact h'

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.delta_fst_and_snd
statement:
lemma delta_fst_and_snd : ((dgHom Z X).d 1 2).hom hc.fst = 0 ∧
    ((dgHom Z Y).d 0 1).hom hc.snd = -dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) hc.fst f
proof:
:= by
  have hpair := (hc.bijective Z 1 2 (by omega)).injective
    (a₁ := (((dgHom Z X).d 1 2).hom hc.fst,
      -(dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) hc.fst f + ((dgHom Z Y).d 0 1).hom hc.snd)))
    (a₂ := (0, 0)) ?_
  · refine ⟨congrArg (fun ab => ab.1) hpair, ?_⟩
    have h2 := congrArg (fun ab => ab.2) hpair
    simp only [neg_eq_zero] at h2
    exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h2
  · show dgComp 2 (-1) 1 (by omega) _ hc.inl + dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) _ hc.inr =
      dgComp 2 (-1) 1 (by omega) 0 hc.inl + dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) 0 hc.inr
    rw [hc.delta_splitId_key]
    simp [map_neg, map_add]

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.delta_fst
statement: lemma delta_fst : ((dgHom Z X).d 1 2).hom hc.fst = 0
proof: := hc.delta_fst_and_snd.1

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.delta_snd
statement:
lemma delta_snd :
    ((dgHom Z Y).d 0 1).hom hc.snd = -dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) hc.fst f
proof:
:=
  hc.delta_fst_and_snd.2

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.inr_comp_fst_and_snd
statement:
lemma inr_comp_fst_and_snd :
    dgComp 0 1 1 (by omega) hc.inr hc.fst = 0 ∧
      dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) hc.inr hc.snd = dgId Y
proof:
:= by
  have hpair := (hc.bijective Y 0 1 (by omega)).injective
    (a₁ := (dgComp 0 1 1 (by omega) hc.inr hc.fst, dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) hc.inr hc.snd))
    (a₂ := (0, dgId Y)) ?_
  · exact ⟨congrArg (fun ab => ab.1) hpair, congrArg (fun ab => ab.2) hpair⟩
  · show dgComp 1 (-1) 0 (by omega) _ hc.inl + dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) _ hc.inr =
      dgComp 1 (-1) 0 (by omega) 0 hc.inl + dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) (dgId Y) hc.inr
    rw [dgComp_assoc 0 1 (-1) 1 0 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      dgComp_assoc 0 0 0 0 0 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      ← map_add, hc.fst_inl_add_snd_inr, dgComp_id]
    simp [dgId_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.inl_comp_fst_and_snd
statement:
lemma inl_comp_fst_and_snd :
    dgComp (-1) 1 0 (by omega) hc.inl hc.fst = dgId X ∧
      dgComp (-1) 0 (-1) (by omega) hc.inl hc.snd = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpair := (hc.bijective X (-1) 0 (by omega)).injective
    (a₁ := (dgComp (-1) 1 0 (by omega) hc.inl hc.fst,
      dgComp (-1) 0 (-1) (by omega) hc.inl hc.snd))
    (a₂ := (dgId X, 0)) ?_
  · exact ⟨congrArg (fun ab => ab.1) hpair, congrArg (fun ab => ab.2) hpair⟩
  · show dgComp 0 (-1) (-1) (by omega) _ hc.inl + dgComp (-1) 0 (-1) (by omega) _ hc.inr =
      dgComp 0 (-1) (-1) (by omega) (dgId X) hc.inl +
        dgComp (-1) 0 (-1) (by omega) 0 hc.inr
    rw [dgComp_assoc (-1) 1 (-1) 0 0 (-1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      dgComp_assoc (-1) 0 0 (-1) 0 (-1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      ← map_add, hc.fst_inl_add_snd_inr, dgComp_id]
    simp [dgId_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.inl_comp_fst
statement: lemma inl_comp_fst : dgComp (-1) 1 0 (by omega) hc.inl hc.fst = dgId X
proof:
:=
  hc.inl_comp_fst_and_snd.1

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.inl_comp_snd
statement: lemma inl_comp_snd : dgComp (-1) 0 (-1) (by omega) hc.inl hc.snd = 0
proof:
:=
  hc.inl_comp_fst_and_snd.2

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.inr_comp_fst
statement: lemma inr_comp_fst : dgComp 0 1 1 (by omega) hc.inr hc.fst = 0
proof:
:=
  hc.inr_comp_fst_and_snd.1

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.inr_comp_snd
statement: lemma inr_comp_snd : dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) hc.inr hc.snd = dgId Y
proof:
:=
  hc.inr_comp_fst_and_snd.2

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.toShift_closed
statement: lemma toShift_closed : ((dgHom Z X').d 0 1).hom (hc.toShift s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine dgComp_closed (p := 1) (q := -1) (r := 0) (r' := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    hc.delta_fst ?_
  simpa using s.hom_closed

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.toShift_mem_cocycles
statement: lemma toShift_mem_cocycles : hc.toShift s ∈ cocycles Z X'
proof:
:=
  hc.toShift_closed s

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.toShift_comp_compare
statement:
lemma toShift_comp_compare {X'' : C} (t : IsShiftBy X 1 X'') :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) (hc.toShift s) (IsShiftBy.compare s t) = hc.toShift t
proof:
:= by
  rw [toShift, toShift, IsShiftBy.compare,
    dgComp_assoc 1 (-1) 0 0 (-1) 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    ← dgComp_assoc (-1) 1 (-1) 0 0 (-1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    IsShiftBy.hom_inv, dgId_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.inr_comp_toShift
statement:
lemma inr_comp_toShift :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) hc.inr (hc.toShift s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [toShift, ← dgComp_assoc 0 1 (-1) 1 0 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hc.inr_comp_fst]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.delta_f
statement: lemma delta_f : ((dgHom X Y).d 0 1).hom f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd2 : ((dgHom X Z).d 0 1).hom (dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) f hc.inr) = 0 := by
    rw [← hc.δ_inl, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d]
    simp
  have hleib : ((dgHom X Z).d 0 1).hom (dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) f hc.inr) =
      dgComp 0 1 1 (by omega) f (((dgHom Y Z).d 0 1).hom hc.inr) +
        (0 : ℤ).negOnePow •
          dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) (((dgHom X Y).d 0 1).hom f) hc.inr :=
    dgComp_leibniz (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) 0 0 0 1 (by omega) (by omega) f hc.inr
  rw [hleib, hc.inr_closed, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul] at hd2
  simp only [map_zero, zero_add] at hd2
  have hpair := (hc.bijective X 1 2 (by omega)).injective
    (a₁ := (0, ((dgHom X Y).d 0 1).hom f)) (a₂ := (0, 0)) ?_
  · exact congrArg (fun ab => ab.2) hpair
  · show dgComp 2 (-1) 1 (by omega) 0 hc.inl + dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) _ hc.inr =
      dgComp 2 (-1) 1 (by omega) 0 hc.inl + dgComp 1 0 1 (by omega) 0 hc.inr
    simpa using hd2

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.dgId_mem_coboundaries_of_dgId
statement:
lemma dgId_mem_coboundaries_of_dgId {X Z : C} (hc : IsConeOf (dgId X) Z) :
    dgId Z ∈ coboundaries Z Z
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨dgComp 0 (-1) (-1) (by omega) hc.snd hc.inl, ?_⟩
  
  
  have hleib : ((dgHom Z Z).d (-1) 0).hom
        (dgComp 0 (-1) (-1) (by omega) hc.snd hc.inl) =
      dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) hc.snd (((dgHom X Z).d (-1) 0).hom hc.inl) +
        (-1 : ℤ).negOnePow •
          dgComp 1 (-1) 0 (by omega) (((dgHom Z X).d 0 1).hom hc.snd) hc.inl :=
    dgComp_leibniz (X := Z) (Y := X) (Z := Z) 0 (-1) (-1) 0 (by omega) (by omega)
      hc.snd hc.inl
  have hneg : (-1 : ℤ).negOnePow = -1 := by decide
  rw [hleib, hc.δ_inl, hc.delta_snd, dgComp_id, dgId_comp, hneg]
  simp only [Units.neg_smul, one_smul, map_neg, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply, neg_neg]
  rw [← hc.fst_inl_add_snd_inr]
  abel

name: CategoryTheory.compRight_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compRight_apply (W : C) {X Y : C} {n : ℤ} (ε : (dgHom X Y).X n) (p q : ℤ)
    (h : p + n = q) (f : (dgHom W X).X p) :
    compRight W ε p q h f = dgComp p n q h f ε
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.dgComp_closed
statement:
lemma dgComp_closed {X Y Z : C} {p q r r' : ℤ} (h : p + q = r) (hr : r + 1 = r')
    {f : (dgHom X Y).X p} {g : (dgHom Y Z).X q}
    (hf : ((dgHom X Y).d p (p + 1)).hom f = 0)
    (hg : ((dgHom Y Z).d q (q + 1)).hom g = 0) :
    ((dgHom X Z).d r r').hom (dgComp p q r h f g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dgComp_leibniz p q r r' h hr f g, hf, hg]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.inv_hom
statement:
lemma inv_hom (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) :
    dgComp n (-n) 0 (by omega) s.inv s.hom = dgId Y
proof:
:=
  ((s.bijective Y n 0 (by omega)).surjective (dgId Y)).choose_spec

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.hom_inv
statement:
lemma hom_inv (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) :
    dgComp (-n) n 0 (by omega) s.hom s.inv = dgId X
proof:
:= by
  refine (s.bijective X 0 (-n) (by omega)).injective ?_
  show dgComp 0 (-n) (-n) _ (dgComp (-n) n 0 (by omega) s.hom s.inv) s.hom =
    dgComp 0 (-n) (-n) _ (dgId X) s.hom
  rw [dgComp_assoc (-n) n (-n) 0 0 (-n) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    inv_hom, dgComp_id, dgId_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.inv_closed
statement:
lemma inv_closed (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) :
    ((dgHom Y X).d n (n + 1)).hom s.inv = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key := dgComp_leibniz (C := C) n (-n) 0 1 (by omega) (by omega) s.inv s.hom
  rw [inv_hom, dgId_cocycle, s.hom_closed] at key
  
  
  have key2 : dgComp (n + 1) (-n) 1 (by omega)
      (((dgHom Y X).d n (n + 1)).hom s.inv) s.hom = 0 := by
    simpa [smul_eq_zero_iff_eq] using key.symm
  refine (s.bijective Y (n + 1) 1 (by omega)).injective ?_
  show dgComp (n + 1) (-n) 1 _ (((dgHom Y X).d n (n + 1)).hom s.inv) s.hom =
    dgComp (n + 1) (-n) 1 _ 0 s.hom
  rw [key2, map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.precompEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma precompEquiv_apply (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (W : C)
    (p q : ℤ) (h : n + p = q) (f : (dgHom X W).X p) :
    s.precompEquiv W p q h f = dgComp n p q h s.inv f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.precompEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
lemma precompEquiv_symm_apply (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (W : C)
    (p q : ℤ) (h : n + p = q) (g : (dgHom Y W).X q) :
    (s.precompEquiv W p q h).symm g =
      dgComp (-n) q p (by omega) s.hom g
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.precompEquiv_d
statement:
lemma precompEquiv_d (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (W : C)
    (p q : ℤ) (h : n + p = q) (f : (dgHom X W).X p) :
    ((dgHom Y W).d q (q + 1)).hom (s.precompEquiv W p q h f) =
      s.precompEquiv W (p + 1) (q + 1) (by omega)
        (((dgHom X W).d p (p + 1)).hom f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [precompEquiv_apply, precompEquiv_apply,
    dgComp_leibniz n p q (q + 1) h (by omega) s.inv f,
    s.inv_closed]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.precompEquiv_d_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma precompEquiv_d_eq_zero_iff (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (W : C)
    (p q : ℤ) (h : n + p = q) (f : (dgHom X W).X p) :
    ((dgHom Y W).d q (q + 1)).hom (s.precompEquiv W p q h f) = 0 ↔
      ((dgHom X W).d p (p + 1)).hom f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [s.precompEquiv_d W p q h f]
  exact (s.precompEquiv W (p + 1) (q + 1) (by omega)).map_eq_zero_iff

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.compare_mem_cocycles
statement:
lemma compare_mem_cocycles (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (s' : IsShiftBy X n Y') :
    compare s s' ∈ cocycles Y Y'
proof:
:= by
  have key := dgComp_leibniz (C := C) n (-n) 0 1 (by omega) (by omega) s.inv s'.hom
  rw [mem_cocycles_iff, compare, key, s'.hom_closed, s.inv_closed]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.compare_comp_compare
statement:
lemma compare_comp_compare (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (s' : IsShiftBy X n Y') :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) (compare s s') (compare s' s) = dgId Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [compare, compare,
    dgComp_assoc n (-n) 0 0 (-n) 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    ← dgComp_assoc (-n) n (-n) 0 0 (-n) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hom_inv, dgId_comp, inv_hom]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.compare_self
statement: lemma compare_self (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) : compare s s = dgId Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [compare, inv_hom]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.compare_trans
statement:
lemma compare_trans (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (t : IsShiftBy X n Y')
    (w : IsShiftBy X n Y'') :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) (compare s t) (compare t w) = compare s w
proof:
:= by
  rw [compare, compare, compare,
    dgComp_assoc n (-n) 0 0 (-n) 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    ← dgComp_assoc (-n) n (-n) 0 0 (-n) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hom_inv, dgId_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.comp_eq_comp'
statement:
lemma comp_eq_comp' (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (u : IsShiftBy Y m Z) :
    comp s u = comp' s u (n + m) rfl
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.comp'_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp'_hom (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (u : IsShiftBy Y m Z) (nm : ℤ) (hnm : n + m = nm) :
    (comp' s u nm hnm).hom = dgComp (-n) (-m) (-nm) (by omega) s.hom u.hom
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.comp_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_hom (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (u : IsShiftBy Y m Z) :
    (comp s u).hom = dgComp (-n) (-m) (-(n + m)) (by omega) s.hom u.hom
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.inv_unique
statement:
lemma inv_unique (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) {a : (dgHom Y X).X n}
    (ha : dgComp n (-n) 0 (by omega) a s.hom = dgId Y) : a = s.inv
proof:
:= by
  refine (s.bijective Y n 0 (by omega)).injective ?_
  show dgComp n (-n) 0 _ a s.hom = dgComp n (-n) 0 _ s.inv s.hom
  rw [ha, inv_hom]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.comp'_inv
statement:
lemma comp'_inv (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (u : IsShiftBy Y m Z) (nm : ℤ) (hnm : n + m = nm) :
    dgComp m n nm (by omega) u.inv s.inv = (comp' s u nm hnm).inv
proof:
:= by
  refine inv_unique _ ?_
  show dgComp nm (-nm) 0 _ (dgComp m n nm (by omega) u.inv s.inv)
    (dgComp (-n) (-m) (-nm) (by omega) s.hom u.hom) = dgId Z
  rw [dgComp_assoc m n (-nm) nm (-m) 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    ← dgComp_assoc n (-n) (-m) 0 (-nm) (-m) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    inv_hom, dgId_comp, inv_hom]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.comp_inv
statement:
lemma comp_inv (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (u : IsShiftBy Y m Z) :
    dgComp m n (n + m) (by omega) u.inv s.inv = (comp s u).inv
proof:
:=
  comp'_inv s u (n + m) rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.comp'_self_left_inv
statement:
lemma comp'_self_left_inv (u : IsShiftBy X m Z) (h : 0 + m = m) :
    (comp' (self X) u m h).inv = u.inv
proof:
:= by
  refine (inv_unique _ ?_).symm
  
  
  show dgComp m (-m) 0 _ u.inv (dgComp 0 (-m) (-m) (by omega) (dgId X) u.hom) = dgId Z
  rw [dgId_comp, inv_hom]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.comp'_self_right_inv
statement:
lemma comp'_self_right_inv (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (h : n + 0 = n) :
    (comp' s (self Y) n h).inv = s.inv
proof:
:= by
  refine (inv_unique _ ?_).symm
  show dgComp n (-n) 0 _ s.inv (dgComp (-n) 0 (-n) (by omega) s.hom (dgId Y)) = dgId Y
  rw [dgComp_id, inv_hom]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.mapShift_mem_cocycles
statement:
lemma mapShift_mem_cocycles (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (s' : IsShiftBy X' n Y')
    {f : (dgHom X X').X 0} (hf : f ∈ cocycles X X') :
    mapShift s s' f ∈ cocycles Y Y'
proof:
:=
  dgComp_closed (by omega) (by omega)
    (dgComp_closed (by omega) (by omega) s.inv_closed hf) s'.hom_closed

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.mapShift_id
statement: lemma mapShift_id (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) : mapShift s s (dgId X) = dgId Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapShift, dgComp_id, inv_hom]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.mapShift_comp
statement:
lemma mapShift_comp (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (s' : IsShiftBy X' n Y')
    (s'' : IsShiftBy X'' n Y'') (f : (dgHom X X').X 0) (g : (dgHom X' X'').X 0) :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) (mapShift s s' f) (mapShift s' s'' g) =
      mapShift s s'' (dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) f g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapShift, mapShift, mapShift,
    dgComp_assoc n (-n) 0 0 (-n) 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    ← dgComp_assoc (-n) n (-n) 0 0 (-n) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    ← dgComp_assoc (-n) n 0 0 n 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hom_inv, dgId_comp,
    ← dgComp_assoc n 0 (-n) n (-n) 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    dgComp_assoc n 0 0 n 0 n (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.compare_eq_mapShift
statement:
lemma compare_eq_mapShift (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (s' : IsShiftBy X n Y') :
    compare s s' = mapShift s s' (dgId X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [compare, mapShift, dgComp_id]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.mapShift_add
statement:
lemma mapShift_add (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (s' : IsShiftBy X' n Y')
    (f g : (dgHom X X').X 0) :
    mapShift s s' (f + g) = mapShift s s' f + mapShift s s' g
proof:
:= by
  simp [mapShift, map_add]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.mapShift_mem_coboundaries
statement:
lemma mapShift_mem_coboundaries (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (s' : IsShiftBy X' n Y')
    {f : (dgHom X X').X 0} (hf : f ∈ coboundaries X X') :
    mapShift s s' f ∈ coboundaries Y Y'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m : ℤ, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  refine ⟨(-(m + 1)).negOnePow • dgComp m (-(m + 1)) (-1) (by omega)
    (dgComp (m + 1) (-1) m (by omega) s.inv h) s'.hom, ?_⟩
  rw [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]
  
  rw [dgComp_leibniz m (-(m + 1)) (-1) 0 (by omega) (by omega)
    (dgComp (m + 1) (-1) m (by omega) s.inv h) s'.hom, s'.hom_closed]
  
  rw [dgComp_leibniz (m + 1) (-1) m (m + 1) (by omega) (by omega) s.inv h,
    s.inv_closed]
  simp only [map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, smul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
  rw [mapShift, ← Units.smul_def, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
  
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.mapShiftHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mapShiftHom_apply (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (s' : IsShiftBy X' n Y')
    (f : (dgHom X X').X 0) : mapShiftHom s s' f = mapShift s s' f
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.mapShift_compare
statement:
lemma mapShift_compare (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (t : IsShiftBy X n Y'')
    (s' : IsShiftBy X' n Y') (t' : IsShiftBy X' n Y''') (f : (dgHom X X').X 0) :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) (mapShift s s' f) (compare s' t') =
      dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) (compare s t) (mapShift t t' f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [compare_eq_mapShift, compare_eq_mapShift, mapShift_comp, mapShift_comp,
    dgComp_id, dgId_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.self_inv
statement: lemma self_inv (X : C) : (self X).inv = dgId X
proof:
:=
  (dgComp_id 0 (self X).inv).symm.trans (self X).inv_hom

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.mapShift_self
statement:
lemma mapShift_self (X X' : C) (f : (dgHom X X').X 0) :
    mapShift (self X) (self X') f = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapShift, self_inv]
  exact (congrArg (fun z => dgComp 0 (-0) 0 (by omega) z (dgId X')) (dgId_comp 0 f)).trans
    (dgComp_id 0 f)

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.mapShift_unique
statement:
lemma mapShift_unique (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (s' : IsShiftBy X' n Y')
    (f : (dgHom X X').X 0) (c : (dgHom Y Y').X 0)
    (h : dgComp (-n) 0 (-n) (by omega) s.hom c =
      dgComp 0 (-n) (-n) (by omega) f s'.hom) :
    mapShift s s' f = c
proof:
:= by
  have hc : dgComp n (-n) 0 (by omega) s.inv (dgComp (-n) 0 (-n) (by omega) s.hom c) = c := by
    rw [← dgComp_assoc n (-n) 0 0 (-n) 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega), inv_hom, dgId_comp]
  have hm : mapShift s s' f =
      dgComp n (-n) 0 (by omega) s.inv (dgComp 0 (-n) (-n) (by omega) f s'.hom) :=
    dgComp_assoc n 0 (-n) n (-n) 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) s.inv f s'.hom
  rw [hm, ← h, hc]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.compare_unique
statement:
lemma compare_unique {Y' : C} (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (t : IsShiftBy X n Y')
    (c : (dgHom Y Y').X 0)
    (h : dgComp (-n) 0 (-n) (by omega) s.hom c = t.hom) : compare s t = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [compare_eq_mapShift]
  refine mapShift_unique s t _ c ?_
  rw [h, dgId_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.mapShift_comp'_shift
statement:
lemma mapShift_comp'_shift (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (u : IsShiftBy Y m Z)
    (s' : IsShiftBy X' n Y') (u' : IsShiftBy Y' m Z') (nm : ℤ) (hnm : n + m = nm)
    (f : (dgHom X X').X 0) :
    mapShift (comp' s u nm hnm) (comp' s' u' nm hnm) f = mapShift u u' (mapShift s s' f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mapShift, comp'_hom]
  rw [← comp'_inv s u nm hnm,
    dgComp_assoc m n 0 nm n nm (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    dgComp_assoc m n (-nm) nm (-m) 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    ← dgComp_assoc n (-n) (-m) 0 (-nm) (-m) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    ← dgComp_assoc m 0 (-m) m (-m) 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.mapShift_comp_shift
statement:
lemma mapShift_comp_shift (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (u : IsShiftBy Y m Z)
    (s' : IsShiftBy X' n Y') (u' : IsShiftBy Y' m Z') (f : (dgHom X X').X 0) :
    mapShift (comp s u) (comp s' u') f = mapShift u u' (mapShift s s' f)
proof:
:=
  mapShift_comp'_shift s u s' u' (n + m) rfl f

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.mapShift_compare_comp'
statement:
lemma mapShift_compare_comp' (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (t : IsShiftBy X n Y')
    (u : IsShiftBy Y m Z) (u' : IsShiftBy Y' m Z') (nm : ℤ) (hnm : n + m = nm) :
    mapShift u u' (compare s t) = compare (comp' s u nm hnm) (comp' t u' nm hnm)
proof:
:= by
  rw [compare_eq_mapShift s t,
    compare_eq_mapShift (comp' s u nm hnm) (comp' t u' nm hnm),
    mapShift_comp'_shift]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.mapShift_compare_comp
statement:
lemma mapShift_compare_comp (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (t : IsShiftBy X n Y')
    (u : IsShiftBy Y m Z) (u' : IsShiftBy Y' m Z') :
    mapShift u u' (compare s t) = compare (comp s u) (comp t u')
proof:
:=
  mapShift_compare_comp' s t u u' (n + m) rfl

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.compare_congr
statement:
lemma compare_congr {n : ℤ} (s : IsShiftBy X n Y) (t t' : IsShiftBy X n Y')
    (h : t.hom = t'.hom) : compare s t = compare s t'
proof:
:= by
  rw [compare, compare, h]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.compare_congr_left
statement:
lemma compare_congr_left {n : ℤ} (s s' : IsShiftBy X n Y) (t : IsShiftBy X n Y')
    (h : s.hom = s'.hom) : compare s t = compare s' t
proof:
:= by
  apply compare_unique s t
  rw [h, compare]
  rw [← dgComp_assoc (-n) n (-n) 0 0 (-n) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    s'.hom_inv, dgId_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.comp'_assoc_hom
statement:
lemma comp'_assoc_hom (s : IsShiftBy X a Y) (u : IsShiftBy Y b Z) (w : IsShiftBy Z d W)
    (ab bd abd : ℤ) (hab : a + b = ab) (hbd : b + d = bd) (habd : ab + d = abd) :
    (comp' (comp' s u ab hab) w abd habd).hom =
      (comp' s (comp' u w bd hbd) abd (by omega)).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [comp'_hom]
  exact dgComp_assoc (-a) (-b) (-d) (-ab) (-bd) (-abd) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
    s.hom u.hom w.hom

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.compare_comp'_right
statement:
lemma compare_comp'_right {k : ℤ} (s : IsShiftBy X k Y') (t : IsShiftBy X a Y)
    (v : IsShiftBy Y b Z) (v' : IsShiftBy Y b Z') (hk : a + b = k) :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) (compare s (comp' t v k hk)) (compare v v') =
      compare s (comp' t v' k hk)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compare, comp'_hom]
  rw [dgComp_assoc k (-k) 0 0 (-k) 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    dgComp_assoc (-a) (-b) 0 (-k) (-b) (-k) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    ← dgComp_assoc (-b) b (-b) 0 0 (-b) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    hom_inv, dgId_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.comp_inr_mem_coboundaries
statement:
lemma comp_inr_mem_coboundaries (hc : IsConeOf f Z) :
    dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) f hc.inr ∈ coboundaries X Z
proof:
:=
  ⟨hc.inl, hc.δ_inl⟩

name: CategoryTheory.IsConeOf.inr_mem_cocycles
statement: lemma inr_mem_cocycles (hc : IsConeOf f Z) : hc.inr ∈ cocycles Y Z
proof:
:=
  hc.inr_closed

name: CategoryTheory.dgComp_units_smul_left
statement:
lemma dgComp_units_smul_left {W X Y : C} (p q r : ℤ) (h : p + q = r)
    (c : ℤˣ) (f : (dgHom W X).X p) (g : (dgHom X Y).X q) :
    dgComp p q r h (c • f) g = c • dgComp p q r h f g
proof:
:= by
  simp [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: CategoryTheory.dgComp_units_smul_right
statement:
lemma dgComp_units_smul_right {W X Y : C} (p q r : ℤ) (h : p + q = r)
    (c : ℤˣ) (f : (dgHom W X).X p) (g : (dgHom X Y).X q) :
    dgComp p q r h f (c • g) = c • dgComp p q r h f g
proof:
:= by
  simp [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.hom_comp_shiftMap
statement:
lemma hom_comp_shiftMap (s : IsShiftBy A n A') (s' : IsShiftBy B n B')
    (p m : ℤ) (hm : -n + p = m) (hm' : p + -n = m)
    (f : (dgHom A B).X p) :
    dgComp (-n) p m hm s.hom (s.shiftMap s' p f) =
      dgComp p (-n) m hm' f s'.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftMap,
    ← dgComp_assoc (-n) (n + p) (-n) p p m (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    ← dgComp_assoc (-n) n p 0 (n + p) p (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    s.hom_inv, dgId_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.shiftMap_unique
statement:
lemma shiftMap_unique (s : IsShiftBy A n A') (s' : IsShiftBy B n B')
    (p m : ℤ) (hm : -n + p = m) (hm' : p + -n = m)
    (f : (dgHom A B).X p) (c : (dgHom A' B').X p)
    (h : dgComp (-n) p m hm s.hom c = dgComp p (-n) m hm' f s'.hom) :
    s.shiftMap s' p f = c
proof:
:= by
  have hcancel : ∀ d : (dgHom A' B').X p,
      dgComp n m p (by omega) s.inv (dgComp (-n) p m hm s.hom d) = d := by
    intro d
    rw [← dgComp_assoc n (-n) p 0 m p (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      s.inv_hom, dgId_comp]
  rw [← hcancel (s.shiftMap s' p f), ← hcancel c,
    s.hom_comp_shiftMap s' p m hm hm' f, h]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.shiftMap_add
statement:
lemma shiftMap_add (s : IsShiftBy A n A') (s' : IsShiftBy B n B') (p : ℤ)
    (f g : (dgHom A B).X p) :
    s.shiftMap s' p (f + g) = s.shiftMap s' p f + s.shiftMap s' p g
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftMap, map_add]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.shiftMap_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma shiftMap_zero (s : IsShiftBy A n A') (s' : IsShiftBy B n B') (p : ℤ) :
    s.shiftMap s' p 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftMap]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.shiftMap_units_smul
statement:
lemma shiftMap_units_smul (s : IsShiftBy A n A') (s' : IsShiftBy B n B') (p : ℤ)
    (c : ℤˣ) (f : (dgHom A B).X p) :
    s.shiftMap s' p (c • f) = c • s.shiftMap s' p f
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftMap, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.shiftMap_id
statement:
lemma shiftMap_id (s : IsShiftBy A n A') :
    s.shiftMap s 0 (dgId A) = dgId A'
proof:
:= by
  refine s.shiftMap_unique s 0 (-n) (by omega) (by omega) (dgId A) (dgId A') ?_
  rw [dgComp_id, dgId_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.shiftMap_comp
statement:
lemma shiftMap_comp (s : IsShiftBy A n A') (s' : IsShiftBy B n B')
    (s'' : IsShiftBy E n E') (p q r : ℤ) (h : p + q = r)
    (f : (dgHom A B).X p) (g : (dgHom B E).X q) :
    s.shiftMap s'' r (dgComp p q r h f g) =
      dgComp p q r h (s.shiftMap s' p f) (s'.shiftMap s'' q g)
proof:
:= by
  refine s.shiftMap_unique s'' r (-n + r) (by omega) (by omega) _ _ ?_
  rw [← dgComp_assoc (-n) p q (-n + p) r (-n + r)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    s.hom_comp_shiftMap s' p (-n + p) (by omega) (by omega) f,
    dgComp_assoc p (-n) q (-n + p) (-n + q) (-n + r)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    s'.hom_comp_shiftMap s'' q (-n + q) (by omega) (by omega) g,
    ← dgComp_assoc p q (-n) r (-n + q) (-n + r)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.shiftMap_comp_inv
statement:
lemma shiftMap_comp_inv (s : IsShiftBy A n A') (s' : IsShiftBy B n B')
    (p m : ℤ) (hm : p + n = m) (hm' : n + p = m)
    (f : (dgHom A B).X p) :
    dgComp p n m hm (s.shiftMap s' p f) s'.inv =
      dgComp n p m hm' s.inv f
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have hmn : m = n + p := by omega
  cases hmn
  rw [shiftMap,
    dgComp_assoc (n + p) (-n) n p 0 (n + p) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    s'.hom_inv, dgComp_id]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.shiftMap_d
statement:
lemma shiftMap_d (s : IsShiftBy A n A') (s' : IsShiftBy B n B') (p : ℤ)
    (f : (dgHom A B).X p) :
    ((dgHom A' B').d p (p + 1)).hom (s.shiftMap s' p f) =
      n.negOnePow •
        s.shiftMap s' (p + 1) (((dgHom A B).d p (p + 1)).hom f)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have hleft := dgComp_leibniz (C := C) (-n) p (-n + p) (-n + p + 1)
    (by omega) (by omega) s.hom (s.shiftMap s' p f)
  have hright := dgComp_leibniz (C := C) p (-n) (-n + p) (-n + p + 1)
    (by omega) (by omega) f s'.hom
  have hsq : ((dgHom A B').d (-n + p) (-n + p + 1)).hom
        (dgComp (-n) p (-n + p) (by omega) s.hom (s.shiftMap s' p f)) =
      ((dgHom A B').d (-n + p) (-n + p + 1)).hom
        (dgComp p (-n) (-n + p) (by omega) f s'.hom) := by
    rw [s.hom_comp_shiftMap s' p (-n + p) (by omega) (by omega) f]
  rw [hleft, hright, s.hom_closed, s'.hom_closed] at hsq
  simp only [map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, smul_zero, add_zero,
    zero_add] at hsq
  rw [Int.negOnePow_neg] at hsq
  
  have huniq : s.shiftMap s' (p + 1) (((dgHom A B).d p (p + 1)).hom f) =
      n.negOnePow • ((dgHom A' B').d p (p + 1)).hom (s.shiftMap s' p f) := by
    refine s.shiftMap_unique s' (p + 1) (-n + p + 1) (by omega) (by omega) _ _ ?_
    rw [dgComp_units_smul_right, hsq, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
  rw [huniq, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.comp_inv_naturality
statement:
lemma comp_inv_naturality (s : IsShiftBy A n A') (t : IsShiftBy B n B')
    {V V' : C} (q p r m rq : ℤ) (hp : q + n = p) (hrq : r + q = rq)
    (hm : r + p = m) (hm' : p + r = m)
    (w : (dgHom V V').X r) (α : (dgHom V A').X q) (β : (dgHom V' B').X q)
    (g : (dgHom A B).X r)
    (hnat : dgComp r q rq hrq w β =
      (q * r).negOnePow • dgComp q r rq (by omega) α
        ((n * r).negOnePow • s.shiftMap t r g)) :
    dgComp r p m hm w (dgComp q n p hp β t.inv) =
      (p * r).negOnePow • dgComp p r m hm' (dgComp q n p hp α s.inv) g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dgComp_assoc r q n rq p m (by omega) (by omega) (by omega), hnat]
  simp only [dgComp_units_smul_left, dgComp_units_smul_right, smul_smul,
    ← Int.negOnePow_add]
  rw [dgComp_assoc q r n rq (r + n) m (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    s.shiftMap_comp_inv t r (r + n) (by omega) (by omega) g,
    ← dgComp_assoc q n r p (r + n) m (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    show q * r + n * r = p * r by rw [← hp]; ring]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.comp_inv_comp_hom
statement:
lemma comp_inv_comp_hom (s : IsShiftBy A n A') {V : C} (q p : ℤ)
    (hp : q + n = p) (hq : p + -n = q) (α : (dgHom V A').X q) :
    dgComp p (-n) q hq (dgComp q n p hp α s.inv) s.hom = α
proof:
:= by
  rw [dgComp_assoc q n (-n) p 0 q (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    s.inv_hom, dgComp_id]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.hom_comp_compare
statement:
lemma hom_comp_compare {A'' : C} (s : IsShiftBy A n A') (t : IsShiftBy A n A'') :
    dgComp (-n) 0 (-n) (by omega) s.hom (compare s t) = t.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [compare,
    ← dgComp_assoc (-n) n (-n) 0 0 (-n) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    s.hom_inv, dgId_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.shiftMap_compare
statement:
lemma shiftMap_compare {A'' B'' : C} (s : IsShiftBy A n A')
    (t : IsShiftBy A n A'') (s' : IsShiftBy B n B') (t' : IsShiftBy B n B'')
    (p : ℤ) (f : (dgHom A B).X p) :
    dgComp p 0 p (by omega) (s.shiftMap s' p f) (compare s' t') =
      dgComp 0 p p (by omega) (compare s t) (t.shiftMap t' p f)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : s.shiftMap t' p f =
      dgComp p 0 p (by omega) (s.shiftMap s' p f) (compare s' t') := by
    refine s.shiftMap_unique t' p (-n + p) (by omega) (by omega) f _ ?_
    rw [← dgComp_assoc (-n) p 0 (-n + p) p (-n + p)
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      s.hom_comp_shiftMap s' p (-n + p) (by omega) (by omega) f,
      dgComp_assoc p (-n) 0 (-n + p) (-n) (-n + p)
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      s'.hom_comp_compare t']
  have hright : s.shiftMap t' p f =
      dgComp 0 p p (by omega) (compare s t) (t.shiftMap t' p f) := by
    refine s.shiftMap_unique t' p (-n + p) (by omega) (by omega) f _ ?_
    rw [← dgComp_assoc (-n) 0 p (-n) p (-n + p)
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
      s.hom_comp_compare t,
      t.hom_comp_shiftMap t' p (-n + p) (by omega) (by omega) f]
  rw [← hleft, ← hright]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.comp'_shiftMap
statement:
lemma comp'_shiftMap {E E'' : C} {m : ℤ} (s : IsShiftBy A n A')
    (u : IsShiftBy A' m E) (s' : IsShiftBy B n B') (u' : IsShiftBy B' m E'')
    (nm : ℤ) (hnm : n + m = nm) (p : ℤ) (f : (dgHom A B).X p) :
    (s.comp' u nm hnm).shiftMap (s'.comp' u' nm hnm) p f =
      u.shiftMap u' p (s.shiftMap s' p f)
proof:
:= by
  refine (s.comp' u nm hnm).shiftMap_unique (s'.comp' u' nm hnm) p (-nm + p)
    (by omega) (by omega) f _ ?_
  rw [comp'_hom, comp'_hom,
    dgComp_assoc (-n) (-m) p (-nm) (-m + p) (-nm + p)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    u.hom_comp_shiftMap u' p (-m + p) (by omega) (by omega) (s.shiftMap s' p f),
    ← dgComp_assoc (-n) p (-m) (-n + p) (-m + p) (-nm + p)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    s.hom_comp_shiftMap s' p (-n + p) (by omega) (by omega) f,
    dgComp_assoc p (-n) (-m) (-n + p) (-nm) (-nm + p)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.comp'_shiftMap_smul
statement:
lemma comp'_shiftMap_smul {E E'' : C} {m : ℤ} (s : IsShiftBy A n A')
    (u : IsShiftBy A' m E) (s' : IsShiftBy B n B') (u' : IsShiftBy B' m E'')
    (nm : ℤ) (hnm : n + m = nm) (p : ℤ) (f : (dgHom A B).X p) :
    (m * p).negOnePow • u.shiftMap u' p ((n * p).negOnePow • s.shiftMap s' p f) =
      (nm * p).negOnePow • (s.comp' u nm hnm).shiftMap (s'.comp' u' nm hnm) p f
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftMap_units_smul, smul_smul, ← Int.negOnePow_add,
    show m * p + n * p = nm * p by rw [← hnm]; ring,
    comp'_shiftMap s u s' u' nm hnm p f]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.shiftMap_compare_compOfDegree
statement:
lemma shiftMap_compare_compOfDegree {A'' E'' : C} {m nm : ℤ}
    (s : IsShiftBy A n A') (t : IsShiftBy A n A'')
    (u : IsShiftBy A' m E) (v : IsShiftBy A'' m E'')
    (hnm : n + m = nm) :
    u.shiftMap v 0 (compare s t) =
      compare (s.comp' u nm hnm) (t.comp' v nm hnm)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  refine (s.comp' u nm hnm).compare_unique (t.comp' v nm hnm) _ ?_
  rw [comp'_hom, comp'_hom,
    dgComp_assoc (-n) (-m) 0 (-nm) (-m) (-nm)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    u.hom_comp_shiftMap v 0 (-m) (by omega) (by omega) (compare s t),
    ← dgComp_assoc (-n) 0 (-m) (-n) (-m) (-nm)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    s.hom_comp_compare t]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.compare_compLeftOfDegree
statement:
lemma compare_compLeftOfDegree {Z Z' : C} {m nm : ℤ}
    (s : IsShiftBy A n A') (u : IsShiftBy A' m Z)
    (v : IsShiftBy A' m Z') (hnm : n + m = nm) :
    compare (s.comp' u nm hnm) (s.comp' v nm hnm) = compare u v
proof:
:= by
  refine (s.comp' u nm hnm).compare_unique (s.comp' v nm hnm) _ ?_
  rw [comp'_hom, comp'_hom,
    dgComp_assoc (-n) (-m) 0 (-nm) (-m) (-nm)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    u.hom_comp_compare v]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.shiftMap_zero_eq_mapShift
statement:
lemma shiftMap_zero_eq_mapShift (s : IsShiftBy A n A') (s' : IsShiftBy B n B')
    (f : (dgHom A B).X 0) :
    s.shiftMap s' 0 f = mapShift s s' f
proof:
:= by
  refine s.shiftMap_unique s' 0 (-n) (by omega) (by omega) f _ ?_
  rw [mapShift,
    ← dgComp_assoc (-n) n (-n) 0 0 (-n) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    ← dgComp_assoc (-n) n 0 0 n 0 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
    s.hom_inv, dgId_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.shiftMap_self
statement:
lemma shiftMap_self (p : ℤ) (f : (dgHom A B).X p) :
    (IsShiftBy.self A).shiftMap (IsShiftBy.self B) p f = f
proof:
:= by
  refine (IsShiftBy.self A).shiftMap_unique (IsShiftBy.self B) p p
    (by omega) (by omega) f f ?_
  
  
  exact (dgId_comp p f).trans (dgComp_id p f).symm

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.ConeData.naturalitySquare
statement:
private lemma naturalitySquare {X Y : C} (p : ℤ)
    (f : (dgHom X Y).X p) :
    dgComp 0 p p (by omega) (app α X) (G.map p f) =
      dgComp p 0 p (by omega) (F.map p f) (app α Y)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  simpa only [zero_mul, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul] using
    naturality α p p (by omega) (by omega) f

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.ConeData.functor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem functor_obj (X : C) : K.functor.obj X = K.obj X
proof:
:=

        dgComp 0 0 0 (by omega) K.snd K.inr =

  intro X
  change dgComp 1 (-1) 0 (by omega)

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.ConeData.isConeOf_lift_app
statement:
private lemma isConeOf_lift_app {F' G' : DGFunctor C D}
    {α' : HomogeneousNatTrans F' G' 0} (K' : ConeData α')
    (u : HomogeneousNatTrans F F' 0) (v : HomogeneousNatTrans G G' 0)
    (X : C) :
    HomogeneousNatTrans.app (K.isConeOf.lift K'.isConeOf u v 0) X =
      (K.isCone X).lift (K'.isCone X)
        (HomogeneousNatTrans.app u X) (HomogeneousNatTrans.app v X) 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (K'.isCone X).homogeneous_ext 0
  · have h := congrArg (fun θ => HomogeneousNatTrans.app θ X)
      (K.isConeOf.lift_comp_fst K'.isConeOf u v 0)
    rw [K'.isConeOf_fst, K.isConeOf_fst] at h
    change HomogeneousNatTrans.app
        (HomogeneousNatTrans.composition K.functor K'.functor F'
          0 1 1 (by omega) (K.isConeOf.lift K'.isConeOf u v 0) K'.fst) X =
      HomogeneousNatTrans.app
        (HomogeneousNatTrans.composition K.functor F F'
          1 0 1 (by omega) K.fst u) X at h
    rw [HomogeneousNatTrans.composition_apply_app,
      HomogeneousNatTrans.composition_apply_app, fst_app, fst_app] at h
    exact h.trans ((K.isCone X).lift_comp_fst
      (K'.isCone X) (HomogeneousNatTrans.app u X)
      (HomogeneousNatTrans.app v X) 0).symm
  · have h := congrArg (fun θ => HomogeneousNatTrans.app θ X)
      (K.isConeOf.homogeneousLift_comp_snd K'.isConeOf 0 u v)
    rw [K'.isConeOf_snd, K.isConeOf_snd] at h
    change HomogeneousNatTrans.app
        (HomogeneousNatTrans.composition K.functor K'.functor G'
          0 0 0 (by omega) (K.isConeOf.lift K'.isConeOf u v 0) K'.snd) X =
      HomogeneousNatTrans.app
        (HomogeneousNatTrans.composition K.functor G G'
          0 0 0 (by omega) K.snd v) X at h
    rw [HomogeneousNatTrans.composition_apply_app,
      HomogeneousNatTrans.composition_apply_app, snd_app, snd_app] at h
    exact h.trans ((K.isCone X).homogeneousLift_comp_snd
      (K'.isCone X) 0 (HomogeneousNatTrans.app u X)
      (HomogeneousNatTrans.app v X)).symm

name: CategoryTheory.IsShiftBy.homologyLinearEquiv_homologyπ_cyclesMk
statement:
lemma homologyLinearEquiv_homologyπ_cyclesMk {Y Yn : C} {n : ℤ}
    (s : IsShiftBy Y n Yn) (X : C) (f : (dgHom X Y).X n)
    (hf : ((dgHom X Y).d n (n + 1)).hom f = 0) :
    s.homologyLinearEquiv (k := k) X
        (((DGLinear.homComplex k X Y).homologyπ n).hom
          ((DGLinear.homComplex k X Y).cyclesMk f (n + 1) (by simp) hf)) =
      H0.homMk
        ⟨dgComp n (-n) 0 (by omega) f s.hom,
          dgComp_closed (by omega) (by omega) hf s.hom_closed⟩
proof:
:= by
  let K := DGLinear.homComplex k X Y
  let L := DGLinear.homComplex k X Yn
  let φ := s.linearHomMap (k := k) X
  let Q := L⟦-n⟧
  let z := K.cyclesMk f (n + 1) (by simp) hf
  let g : L.X 0 := dgComp n (-n) 0 (by omega) f s.hom
  let gQ : Q.X n := (φ.f n).hom f
  have hg : (L.d 0 1).hom g = 0 :=
    dgComp_closed (by omega) (by omega) hf s.hom_closed
  have hgQ : (Q.d n (n + 1)).hom gQ = 0 := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, φ.comm n (n + 1),
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    change (φ.f (n + 1)).hom (((dgHom X Y).d n (n + 1)).hom f) = 0
    rw [hf, map_zero]
  let zQ := Q.cyclesMk gQ (n + 1) (by simp) hgQ
  let zL := L.cyclesMk g 1 (by simp) hg
  have hzi : (K.iCycles n).hom z = f := by
    dsimp only [z]
    exact K.i_cyclesMk f (n + 1) (by simp) hf
  have hzQi : (Q.iCycles n).hom zQ = gQ := by
    dsimp only [zQ]
    exact Q.i_cyclesMk gQ (n + 1) (by simp) hgQ
  have hzLi : (L.iCycles 0).hom zL = g := by
    dsimp only [zL]
    exact L.i_cyclesMk g 1 (by simp) hg
  have hcyclesMap :
      (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap φ n).hom z = zQ := by
    apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (Q.iCycles n)).1 inferInstance
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    rw [hzi, hzQi]
  have hhomologyMap :
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ n).hom ((K.homologyπ n).hom z) =
        (Q.homologyπ n).hom zQ := by
    calc
      _ = (Q.homologyπ n).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap φ n).hom z) :=
        ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
          (HomologicalComplex.homologyπ_naturality φ n) z
      _ = _ := congrArg (Q.homologyπ n).hom hcyclesMap
  let ψ : Q.sc n ⟶ L.sc 0 := (CochainComplex.shiftShortComplexFunctorIso
    (ModuleCat.{v} k) (-n) n 0 (by omega)).hom.app L
  have htransport (r : ℤ) (hr : n + -n = r) :
      (show ((DGLinear.homComplex k X Yn).sc r).X₂ from
        ((DGLinear.homComplex k X Yn).XIsoOfEq hr).hom.hom
          (dgComp n (-n) (n + -n) rfl f s.hom)) =
        (show ((DGLinear.homComplex k X Yn).sc r).X₂ from
          dgComp n (-n) r hr f s.hom) := by
    subst r
    rfl
  have hshiftCycles :
      (ShortComplex.cyclesMap ψ).hom zQ = zL := by
    apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (L.sc 0).iCycles).1 inferInstance
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ShortComplex.cyclesMap_i,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    change ψ.τ₂.hom ((Q.iCycles n).hom zQ) = (L.iCycles 0).hom zL
    rw [hzQi, hzLi]
    dsimp only [ψ, gQ, g, φ, Q, L]
    rw [CochainComplex.shiftShortComplexFunctorIso_hom_app_τ₂]
    change
      (show ((DGLinear.homComplex k X Yn).sc 0).X₂ from
        ((DGLinear.homComplex k X Yn).XIsoOfEq (by omega)).hom.hom
          (dgComp n (-n) (n + -n) rfl f s.hom)) =
        (show ((DGLinear.homComplex k X Yn).sc 0).X₂ from
          dgComp n (-n) 0 (by omega) f s.hom)
    exact htransport 0 (by omega)
  have hshift :
      ((CochainComplex.ShiftSequence.shiftIso (ModuleCat.{v} k)
        (-n) n 0 (by omega)).hom.app L).hom ((Q.homologyπ n).hom zQ) =
        (L.homologyπ 0).hom zL := by
    rw [CochainComplex.ShiftSequence.shiftIso_hom_app]
    change (ShortComplex.homologyMap ψ).hom ((Q.homologyπ n).hom zQ) = _
    calc
      _ = (L.homologyπ 0).hom ((ShortComplex.cyclesMap ψ).hom zQ) :=
        ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (ShortComplex.homologyπ_naturality ψ) zQ
      _ = _ := congrArg (L.homologyπ 0).hom hshiftCycles
  change H0.homologyZeroLinearEquiv (k := k) X Yn
      (((CochainComplex.ShiftSequence.shiftIso (ModuleCat.{v} k)
        (-n) n 0 (by omega)).hom.app L).hom
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso
          (s.linearHomIso (k := k) X) n).hom.hom ((K.homologyπ n).hom z))) = _
  rw [show
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso (s.linearHomIso (k := k) X) n).hom.hom
          ((K.homologyπ n).hom z) = (Q.homologyπ n).hom zQ by
        exact hhomologyMap,
    hshift]
  exact H0.homologyZeroLinearEquiv_homologyπ_cyclesMk X Yn g hg
