    intro u w huw
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hint u
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hint w
    have hmk : (m : ℝ) ≠ (k : ℝ) := by rw [← hm, ← hk]; exact hne
    have hcontOn : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc u w) := hg.continuousOn
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hmk with hlt | hlt
    · 
      have hle : (m : ℝ) + 1 / 2 ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
        have : m < k := by exact_mod_cast hlt
        have : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast this
        linarith
      have hmem : (m : ℝ) + 1 / 2 ∈ Set.Icc (g u) (g w) := by
        rw [hm, hk]; constructor <;> linarith
      obtain ⟨ψ, _, hψ⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc huw hcontOn hmem
      exact hhalf m ψ hψ
    · 
      have hle : (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2 ≤ (m : ℝ) := by
        have : k < m := by exact_mod_cast hlt
        have : (k : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast this
        linarith
      have hmem : (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2 ∈ Set.Icc (g w) (g u) := by
        rw [hm, hk]; constructor <;> linarith
      obtain ⟨ψ, _, hψ⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' huw hcontOn hmem
      exact hhalf k ψ hψ
  rcases le_total a b with h | h
  · exact step a b h
  · exact (step b a h).symm

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.exists_deckShift_of_mat_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_deckShift_of_mat_eq_one (x : GLTilde) (hx : x.mat = 1) :
    ∃ n : ℤ, x.shift = deckShift n
proof:
:= by
  set f := x.shift.toOrderIso with hf
  
  have hstep : ∀ φ : ℝ, ∃ n : ℤ, f φ = φ + 2 * n := by
    intro φ
    have hcompat := x.compat φ
    rw [hx, toMat_one, Matrix.one_mulVec] at hcompat
    have := rayVec_eq_of_onRay hcompat
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (rayVec_eq_iff φ (f φ)).mp this
    exact ⟨-n, by push_cast; linarith⟩
  
  have hcont : Continuous fun φ : ℝ => (f φ - φ) / 2 :=
    ((f.continuous).sub continuous_id).div_const 2
  have hint : ∀ φ : ℝ, ∃ n : ℤ, (f φ - φ) / 2 = (n : ℝ) := by
    intro φ; obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hstep φ; exact ⟨n, by rw [hn]; ring⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hint 0
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  ext φ
  have := const_of_intValued hcont hint φ 0
  rw [hn] at this
  have : f φ - φ = 2 * n := by linarith [this]
  simp only [deckShift_apply, ← hf]
  linarith

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.deckHom_injective
statement: theorem deckHom_injective : Function.Injective deckHom
proof:
:= by
  intro m n h
  have h0 := congrArg (fun x : GLTilde => x.shift.toOrderIso 0) h
  simp only [deckHom, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, deck_shift, deckShift_apply,
    zero_add] at h0
  have hz : ((Multiplicative.toAdd m : ℤ) : ℝ) = ((Multiplicative.toAdd n : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    linarith
  exact Multiplicative.toAdd.injective (by exact_mod_cast hz)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.range_deckHom_eq_ker
statement: theorem range_deckHom_eq_ker : deckHom.range = GLTilde.toMatHom.ker
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [MonoidHom.mem_range, MonoidHom.mem_ker]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
    rfl
  · intro hx
    have hmat : x.mat = 1 := hx
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_deckShift_of_mat_eq_one x hmat
    exact ⟨Multiplicative.ofAdd n, GLTilde.ext' hmat.symm hn.symm⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.cexpI_re
statement: @[simp] theorem cexpI_re (x : ℝ) : (cexpI x).re = Real.cos x
proof:
:=
  Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re x

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.cexpI_im
statement: @[simp] theorem cexpI_im (x : ℝ) : (cexpI x).im = Real.sin x
proof:
:=
  Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im x

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.cexpI_add
statement: theorem cexpI_add (x y : ℝ) : cexpI (x + y) = cexpI x * cexpI y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cexpI, Complex.ofReal_add, add_mul, Complex.exp_add]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.norm_cexpI
statement: @[simp] theorem norm_cexpI (x : ℝ) : ‖cexpI x‖ = 1
proof:
:=
  Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I x

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.cexpI_ne_zero
statement: theorem cexpI_ne_zero (x : ℝ) : cexpI x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h; have := norm_cexpI x; rw [h] at this; simp at this

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.cplxCoord_cexpI
statement: theorem cplxCoord_cexpI (φ : ℝ) : cplxCoord (cexpI (π * φ)) = rayVec φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [cplxCoord_apply]; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [rayVec]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.mulVec_rayVec_eq
statement:
theorem mulVec_rayVec_eq (φ : ℝ) :
    toMat T *ᵥ rayVec φ
      = cplxCoord (cA T * cexpI (π * φ) + cB T * cexpI (-(π * φ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [cplxCoord_apply]
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [rayVec, cA, cB, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg] <;> ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.normSq_cA_sub_normSq_cB
statement:
theorem normSq_cA_sub_normSq_cB :
    normSq (cA T) - normSq (cB T) = (toMat T).det
proof:
:= by
  simp [Complex.normSq_apply, cA, cB, Matrix.det_fin_two]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.det_toMat_pos
statement: theorem det_toMat_pos : 0 < (toMat T).det

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.normSq_cB_lt_normSq_cA
statement: theorem normSq_cB_lt_normSq_cA : normSq (cB T) < normSq (cA T)
proof:
:= by
  have := normSq_cA_sub_normSq_cB T
  have := det_toMat_pos T
  linarith

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.cA_ne_zero
statement: theorem cA_ne_zero : cA T ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hlt := normSq_cB_lt_normSq_cA T
  rw [h, Complex.normSq_zero] at hlt
  exact absurd (Complex.normSq_nonneg (cB T)) (by linarith)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.norm_cB_lt_norm_cA
statement: theorem norm_cB_lt_norm_cA : ‖cB T‖ < ‖cA T‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := normSq_cB_lt_normSq_cA T
  rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] at h
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (cA T), norm_nonneg (cB T)]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.norm_ratio_lt_one
statement: theorem norm_ratio_lt_one : ‖ratio T‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hA : 0 < ‖cA T‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (cA_ne_zero T)
  rw [ratio, norm_div, div_lt_one hA]
  exact norm_cB_lt_norm_cA T

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.Wmap_re_pos
statement: theorem Wmap_re_pos (φ : ℝ) : 0 < (Wmap T φ).re
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : ‖ratio T * cexpI (-(2 * π * φ))‖ = ‖ratio T‖ := by
    rw [norm_mul, norm_cexpI, mul_one]
  have hre : |(ratio T * cexpI (-(2 * π * φ))).re| ≤ ‖ratio T‖ := by
    rw [← hnorm]; exact Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
  have := norm_ratio_lt_one T
  have habs := abs_le.mp hre
  simp only [Wmap, Complex.add_re, Complex.one_re]
  linarith [habs.1]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.Wmap_ne_zero
statement: theorem Wmap_ne_zero (φ : ℝ) : Wmap T φ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := Wmap_re_pos T φ
  rw [h] at this
  simp at this

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.cexpI_neg_two_pi
statement: theorem cexpI_neg_two_pi : cexpI (-(2 * π)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cexpI]
  rw [show ((-(2 * π) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I = -(2 * ↑π * Complex.I) by push_cast; ring,
    Complex.exp_neg, Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I, inv_one]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.Wmap_add_one
statement: theorem Wmap_add_one (φ : ℝ) : Wmap T (φ + 1) = Wmap T φ
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : -(2 * π * (φ + 1)) = -(2 * π * φ) + -(2 * π) := by ring
  rw [Wmap, Wmap, hsplit, cexpI_add, cexpI_neg_two_pi, mul_one]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.pi_mul_lift
statement:
theorem pi_mul_lift (φ : ℝ) :
    π * lift T φ = π * φ + (cA T).arg + (Wmap T φ).arg
proof:
:= by
  have hπ : (π : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero
  simp only [lift]
  field_simp

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.mulVec_rayVec_lift
statement:
theorem mulVec_rayVec_lift (φ : ℝ) :
    toMat T *ᵥ rayVec φ = (‖cA T‖ * ‖Wmap T φ‖) • rayVec (lift T φ)
proof:
:= by
  have hfactor : cA T * cexpI (π * φ) + cB T * cexpI (-(π * φ))
      = cexpI (π * φ) * cA T * Wmap T φ := by
    have hinv : cexpI (-(π * φ)) = cexpI (π * φ) * cexpI (-(2 * π * φ)) := by
      rw [← cexpI_add]; congr 1; ring
    rw [Wmap, ratio, hinv]
    field_simp [cA_ne_zero T]
  have hpolarA : (‖cA T‖ : ℂ) * cexpI (cA T).arg = cA T :=
    Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (cA T)
  have hpolarW : (‖Wmap T φ‖ : ℂ) * cexpI (Wmap T φ).arg = Wmap T φ :=
    Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (Wmap T φ)
  have hcomplex : cA T * cexpI (π * φ) + cB T * cexpI (-(π * φ))
      = ((‖cA T‖ * ‖Wmap T φ‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) * cexpI (π * lift T φ) := by
    rw [hfactor, pi_mul_lift, cexpI_add, cexpI_add]
    calc cexpI (π * φ) * cA T * Wmap T φ
        = cexpI (π * φ) * ((‖cA T‖ : ℂ) * cexpI (cA T).arg)
            * ((‖Wmap T φ‖ : ℂ) * cexpI (Wmap T φ).arg) := by
          rw [hpolarA, hpolarW]
      _ = ((‖cA T‖ * ‖Wmap T φ‖ : ℝ) : ℂ)
            * (cexpI (π * φ) * cexpI (cA T).arg * cexpI (Wmap T φ).arg) := by
          push_cast; ring
  rw [mulVec_rayVec_eq, hcomplex]
  rw [show (((‖cA T‖ * ‖Wmap T φ‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) * cexpI (π * lift T φ))
      = (‖cA T‖ * ‖Wmap T φ‖ : ℝ) • cexpI (π * lift T φ) from (Complex.real_smul ..).symm]
  rw [map_smul, cplxCoord_cexpI]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.lift_scale_pos
statement: theorem lift_scale_pos (φ : ℝ) : 0 < ‖cA T‖ * ‖Wmap T φ‖
proof:
:=
  mul_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr (cA_ne_zero T)) (norm_pos_iff.mpr (Wmap_ne_zero T φ))

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.compatible_lift
statement:
theorem compatible_lift (φ : ℝ) :
    OnRay (toMat T *ᵥ rayVec φ) (rayVec (lift T φ))
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, lift_scale_pos T φ, mulVec_rayVec_lift T φ⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.lift_add_one
statement: theorem lift_add_one (φ : ℝ) : lift T (φ + 1) = lift T φ + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lift, Wmap_add_one]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.cross_rayVec
statement:
theorem cross_rayVec (φ ψ : ℝ) :
    cross (rayVec φ) (rayVec ψ) = Real.sin (π * (ψ - φ))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, rayVec, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
  rw [show π * (ψ - φ) = π * ψ - π * φ by ring, Real.sin_sub]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.cross_mulVec
statement:
theorem cross_mulVec (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (v w : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    cross (M *ᵥ v) (M *ᵥ w) = M.det * cross v w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.det_fin_two]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.cross_smul
statement:
theorem cross_smul (a b : ℝ) (v w : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    cross (a • v) (b • w) = a * b * cross v w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.abs_arg_Wmap_lt
statement: theorem abs_arg_Wmap_lt (φ : ℝ) : |(Wmap T φ).arg| < π / 2
proof:
:=
  Complex.abs_arg_lt_pi_div_two_iff.mpr (Or.inl (Wmap_re_pos T φ))

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.sin_pos_unique
statement:
private theorem sin_pos_unique {x : ℝ} (hx : -1 < x) (hx2 : x < 2)
    (hsin : 0 < Real.sin (π * x)) : 0 < x ∧ x < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hπ := Real.pi_pos
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases le_or_gt x 0 with hle | hpos
    · exfalso
      
      have h1 : 0 ≤ -(π * x) := by nlinarith
      have h2 : -(π * x) ≤ π := by nlinarith
      have hnn := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi h1 h2
      rw [Real.sin_neg] at hnn
      linarith
    · exact hpos
  · rcases lt_or_ge x 1 with hlt | hge
    · exact hlt
    · exfalso
      
      have h1 : 0 ≤ π * x - π := by nlinarith
      have h2 : π * x - π ≤ π := by nlinarith
      have hnn := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi h1 h2
      have hkey : Real.sin (π * x) = -Real.sin (π * x - π) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [show π * x = (π * x - π) + π by ring]
        rw [Real.sin_add_pi]
      rw [hkey] at hsin
      linarith

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.lift_lt_lift_of_lt_of_sub_lt_one
statement:
theorem lift_lt_lift_of_lt_of_sub_lt_one {φ ψ : ℝ} (h1 : φ < ψ) (h2 : ψ - φ < 1) :
    lift T φ < lift T ψ
proof:
:= by
  
  have hsin : 0 < Real.sin (π * (ψ - φ)) := by
    apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi <;> nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have himg : 0 < cross (toMat T *ᵥ rayVec φ) (toMat T *ᵥ rayVec ψ) := by
    rw [cross_mulVec, cross_rayVec]
    exact mul_pos (det_toMat_pos T) hsin
  
  rw [mulVec_rayVec_lift, mulVec_rayVec_lift, cross_smul, cross_rayVec] at himg
  have hscale : 0 < (‖cA T‖ * ‖Wmap T φ‖) * (‖cA T‖ * ‖Wmap T ψ‖) :=
    mul_pos (lift_scale_pos T φ) (lift_scale_pos T ψ)
  have hsin2 : 0 < Real.sin (π * (lift T ψ - lift T φ)) := by
    rcases le_or_gt (Real.sin (π * (lift T ψ - lift T φ))) 0 with hle | hpos
    · nlinarith [himg, hscale]
    · exact hpos
  
  have hbound : -1 < lift T ψ - lift T φ ∧ lift T ψ - lift T φ < 2 := by
    have ha := abs_lt.mp (abs_arg_Wmap_lt T φ)
    have hb := abs_lt.mp (abs_arg_Wmap_lt T ψ)
    have hπ : 0 < π := Real.pi_pos
    have hdiff : lift T ψ - lift T φ
        = (ψ - φ) + ((Wmap T ψ).arg - (Wmap T φ).arg) / π := by
      simp only [lift]; field_simp; ring
    rw [hdiff]
    constructor
    · have : ((Wmap T ψ).arg - (Wmap T φ).arg) / π > -1 := by
        rw [gt_iff_lt, lt_div_iff₀ hπ]; linarith [ha.2, hb.1]
      linarith
    · have : ((Wmap T ψ).arg - (Wmap T φ).arg) / π < 1 := by
        rw [div_lt_one hπ]; linarith [ha.1, hb.2]
      linarith
  have := sin_pos_unique hbound.1 hbound.2 hsin2
  linarith [this.1]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.lift_add_nat
statement: theorem lift_add_nat (φ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : lift T (φ + n) = lift T φ + n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have : φ + (k + 1 : ℕ) = (φ + k) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
    rw [this, lift_add_one, ih]
    push_cast; ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.lift_lt_of_sub_lt_nat
statement:
private theorem lift_lt_of_sub_lt_nat (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ φ ψ : ℝ, φ < ψ → ψ - φ < n → lift T φ < lift T ψ
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro φ ψ h1 h2; simp only [Nat.cast_zero] at h2; linarith
  | succ k ih =>
    intro φ ψ h1 h2
    rcases lt_or_ge (ψ - φ) 1 with hsmall | hbig
    · exact lift_lt_lift_of_lt_of_sub_lt_one T h1 hsmall
    · 
      have hstep : lift T φ < lift T (φ + 1) := by rw [lift_add_one]; linarith
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (by linarith : φ + 1 ≤ ψ) with heq | hlt
      · rwa [heq] at hstep
      · refine hstep.trans (ih (φ + 1) ψ hlt ?_)
        push_cast at h2
        linarith

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.lift_strictMono
statement: theorem lift_strictMono : StrictMono (lift T)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ ψ hlt
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (ψ - φ)
  exact lift_lt_of_sub_lt_nat T n φ ψ hlt hn

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.lift_continuous
statement: theorem lift_continuous : Continuous (lift T)
proof:
:= by
  have hW : Continuous (Wmap T) := by
    apply continuous_const.add
    exact continuous_const.mul
      (Complex.continuous_exp.comp (by fun_prop))
  refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun φ => ?_
  refine (continuousAt_id.add continuousAt_const).add ?_
  exact ((Complex.continuousAt_arg
    (Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl (Wmap_re_pos T φ)))).comp
      hW.continuousAt).div_const π

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.lift_surjective
statement: theorem lift_surjective : Function.Surjective (lift T)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (|y - lift T 0| + 1)
  have hup : y < lift T ((0 : ℝ) + n) := by
    rw [lift_add_nat]
    have := le_abs_self (y - lift T 0)
    linarith
  have hdown : lift T ((0 : ℝ) - n) < y := by
    have hkey : lift T ((0 : ℝ) - n) + n = lift T 0 := by
      have : ((0 : ℝ) - n) + n = 0 := by ring
      rw [← lift_add_nat T ((0:ℝ) - n) n, this]
    have := neg_abs_le (y - lift T 0)
    linarith
  have hle : (0 : ℝ) - n ≤ (0 : ℝ) + n := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    linarith
  have hmem : y ∈ Set.Icc (lift T ((0:ℝ) - n)) (lift T ((0:ℝ) + n)) :=
    ⟨hdown.le, hup.le⟩
  obtain ⟨φ, _, hφ⟩ :=
    intermediate_value_Icc hle (lift_continuous T).continuousOn hmem
  exact ⟨φ, hφ⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.liftShift_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem liftShift_apply (φ : ℝ) : (liftShift T).toOrderIso φ = lift T φ
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.compatible_liftShift
statement: theorem compatible_liftShift : Compatible T (liftShift T)
proof: := compatible_lift T

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.toMatHom_surjective
statement: theorem toMatHom_surjective : Function.Surjective GLTilde.toMatHom
proof:
:=
  fun T => ⟨⟨T, liftShift T, compatible_liftShift T⟩, rfl⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.sect_mat
statement: @[simp] theorem sect_mat (T : Matrix.GLPos (Fin 2) ℝ) : (sect T).mat = T
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.toMatHom_comp_sect
statement:
theorem toMatHom_comp_sect (T : Matrix.GLPos (Fin 2) ℝ) :
    GLTilde.toMatHom (sect T) = T
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.deck_injective
statement: theorem deck_injective : Function.Injective deck
proof:
:= by
  intro m n h
  have : deckHom (Multiplicative.ofAdd m) = deckHom (Multiplicative.ofAdd n) := h
  simpa using deckHom_injective this

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.existsUnique_deck_mul_sect
statement:
theorem existsUnique_deck_mul_sect (x : GLTilde) :
    ∃! n : ℤ, x = deck n * sect x.mat
proof:
:= by
  have hker : x * (sect x.mat)⁻¹ ∈ GLTilde.toMatHom.ker := by
    simp only [MonoidHom.mem_ker, map_mul, map_inv, toMatHom_comp_sect]
    show x.mat * x.mat⁻¹ = 1
    exact mul_inv_cancel _
  rw [← range_deckHom_eq_ker] at hker
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hker
  refine ⟨Multiplicative.toAdd m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show x = deck (Multiplicative.toAdd m) * sect x.mat
    have hd : deck (Multiplicative.toAdd m) = x * (sect x.mat)⁻¹ := hm
    rw [hd, inv_mul_cancel_right]
  · intro n hn
    refine deck_injective ?_
    
    have h1 : x * (sect x.mat)⁻¹ = deck n := mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul.mpr hn
    have h2 : deck (Multiplicative.toAdd m) = x * (sect x.mat)⁻¹ := hm
    rw [h2, h1]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.exact_deckHom_toMatHom
statement:
theorem exact_deckHom_toMatHom :
    Function.Injective deckHom
      ∧ deckHom.range = GLTilde.toMatHom.ker
      ∧ Function.Surjective GLTilde.toMatHom
proof:
:=
  ⟨deckHom_injective, range_deckHom_eq_ker, toMatHom_surjective⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.circleMatrix_det
statement:
@[simp]
theorem circleMatrix_det (z : Circle) : (circleMatrix z).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hz := Circle.normSq_coe z
  simpa [circleMatrix, Matrix.det_fin_two_of, Complex.normSq_apply] using hz

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.circleMatrix_mul_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem circleMatrix_mul_inv (z : Circle) : circleMatrix z * circleMatrixInv z = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (z : ℂ).re * (z : ℂ).re + (z : ℂ).im * (z : ℂ).im = 1 := by
    simpa [Complex.normSq_apply] using Circle.normSq_coe z
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [circleMatrix, circleMatrixInv, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;>
    nlinarith [hz]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.circleMatrix_inv_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem circleMatrix_inv_mul (z : Circle) : circleMatrixInv z * circleMatrix z = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (z : ℂ).re * (z : ℂ).re + (z : ℂ).im * (z : ℂ).im = 1 := by
    simpa [Complex.normSq_apply] using Circle.normSq_coe z
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [circleMatrix, circleMatrixInv, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;>
    nlinarith [hz]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.circleGLPos_mat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem circleGLPos_mat (z : Circle) : toMat (circleGLPos z) = circleMatrix z
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.firstColumnComplex_ne_zero
statement:
theorem firstColumnComplex_ne_zero (T : Matrix.GLPos (Fin 2) ℝ) :
    firstColumnComplex T ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
  have him := congrArg Complex.im h
  simp [firstColumnComplex] at hre him
  have hdet := T.2
  change 0 < (toMat T).det at hdet
  rw [Matrix.det_fin_two] at hdet
  simp [hre, him] at hdet

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.firstColumnDirection_re
statement:
@[simp]
theorem firstColumnDirection_re (T : Matrix.GLPos (Fin 2) ℝ) :
    ((firstColumnDirection T : Circle) : ℂ).re =
      toMat T 0 0 / (firstColumnRadius T : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ((firstColumnDirection T : Circle) : ℂ) =
      ((‖firstColumnComplex T‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * firstColumnComplex T by rfl]
  change (((‖firstColumnComplex T‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * firstColumnComplex T).re =
    toMat T 0 0 / ‖firstColumnComplex T‖
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero,
    firstColumnComplex]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.firstColumnDirection_im
statement:
@[simp]
theorem firstColumnDirection_im (T : Matrix.GLPos (Fin 2) ℝ) :
    ((firstColumnDirection T : Circle) : ℂ).im =
      toMat T 1 0 / (firstColumnRadius T : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ((firstColumnDirection T : Circle) : ℂ) =
      ((‖firstColumnComplex T‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * firstColumnComplex T by rfl]
  change (((‖firstColumnComplex T‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * firstColumnComplex T).im =
    toMat T 1 0 / ‖firstColumnComplex T‖
  simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero,
    firstColumnComplex]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.secondColumnPerp_pos
statement: theorem secondColumnPerp_pos (T : Matrix.GLPos (Fin 2) ℝ) : 0 < secondColumnPerp T
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < (firstColumnRadius T : ℝ) := (firstColumnRadius T).2
  have hdet := T.2
  change 0 < (toMat T).det at hdet
  rw [Matrix.det_fin_two] at hdet
  rw [secondColumnPerp, firstColumnDirection_re, firstColumnDirection_im,
    div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  have : -((toMat T 1 0 * toMat T 0 1) / (firstColumnRadius T : ℝ)) +
      (toMat T 0 0 * toMat T 1 1) / (firstColumnRadius T : ℝ) =
      (toMat T 0 0 * toMat T 1 1 - toMat T 0 1 * toMat T 1 0) /
        (firstColumnRadius T : ℝ) := by ring
  rw [this]
  exact div_pos hdet hr

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.glPosOfCoordinates_mat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem glPosOfCoordinates_mat (c : GLPosCoordinates) :
    toMat (glPosOfCoordinates c) = circleMatrix c.1 *
      upperMatrix c.2.1 c.2.2.1 c.2.2.2
proof:
:= by
  simp [glPosOfCoordinates, toMat_mul]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.norm_firstColumn_glPosOfCoordinates
statement:
private theorem norm_firstColumn_glPosOfCoordinates (c : GLPosCoordinates) :
    ‖firstColumnComplex (glPosOfCoordinates c)‖ = (c.2.1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨z, r, b, d⟩
  rw [show firstColumnComplex (glPosOfCoordinates (z, r, b, d)) =
      (r : ℂ) * (z : ℂ) by
    apply Complex.ext <;>
      simp [firstColumnComplex, glPosOfCoordinates_mat, circleMatrix, upperMatrix,
        Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring]
  have hr : 0 < (r : ℝ) := r.2
  change ‖(r : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)‖ = (r : ℝ)
  rw [norm_mul, norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr.le, Circle.norm_coe, mul_one]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.firstColumnDirection_glPosOfCoordinates
statement:
@[simp]
theorem firstColumnDirection_glPosOfCoordinates (c : GLPosCoordinates) :
    firstColumnDirection (glPosOfCoordinates c) = c.1
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨z, r, b, d⟩
  apply Circle.ext
  rw [show ((firstColumnDirection (glPosOfCoordinates (z, r, b, d)) : Circle) : ℂ) =
      ((‖firstColumnComplex (glPosOfCoordinates (z, r, b, d))‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        firstColumnComplex (glPosOfCoordinates (z, r, b, d)) by rfl]
  rw [show firstColumnComplex (glPosOfCoordinates (z, r, b, d)) =
      (r : ℂ) * (z : ℂ) by
    apply Complex.ext <;>
      simp [firstColumnComplex, glPosOfCoordinates_mat, circleMatrix, upperMatrix,
        Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring]
  have hr : 0 < (r : ℝ) := r.2
  rw [show ‖(r : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)‖ = (r : ℝ) by
    rw [norm_mul, norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr.le, Circle.norm_coe, mul_one]]
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← Complex.ofReal_mul]
  simp [ne_of_gt hr]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.secondColumnAlong_glPosOfCoordinates
statement:
@[simp]
theorem secondColumnAlong_glPosOfCoordinates (c : GLPosCoordinates) :
    secondColumnAlong (glPosOfCoordinates c) = c.2.2.1
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨z, r, b, d⟩
  have hz : (z : ℂ).re * (z : ℂ).re + (z : ℂ).im * (z : ℂ).im = 1 := by
    simpa [Complex.normSq_apply] using Circle.normSq_coe z
  rw [secondColumnAlong, firstColumnDirection_glPosOfCoordinates]
  simp [glPosOfCoordinates_mat, circleMatrix, upperMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Fin.sum_univ_two]
  calc
    (z : ℂ).re * ((z : ℂ).re * b - (z : ℂ).im * (d : ℝ)) +
        (z : ℂ).im * ((z : ℂ).im * b + (z : ℂ).re * d) =
      ((z : ℂ).re * (z : ℂ).re + (z : ℂ).im * (z : ℂ).im) * b := by ring
    _ = b := by rw [hz]; ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.secondColumnPerp_glPosOfCoordinates
statement:
@[simp]
theorem secondColumnPerp_glPosOfCoordinates (c : GLPosCoordinates) :
    secondColumnPerp (glPosOfCoordinates c) = c.2.2.2
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨z, r, b, d⟩
  have hz : (z : ℂ).re * (z : ℂ).re + (z : ℂ).im * (z : ℂ).im = 1 := by
    simpa [Complex.normSq_apply] using Circle.normSq_coe z
  rw [secondColumnPerp, firstColumnDirection_glPosOfCoordinates]
  simp [glPosOfCoordinates_mat, circleMatrix, upperMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Fin.sum_univ_two]
  calc
    -((z : ℂ).im * ((z : ℂ).re * b - (z : ℂ).im * (d : ℝ))) +
        (z : ℂ).re * ((z : ℂ).im * b + (z : ℂ).re * d) =
      ((z : ℂ).re * (z : ℂ).re + (z : ℂ).im * (z : ℂ).im) * d := by ring
    _ = d := by rw [hz]; ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.glPosCoordinates_ofCoordinates
statement:
@[simp]
theorem glPosCoordinates_ofCoordinates (c : GLPosCoordinates) :
    glPosCoordinates (glPosOfCoordinates c) = c
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨z, r, b, d⟩
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact firstColumnDirection_glPosOfCoordinates _
  · apply Prod.ext
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact norm_firstColumn_glPosOfCoordinates _
    · apply Prod.ext
      · exact secondColumnAlong_glPosOfCoordinates _
      · apply Subtype.ext
        exact secondColumnPerp_glPosOfCoordinates _

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.glPosOfCoordinates_coordinates
statement:
theorem glPosOfCoordinates_coordinates (T : Matrix.GLPos (Fin 2) ℝ) :
    glPosOfCoordinates (glPosCoordinates T) = T
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < (firstColumnRadius T : ℝ) := (firstColumnRadius T).2
  have hr0 : (firstColumnRadius T : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr
  have hnorm : (firstColumnRadius T : ℝ) ^ 2 =
      toMat T 0 0 ^ 2 + toMat T 1 0 ^ 2 := by
    simp [firstColumnRadius, firstColumnComplex, Complex.sq_norm]
    ring
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Units.ext
  change toMat (glPosOfCoordinates (glPosCoordinates T)) = toMat T
  rw [glPosOfCoordinates_mat]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · simp [glPosCoordinates, circleMatrix, upperMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      firstColumnDirection_re, hr0]
  · simp [glPosCoordinates, circleMatrix, upperMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      secondColumnAlong, secondColumnPerp, firstColumnDirection_re,
      firstColumnDirection_im]
    field_simp [hr0]
    rw [hnorm]
    ring
  · simp [glPosCoordinates, circleMatrix, upperMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      firstColumnDirection_im, hr0]
  · simp [glPosCoordinates, circleMatrix, upperMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      secondColumnAlong, secondColumnPerp, firstColumnDirection_re,
      firstColumnDirection_im]
    field_simp [hr0]
    rw [hnorm]
    ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.continuous_toMatGLPos
statement:
theorem continuous_toMatGLPos :
    Continuous (toMat : Matrix.GLPos (Fin 2) ℝ → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
proof:
:=
  Units.continuous_val.comp continuous_subtype_val

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.continuous_firstColumnComplex
statement: private theorem continuous_firstColumnComplex : Continuous firstColumnComplex
proof:
:= by
  have h : Continuous fun T : Matrix.GLPos (Fin 2) ℝ =>
      (toMat T 0 0, toMat T 1 0) :=
    (continuous_apply 0 |>.comp (continuous_apply 0 |>.comp continuous_toMatGLPos)).prodMk
      (continuous_apply 0 |>.comp (continuous_apply 1 |>.comp continuous_toMatGLPos))
  convert Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm.continuous.comp h using 1
  funext T
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp [firstColumnComplex, Complex.equivRealProdCLM_symm_apply]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.continuous_firstColumnDirection
statement: private theorem continuous_firstColumnDirection : Continuous firstColumnDirection
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  have hInv : Continuous fun T : Matrix.GLPos (Fin 2) ℝ => ‖firstColumnComplex T‖⁻¹ :=
    (continuous_norm.comp continuous_firstColumnComplex).inv₀
      (fun T ↦ norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (firstColumnComplex_ne_zero T))
  exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hInv).mul continuous_firstColumnComplex

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.continuous_glPosCoordinates
statement: private theorem continuous_glPosCoordinates : Continuous glPosCoordinates
proof:
:= by
  have hz : Continuous fun T : Matrix.GLPos (Fin 2) ℝ =>
      ((firstColumnDirection T : Circle) : ℂ) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_firstColumnDirection
  apply Continuous.prodMk continuous_firstColumnDirection
  apply Continuous.prodMk
  · exact Continuous.subtype_mk (continuous_norm.comp continuous_firstColumnComplex) _
  apply Continuous.prodMk
  · exact ((Complex.continuous_re.comp hz).mul
      (continuous_apply 1 |>.comp (continuous_apply 0 |>.comp continuous_toMatGLPos))).add
      ((Complex.continuous_im.comp hz).mul
        (continuous_apply 1 |>.comp (continuous_apply 1 |>.comp continuous_toMatGLPos)))
  · apply Continuous.subtype_mk
    · exact ((Complex.continuous_im.comp hz).mul
        (continuous_apply 1 |>.comp (continuous_apply 0 |>.comp continuous_toMatGLPos))).neg.add
        ((Complex.continuous_re.comp hz).mul
          (continuous_apply 1 |>.comp (continuous_apply 1 |>.comp continuous_toMatGLPos)))

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.continuous_glPosOfCoordinates
statement: private theorem continuous_glPosOfCoordinates : Continuous glPosOfCoordinates
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_induced_rng, Units.continuous_iff]
  constructor
  · change Continuous fun c : GLPosCoordinates => toMat (glPosOfCoordinates c)
    simp only [glPosOfCoordinates_mat]
    apply Continuous.matrix_mul
    · apply continuous_matrix
      intro i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [circleMatrix] <;> fun_prop
    · apply continuous_matrix
      intro i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [upperMatrix] <;> fun_prop
  · have hr : Continuous fun c : GLPosCoordinates => ((c.2.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd)).inv₀
        (fun c => ne_of_gt c.2.1.2))
    have hd : Continuous fun c : GLPosCoordinates => ((c.2.2.2 : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp
        (continuous_snd.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd))).inv₀
          (fun c => ne_of_gt c.2.2.2.2))
    apply continuous_matrix
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [glPosOfCoordinates, circleGLPos, circleMatrixInv, upperGLPos, upperMatrixInv,
        Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;>
      fun_prop

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.phaseCircle_isCoveringMap
statement: theorem phaseCircle_isCoveringMap : IsCoveringMap phaseCircle
proof:
:= by
  have h := Circle.isCoveringMap_exp.comp_homeomorph
    (Homeomorph.mulLeft₀ Real.pi Real.pi_ne_zero)
  change IsCoveringMap (fun θ : ℝ ↦ Circle.exp (Real.pi * θ))
  simpa [Function.comp_def, Homeomorph.coe_mulLeft₀] using h

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.coordinateProjection_isCoveringMap
statement: theorem coordinateProjection_isCoveringMap : IsCoveringMap coordinateProjection
proof:
:= by
  exact isCoveringMap_prodMap_id phaseCircle_isCoveringMap

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.phaseCircle_coe
statement:
theorem phaseCircle_coe (θ : ℝ) : ((phaseCircle θ : Circle) : ℂ) =
    Real.cos (Real.pi * θ) + Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) * I
proof:
:= by
  change Complex.exp ((Real.pi * θ : ℝ) * I) =
    Real.cos (Real.pi * θ) + Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) * I
  rw [Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.circleMatrix_phaseCircle
statement:
@[simp]
theorem circleMatrix_phaseCircle (θ : ℝ) :
    circleMatrix (phaseCircle θ) = rotationMatrix θ
proof:
:= by
  have hre : ((phaseCircle θ : Circle) : ℂ).re = Real.cos (Real.pi * θ) := by
    change (Complex.exp (((Real.pi * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)).re = Real.cos (Real.pi * θ)
    exact Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re _
  have him : ((phaseCircle θ : Circle) : ℂ).im = Real.sin (Real.pi * θ) := by
    change (Complex.exp (((Real.pi * θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)).im = Real.sin (Real.pi * θ)
    exact Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im _
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [circleMatrix, rotationMatrix, hre, him]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.glPosOfCoordinates_coordinateProjection
statement:
theorem glPosOfCoordinates_coordinateProjection (c : GLTildeCoordinates) :
    glPosOfCoordinates (coordinateProjection c) = (glTildeOfCoordinates c).mat
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Units.ext
  change toMat (glPosOfCoordinates (coordinateProjection c)) =
    toMat (glTildeOfCoordinates c).mat
  rw [glPosOfCoordinates_mat, glTildeOfCoordinates_mat]
  simp [coordinateProjection, matrixOfCoordinates, Prod.map]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.coordinateProjection_apply_glTildeCoordinates
statement:
theorem coordinateProjection_apply_glTildeCoordinates (x : GLTilde) :
    coordinateProjection (glTildeCoordinateHomeomorph x) =
      glPosCoordinateHomeomorph x.mat
proof:
:= by
  apply glPosCoordinateHomeomorph.symm.injective
  rw [glPosCoordinateHomeomorph.symm_apply_apply]
  change glPosOfCoordinates (coordinateProjection (glTildeCoordinates x)) = x.mat
  rw [glPosOfCoordinates_coordinateProjection]
  exact congrArg GLTilde.mat (glTildeOfCoordinates_coordinates x)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.GLTilde.isCoveringMap_toMat
statement: theorem GLTilde.isCoveringMap_toMat : IsCoveringMap GLTilde.mat
proof:
:= by
  have h := (coordinateProjection_isCoveringMap.comp_homeomorph
    glTildeCoordinateHomeomorph).homeomorph_comp glPosCoordinateHomeomorph.symm
  convert h using 1
  funext x
  apply glPosCoordinateHomeomorph.injective
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
  exact (coordinateProjection_apply_glTildeCoordinates x).symm

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.GLTilde.universalCoverData
statement:
@[discharges "gltilde-universal-cover"]
theorem GLTilde.universalCoverData :
    IsCoveringMap GLTilde.mat ∧
      Function.Surjective GLTilde.mat ∧ SimplyConnectedSpace GLTilde
proof:
:=
  ⟨GLTilde.isCoveringMap_toMat, toMatHom_surjective, inferInstance⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.rayVec_add_one
statement: theorem rayVec_add_one (φ : ℝ) : rayVec (φ + 1) = -rayVec φ
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [rayVec, mul_add, mul_one, Real.cos_add_pi, Real.sin_add_pi]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.rayVec_ne_zero
statement: theorem rayVec_ne_zero (φ : ℝ) : rayVec φ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc : Real.cos (π * φ) = 0 := congrFun h 0
  have hs : Real.sin (π * φ) = 0 := congrFun h 1
  have hpyth := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (π * φ)
  rw [hs, hc] at hpyth
  norm_num at hpyth

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.OnRay.refl
statement: theorem refl (v : Fin 2 → ℝ) : OnRay v v
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, one_pos, (one_smul ℝ v).symm⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.OnRay.trans
statement:
theorem trans {u v w : Fin 2 → ℝ} (h₁ : OnRay u v) (h₂ : OnRay v w) :
    OnRay u w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := h₂
  exact ⟨r * s, mul_pos hr hs, by rw [smul_smul]⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.compat_one
statement: theorem compat_one : Compatible 1 1
proof:
:= by
  intro φ
  simp only [toMat_one, Matrix.one_mulVec, NormalizedShift.one_apply]
  exact OnRay.refl _

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.compat_mul
proof:
:= by
  intro φ
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hUφ⟩ := hU φ
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hTφ⟩ := hT (g.toOrderIso φ)
  refine ⟨s * r, mul_pos hs hr, ?_⟩
  rw [NormalizedShift.mul_apply, toMat_mul, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hUφ,
    Matrix.mulVec_smul, hTφ, smul_smul]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.compat_inv
statement:
theorem compat_inv {T : Matrix.GLPos (Fin 2) ℝ} {f : NormalizedShift}
    (hT : Compatible T f) : Compatible T⁻¹ f⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro ψ
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hTφ⟩ := hT (f.toOrderIso.symm ψ)
  rw [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] at hTφ
  refine ⟨r⁻¹, inv_pos.mpr hr, ?_⟩
  rw [NormalizedShift.inv_apply]
  
  
  have key : toMat T⁻¹ *ᵥ (toMat T *ᵥ rayVec (f.toOrderIso.symm ψ))
      = rayVec (f.toOrderIso.symm ψ) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← toMat_mul, inv_mul_cancel, toMat_one,
      Matrix.one_mulVec]
  rw [hTφ, Matrix.mulVec_smul] at key
  rw [← key, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.GLTilde.ext'
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext' (hm : x.mat = y.mat) (hs : x.shift = y.shift) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  cases y
  subst hm
  subst hs
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.GLTilde.mul_mat
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_mat (x y : GLTilde) : (x * y).mat = x.mat * y.mat
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.GLTilde.mul_shift
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_shift (x y : GLTilde) : (x * y).shift = x.shift * y.shift
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.GLTilde.one_mat
statement: @[simp] theorem one_mat : (1 : GLTilde).mat = 1
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.GLTilde.one_shift
statement: @[simp] theorem one_shift : (1 : GLTilde).shift = 1
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.GLTilde.inv_mat
statement: @[simp] theorem inv_mat (x : GLTilde) : x⁻¹.mat = x.mat⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.GLTilde.inv_shift
statement: @[simp] theorem inv_shift (x : GLTilde) : x⁻¹.shift = x.shift⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.cplxCoord_exp
statement:
theorem cplxCoord_exp (φ : ℝ) :
    cplxCoord (Complex.exp (↑(Real.pi * φ) * Complex.I)) = rayVec φ
proof:
:= by
  show ⇑(Complex.basisOneI.repr (Complex.exp (↑(Real.pi * φ) * Complex.I))) = _
  rw [Complex.coe_basisOneI_repr, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re,
    Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.compat_exp
statement:
theorem compat_exp {T : Matrix.GLPos (Fin 2) ℝ} {f : NormalizedShift}
    (h : Compatible T f) (φ : ℝ) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧
      toMat T *ᵥ cplxCoord (Complex.exp (↑(Real.pi * φ) * Complex.I))
        = r • cplxCoord (Complex.exp (↑(Real.pi * f.toOrderIso φ) * Complex.I))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hry⟩ := h φ
  exact ⟨r, hr, by rw [cplxCoord_exp, cplxCoord_exp, hry]⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.actC_exp
statement:
theorem actC_exp {T : Matrix.GLPos (Fin 2) ℝ} {f : NormalizedShift}
    (h : Compatible T f) (φ : ℝ) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧
      actC T (Complex.exp (↑(Real.pi * φ) * Complex.I))
        = r • Complex.exp (↑(Real.pi * f.toOrderIso φ) * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hry⟩ := compat_exp h φ
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  rw [actC_apply, hry, map_smul, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.rotationMatrix_det
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotationMatrix_det (θ : ℝ) : (rotationMatrix θ).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [rotationMatrix, Matrix.det_fin_two_of]
  nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (Real.pi * θ)]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.rotationMatrix_mulVec_rayVec
statement:
theorem rotationMatrix_mulVec_rayVec (θ φ : ℝ) :
    rotationMatrix θ *ᵥ rayVec φ = rayVec (φ + θ)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [rotationMatrix, rayVec, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      mul_add, Real.cos_add, Real.sin_add] <;> ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.rotationMatrix_neg_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotationMatrix_neg_mul (θ : ℝ) :
    rotationMatrix (-θ) * rotationMatrix θ = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [rotationMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.cos_neg,
      Real.sin_neg] <;>
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (Real.pi * θ)]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.rotationMatrix_mul_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotationMatrix_mul_neg (θ : ℝ) :
    rotationMatrix θ * rotationMatrix (-θ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [neg_neg] using rotationMatrix_neg_mul (-θ)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.rotationGLPos_mat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotationGLPos_mat (θ : ℝ) : toMat (rotationGLPos θ) = rotationMatrix θ
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.phaseTranslation_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem phaseTranslation_apply (θ φ : ℝ) :
    (phaseTranslation θ).toOrderIso φ = φ + θ
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.compatible_rotation
statement: theorem compatible_rotation (θ : ℝ) : Compatible (rotationGLPos θ) (phaseTranslation θ)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ
  rw [rotationGLPos_mat, rotationMatrix_mulVec_rayVec, phaseTranslation_apply]
  exact OnRay.refl _

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.liftedRotation_mat
statement: @[simp] theorem liftedRotation_mat (θ : ℝ) : (liftedRotation θ).mat = rotationGLPos θ
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.liftedRotation_shift_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftedRotation_shift_zero (θ : ℝ) :
    (liftedRotation θ).shift.toOrderIso 0 = θ
proof: := by simp [liftedRotation]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.GLTilde.ext_mat_shift_zero
statement:
theorem GLTilde.ext_mat_shift_zero {x y : GLTilde} (hmat : x.mat = y.mat)
    (hzero : x.shift.toOrderIso 0 = y.shift.toOrderIso 0) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hxm, -⟩ := existsUnique_deck_mul_sect x
  obtain ⟨n, hyn, -⟩ := existsUnique_deck_mul_sect y
  have hxm0 := congrArg (fun z : GLTilde => z.shift.toOrderIso 0) hxm
  have hyn0 := congrArg (fun z : GLTilde => z.shift.toOrderIso 0) hyn
  simp only [GLTilde.mul_shift, NormalizedShift.mul_apply, deck_shift, deckShift_apply,
    sect, liftShift_apply] at hxm0 hyn0
  have hmnR : (m : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) := by
    rw [hmat] at hxm0
    linarith
  have hmn : m = n := by exact_mod_cast hmnR
  rw [hxm, hyn, hmat, hmn]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.upperMatrix_det
statement:
@[simp]
theorem upperMatrix_det (r : PositiveReal) (b : ℝ) (d : PositiveReal) :
    (upperMatrix r b d).det = (r : ℝ) * d
proof:
:= by
  simp [upperMatrix, Matrix.det_fin_two_of]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.upperMatrix_mul_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem upperMatrix_mul_inv (r : PositiveReal) (b : ℝ) (d : PositiveReal) :
    upperMatrix r b d * upperMatrixInv r b d = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hr : (r : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt r.2
  have hd : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt d.2
  ext i j
  all_goals fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  all_goals simp [upperMatrix, upperMatrixInv, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, hr, hd]
  field_simp
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.upperMatrix_inv_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem upperMatrix_inv_mul (r : PositiveReal) (b : ℝ) (d : PositiveReal) :
    upperMatrixInv r b d * upperMatrix r b d = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hr : (r : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt r.2
  have hd : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt d.2
  ext i j
  all_goals fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  all_goals simp [upperMatrix, upperMatrixInv, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, hr, hd]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.upperGLPos_mat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem upperGLPos_mat (r : PositiveReal) (b : ℝ) (d : PositiveReal) :
    toMat (upperGLPos r b d) = upperMatrix r b d
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.alignedMatrix_firstColumn
statement:
private theorem alignedMatrix_firstColumn (x : GLTilde) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ alignedMatrix x *ᵥ rayVec 0 = r • rayVec 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hx⟩ := x.compat 0
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  rw [alignedMatrix, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hx, Matrix.mulVec_smul,
    rotationMatrix_mulVec_rayVec]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.alignedMatrix_zero_zero_pos
statement: theorem alignedMatrix_zero_zero_pos (x : GLTilde) : 0 < alignedMatrix x 0 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := alignedMatrix_firstColumn x
  have h0 := congrFun h 0
  have h0' : alignedMatrix x 0 0 = r := by
    simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, rayVec] using h0
  rwa [h0']

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.alignedMatrix_one_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem alignedMatrix_one_zero (x : GLTilde) : alignedMatrix x 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, -, h⟩ := alignedMatrix_firstColumn x
  have h1 := congrFun h 1
  simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, rayVec] using h1

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.alignedMatrix_det
statement:
private theorem alignedMatrix_det (x : GLTilde) :
    (alignedMatrix x).det = (toMat x.mat).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [alignedMatrix, Matrix.det_mul, rotationMatrix_det, one_mul]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.alignedMatrix_one_one_pos
statement: theorem alignedMatrix_one_one_pos (x : GLTilde) : 0 < alignedMatrix x 1 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : 0 < (alignedMatrix x).det := by rw [alignedMatrix_det]; exact x.mat.2
  rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, alignedMatrix_one_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero] at hdet
  rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hdet with h | h
  · exact h.2
  · linarith [alignedMatrix_zero_zero_pos x]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.alignedMatrix_eq_upper
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [glTildeCoordinates, upperMatrix, alignedMatrix_one_zero]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.matrixOfCoordinates_apply
statement:
theorem matrixOfCoordinates_apply (x : GLTilde) :
    matrixOfCoordinates (glTildeCoordinates x) = toMat x.mat
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixOfCoordinates, ← alignedMatrix_eq_upper]
  simp only [glTildeCoordinates]
  rw [alignedMatrix, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, rotationMatrix_mul_neg, Matrix.one_mul]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.upper_mulVec_rayVec_zero
statement:
private theorem upper_mulVec_rayVec_zero (r : PositiveReal) (b : ℝ) (d : PositiveReal) :
    upperMatrix r b d *ᵥ rayVec 0 = (r : ℝ) • rayVec 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [upperMatrix, rayVec, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.upper_lift_zero_even
statement:
private theorem upper_lift_zero_even (r : PositiveReal) (b : ℝ) (d : PositiveReal) :
    ∃ n : ℤ, lift (upperGLPos r b d) 0 = 2 * n
proof:
:= by
  have hcompat := compatible_liftShift (upperGLPos r b d) 0
  rw [upperGLPos_mat, upper_mulVec_rayVec_zero] at hcompat
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hEq⟩ := hcompat
  have honRay : OnRay (rayVec 0) (rayVec (lift (upperGLPos r b d) 0)) := by
    refine ⟨s / (r : ℝ), div_pos hs r.2, ?_⟩
    ext i
    have hi := congrFun hEq i
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hi ⊢
    have hr : (r : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt r.2
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hr]
    simpa [liftShift_apply, mul_comm] using hi
  have hRay : rayVec 0 = rayVec (lift (upperGLPos r b d) 0) :=
    rayVec_eq_of_onRay honRay
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (rayVec_eq_iff 0 (lift (upperGLPos r b d) 0)).mp hRay
  refine ⟨-n, ?_⟩
  push_cast
  linarith

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.upperDeckIndex_spec
statement:
theorem upperDeckIndex_spec (r : PositiveReal) (b : ℝ) (d : PositiveReal) :
    lift (upperGLPos r b d) 0 = 2 * upperDeckIndex r b d
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (upper_lift_zero_even r b d)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.upperSectionZero_mat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem upperSectionZero_mat (r : PositiveReal) (b : ℝ) (d : PositiveReal) :
    (upperSectionZero r b d).mat = upperGLPos r b d
proof:
:= by
  simp [upperSectionZero]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.upperSectionZero_shift_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem upperSectionZero_shift_zero (r : PositiveReal) (b : ℝ) (d : PositiveReal) :
    (upperSectionZero r b d).shift.toOrderIso 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [upperSectionZero, GLTilde.mul_shift, NormalizedShift.mul_apply, deck_shift,
    deckShift_apply, sect, liftShift_apply]
  rw [upperDeckIndex_spec]
  push_cast
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.glTildeOfCoordinates_shift_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem glTildeOfCoordinates_shift_zero (c : GLTildeCoordinates) :
    (glTildeOfCoordinates c).shift.toOrderIso 0 = c.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [glTildeOfCoordinates]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.glTildeOfCoordinates_mat
statement:
theorem glTildeOfCoordinates_mat (c : GLTildeCoordinates) :
    toMat (glTildeOfCoordinates c).mat = matrixOfCoordinates c
proof:
:= by
  simp [glTildeOfCoordinates, matrixOfCoordinates, toMat_mul]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.alignedMatrix_glTildeOfCoordinates
statement:
@[simp]
theorem alignedMatrix_glTildeOfCoordinates (c : GLTildeCoordinates) :
    alignedMatrix (glTildeOfCoordinates c) = upperMatrix c.2.1 c.2.2.1 c.2.2.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [alignedMatrix, glTildeOfCoordinates_shift_zero, glTildeOfCoordinates_mat,
    matrixOfCoordinates, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, rotationMatrix_neg_mul, Matrix.one_mul]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.glTildeCoordinates_ofCoordinates
statement:
@[simp]
theorem glTildeCoordinates_ofCoordinates (c : GLTildeCoordinates) :
    glTildeCoordinates (glTildeOfCoordinates c) = c
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨θ, r, b, d⟩
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact glTildeOfCoordinates_shift_zero _
  · apply Prod.ext
    · apply Subtype.ext
      simp [glTildeCoordinates, upperMatrix]
    · apply Prod.ext
      · simp [glTildeCoordinates, upperMatrix]
      · apply Subtype.ext
        simp [glTildeCoordinates, upperMatrix]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.glTildeCoordinates_injective
statement: theorem glTildeCoordinates_injective : Function.Injective glTildeCoordinates
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hmat0 : toMat x.mat = toMat y.mat := by
    rw [← matrixOfCoordinates_apply x, ← matrixOfCoordinates_apply y, hxy]
  have hmat : x.mat = y.mat := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Units.ext hmat0
  apply GLTilde.ext_mat_shift_zero hmat
  exact congrArg _root_.Prod.fst hxy

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.glTildeCoordinates_surjective
statement: theorem glTildeCoordinates_surjective : Function.Surjective glTildeCoordinates
proof:
:=
  fun c => ⟨glTildeOfCoordinates c, glTildeCoordinates_ofCoordinates c⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.glTildeCoordinateEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem glTildeCoordinateEquiv_apply (x : GLTilde) :
    glTildeCoordinateEquiv x = glTildeCoordinates x
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.continuous_rotationMatrix
statement: theorem continuous_rotationMatrix : Continuous rotationMatrix
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [rotationMatrix] <;> fun_prop

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.continuous_matrixOfCoordinates
statement: private theorem continuous_matrixOfCoordinates : Continuous matrixOfCoordinates
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.matrix_mul
  · exact continuous_rotationMatrix.comp continuous_fst
  · apply continuous_matrix
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [upperMatrix] <;> fun_prop

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.continuous_glTildeOfCoordinates_mat
statement:
private theorem continuous_glTildeOfCoordinates_mat :
    Continuous fun c : GLTildeCoordinates => (glTildeOfCoordinates c).mat
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_induced_rng, Units.continuous_iff]
  constructor
  · change Continuous fun c => toMat (glTildeOfCoordinates c).mat
    simpa only [glTildeOfCoordinates_mat] using continuous_matrixOfCoordinates
  · have hr : Continuous fun c : GLTildeCoordinates => ((c.2.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd)).inv₀
        (fun c => ne_of_gt c.2.1.2))
    have hd : Continuous fun c : GLTildeCoordinates => ((c.2.2.2 : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp
        (continuous_snd.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd))).inv₀
          (fun c => ne_of_gt c.2.2.2.2))
    apply continuous_matrix
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [glTildeOfCoordinates, liftedRotation, rotationGLPos, upperSectionZero,
        upperGLPos, upperMatrixInv, rotationMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;>
      fun_prop

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.glTildeOfCoordinates_coordinates
statement:
@[simp]
theorem glTildeOfCoordinates_coordinates (x : GLTilde) :
    glTildeOfCoordinates (glTildeCoordinates x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply glTildeCoordinates_injective
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.GroupAction.GLTilde.continuous_toMat
statement: theorem GLTilde.continuous_toMat : Continuous GLTilde.mat
proof:
:= by
  have h := continuous_glTildeOfCoordinates_mat.comp glTildeCoordinateHomeomorph.continuous
  have heq : (fun c : GLTildeCoordinates => (glTildeOfCoordinates c).mat) ∘
      glTildeCoordinateHomeomorph = GLTilde.mat := by
    funext x
    exact congrArg GLTilde.mat (glTildeOfCoordinates_coordinates x)
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

name: IntegralLattice.finrank_numLattice
statement: theorem finrank_numLattice : Module.finrank ℤ NumLattice = 2
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: IntegralLattice.ne_zero_of_apply_ne_zero
statement:
theorem ne_zero_of_apply_ne_zero {v : NumLattice} {i : Fin 2} (h : v i ≠ 0) :
    v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hv
  exact h (by rw [hv]; rfl)

name: IntegralLattice.eq_zero_of_two_zsmul_eq_zero_num
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_two_zsmul_eq_zero_num {v : NumLattice} (h : (2 : ℤ) • v = 0) :
    v = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_zero_of_two_zsmul_eq_zero h

name: QuadraticMap.sigPos_smul_of_pos
statement:
theorem sigPos_smul_of_pos {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (Q : QuadraticForm ℝ M) :
    sigPos (c • Q) = sigPos Q
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (d : ℝ), 0 < d → ∀ Q' : QuadraticForm ℝ M, sigPos Q' ≤ sigPos (d • Q') := by
    intro d hd Q'
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hpos⟩ := exists_finrank_eq_sigPos_and_posDef Q'
    refine hU ▸ le_sigPos_of_posDef _ ?_
    intro u hu
    have := hpos u hu
    rw [restrict_apply] at this ⊢
    simpa using mul_pos hd this
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (key c hc Q)
  have h := key c⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hc) (c • Q)
  rwa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc), one_smul] at h

name: QuadraticMap.sigNeg_smul_of_pos
statement:
theorem sigNeg_smul_of_pos {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (Q : QuadraticForm ℝ M) :
    sigNeg (c • Q) = sigNeg Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigNeg, sigNeg, ← sigPos_smul_of_pos hc (-Q)]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp

name: Mukai.hyperbolicIncl_injective
statement: theorem hyperbolicIncl_injective : Function.Injective (hyperbolicIncl V)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  have h1 : p.1 = q.1 := congrArg (fun v : RealExtension V => v.1) h
  have h2 : p.2 = q.2 := congrArg (fun v : RealExtension V => v.2.2) h
  exact Prod.ext h1 h2

name: Mukai.middleIncl_injective
statement: theorem middleIncl_injective : Function.Injective (middleIncl V)
proof:
:= by
  intro c d h
  exact congrArg (fun v : RealExtension V => v.2.1) h

name: Mukai.mem_hyperbolic_iff
statement: theorem mem_hyperbolic_iff {v : RealExtension V} : v ∈ hyperbolic V ↔ v.2.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩; rfl
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(v.1, v.2.2), Prod.ext rfl (Prod.ext h.symm rfl)⟩

name: Mukai.mem_middle_iff
statement: theorem mem_middle_iff {v : RealExtension V} : v ∈ middle V ↔ v.1 = 0 ∧ v.2.2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨v.2.1, Prod.ext h1.symm (Prod.ext rfl h2.symm)⟩

name: Mukai.isCompl_hyperbolic_middle
statement: theorem isCompl_hyperbolic_middle : IsCompl (hyperbolic V) (middle V)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    intro v hv hv'
    rw [mem_hyperbolic_iff] at hv
    rw [mem_middle_iff] at hv'
    exact Prod.ext hv'.1 (Prod.ext hv hv'.2)
  · rw [codisjoint_iff, eq_top_iff]
    intro v _
    refine Submodule.mem_sup.mpr ⟨(v.1, 0, v.2.2), mem_hyperbolic_iff.mpr rfl,
      (0, v.2.1, 0), mem_middle_iff.mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp

name: Mukai.orthogonal_hyperbolic_middle
statement:
theorem orthogonal_hyperbolic_middle (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) :
    ∀ w ∈ hyperbolic V, ∀ w' ∈ middle V, polar (⇑(realForm b)) w w' = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw w' hw'
  rw [mem_hyperbolic_iff] at hw
  rw [mem_middle_iff] at hw'
  rw [polar_realForm b hb, realPairing, pairing, hw, hw'.1, hw'.2]
  simp

name: Mukai.comp_hyperbolicIncl_apply
statement:
theorem comp_hyperbolicIncl_apply (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ((realForm b).comp (hyperbolicIncl V)) p = -(p.1 * p.2)
proof:
:= by
  show realForm b (p.1, 0, p.2) = -(p.1 * p.2)
  rw [realForm_mk]
  simp
  ring

name: Mukai.comp_middleIncl_apply
statement:
theorem comp_middleIncl_apply (c : V) :
    ((realForm b).comp (middleIncl V)) c = b c c / 2
proof:
:= by
  show realForm b (0, c, 0) = b c c / 2
  rw [realForm_mk]
  ring

name: Mukai.one_le_sigPos_hyp
statement: private theorem one_le_sigPos_hyp : 1 ≤ sigPos (hypQ b)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ((1 : ℝ), (-1 : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hrank : Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ {((1 : ℝ), (-1 : ℝ))}) = 1 :=
    finrank_span_singleton hne
  refine hrank ▸ le_sigPos_of_posDef _ ?_
  rintro ⟨u, hu⟩ hu0
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hu
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hu
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hu0 (by simp [h])
  rw [restrict_apply, comp_hyperbolicIncl_apply]
  simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, mul_neg]
  nlinarith [mul_self_pos.mpr ha]

name: Mukai.one_le_sigNeg_hyp
statement: private theorem one_le_sigNeg_hyp : 1 ≤ sigNeg (hypQ b)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ((1 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hrank : Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ {((1 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))}) = 1 :=
    finrank_span_singleton hne
  refine hrank ▸ le_sigNeg_of_negDef _ ?_
  rintro ⟨u, hu⟩ hu0
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hu
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hu
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hu0 (by simp [h])
  rw [restrict_apply, QuadraticMap.neg_apply, comp_hyperbolicIncl_apply]
  simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  nlinarith [mul_self_pos.mpr ha]

name: Mukai.sigPos_sigNeg_hyp
statement: private theorem sigPos_sigNeg_hyp : sigPos (hypQ b) = 1 ∧ sigNeg (hypQ b) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := one_le_sigPos_hyp b
  have h2 := one_le_sigNeg_hyp b
  have htot := QuadraticForm.sigPos_add_sigNeg_add_radical (Q := hypQ b)
  rw [show Module.finrank ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) = 2 by simp] at htot
  omega

name: Mukai.equivalent_hyp
statement:
private theorem equivalent_hyp :
    QuadraticMap.Equivalent (hypQ b) ((realForm b).restrict (hyperbolic V))
proof:
:=
  ⟨QuadraticMap.rangeIsometry _ _ (hyperbolicIncl_injective V)⟩

name: Mukai.comp_middleIncl_eq
statement:
private theorem comp_middleIncl_eq :
    (realForm b).comp (middleIncl V) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b)
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  rw [comp_middleIncl_apply]
  simp [LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap_apply]
  ring

name: Mukai.equivalent_middle
proof:
:=
  ⟨(comp_middleIncl_eq b) ▸ QuadraticMap.rangeIsometry _ _ (middleIncl_injective V)⟩

name: Mukai.finrank_hyperbolic
statement: private theorem finrank_hyperbolic : Module.finrank ℝ (hyperbolic V) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [hyperbolic, ← (LinearEquiv.ofInjective _ (hyperbolicIncl_injective V)).finrank_eq]
  simp

name: Mukai.finrank_middle
statement: private theorem finrank_middle : Module.finrank ℝ (middle V) = Module.finrank ℝ V
proof:
:= by
  rw [middle, ← (LinearEquiv.ofInjective _ (middleIncl_injective V)).finrank_eq]

name: Mukai.hasSignatureTwo_realForm
statement:
theorem hasSignatureTwo_realForm [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (hpos : sigPos (LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b) = 1)
    (hneg : sigNeg (LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b) + 1 = Module.finrank ℝ V) :
    PeriodDomain.HasSignatureTwo (realForm b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hhp, hhn⟩ := sigPos_sigNeg_hyp b
  
  have hP₁ : sigPos ((realForm b).restrict (hyperbolic V)) = 1 := by
    rw [← (equivalent_hyp b).sigPos_eq, hhp]
  have hN₁ : sigNeg ((realForm b).restrict (hyperbolic V)) = 1 := by
    rw [← (equivalent_hyp b).sigNeg_eq, hhn]
  have hP₂ : sigPos ((realForm b).restrict (middle V)) = 1 := by
    rw [← (equivalent_middle b).sigPos_eq,
      QuadraticMap.sigPos_smul_of_pos (by norm_num) _, hpos]
  have hN₂ : sigNeg ((realForm b).restrict (middle V)) + 1 = Module.finrank ℝ V := by
    rw [← (equivalent_middle b).sigNeg_eq,
      QuadraticMap.sigNeg_smul_of_pos (by norm_num) _, hneg]
  
  have hnd₁ : ((realForm b).restrict (hyperbolic V)).Nondegenerate := by
    rw [nondegenerate_iff_radical_eq_bot, ← Submodule.finrank_eq_zero]
    have h := QuadraticForm.sigPos_add_sigNeg_add_radical
      (Q := (realForm b).restrict (hyperbolic V))
    rw [hP₁, hN₁, finrank_hyperbolic] at h
    omega
  have hnd₂ : ((realForm b).restrict (middle V)).Nondegenerate := by
    rw [nondegenerate_iff_radical_eq_bot, ← Submodule.finrank_eq_zero]
    have h := QuadraticForm.sigPos_add_sigNeg_add_radical
      (Q := (realForm b).restrict (middle V))
    rw [hP₂, finrank_middle] at h
    omega
  obtain ⟨hsumP, hsumN⟩ := QuadraticMap.sigPos_eq_add isCompl_hyperbolic_middle
    (orthogonal_hyperbolic_middle b hb) hnd₁ hnd₂
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ (RealExtension V) = Module.finrank ℝ V + 2 := by
    simp [RealExtension, Module.finrank_prod]
    ring
  constructor
  · rw [hsumP, hP₁, hP₂]
  · rw [hsumN, hN₁, hdim]
    omega

name: Mukai.reflect_apply
statement:
theorem reflect_apply (s v : MukaiLattice N) :
    reflect b s v = v + pairing b v s • s
proof:
:=

:=

name: Mukai.pairing_reflect_eq_zero_iff

theorem pairing_reflect_eq_zero_iff (s : MukaiLattice N) (hs : IsSpherical b s)

name: Mukai.pairing_reflect_reflect
statement:
theorem pairing_reflect_reflect (hb : ∀ x y : N, b x y = b y x)
    (s : MukaiLattice N) (hs : IsSpherical b s) (v w : MukaiLattice N) :
    pairing b (reflect b s v) (reflect b s w) = pairing b v w
proof:
:=
  BilinearForm.apply_reflect_reflect (pairingBilin b)
    (fun x y => pairing_comm b hb x y) s hs v w

    selfPairing b (reflect b s v) = selfPairing b v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [selfPairing_eq_pairing]
  exact pairing_reflect_reflect b hb s hs v v

name: Mukai.reflectIsometry_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reflectIsometry_apply (hb : ∀ x y : N, b x y = b y x)

proof:

name: Mukai.IsSpherical.reflect
statement:
theorem IsSpherical.reflect (hb : ∀ x y : N, b x y = b y x)
    {s : MukaiLattice N} (hs : IsSpherical b s) {v : MukaiLattice N}
    (hv : IsSpherical b v) :
    IsSpherical b (Mukai.reflect b s v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSpherical_iff, selfPairing_reflect b hb s hs]
  exact hv

name: Mukai.IsIsotropic.reflect
statement:
theorem IsIsotropic.reflect (hb : ∀ x y : N, b x y = b y x)

proof:

  rw [isIsotropic_iff, selfPairing_reflect b hb s hs]
  exact hv

    expectedDim b (reflect b s v) = expectedDim b v
proof:

  rw [expectedDim, expectedDim, selfPairing_reflect b hb s hs]

name: Mukai.gram_apply
statement:
theorem gram_apply (v w : MukaiLattice N) :
    gram b v w = selfPairing b v * selfPairing b w - pairing b v w ^ 2
proof: := rfl

name: Mukai.gram_comm
statement:
theorem gram_comm (hb : ∀ x y : N, b x y = b y x) (v w : MukaiLattice N) :
    gram b v w = gram b w v
proof:
:=
  BilinearForm.gram_comm (pairingBilin b) (fun x y => pairing_comm b hb x y) v w

statement:
@[simp]
theorem gram_zero_left (w : MukaiLattice N) : gram b (0 : MukaiLattice N) w = 0
proof:
:=

proof:

name: Mukai.pairing_lincomb
statement:
theorem pairing_lincomb (hb : ∀ x y : N, b x y = b y x) (a₁ a₂ a₃ a₄ : ℤ)
    (v w : MukaiLattice N) :
    pairing b (a₁ • v + a₂ • w) (a₃ • v + a₄ • w)
      = a₁ * a₃ * selfPairing b v + (a₁ * a₄ + a₂ * a₃) * pairing b v w
        + a₂ * a₄ * selfPairing b w
proof:
:=
  BilinearForm.apply_lincomb (pairingBilin b)
    (fun x y => pairing_comm b hb x y) a₁ a₂ a₃ a₄ v w

name: Mukai.selfPairing_lincomb
statement:
theorem selfPairing_lincomb (hb : ∀ x y : N, b x y = b y x) (a₁ a₂ : ℤ)
    (v w : MukaiLattice N) :
    selfPairing b (a₁ • v + a₂ • w)
      = a₁ ^ 2 * selfPairing b v + 2 * (a₁ * a₂) * pairing b v w
        + a₂ ^ 2 * selfPairing b w
proof:
:=
  BilinearForm.self_lincomb (pairingBilin b)
    (fun x y => pairing_comm b hb x y) a₁ a₂ v w

name: Mukai.gram_lincomb
statement:
theorem gram_lincomb (hb : ∀ x y : N, b x y = b y x) (a₁ a₂ a₃ a₄ : ℤ)
    (v w : MukaiLattice N) :
    gram b (a₁ • v + a₂ • w) (a₃ • v + a₄ • w)
      = (a₁ * a₄ - a₂ * a₃) ^ 2 * gram b v w
proof:
:=
  BilinearForm.gram_lincomb (pairingBilin b)
    (fun x y => pairing_comm b hb x y) a₁ a₂ a₃ a₄ v w

:=
  BilinearForm.isHyperbolicPair_iff (pairingBilin b) v w

name: Mukai.discr_pos_of_isHyperbolicPair

:=

name: Mukai.isIsotropic_iff
statement:
theorem isIsotropic_iff (v : MukaiLattice N) :
    IsIsotropic b v ↔ selfPairing b v = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Mukai.IsSpherical.neg
statement:
theorem IsSpherical.neg {v : MukaiLattice N} (h : IsSpherical b v) :
    IsSpherical b (-v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsSpherical, selfPairing_neg]; exact h

name: Mukai.IsIsotropic.neg
statement:
theorem IsIsotropic.neg {v : MukaiLattice N} (h : IsIsotropic b v) :
    IsIsotropic b (-v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsIsotropic, selfPairing_neg]; exact h

name: Mukai.not_isSpherical_and_isIsotropic
statement:
theorem not_isSpherical_and_isIsotropic (v : MukaiLattice N) :
    ¬(IsSpherical b v ∧ IsIsotropic b v)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨hs, hi⟩
  rw [IsSpherical, hi] at hs
  exact absurd hs (by decide)

name: Mukai.expectedDim_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem expectedDim_eq_zero_iff (v : MukaiLattice N) :
    expectedDim b v = 0 ↔ IsSpherical b v
proof:
:= by
