name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SemiorthogonalSequence.HasTriangulatedComponents.totalIsStableUnderShift
statement:
theorem HasTriangulatedComponents.totalIsStableUnderShift
    [Limits.HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [Preadditive C]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C]
    (hS : S.HasTriangulatedComponents) : S.total.IsStableUnderShift ℤ
proof:
:= by
  letI (i : ι) : (S.component i).IsTriangulated := hS i
  constructor
  intro n

  · intro X hX
    change S.total (X⟦n⟧)
    rw [total, ObjectProperty.prop_iSup_iff] at hX ⊢
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hX
    exact ⟨i, (S.component i).le_shift n _ hi⟩

    (p q : ℤ) (X : C) (hGE : t.IsGE X p) (hLE : t.IsLE X q) :
    t'.IsLE (F.obj X) (q + b)
proof:

name: CategoryTheory.Functor.HasCohomologicalAmplitude.comp
proof:
:= by
  intro p q X hGE hLE
  obtain ⟨hGE', hLE'⟩ := hF p q X hGE hLE
  obtain ⟨hGE'', hLE''⟩ := hG (p + a) (q + b) (F.obj X) hGE' hLE'
  constructor
  · rw [← add_assoc]
    exact hGE''
  · rw [← add_assoc]
    exact hLE''

  exact ⟨⟨p + a, hF.isGE p q X hp hq⟩, ⟨q + b, hF.isLE p q X hp hq⟩⟩

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.RightProjectionData.fixedTargetArrowExtension_of_ambient
statement:
theorem fixedTargetArrowExtension_of_ambient
    (inclusionIso : G ⋙ Q.ι ≅ P.ι ⋙ F)
    (projectionIso : F ⋙ q.projection ≅ p.projection ⋙ G)
    (counit_compat : ∀ Y : C,
      q.counitApp (F.obj Y) =
        Q.ι.map ((projectionIso.app Y).hom) ≫
          (inclusionIso.app (p.project Y)).hom ≫ F.map (p.counitApp Y))
    (X : P.FullSubcategory)
    (hExt : Subobject.FixedTargetArrowExtension F (P.ι.obj X)) :
    Subobject.FixedTargetArrowExtension G X
proof:
:= by
  letI : P.ι.Full := P.fullyFaithfulι.full
  letI : Q.ι.Full := Q.fullyFaithfulι.full
  letI : Q.ι.Faithful := Q.fullyFaithfulι.faithful
  letI : IsIso q.adjunction.unit :=
    q.adjunction.unit_isIso_of_L_fully_faithful
  intro Z β
  letI : IsIso (q.adjunction.unit.app Z) :=
    NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso _ _
  obtain ⟨Y, f, e, he⟩ := hExt (Q.ι.map β ≫ (inclusionIso.app X).hom)
  let g : p.project Y ⟶ X := P.ι.preimage (p.counitApp Y ≫ f)
  let e' : Z ≅ G.obj (p.project Y) :=
    (@asIso _ _ _ _ (q.adjunction.unit.app Z)
      (NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso q.adjunction.unit Z)) ≪≫ q.projection.mapIso e ≪≫
      projectionIso.app Y
  refine ⟨p.project Y, g, e', ?_⟩
  apply Q.ι.map_injective
  have hg : P.ι.map g = p.counitApp Y ≫ f := P.ι.map_preimage _
  have htriangle : Q.ι.map (q.adjunction.unit.app Z) ≫
      q.counitApp (Q.ι.obj Z) = 𝟙 (Q.ι.obj Z) :=
    q.adjunction.left_triangle_components Z
  have hnat : Q.ι.map (q.projection.map e.hom) ≫
      q.counitApp (F.obj Y) =
        q.counitApp (Q.ι.obj Z) ≫ e.hom :=
    q.adjunction.counit.naturality e.hom
  have hcomm : Q.ι.map (G.map g) ≫ (inclusionIso.app X).hom =
      (inclusionIso.app (p.project Y)).hom ≫ F.map (P.ι.map g) :=
    inclusionIso.hom.naturality g
  have hfactor :
      Q.ι.map (e'.hom ≫ G.map g) ≫ (inclusionIso.app X).hom =
        e.hom ≫ F.map f := by
    change Q.ι.map (((asIso (q.adjunction.unit.app Z)).hom ≫
        q.projection.map e.hom ≫ (projectionIso.app Y).hom) ≫
        G.map g) ≫ (inclusionIso.app X).hom = e.hom ≫ F.map f
    rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    erw [hcomm, hg, F.map_comp]
    calc
      _ = Q.ι.map (q.adjunction.unit.app Z) ≫
          Q.ι.map (q.projection.map e.hom) ≫
          q.counitApp (F.obj Y) ≫ F.map f := by
        simpa only [Category.assoc, asIso_hom] using
          congrArg (fun k => Q.ι.map (q.adjunction.unit.app Z) ≫
            Q.ι.map (q.projection.map e.hom) ≫ k ≫ F.map f)
            (counit_compat Y).symm
      _ = Q.ι.map (q.adjunction.unit.app Z) ≫
          q.counitApp (Q.ι.obj Z) ≫ e.hom ≫ F.map f := by
        simpa only [Category.assoc] using
          congrArg (fun k => Q.ι.map (q.adjunction.unit.app Z) ≫
            k ≫ F.map f) hnat
      _ = e.hom ≫ F.map f := by
        simp only [← Category.assoc, htriangle]
        simp
  have hβ : Q.ι.map β ≫ (inclusionIso.app X).hom =
      Q.ι.map (e'.hom ≫ G.map g) ≫ (inclusionIso.app X).hom := by
    rw [hfactor]
    exact he
  exact (cancel_mono (inclusionIso.app X).hom).mp hβ

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsRightAdmissible.exists_distTriang_mem_rightOrthogonal
statement:
theorem IsRightAdmissible.exists_distTriang_mem_rightOrthogonal
    {P : ObjectProperty C} (hP : P.IsRightAdmissible) (X : C) :
    P.extensionProduct P.rightOrthogonal X
proof:
:= by
  letI : P.IsTriangulated := hP.1
  obtain ⟨_, G, ⟨adj⟩⟩ := hP
  letI : P.ι.Full := P.fullyFaithfulι.full
  letI : P.ι.Faithful := P.fullyFaithfulι.faithful
  letI : IsIso adj.unit := adj.unit_isIso_of_L_fully_faithful
  letI := adj.rightAdjointCommShift ℤ
  letI : adj.CommShift ℤ := adj.commShift_of_leftAdjoint ℤ
  letI : G.IsTriangulated := adj.isTriangulated_rightAdjoint
  obtain ⟨Z, g, h, hT⟩ :=
    Pretriangulated.distinguished_cocone_triangle (adj.counit.app X)
  refine ⟨P.ι.obj (G.obj X), Z, adj.counit.app X, g, h, hT,
    (G.obj X).property, ?_⟩
  set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    haveI : IsIso (G.map (adj.counit.app X)) := by infer_instance
  have hGZ : Limits.IsZero (G.obj Z) :=
    Pretriangulated.Triangle.isZero₃_of_isIso₁
      (G.mapTriangle.obj (Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk _ _ _))
      (G.map_distinguished _ hT) (by
        change IsIso (G.map (adj.counit.app X))
        infer_instance)
  intro Y f hY
  let Y' : P.FullSubcategory := ⟨Y, hY⟩
  apply (adj.homEquiv Y' Z).injective
  exact hGZ.eq_of_tgt _ _

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsLeftAdmissible.exists_distTriang_mem_leftOrthogonal
statement:
theorem IsLeftAdmissible.exists_distTriang_mem_leftOrthogonal
    {P : ObjectProperty C} (hP : P.IsLeftAdmissible) (X : C) :
    P.leftOrthogonal.extensionProduct P X
proof:
:= by
  letI : P.IsTriangulated := hP.1
  obtain ⟨_, L, ⟨adj⟩⟩ := hP
  letI : P.ι.Full := P.fullyFaithfulι.full
  letI : P.ι.Faithful := P.fullyFaithfulι.faithful
  letI := adj.leftAdjointCommShift ℤ
  letI : adj.CommShift ℤ := adj.commShift_of_rightAdjoint ℤ
  letI : L.IsTriangulated := adj.isTriangulated_leftAdjoint
  obtain ⟨W, f, h, hT⟩ :=
    Pretriangulated.distinguished_cocone_triangle₁ (adj.unit.app X)
  refine ⟨W, P.ι.obj (L.obj X), f, adj.unit.app X, h, hT, ?_,
    (L.obj X).property⟩
  set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    haveI : IsIso (L.map (adj.unit.app X)) := by infer_instance
  have hLW : Limits.IsZero (L.obj W) :=
    Pretriangulated.Triangle.isZero₁_of_isIso₂
      (L.mapTriangle.obj (Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk _ _ _))
      (L.map_distinguished _ hT) (by
        change IsIso (L.map (adj.unit.app X))
        infer_instance)
  intro Y g hY
  let Y' : P.FullSubcategory := ⟨Y, hY⟩
  apply (adj.homEquiv W Y').symm.injective
  exact hLW.eq_of_src _ _

  rw [eq_top_iff]
  exact fun X _ ↦ hP.exists_distTriang_mem_leftOrthogonal X

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.top_rightOrthogonal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem top_rightOrthogonal :
    (⊤ : ObjectProperty C).rightOrthogonal = zeroObjects
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  constructor
  · intro hX
    change Limits.IsZero X
    rw [Limits.IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
    exact hX (CategoryStruct.id X) trivial
  · intro hX Y f _
    exact hX.eq_of_tgt f 0

statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroObjects_rightOrthogonal :
    (zeroObjects (C := C)).rightOrthogonal = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  constructor
  · intro _
    trivial
  · intro _ Y f hY
    exact hY.eq_of_src f 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SemiorthogonalSequence.twoBlock_component_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoBlock_component_zero (P : ObjectProperty C) :
    (twoBlock P).component 0 = P
proof:
:= by

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SemiorthogonalSequence.twoBlock_component_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoBlock_component_one (P : ObjectProperty C) :

proof:
:= by

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SemiorthogonalSequence.twoBlock_hasTriangulatedComponents
statement:
theorem twoBlock_hasTriangulatedComponents (P : ObjectProperty C)
    (hP : P.IsRightAdmissible) :
    (twoBlock P).HasTriangulatedComponents
proof:
:= by
  letI : P.IsTriangulated := hP.1
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    change P.IsTriangulated
    infer_instance
  · have hi' : i = 1 := Fin.ext (by omega)
    subst i
    change P.rightOrthogonal.IsTriangulated
    infer_instance

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SemiorthogonalSequence.twoBlock_isStronglyFull
statement:
theorem twoBlock_isStronglyFull (P : ObjectProperty C)
    (hP : P.IsRightAdmissible) :
    (twoBlock P).IsStronglyFull
proof:
:= by
  letI : P.IsTriangulated := hP.1
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro X -
  obtain ⟨A, Z, f, g, h, hT, hA, hZ⟩ :=
    hP.exists_distTriang_mem_rightOrthogonal X
  have hAtotal : (twoBlock P).total A :=
    (twoBlock P).component_le_total 0 A (by simpa using hA)
  have hZtotal : (twoBlock P).total Z :=
    (twoBlock P).component_le_total 1 Z (by simpa using hZ)
  rw [ObjectProperty.triangEnvelopeIter_succ]
  apply ObjectProperty.le_retractClosure
  exact ⟨A, Z, f, g, h, hT,
    (by simpa only [ObjectProperty.triangEnvelopeIter_zero] using
      ((twoBlock P).total.le_triangEnvelopeIter 0 A hAtotal)),
    (twoBlock P).total.le_triangEnvelopeIter 0 Z hZtotal⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SemiorthogonalSequence.twoBlock_top_component

name: CategoryTheory.ModuleCat.algebraMap_end_self_bijective
statement:
theorem algebraMap_end_self_bijective (R : Type u) [CommRing R] :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R (End (ModuleCat.of R R)))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro c c' h
    have := congrArg (fun f => (ModuleCat.Hom.hom f) (1 : R)) h
    simpa [algebraMap_end_apply] using this
  · intro f
    refine ⟨(ModuleCat.Hom.hom f) 1, ?_⟩
    rw [algebraMap_end_apply]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    ext
    simp [mul_comm]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.isExceptional_residueObject
statement: theorem isExceptional_residueObject : IsExceptional k (residueObject k)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro n hn f
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hn with hneg | hpos
    · haveI : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.IsGE
          ((shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} k)) n).obj
            (residueObject k)) (-n) :=
        DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.isGE_shift (residueObject k) 0 n (-n)
          (by omega)
      exact DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.zero f 0 (-n) (by omega)
    · haveI := CategoryTheory.hasExt_of_hasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} k)
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, n = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
        ⟨(n - 1).toNat, by omega⟩
      haveI := Abelian.Ext.subsingleton_of_projective (C := ModuleCat.{u} k)
        (ModuleCat.of k k) (ModuleCat.of k k) m
      haveI : Subsingleton (residueObject k ⟶
          (residueObject k)⟦((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)⟧) :=
        (Abelian.Ext.homEquiv (X := ModuleCat.of k k)
          (Y := ModuleCat.of k k) (n := m + 1)).symm.subsingleton
      exact Subsingleton.elim f 0
  · have hcomp : ∀ c : k,
        algebraMap k (End (residueObject k)) c
          = (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} k) 0).map
              (algebraMap k (End (ModuleCat.of k k)) c) := by
      intro c
      rw [algebraMap_end_apply, algebraMap_end_apply,
        Functor.Linear.map_smul, Functor.map_id]
    constructor
    · intro c c' hcc
      exact (ModuleCat.algebraMap_end_self_bijective k).1
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} k) 0).map_injective
          (by rw [← hcomp, ← hcomp, hcc]))
    · intro g
      obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ :=
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} k) 0).map_surjective g
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (ModuleCat.algebraMap_end_self_bijective k).2 g'
      exact ⟨c, by rw [hcomp, hc, hg']⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.residueObjectExceptionalCollection_component
statement:
@[simp]
theorem residueObjectExceptionalCollection_component :
    (residueObjectExceptionalCollection k).component PUnit.unit

proof:

name: CategoryTheory.algebraMap_end_apply
statement:
theorem algebraMap_end_apply {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Preadditive C]
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Linear R C] (c : R) (E : C) :
    algebraMap R (End E) c = c • 𝟙 E
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, End.one_def]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.IsExceptional.end_eq_smul_id
statement: theorem end_eq_smul_id (f : End E) : ∃ c : k, f = c • 𝟙 E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h.algebraMap_bijective.2 f
  exact ⟨c, by rw [← hc, algebraMap_end_apply]⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.IsExceptional.not_isZero
statement: theorem not_isZero : ¬ IsZero E
proof:
:= by
  intro hE
  have h10 : algebraMap k (End E) 1 = algebraMap k (End E) 0 := by
    rw [algebraMap_end_apply, algebraMap_end_apply, one_smul, zero_smul]
    exact hE.eq_of_src _ _
  exact one_ne_zero (h.algebraMap_bijective.1 h10)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.IsExceptional.end_eq_zero_or_eq_one_of_mul_self
statement:
theorem end_eq_zero_or_eq_one_of_mul_self (e : End E) (he : e * e = e) :
    e = 0 ∨ e = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h.algebraMap_bijective.2 e
  have hcc : c * c = c := h.algebraMap_bijective.1 (by rw [map_mul, hc]; exact he)
  rcases mul_eq_zero.1
      (show c * (c - 1) = 0 by rw [mul_sub, mul_one, hcc, sub_self]) with h0 | h1
  · exact Or.inl (by rw [← hc, h0, map_zero])
  · exact Or.inr (by rw [← hc, sub_eq_zero.mp h1, map_one])

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.IsExceptional.not_nonempty_iso_shift
statement: theorem not_nonempty_iso_shift (n : ℤ) (hn : n ≠ 0) : ¬ Nonempty (E ≅ E⟦n⟧)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e⟩
  refine h.not_isZero ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero E).mpr ?_)
  rw [← e.hom_inv_id, h.hom_shift_eq_zero n hn e.hom, zero_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.IsExceptional.hom_shift_shift_eq_zero
statement:
theorem hom_shift_shift_eq_zero (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≠ b) (f : E⟦a⟧ ⟶ E⟦b⟧) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hne : b - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hab)
  have h0 :
      (shiftFunctorZero C ℤ).inv.app E ≫
        (shiftFunctorAdd' C a (-a) 0 (add_neg_cancel a)).hom.app E ≫
          (shiftFunctor C (-a)).map f ≫
            (shiftFunctorAdd' C b (-a) (b - a) (sub_eq_add_neg b a).symm).inv.app E
        = 0 :=
    h.hom_shift_eq_zero (b - a) hne _
  have h1 := (cancel_epi ((shiftFunctorZero C ℤ).inv.app E)).1
    (h0.trans comp_zero.symm)
  have h2 := (cancel_epi
      ((shiftFunctorAdd' C a (-a) 0 (add_neg_cancel a)).hom.app E)).1
    (h1.trans comp_zero.symm)
  have h3 := (cancel_mono
      ((shiftFunctorAdd' C b (-a) (b - a) (sub_eq_add_neg b a).symm).inv.app E)).1
    (h2.trans zero_comp.symm)
  exact (shiftFunctor C (-a)).map_injective
    (h3.trans ((shiftFunctor C (-a)).map_zero _ _).symm)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.IsExceptional.shift
statement:
theorem shift [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Linear k] (m : ℤ) :
    IsExceptional k (E⟦m⟧)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ∀ c : k,
      algebraMap k (End (E⟦m⟧)) c = (shiftFunctor C m).map (algebraMap k (End E) c) := by
    intro c
    rw [algebraMap_end_apply, algebraMap_end_apply, Functor.Linear.map_smul,
      Functor.map_id]
  constructor
  · intro n hn f
    have h0 : f ≫ (shiftFunctorAdd' C m n (m + n) rfl).inv.app E = 0 :=
      h.hom_shift_shift_eq_zero m (m + n) (by omega) _
    exact (cancel_mono ((shiftFunctorAdd' C m n (m + n) rfl).inv.app E)).1
      (h0.trans zero_comp.symm)
  · exact ⟨fun c c' hcc => h.algebraMap_bijective.1
        ((shiftFunctor C m).map_injective (by rw [← hcomp, ← hcomp, hcc])),
      fun g => ((shiftFunctor C m).map_surjective g).elim fun g' hg' =>
        (h.algebraMap_bijective.2 g').elim fun c hc => ⟨c, by rw [hcomp, hc, hg']⟩⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.IsExceptional.of_equivalence
statement:
theorem of_equivalence {D : Type*} [Category.{v} D] [Preadditive D]
    [Linear k D] [HasShift D ℤ] (e : C ≌ D)
    [e.functor.CommShift ℤ] [e.functor.Additive] [e.functor.Linear k] :
    IsExceptional k (e.functor.obj E)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ∀ c : k,
      algebraMap k (End (e.functor.obj E)) c
        = e.functor.map (algebraMap k (End E) c) := by
    intro c
    rw [algebraMap_end_apply, algebraMap_end_apply, Functor.Linear.map_smul,
      Functor.map_id]
  constructor
  · intro n hn f
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ :=
      e.functor.map_surjective (f ≫ (e.functor.commShiftIso n).inv.app E)
    have hf0 : f ≫ (e.functor.commShiftIso n).inv.app E = 0 :=
      hg.symm.trans ((congrArg e.functor.map (h.hom_shift_eq_zero n hn g)).trans
        (e.functor.map_zero _ _))
    exact (cancel_mono ((e.functor.commShiftIso n).inv.app E)).1
      (hf0.trans zero_comp.symm)
  · exact ⟨fun c c' hcc => h.algebraMap_bijective.1
        (e.functor.map_injective (by rw [← hcomp, ← hcomp, hcc])),
      fun g => (e.functor.map_surjective g).elim fun g' hg' =>
        (h.algebraMap_bijective.2 g').elim fun c hc => ⟨c, by rw [hcomp, hc, hg']⟩⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SemiorthogonalSequence.single_component
statement:

proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SemiorthogonalSequence.single_total
statement:

lemma single_total : (single (C := C)).total = ⊤

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SemiorthogonalSequence.single_isStronglyFull
statement:
lemma single_isStronglyFull
    [Limits.HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [Preadditive C]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C] :
    (single (C := C)).IsStronglyFull
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  rw [single_total]
  apply top_unique
  exact (⊤ : ObjectProperty C).le_triangEnvelopeIter 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SemiorthogonalSequence.single_isFull

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.RightProjectionData.homEquivFromProject_id
statement:
theorem homEquivFromProject_id (X : C) :
    Q.homEquivFromProject (Q.project X) X (𝟙 (Q.project X)) =
      Q.counitApp X
proof:
:=
  Q.adjunction.homEquiv_symm_id X

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.RightProjectionData.isRightAdmissible
statement:
theorem isRightAdmissible
    [Limits.HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [Preadditive C]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C]
    (hP : P.IsTriangulated) : P.IsRightAdmissible
proof:
:=
  ⟨hP, Q.projection, ⟨Q.adjunction⟩⟩

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.RightProjectionData.project_isZero_iff
statement:
theorem project_isZero_iff (X : C) :
    Limits.IsZero (Q.project X) ↔
      ∀ (R : P.FullSubcategory) (f : P.ι.obj R ⟶ X), f = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Q.projection.Additive := Q.adjunction.right_adjoint_additive
  constructor
  · intro h R f
    apply (Q.homEquiv R X).injective
    exact h.eq_of_tgt _ _
  · intro h
    rw [Limits.IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
    apply (Q.homEquivFromProject (Q.project X) X).injective
    rw [Q.homEquivFromProject_id]
    exact (h (Q.project X) (Q.counitApp X)).trans (by
      change 0 = (Q.adjunction.homEquiv (Q.project X) X).symm 0
      exact (Q.adjunction.homAddEquiv_symm_zero (Q.project X) X).symm)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.OrthogonalExceptionalBlocks.projectedObjectHomEquiv_id

theorem projectedObjectHomEquiv_id
    (B : OrthogonalExceptionalBlocks k C ι)

        (𝟙 (B.projectedObject Q i)) =
      Q.counitApp (B.firstObject i)
proof:
:=
  Q.homEquivFromProject_id (B.firstObject i)

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.RightProjectionData.mappedCounit_isIso
statement:
private lemma mappedCounit_isIso (Y : C) :
    IsIso (q.projection.map (F.map (p.counitApp Y)))
proof:
:= by
  let M := p.counitTriangle hP Y
  have hFM : Q.rightOrthogonal (F.obj M.mutation) := horth _ M.mutation_mem
  apply q.projectMap_isIso_of_distinguished hQ
    (F.map (p.counitApp Y)) (F.map M.toMutation)
    (F.map M.connecting ≫ (F.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app (p.projectObj Y))
  · exact F.map_distinguished _ M.distinguished
  · exact hFM

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.RightProjectionData.projectionMate_app
statement:
private lemma projectionMate_app (Y : C) :
    (projectionMate p q F G inc).app Y =
      q.adjunction.unit.app (G.obj (p.project Y)) ≫
        q.projection.map ((inc.app (p.project Y)).hom) ≫
          q.projection.map (F.map (p.counitApp Y))
proof:
:= by
  simp [projectionMate, mateEquiv]

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.RightProjectionData.projectionMate_app_isIso
statement:
private lemma projectionMate_app_isIso (Y : C) :
    IsIso ((projectionMate p q F G inc).app Y)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Q.ι.Full := Q.fullyFaithfulι.full
  letI : Q.ι.Faithful := Q.fullyFaithfulι.faithful
  letI : IsIso q.adjunction.unit := q.adjunction.unit_isIso_of_L_fully_faithful
  have hunit : IsIso (q.adjunction.unit.app (G.obj (p.project Y))) :=
    NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso _ _
  have hinc : IsIso (q.projection.map ((inc.app (p.project Y)).hom)) := inferInstance
  have hcounit : IsIso (q.projection.map (F.map (p.counitApp Y))) :=
    mappedCounit_isIso p q F hP hQ horth Y
  rw [projectionMate_app]
  exact IsIso.comp_isIso'
    (f := q.adjunction.unit.app (G.obj (p.project Y)))
    (h := q.projection.map ((inc.app (p.project Y)).hom) ≫
      q.projection.map (F.map (p.counitApp Y)))
    hunit
    (IsIso.comp_isIso'
      (f := q.projection.map ((inc.app (p.project Y)).hom))
      (h := q.projection.map (F.map (p.counitApp Y)))
      hinc hcounit)

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.RightProjectionData.projectionMateIso_counit
statement:
theorem projectionMateIso_counit (Y : C) :
    q.counitApp (F.obj Y) =
      Q.ι.map (((projectionMateIso p q F G inc hP hQ horth).app Y).hom) ≫
        (inc.app (p.project Y)).hom ≫ F.map (p.counitApp Y)
proof:
:= by
  let e := projectionMateIso p q F G inc hP hQ horth
  haveI : Epi (Q.ι.map (e.inv.app Y)) := inferInstance
  apply (cancel_epi (Q.ι.map (e.inv.app Y))).mp
  have hm := mateEquiv_counit p.adjunction q.adjunction inc.hom Y
  change Q.ι.map (e.inv.app Y) ≫ q.counitApp (F.obj Y) =
      (inc.app (p.project Y)).hom ≫ F.map (p.counitApp Y) at hm
  change Q.ι.map (e.inv.app Y) ≫ q.counitApp (F.obj Y) =
    Q.ι.map (e.inv.app Y) ≫ Q.ι.map (e.hom.app Y) ≫
      (inc.app (p.project Y)).hom ≫ F.map (p.counitApp Y)
  simp only [← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_app, Functor.map_id,
    Category.id_comp]
  exact hm

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.ExceptionalCollection.obj_mem_span
statement:
theorem obj_mem_span (E : ExceptionalCollection k C ι) (i : ι) :
    E.span (E.obj i)
proof:
:= by
  apply ObjectProperty.le_triangEnvelope
  exact E.toSemiorthogonalSequence.component_le_total
    (OrderDual.toDual i) (E.obj i) (E.obj_mem_component i)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.ExceptionalCollection.span_isTriangulated
statement:
theorem span_isTriangulated [Nonempty ι] [IsTriangulated C]
    (E : ExceptionalCollection k C ι) : E.span.IsTriangulated
proof:
:= by
  haveI : E.toSemiorthogonalSequence.total.Nonempty := by
    let i : ι := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty ι)
    exact ⟨E.obj i, E.toSemiorthogonalSequence.component_le_total
      (OrderDual.toDual i) (E.obj i) (E.obj_mem_component i)⟩
  infer_instance

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.OrthogonalExceptionalBlocks.obj_mem_blockSpan
statement:
theorem obj_mem_blockSpan (i : ι) (j : Fin (B.length i)) :
    B.blockSpan i ((B.collection i).obj j)
proof:
:=
  (B.collection i).obj_mem_span j

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.OrthogonalExceptionalBlocks.obj_mem_total
statement:
theorem obj_mem_total (i : ι) (j : Fin (B.length i)) :
    B.total ((B.collection i).obj j)
proof:
:=
  le_iSup B.blockSpan i _ (B.obj_mem_blockSpan i j)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.OrthogonalExceptionalBlocks.total_le_of_forall_obj
statement:
theorem total_le_of_forall_obj
    {P : ObjectProperty C} [P.IsTriangulated] [P.IsStableUnderRetracts]
    (hP : ∀ (i : ι) (j : Fin (B.length i)),
      P ((B.collection i).obj j)) :
    B.total ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  rw [total]
  apply iSup_le
  intro i
  change (B.collection i).toSemiorthogonalSequence.total.triangEnvelope ≤ P
  rw [ObjectProperty.triangEnvelope_le_iff]
  rw [SemiorthogonalSequence.total]
  apply iSup_le
  intro j
  change (ObjectProperty.shiftClosure
    (fun X : C ↦ X = (B.collection i).obj j) ℤ).triangEnvelope ≤ P
  rw [ObjectProperty.triangEnvelope_le_iff]
  rw [ObjectProperty.shiftClosure_le_iff]
  intro X hX
  subst X
  exact hP i j

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.OrthogonalExceptionalBlocks.length_eq_one_or_two_le
statement:
theorem length_eq_one_or_two_le (i : ι) :
    B.length i = 1 ∨ 2 ≤ B.length i
proof:
:= by
  have := B.length_pos i
  omega

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.OrthogonalExceptionalBlocks.hom_eq_zero_of_ne
proof:
:=

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.retractClosure_isClosedUnderBinaryProducts
statement:
private lemma retractClosure_isClosedUnderBinaryProducts (Q : ObjectProperty C)
    [HasBinaryProducts C] [Q.IsClosedUnderBinaryProducts] :
    Q.retractClosure.IsClosedUnderBinaryProducts where
  limitsOfShape_le
proof:
:= by
    intro X hX
    rcases hX with ⟨p⟩
    let X₁ := p.diag.obj ⟨WalkingPair.left⟩
    let X₂ := p.diag.obj ⟨WalkingPair.right⟩
    have hdiag : p.diag = Limits.pair X₁ X₂ := by
      ext j
      cases j <;> rfl
    have hprod : Q.retractClosure (X₁ ⨯ X₂) := by
      rcases p.prop_diag_obj ⟨WalkingPair.left⟩ with ⟨A, hA, ⟨rA⟩⟩
      rcases p.prop_diag_obj ⟨WalkingPair.right⟩ with ⟨B, hB, ⟨rB⟩⟩
      exact ⟨A ⨯ B, Q.prop_prod A B hA hB, ⟨retractBinaryProduct rA rB⟩⟩
    let e : X ≅ X₁ ⨯ X₂ :=
      p.isLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso (Limits.limit.isLimit p.diag) ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg (fun F : Discrete WalkingPair ⥤ C => limit F) hdiag)
    exact Q.retractClosure.prop_of_iso e.symm hprod

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.extensionProduct_prop_prod
statement:
private lemma extensionProduct_prop_prod (Q R : ObjectProperty C)
    [HasBinaryProducts C] [Q.IsClosedUnderBinaryProducts] [R.IsClosedUnderBinaryProducts]
    {X Y : C} (hX : extensionProduct Q R X) (hY : extensionProduct Q R Y) :
    extensionProduct Q R (X ⨯ Y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hX with ⟨A₁, B₁, f₁, g₁, k₁, hT₁, hQ₁, hR₁⟩
  rcases hY with ⟨A₂, B₂, f₂, g₂, k₂, hT₂, hQ₂, hR₂⟩
  let T₁ : Triangle C := Triangle.mk f₁ g₁ k₁
  let T₂ : Triangle C := Triangle.mk f₂ g₂ k₂
  let T : WalkingPair → Triangle C := fun j => j.casesOn T₁ T₂
  have hT : ∀ j, T j ∈ distTriang C := by
    intro j
    cases j with
    | left => exact hT₁
    | right => exact hT₂
  let U := productTriangle T
  have hU : U ∈ distTriang C := productTriangle_distinguished T hT
  have hQA : Q U.obj₁ := by
    simpa [U] using Q.prop_pi (fun j : WalkingPair => (T j).obj₁) (by
      intro j
      cases j with
      | left => exact hQ₁
      | right => exact hQ₂)
  have hRB : R U.obj₃ := by
    simpa [U] using R.prop_pi (fun j : WalkingPair => (T j).obj₃) (by
      intro j
      cases j with
      | left => exact hR₁
      | right => exact hR₂)
  have hUmem : extensionProduct Q R U.obj₂ :=
    ⟨U.obj₁, U.obj₃, U.mor₁, U.mor₂, U.mor₃, hU, hQA, hRB⟩
  let F : WalkingPair → C := fun j => (T j).obj₂
  let A := (Discrete.functor F).obj ⟨WalkingPair.left⟩
  let B := (Discrete.functor F).obj ⟨WalkingPair.right⟩
  have hFan : IsLimit (Fan.mk U.obj₂ (Pi.π F)) := productIsProduct F
  let α := diagramIsoPair (Discrete.functor F)
  let c : Fan F := Fan.mk U.obj₂ (Pi.π F)
  let d := (Cone.postcompose α.hom).obj c
  have hMid : IsLimit d :=
    (IsLimit.equivOfNatIsoOfIso α c d (Iso.refl d)).toFun hFan
  let e : U.obj₂ ≅ A ⨯ B :=
    IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso hMid (Limits.limit.isLimit (Limits.pair A B))
  have hA : A = X := by dsimp [A, F, T, T₁, T₂]; rfl
  have hB : B = Y := by dsimp [B, F, T, T₁, T₂]; rfl
  exact (extensionProduct Q R).prop_of_iso (e ≪≫ eqToIso (by rw [hA, hB])) hUmem

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.extensionProduct_isClosedUnderBinaryProducts
statement:
private lemma extensionProduct_isClosedUnderBinaryProducts (Q R : ObjectProperty C)
    [HasBinaryProducts C] [Q.IsClosedUnderBinaryProducts] [R.IsClosedUnderBinaryProducts] :
    (extensionProduct Q R).IsClosedUnderBinaryProducts where
  limitsOfShape_le
proof:
:= by
    intro X hX
    rcases hX with ⟨p⟩
    let X₁ := p.diag.obj ⟨WalkingPair.left⟩
    let X₂ := p.diag.obj ⟨WalkingPair.right⟩
    have hdiag : p.diag = Limits.pair X₁ X₂ := by
      ext j
      cases j <;> rfl
    have hprod : extensionProduct Q R (X₁ ⨯ X₂) :=
      extensionProduct_prop_prod Q R (p.prop_diag_obj ⟨WalkingPair.left⟩)
        (p.prop_diag_obj ⟨WalkingPair.right⟩)
    let e : X ≅ X₁ ⨯ X₂ :=
      p.isLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso (Limits.limit.isLimit p.diag) ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg (fun F : Discrete WalkingPair ⥤ C => limit F) hdiag)
    exact (extensionProduct Q R).prop_of_iso e.symm hprod

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.triangEnvelopeIter_isClosedUnderBinaryProducts
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [triangEnvelopeIter_zero]
    letI : ((P.shiftClosure ℤ).binaryProductsClosure).IsClosedUnderBinaryProducts := by
      infer_instance
    exact retractClosure_isClosedUnderBinaryProducts _
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [triangEnvelopeIter_succ P n]
    letI : (P.triangEnvelopeIter n).IsClosedUnderBinaryProducts := ih
    letI : ((P.shiftClosure ℤ).binaryProductsClosure.retractClosure).IsClosedUnderBinaryProducts :=
      retractClosure_isClosedUnderBinaryProducts _
    letI : (extensionProduct ((P.shiftClosure ℤ).binaryProductsClosure.retractClosure)
        (P.triangEnvelopeIter n)).IsClosedUnderBinaryProducts :=
      extensionProduct_isClosedUnderBinaryProducts _ _
    exact retractClosure_isClosedUnderBinaryProducts _

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.triangEnvelopeIter_bot_of_not_nonempty
statement:
private lemma triangEnvelopeIter_bot_of_not_nonempty (P : ObjectProperty C) (n : ℕ)
    (hP : ¬ P.Nonempty) : P.triangEnvelopeIter n = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hbot : P = ⊥ := (ObjectProperty.not_nonempty_iff_eq_bot P).mp hP
  subst P
  simp [triangEnvelopeIter]

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.triangEnvelopeIter_zero_le
statement:
theorem triangEnvelopeIter_zero_le (P : ObjectProperty C) (n : ℕ) :
    (P.triangEnvelopeIter n).triangEnvelopeIter 0 ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hP : P.Nonempty
  · letI := hP
    rw [triangEnvelopeIter_zero]
    let E := P.triangEnvelopeIter n
    letI : E.IsClosedUnderBinaryProducts := triangEnvelopeIter_isClosedUnderBinaryProducts P n
    letI : E.ContainsZero := by
      dsimp [E, triangEnvelopeIter]
      infer_instance
    rw [retractClosure_le_iff, binaryProductsClosure_le_iff, shiftClosure_le_iff]
  · rw [triangEnvelopeIter_bot_of_not_nonempty P n hP]
    simp [triangEnvelopeIter]

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.triangEnvelopeIter_compose
statement:
theorem triangEnvelopeIter_compose (P : ObjectProperty C) (m n : ℕ) :
    (P.triangEnvelopeIter m).triangEnvelopeIter n ≤
      P.triangEnvelopeIter (m * n + m + n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simpa using triangEnvelopeIter_zero_le P m
  | succ n ih =>
    let k := m * n + m + n
    let Q0 :=
      ((P.triangEnvelopeIter m).shiftClosure ℤ).binaryProductsClosure.retractClosure
    have hbase :
        Q0 ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter m := by
      have hfixed := triangEnvelopeIter_zero_le P m
      rw [triangEnvelopeIter_zero (P.triangEnvelopeIter m)] at hfixed
      simpa [Q0] using hfixed
    rw [triangEnvelopeIter_succ' (P.triangEnvelopeIter m) n]
    calc
      _ ≤ (extensionProduct (P.triangEnvelopeIter k) (P.triangEnvelopeIter m)).retractClosure := by
        apply monotone_retractClosure
        calc
          extensionProduct ((P.triangEnvelopeIter m).triangEnvelopeIter n)
              Q0
              ≤ extensionProduct (P.triangEnvelopeIter k)
                  Q0 :=
                monotone_extensionProduct_left _ ih
          _ ≤ extensionProduct (P.triangEnvelopeIter k) (P.triangEnvelopeIter m) :=
                monotone_extensionProduct_right _ hbase
      _ ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter (m * (n + 1) + m + (n + 1)) := by
        have hk : m * (n + 1) + m + (n + 1) = k + (m + 1) := by
          simp only [Nat.mul_succ]
          dsimp [k]
          omega
        rw [hk, P.triangEnvelopeIter_add' (n := k) (m := m + 1) (m' := m) rfl]

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.le_triangEnvelopeIter_of_le_triangEnvelopeIter
statement:
theorem le_triangEnvelopeIter_of_le_triangEnvelopeIter
    {P Q R : ObjectProperty C} {m n : ℕ}
    (hQP : Q ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter m) (hRQ : R ≤ Q.triangEnvelopeIter n) :
    R ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter (m * n + m + n)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    R ≤ Q.triangEnvelopeIter n := hRQ
    _ ≤ (P.triangEnvelopeIter m).triangEnvelopeIter n := monotone_triangEnvelopeIter hQP n
    _ ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter (m * n + m + n) := triangEnvelopeIter_compose P m n

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.nonempty_of_triangEnvelopeIter_nonempty
statement:
private lemma nonempty_of_triangEnvelopeIter_nonempty (P : ObjectProperty C) (n : ℕ)
    (hT : (P.triangEnvelopeIter n).Nonempty) : P.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hP
  have hbot : P = ⊥ := (ObjectProperty.not_nonempty_iff_eq_bot P).mp hP
  subst P
  simp [triangEnvelopeIter] at hT
  letI : (⊥ : ObjectProperty C).Nonempty := hT
  rcases exists_prop_of_nonempty (⊥ : ObjectProperty C) with ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact hx

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.nonempty_of_isStrongTriangulatedGenerator
statement:
private lemma nonempty_of_isStrongTriangulatedGenerator (Q : ObjectProperty C)
    (hQ : Q.IsStrongTriangulatedGenerator) : Q.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hQ
  apply nonempty_of_triangEnvelopeIter_nonempty Q n
  rw [hn]
  infer_instance

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_of_strong_le_iter
statement:
theorem isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_of_strong_le_iter
    (P Q : ObjectProperty C) (k : ℕ)
    (hQ : Q.IsStrongTriangulatedGenerator) (hQP : Q ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter k) :
    P.IsStrongTriangulatedGenerator
proof:
:= by
  have hQne : Q.Nonempty := nonempty_of_isStrongTriangulatedGenerator Q hQ
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hQ
  letI : P.Nonempty := nonempty_of_triangEnvelopeIter_nonempty P k (hQne.mono hQP)
  apply (isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_iff P).2
  refine ⟨k * n + k + n, top_le_iff.1 ?_⟩
  calc
    ⊤ = Q.triangEnvelopeIter n := hn.symm
    _ ≤ (P.triangEnvelopeIter k).triangEnvelopeIter n := monotone_triangEnvelopeIter hQP n
    _ ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter (k * n + k + n) := triangEnvelopeIter_compose P k n

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_of_isClassical_of_singleton_strong
statement:
theorem isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_of_isClassical_of_singleton_strong
    (P : ObjectProperty C) (G : C)
    (hP : P.IsClassicalTriangulatedGenerator)
    (hG : (singleton G).IsStrongTriangulatedGenerator) :
    P.IsStrongTriangulatedGenerator
proof:
:= by
  have hGmem : P.triangEnvelope G := by
    rw [isClassicalTriangulatedGenerator_iff] at hP
    rw [hP]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (P.prop_triangEnvelope_iff G).1 hGmem
  apply CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_of_strong_le_iter
    P (singleton G) k hG
  exact singleton_le_iff.2 hk

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.shiftClosure_map_obj
statement:
private lemma shiftClosure_map_obj (F : C ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ]
    (P : ObjectProperty C) (Q : ObjectProperty D)
    (h : ∀ X, P X → Q (F.obj X)) (X : C)
    (hX : P.shiftClosure ℤ X) : Q.shiftClosure ℤ (F.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hX with ⟨Y, n, e, hY⟩
  exact ⟨F.obj Y, n, (F.mapIso e).trans ((F.commShiftIso n).app Y), h Y hY⟩

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.binaryProductsClosure_map_obj
statement:
private lemma binaryProductsClosure_map_obj (F : C ⥤ D)
    [PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete WalkingPair) F]
    (P : ObjectProperty C) (Q : ObjectProperty D)
    (h : ∀ X, P X → Q (F.obj X)) (X : C)
    (hX : P.binaryProductsClosure X) : Q.binaryProductsClosure (F.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : P ≤ Q.binaryProductsClosure.inverseImage F := by
    intro Y hY
    exact Q.le_limitsClosure _ _ (h Y hY)
  exact limitsClosure_le hbase X hX

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.retractClosure_map_obj
statement:
private lemma retractClosure_map_obj (F : C ⥤ D)
    (P : ObjectProperty C) (Q : ObjectProperty D)
    (h : ∀ X, P X → Q (F.obj X)) (X : C)
    (hX : P.retractClosure X) : Q.retractClosure (F.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hX with ⟨Y, hY, ⟨r⟩⟩
  exact ⟨F.obj Y, h Y hY, ⟨r.map F⟩⟩

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.extensionProduct_map_obj
statement:
private lemma extensionProduct_map_obj (F : C ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    (P R : ObjectProperty C) (Q S : ObjectProperty D)
    (hP : ∀ X, P X → Q (F.obj X)) (hR : ∀ X, R X → S (F.obj X)) (X : C)
    (hX : extensionProduct P R X) : extensionProduct Q S (F.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hX with ⟨Y, Z, f, g, t, ht, hY, hZ⟩
  exact ⟨F.obj Y, F.obj Z, F.map f, F.map g,
    F.map t ≫ (F.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app Y,
    F.map_distinguished _ ht, hP Y hY, hR Z hZ⟩

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.triangEnvelopeIter_map_obj_of_le
statement:
theorem triangEnvelopeIter_map_obj_of_le (F : C ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    (P : ObjectProperty C) (Q : ObjectProperty D) (h : ∀ X, P X → Q (F.obj X))
    (X : C) (n : ℕ) (hX : P.triangEnvelopeIter n X) :
    Q.triangEnvelopeIter n (F.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : ∀ X, P.shiftClosure ℤ X → Q.shiftClosure ℤ (F.obj X) :=
    fun X hX => shiftClosure_map_obj F P Q h X hX
  have hproducts : ∀ X, (P.shiftClosure ℤ).binaryProductsClosure X →
      (Q.shiftClosure ℤ).binaryProductsClosure (F.obj X) :=
    fun X hX => binaryProductsClosure_map_obj F _ _ hshift X hX
  have hbase : ∀ X, ((P.shiftClosure ℤ).binaryProductsClosure).retractClosure X →
      ((Q.shiftClosure ℤ).binaryProductsClosure).retractClosure (F.obj X) :=
    fun X hX => retractClosure_map_obj F _ _ hproducts X hX
  induction n generalizing X with
  | zero =>
    simpa only [triangEnvelopeIter_zero] using
      hbase X (by simpa only [triangEnvelopeIter_zero] using hX)
  | succ n ih =>
    have hX' :
        ((P.shiftClosure ℤ).binaryProductsClosure.retractClosure.extensionProduct
          (P.triangEnvelopeIter n)).retractClosure X := by
      simpa only [triangEnvelopeIter_succ] using hX
    have hY := retractClosure_map_obj F _ _
      (extensionProduct_map_obj F _ _ _ _ hbase (fun X hX => ih X hX)) X hX'
    simpa only [triangEnvelopeIter_succ] using hY

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.triangEnvelopeIter_map_obj
statement:
theorem triangEnvelopeIter_map_obj (F : C ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    (P : ObjectProperty C) (n : ℕ) {X : C} (hX : P.triangEnvelopeIter n X) :
    (P.map F).triangEnvelopeIter n (F.obj X)
proof:
:=
  triangEnvelopeIter_map_obj_of_le F P (P.map F) (fun _ hP => P.prop_map_obj F hP) X n hX

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.triangEnvelopeIter_map_le
statement:
theorem triangEnvelopeIter_map_le (F : C ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    (P : ObjectProperty C) (n : ℕ) :
    (P.triangEnvelopeIter n).map F ≤ (P.map F).triangEnvelopeIter n
proof:
:= by
  rintro Y ⟨X, hX, ⟨e⟩⟩
  exact ((P.map F).triangEnvelopeIter n).prop_of_iso e (triangEnvelopeIter_map_obj F P n hX)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.singleton_triangEnvelopeIter_map_obj
statement:
theorem singleton_triangEnvelopeIter_map_obj (F : C ⥤ D)
    [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated] (G : C) (n : ℕ) {X : C}
    (hX : (ObjectProperty.singleton G).triangEnvelopeIter n X) :
    (ObjectProperty.singleton (F.obj G)).triangEnvelopeIter n (F.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  apply ObjectProperty.triangEnvelopeIter_map_obj_of_le F _ _ _ X n hX
  intro X hX
  obtain rfl := (ObjectProperty.singleton_iff G X).1 hX
  exact (ObjectProperty.singleton_iff _ _).2 rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.singleton_triangEnvelopeIter_top_of_retract_coverage
statement:
theorem singleton_triangEnvelopeIter_top_of_retract_coverage (F : C ⥤ D)
    [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    (hCover : ∀ Y : D, ∃ X : C, Nonempty (Retract Y (F.obj X))) (G : C) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : (ObjectProperty.singleton G).triangEnvelopeIter n = ⊤) :
    (ObjectProperty.singleton (F.obj G)).triangEnvelopeIter n = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_le_iff.mp
  intro Y _
  obtain ⟨X, ⟨r⟩⟩ := hCover Y
  exact ((ObjectProperty.singleton (F.obj G)).triangEnvelopeIter n).prop_of_retract r
    (singleton_triangEnvelopeIter_map_obj F G n (by rw [hn]; trivial))

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_map_of_retract_coverage
statement:
theorem isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_map_of_retract_coverage (F : C ⥤ D)
    [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    (hCover : ∀ Y : D, ∃ X : C, Nonempty (Retract Y (F.obj X))) (G : C)
    (hG : (ObjectProperty.singleton G).IsStrongTriangulatedGenerator) :
    (ObjectProperty.singleton (F.obj G)).IsStrongTriangulatedGenerator
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hG
  exact ⟨n, singleton_triangEnvelopeIter_top_of_retract_coverage F hCover G n hn⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.exists_isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_iff_of_equiv
statement:
theorem exists_isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_iff_of_equiv (E : C ≌ D)
    [E.functor.CommShift ℤ] [E.functor.IsTriangulated] :
    (∃ G : C, (ObjectProperty.singleton G).IsStrongTriangulatedGenerator) ↔
      ∃ H : D, (ObjectProperty.singleton H).IsStrongTriangulatedGenerator
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨G, hG⟩
    exact ⟨E.functor.obj G, isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_map_of_retract_coverage E.functor
      (fun Y => by
        let X := E.functor.objPreimage Y
        exact ⟨X, ⟨(E.functor.objObjPreimageIso Y).symm.retract⟩⟩) G hG⟩
  · rintro ⟨H, hH⟩
    letI := E.commShiftInverse ℤ
    letI := E.commShift_of_functor ℤ
    letI := E.toAdjunction.isTriangulated_rightAdjoint
    exact ⟨E.inverse.obj H, isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_map_of_retract_coverage E.inverse
      (fun X => by
        let Y := E.inverse.objPreimage X
        exact ⟨Y, ⟨(E.inverse.objObjPreimageIso X).symm.retract⟩⟩) H hH⟩

statement:
theorem map_twistK₀ (E : C) (x : K₀ C) :

proof:

    Mukai.pairing_comm b R.symm (R.v x) (R.v (K₀.of C E)),
    R.chi_eq_neg_pairing (K₀.of C E) x, neg_smul, sub_neg_eq_add]

proof:

    letI : K.twist.h0.IsTriangulated := K.twistH0IsTriangulated

    (hsymm : ∀ x y : K₀ C, chiK₀ k C x y = chiK₀ k C y x) {E : C}
    (hE : chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C E) (K₀.of C E) = 2) (x y : K₀ C) :
    chiK₀ k C (twistK₀ k C E x) (twistK₀ k C E y) = chiK₀ k C x y
proof:

  have hxE : chiK₀ k C x (K₀.of C E) = chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C E) x := hsymm _ _
  simp only [twistK₀_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply,
    AddMonoidHom.zsmul_apply, hE, hxE, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

theorem twistH0EquivalenceIsTriangulated [IsPretriangulated B]
    (h : TwistCotwistEquivalenceConditions P) :
    letI : (P.twistH0Equivalence h).functor.CommShift ℤ
proof:
:= P.twistH0CommShift
    letI : (P.twistH0Equivalence h).inverse.CommShift ℤ :=
      (P.twistH0Equivalence h).commShiftInverse ℤ
    letI : (P.twistH0Equivalence h).CommShift ℤ :=
      (P.twistH0Equivalence h).commShift_of_functor ℤ
    (P.twistH0Equivalence h).IsTriangulated := by
  letI : (P.twistH0Equivalence h).functor.CommShift ℤ := P.twistH0CommShift
  letI : (P.twistH0Equivalence h).inverse.CommShift ℤ :=
    (P.twistH0Equivalence h).commShiftInverse ℤ
  letI : (P.twistH0Equivalence h).CommShift ℤ :=
    (P.twistH0Equivalence h).commShift_of_functor ℤ
  exact Equivalence.IsTriangulated.mk' _ P.twistH0IsTriangulated

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SphericalTwist.EnhancedAdjunctionCones.cotwistH0EquivalenceIsTriangulated
statement:
theorem cotwistH0EquivalenceIsTriangulated [IsPretriangulated A]
    (h : TwistCotwistEquivalenceConditions P) :
    letI : (P.cotwistH0Equivalence h).functor.CommShift ℤ
proof:
:= P.cotwistH0CommShift
    letI : (P.cotwistH0Equivalence h).inverse.CommShift ℤ :=
      (P.cotwistH0Equivalence h).commShiftInverse ℤ
    letI : (P.cotwistH0Equivalence h).CommShift ℤ :=
      (P.cotwistH0Equivalence h).commShift_of_functor ℤ
    (P.cotwistH0Equivalence h).IsTriangulated := by
  letI : (P.cotwistH0Equivalence h).functor.CommShift ℤ := P.cotwistH0CommShift
  letI : (P.cotwistH0Equivalence h).inverse.CommShift ℤ :=
    (P.cotwistH0Equivalence h).commShiftInverse ℤ
  letI : (P.cotwistH0Equivalence h).CommShift ℤ :=
    (P.cotwistH0Equivalence h).commShift_of_functor ℤ
  exact Equivalence.IsTriangulated.mk' _ P.cotwistH0IsTriangulated

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SphericalTwist.EnhancedAdjunctionCones.twistFunctorK₀Of
statement:
theorem twistFunctorK₀Of (X : H0 B) :
    K₀.of (H0 B) (P.twistFunctor.h0.obj X) =
      K₀.of (H0 B) X - K₀.of (H0 B) ((R.comp S).h0.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  have h := K₀.of_triangle (H0 B) ((P.twistTriangleFunctor).obj X)
    (P.twistTriangleFunctor_obj_mem_distinguishedTriangles X)
  change K₀.of (H0 B) X =
    K₀.of (H0 B) ((R.comp S).h0.obj X) +
      K₀.of (H0 B) (P.twistFunctor.h0.obj X) at h
  rw [h]
  abel

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SphericalTwist.EnhancedAdjunctionCones.twistFunctorK₀Map
statement:
theorem twistFunctorK₀Map :
    letI : P.twistFunctor.h0.CommShift ℤ
proof:
:= P.twistH0CommShift
    letI : P.twistFunctor.h0.IsTriangulated :=
      P.twistH0IsTriangulated
    letI : (R.comp S).h0.CommShift ℤ :=
      DGFunctor.h0CommShift (R.comp S)
    letI : (R.comp S).h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated (R.comp S)
    K₀.map P.twistFunctor.h0 =
      AddMonoidHom.id (K₀ (H0 B)) - K₀.map (R.comp S).h0 := by
  letI : P.twistFunctor.h0.CommShift ℤ := P.twistH0CommShift
  letI : P.twistFunctor.h0.IsTriangulated :=
    P.twistH0IsTriangulated
  letI : (R.comp S).h0.CommShift ℤ :=
    DGFunctor.h0CommShift (R.comp S)
  letI : (R.comp S).h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated (R.comp S)
  apply K₀.hom_ext
  intro X
  change K₀.of (H0 B) (P.twistFunctor.h0.obj X) =
    K₀.of (H0 B) X - K₀.of (H0 B) ((R.comp S).h0.obj X)
  exact P.twistFunctorK₀Of X

statement: theorem map_inverse_eq : K₀.map T.Φ.e.inverse = twistK₀ k C E
proof:
:= by
  have hid : (K₀.map T.Φ.e.inverse).comp (K₀.map T.Φ.e.functor) = AddMonoidHom.id (K₀ C) := by
    rw [← K₀.map_comp, K₀.map_congr T.Φ.e.unitIso.symm, K₀.map_id]
  refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  have hx : K₀.map T.Φ.e.inverse (twistK₀ k C E (twistK₀ k C E x)) = twistK₀ k C E x := by
    have := DFunLike.congr_fun hid (twistK₀ k C E x)
    rwa [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, T.map_eq] at this
  rwa [twistK₀_twistK₀ k C T.chi_self x] at hx

:= by

theorem finrank_hom_eq_zero (i : ℤ) (hi₀ : i ≠ 0) (hin : i ≠ n) :
    finrank k (E ⟶ E⟦i⟧) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton (E ⟶ E⟦i⟧) :=
    ⟨fun f g ↦ by rw [h.vanishing i hi₀ hin f, h.vanishing i hi₀ hin g]⟩
  exact finrank_zero_of_subsingleton

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SphericalTwist.IsSphericalObject.finrank_shift_zero
statement: theorem finrank_shift_zero : finrank k (E ⟶ (shiftFunctor C (0 : ℤ)).obj E) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have e : (E ⟶ (shiftFunctor C (0 : ℤ)).obj E) ≃ₗ[k] (E ⟶ E) :=
    Linear.homCongr k (Iso.refl E) ((shiftFunctorZero C ℤ).app E)
  rw [e.finrank_eq, h.finrank_end]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SphericalTwist.IsSphericalObject.of_iso
statement:
theorem of_iso (e : E ≅ F) : IsSphericalObject k n F where
  vanishing i hi₀ hin f
proof:
:= by
    have := h.vanishing i hi₀ hin (e.hom ≫ f ≫ (shiftFunctor C i).map e.inv)
    have he : f = e.inv ≫ (e.hom ≫ f ≫ (shiftFunctor C i).map e.inv) ≫
        (shiftFunctor C i).map e.hom := by
      simp [← Functor.map_comp]
    rw [he, this, zero_comp, comp_zero]
  end_one := ⟨(Linear.homCongr k e e).symm.trans h.end_one.some⟩
  top_one := ⟨(Linear.homCongr k e ((shiftFunctor C n).mapIso e)).symm.trans h.top_one.some⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SphericalTwist.chiHom_self_eq
statement:
theorem chiHom_self_eq (h : IsSphericalObject k n E) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    chiHom k C E E = 1 + (n.negOnePow : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : (Function.support fun i : ℤ ↦ (i.negOnePow : ℤ) * finrank k (E ⟶ E⟦i⟧)) ⊆
      (({0, n} : Finset ℤ) : Set ℤ) := by
    intro i hi
    by_contra hmem
    simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_insert_iff,
      Set.mem_singleton_iff, not_or] at hmem
    exact hi (by simp [h.finrank_hom_eq_zero i hmem.1 hmem.2])
  have hsum : chiHom k C E E =
      ∑ i ∈ ({0, n} : Finset ℤ), (i.negOnePow : ℤ) * finrank k (E ⟶ E⟦i⟧) :=
    finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hsupp
  rw [hsum]
  simp [Finset.sum_pair (Ne.symm hn), h.finrank_shift_zero, h.finrank_top]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SphericalTwist.chiHom_self_eq_one_of_zero
statement:
theorem chiHom_self_eq_one_of_zero (h : IsSphericalObject k (0 : ℤ) E) :
    chiHom k C E E = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : (Function.support fun i : ℤ ↦ (i.negOnePow : ℤ) * finrank k (E ⟶ E⟦i⟧)) ⊆
      (({0} : Finset ℤ) : Set ℤ) := by
    intro i hi
    by_contra hmem
    simp only [Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hmem
    exact hi (by simp [h.finrank_hom_eq_zero i hmem hmem])
  have hsum : chiHom k C E E =
      ∑ i ∈ ({0} : Finset ℤ), (i.negOnePow : ℤ) * finrank k (E ⟶ E⟦i⟧) :=
    finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hsupp
  rw [hsum]
  simp [h.finrank_shift_zero]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SphericalTwist.chiK₀_of_self_eq_two

statement:
theorem map_comp_comp_eq_twistK₀ :
    K₀.map (d₁.T ⋙ d₂.T ⋙ d₃.T) =
      (twistK₀ k C E₃).comp ((twistK₀ k C E₂).comp (twistK₀ k C E₁))
proof:
:= by
  rw [K₀.map_comp, K₀.map_comp, d₁.map_eq_twistK₀, d₂.map_eq_twistK₀, d₃.map_eq_twistK₀]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.TwistConeData.twistK₀Of_eq_twistK₀
statement:
theorem twistK₀Of_eq_twistK₀ (hV : V.IsEulerCopower k) (X : H0 C) :
    K₀.of (H0 C) (K.twist.h0.obj X) =
      SphericalTwist.twistK₀ k (H0 C) (show H0 C from E)
        (K₀.of (H0 C) X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SphericalTwist.twistK₀_of, K.twistK₀Of, hV X, chiRight_of]

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.TwistConeData.twistK₀Map_eq_twistK₀
statement:
theorem twistK₀Map_eq_twistK₀
    (hV : V.IsEulerCopower k) :
    letI : K.twist.h0.CommShift ℤ
proof:
:=
      DGFunctor.h0CommShift K.twist
    letI : K.twist.h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated K.twist
    K₀.map K.twist.h0 =
      SphericalTwist.twistK₀ k (H0 C) (show H0 C from E) := by
  letI : K.twist.h0.CommShift ℤ :=
    DGFunctor.h0CommShift K.twist
  letI : K.twist.h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated K.twist
  apply K₀.hom_ext
  intro X
  rw [K₀.map_of]
  exact K.twistK₀Of_eq_twistK₀ k hV X

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SphericalTwist.chiK₀_twistK₀_right
statement:
theorem chiK₀_twistK₀_right (E F : C) (x : K₀ C) :
    chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C F) (twistK₀ k C E x)
      = chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C F) x
        - chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C E) x * chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C F) (K₀.of C E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistK₀_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SphericalTwist.SphericalPairData.symm
statement:
theorem symm {A B : C} (h : SphericalPairData k C A B) :
    SphericalPairData k C B A where
  chi_A
proof:
:= h.chi_B
  chi_B := h.chi_A
  a_two := by rw [mul_comm]; exact h.a_two

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SphericalTwist.braid_expand
statement:
theorem braid_expand {A B : C}
    (hA : chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C A) (K₀.of C A) = 2)
    (hAB : chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C A) (K₀.of C B)
      * chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C B) (K₀.of C A) = 1) (x : K₀ C) :
    twistK₀ k C A (twistK₀ k C B (twistK₀ k C A x))
      = x + (chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C A) (K₀.of C B) * chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C B) x
              - chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C A) x) • K₀.of C A
          + (chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C B) (K₀.of C A) * chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C A) x
              - chiK₀ k C (K₀.of C B) x) • K₀.of C B
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twistK₀_apply, map_sub, map_zsmul, hA]
  match_scalars <;>
    first
      | linear_combination (-((chiK₀ k C) (K₀.of C A) x)) * hAB
      | ring_nf

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SphericalTwist.twistK₀_braid_apply
statement:
theorem twistK₀_braid_apply {A B : C} (h : SphericalPairData k C A B)
    (x : K₀ C) :
    twistK₀ k C A (twistK₀ k C B (twistK₀ k C A x))
      = twistK₀ k C B (twistK₀ k C A (twistK₀ k C B x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [braid_expand h.chi_A h.a_two x,
    braid_expand h.symm.chi_A h.symm.a_two x]
  abel

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SphericalTwist.twistK₀_braid
statement:
theorem twistK₀_braid {A B : C} (h : SphericalPairData k C A B) :
    (twistK₀ k C A).comp ((twistK₀ k C B).comp (twistK₀ k C A))
      = (twistK₀ k C B).comp ((twistK₀ k C A).comp (twistK₀ k C B))
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => twistK₀_braid_apply h x

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SphericalTwist.MukaiRealization.reflect_braid
statement:
theorem reflect_braid (R : MukaiRealization k C b) {A B : C}
    (h : SphericalPairData k C A B) (x : K₀ C) :
    Mukai.reflect b (R.v (K₀.of C A)) (Mukai.reflect b (R.v (K₀.of C B))
        (Mukai.reflect b (R.v (K₀.of C A)) (R.v x)))
      = Mukai.reflect b (R.v (K₀.of C B)) (Mukai.reflect b (R.v (K₀.of C A))
          (Mukai.reflect b (R.v (K₀.of C B)) (R.v x)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← R.map_twistK₀, ← R.map_twistK₀, ← R.map_twistK₀, ← R.map_twistK₀,
    ← R.map_twistK₀, ← R.map_twistK₀, twistK₀_braid_apply h]

name: CategoryTheory.Enhancement.hasZeroObject
statement: lemma hasZeroObject (E : Enhancement.{v, u} T) : HasZeroObject T
proof:
:= by

name: CategoryTheory.IsCompactObject.of_retract
statement:
theorem IsCompactObject.of_retract {K L : C} (h : Retract K L) (hL : IsCompactObject.{0} L) :
    IsCompactObject.{0} K
proof:
:= by
  apply isCompactObject_of_bijective_directSumToHom
  intro ι _ X _
  have hφ := hL.bijective_directSumToHom X
  have hsplit : ∀ x : ⨁ i, (K ⟶ X i), directSumPrecomp X h.i (directSumPrecomp X h.r x) = x :=
    fun x ↦ by rw [directSumPrecomp_comp, h.retract, directSumPrecomp_id]
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    have h1 : directSumToHom L X (directSumPrecomp X h.r x) =
        directSumToHom L X (directSumPrecomp X h.r y) := by
      rw [directSumToHom_precomp, directSumToHom_precomp, hxy]
    rw [← hsplit x, ← hsplit y, hφ.1 h1]
  · intro f
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hφ.2 (h.r ≫ f)
    refine ⟨directSumPrecomp X h.i z, ?_⟩
    rw [directSumToHom_precomp, hz, ← Category.assoc, h.retract, Category.id_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.IsCompactObject.of_isZero
statement: theorem IsCompactObject.of_isZero {K : C} (hK : IsZero K) : IsCompactObject.{0} K
proof:
:= by
  apply isCompactObject_of_bijective_directSumToHom
  intro ι _ X _
  refine ⟨fun x y _ ↦ ?_, fun _ ↦ ⟨0, hK.eq_of_src _ _⟩⟩
  ext i
  exact hK.eq_of_src _ _

name: CategoryTheory.directSumPrecomp_exact
statement:
theorem directSumPrecomp_exact {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι] (X : ι → C) {A B Y : C}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ Y) (hzero : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hex : ∀ (i : ι) (b : B ⟶ X i), f ≫ b = 0 → ∃ a : Y ⟶ X i, b = g ≫ a)
    (x : ⨁ i, (B ⟶ X i)) :
    directSumPrecomp X f x = 0 ↔ ∃ y : ⨁ i, (Y ⟶ X i), directSumPrecomp X g y = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' : ∀ i, f ≫ x i = 0 := fun i ↦ by
      have := DFunLike.congr_fun hx i
      erw [directSumPrecomp_apply] at this
      exact this.trans (DFinsupp.zero_apply i)
    choose a ha using fun i ↦ hex i (x i) (hx' i)
    refine ⟨DirectSum.mk (fun i ↦ (Y ⟶ X i)) x.support (fun i ↦ a i.1), ?_⟩
    ext i
    rw [directSumPrecomp_apply]
    by_cases hi : i ∈ x.support
    · rw [DirectSum.mk_apply_of_mem hi]
      exact (ha i).symm
    · rw [DirectSum.mk_apply_of_notMem hi, Limits.comp_zero]
      exact (DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hi).symm
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    ext i
    simp [reassoc_of% hzero]

name: CategoryTheory.IsCompactObject.of_distTriang₃
statement:
theorem IsCompactObject.of_distTriang₃ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (h₁ : IsCompactObject.{0} T.obj₁) (h₂ : IsCompactObject.{0} T.obj₂) :
    IsCompactObject.{0} T.obj₃
proof:
:= by
  apply isCompactObject_of_bijective_directSumToHom
  intro ι _ X _
  refine AddMonoidHom.bijective_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_bijective_of_injective
    (directSumPrecomp X (-(T.mor₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'))) (directSumPrecomp X T.mor₃)
    (directSumPrecomp X T.mor₂) (directSumPrecomp X T.mor₁)
    (Preadditive.leftComp (∐ X) (-(T.mor₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'))) (Preadditive.leftComp (∐ X) T.mor₃)
    (Preadditive.leftComp (∐ X) T.mor₂) (Preadditive.leftComp (∐ X) T.mor₁)
    (directSumToHom _ X) (directSumToHom _ X) (directSumToHom _ X) (directSumToHom _ X)
    (directSumToHom _ X) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    ((h₂.shift 1).bijective_directSumToHom X).2 ((h₁.shift 1).bijective_directSumToHom X)
    (h₂.bijective_directSumToHom X) (h₁.bijective_directSumToHom X).1
  · refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
    exact (directSumToHom_precomp X _ x).symm
  · refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
    exact (directSumToHom_precomp X _ x).symm
  · refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
    exact (directSumToHom_precomp X _ x).symm
  · refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
    exact (directSumToHom_precomp X _ x).symm
  · exact fun x ↦ directSumPrecomp_exact X T.mor₃ (-(T.mor₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'))
      (by simp [comp_distTriang_mor_zero₃₁ T hT])
      (fun i b hb ↦ Triangle.yoneda_exact₃ _ (rot_of_distTriang T hT) b hb) x
  · exact fun x ↦ directSumPrecomp_exact X T.mor₂ T.mor₃ (comp_distTriang_mor_zero₂₃ T hT)
      (fun i b hb ↦ Triangle.yoneda_exact₃ T hT b hb) x
  · exact fun x ↦ directSumPrecomp_exact X T.mor₁ T.mor₂ (comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ T hT)
      (fun i b hb ↦ Triangle.yoneda_exact₂ T hT b hb) x
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₃ _ (rot_of_distTriang T hT) x hx
      exact ⟨y, hy.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
      simp [Preadditive.leftComp, comp_distTriang_mor_zero₃₁_assoc T hT]
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₃ T hT x hx
      exact ⟨y, hy.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
      simp [Preadditive.leftComp, comp_distTriang_mor_zero₂₃_assoc T hT]
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₂ T hT x hx
      exact ⟨y, hy.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
      simp [Preadditive.leftComp, comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂_assoc T hT]

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.coprodClosure_le_shift
statement:
theorem coprodClosure_le_shift
    (hG : G ≤ G.shift (1 : ℤ)) :
    G.coprodClosure.{w} ≤ G.coprodClosure.{w}.shift (1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  intro X hX
  induction hX with
  | of_mem X hX =>
      exact G.le_coprodClosure.{w} _ (hG X hX)
  | of_iso e _ ih =>
      exact .of_iso ((shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).mapIso e) ih
  | @of_coproduct ι F c hc hF ih =>
      letI : PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete ι) (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)) :=
        inferInstance
      exact .of_coproduct ((shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).mapCocone c)
        (isColimitOfPreserves (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)) hc) ih
  | of_extension T hT _ _ ih₁ ih₃ =>
      exact .of_extension ((Triangle.shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).obj T)
        (Triangle.shift_distinguished T hT (1 : ℤ)) ih₁ ih₃

proof:

    AisleData.ofApproximationMaps
      (ObjectProperty.coprodClosure_le_shift hG) happrox
  exact

      exists_triangle := hAisle.exists_triangle }
