name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.isKProjective_of_isStrictlyLE
statement:
theorem isKProjective_of_isStrictlyLE (K : CochainComplex (FGModuleCat.{u} k) ℤ)
    (d : ℤ) [K.IsStrictlyLE d] : K.IsKProjective
proof:
:=
  CochainComplex.isKProjective_of_projective K d

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.TStructure.toAmbient_isAdditive
statement:
theorem toAmbient_isAdditive :
    (abelianPresentation t.heart.FullSubcategory).IsAdditive
      ((triangulatedPresentation C).of ∘ (fun X : t.heart.FullSubcategory ↦ X.obj))
proof:
:=
  GrothendieckPresentation.IsAdditive.of_relationMap
    (P := abelianPresentation t.heart.FullSubcategory)
    (Q := triangulatedPresentation C)
    (fun X ↦ X.obj) (shortExactToTriangle t) (fun _ ↦ rfl) (fun _ ↦ rfl) (fun _ ↦ rfl)

name: CategoryTheory.K₀Ab.toAmbient_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.CategoryTheory.K₀Ab.toAmbient_of (E : t.heart.FullSubcategory) :
    K₀Ab.toAmbient t (K₀Ab.of E) = K₀.of C E.obj
proof:
:=
  (abelianPresentation t.heart.FullSubcategory).map_of
    (Q := triangulatedPresentation C) _ _ E

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.rouquierDim_le_coe_iff
statement:
theorem rouquierDim_le_coe_iff (n : ℕ) :
    rouquierDim C ≤ (n : ℕ∞) ↔
      ∃ G : C, (ObjectProperty.singleton G).triangEnvelopeIter n = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    letI : Nonempty C := ⟨HasZeroObject.zero.choose⟩
    obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ :=
      ENat.exists_eq_iInf (fun G : C ↦ (ObjectProperty.singleton G).generationTime ⊤)
    refine ⟨G, ?_⟩
    have htime : (ObjectProperty.singleton G).generationTime ⊤ ≤ (n : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [rouquierDim, ← hG] at h
      exact h
    exact top_le_iff.mp
      ((ObjectProperty.generationTime_le_coe_iff (ObjectProperty.singleton G) ⊤ n).1 htime)
  · rintro ⟨G, hG⟩
    rw [rouquierDim]
    calc
      (⨅ G' : C, (ObjectProperty.singleton G').generationTime ⊤) ≤
          (ObjectProperty.singleton G).generationTime ⊤ := iInf_le _ _
      _ ≤ (n : ℕ∞) :=
        (ObjectProperty.generationTime_le_coe_iff (ObjectProperty.singleton G) ⊤ n).2
          (top_le_iff.mpr hG)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.rouquierDim_ne_top_iff_exists_strong
statement:
theorem rouquierDim_ne_top_iff_exists_strong :
    rouquierDim C ≠ ⊤ ↔
      ∃ G : C, (ObjectProperty.singleton G).IsStrongTriangulatedGenerator
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    letI : Nonempty C := ⟨HasZeroObject.zero.choose⟩
    obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ :=
      ENat.exists_eq_iInf (fun G : C ↦ (ObjectProperty.singleton G).generationTime ⊤)
    have htime : (ObjectProperty.singleton G).generationTime ⊤ ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro htop
      apply h
      change (⨅ G' : C, (ObjectProperty.singleton G').generationTime ⊤) = ⊤
      rw [← hG, htop]
    exact ⟨G,
      (ObjectProperty.isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_iff_generationTime_ne_top
        (ObjectProperty.singleton G)).2 htime⟩
  · rintro ⟨G, hG⟩ hdim
    have htime : (ObjectProperty.singleton G).generationTime ⊤ ≠ ⊤ :=
      (ObjectProperty.isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_iff_generationTime_ne_top
        (ObjectProperty.singleton G)).1 hG
    apply htime
    have hle : rouquierDim C ≤ (ObjectProperty.singleton G).generationTime ⊤ := by
      rw [rouquierDim]
      exact iInf_le _ _
    rw [hdim] at hle
    exact top_le_iff.mp hle

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.exists_isClassicalTriangulatedGenerator_of_rouquierDim_ne_top
statement:
theorem exists_isClassicalTriangulatedGenerator_of_rouquierDim_ne_top
    (h : rouquierDim C ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ G : C, (ObjectProperty.singleton G).IsClassicalTriangulatedGenerator
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := (rouquierDim_ne_top_iff_exists_strong C).mp h
  exact ⟨G, hG.isClassicalTriangulatedGenerator⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.rouquierDim_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem rouquierDim_eq_zero_iff :
    rouquierDim C = 0 ↔
      ∃ G : C, (ObjectProperty.singleton G).triangEnvelopeIter 0 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [rouquierDim, ENat.iInf_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨G, hG⟩
    exact ⟨G, top_le_iff.mp
      ((ObjectProperty.generationTime_eq_zero_iff (ObjectProperty.singleton G) ⊤).1 hG)⟩
  · rintro ⟨G, hG⟩
    exact ⟨G,
      (ObjectProperty.generationTime_eq_zero_iff (ObjectProperty.singleton G) ⊤).2
        (top_le_iff.mpr hG)⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.ExtensionClosure.extensionProductIter_le
statement:
theorem extensionProductIter_le (P : ObjectProperty C) (n : ℕ) :
    P.extensionProductIter n ≤ ExtensionClosure P
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [ObjectProperty.extensionProductIter_zero]
      exact fun _ hP => .mem hP
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [ObjectProperty.extensionProductIter_succ]
      intro E hE
      obtain ⟨X, Y, f, g, h, hT, hX, hY⟩ :=
        (ObjectProperty.extensionProduct_iff P (P.extensionProductIter n) E).mp hE
      exact .ext hT (.mem hX) (ih Y hY)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.ExtensionClosure.le_of_closed_under_isomorphisms
proof:
:= by
  refine ExtensionClosure.le_of_closed (hzero := ?_) hPQ ?_
  · intro E hE
    exact Q.prop_of_isZero hE
  · intro X E Y f g h hT hX hY
    exact Q.ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₂ (Triangle.mk f g h) hT hX hY

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.ExtensionClosure.le_triangEnvelope
statement:
theorem le_triangEnvelope (P : ObjectProperty C) [P.Nonempty] [IsTriangulated C] :
    ExtensionClosure P ≤ P.triangEnvelope
proof:
:= by
  exact le_of_closed_under_isomorphisms (P := P) (Q := P.triangEnvelope)
    (ObjectProperty.le_triangEnvelope P)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.ExtensionClosure.eq_iSup_extensionProductIter
statement:
theorem eq_iSup_extensionProductIter (P : ObjectProperty C) [IsTriangulated C] :
    ExtensionClosure P =
      ⨆ n : ℕ, (P ⊔ (IsZero (C := C))).extensionProductIter n
proof:
:= by
  let P₀ : ObjectProperty C := P ⊔ (IsZero (C := C))
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro E hE
    induction hE with
    | zero hzero =>
        rw [ObjectProperty.prop_iSup_iff]
        refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
        simp only [ObjectProperty.extensionProductIter_zero,
          ObjectProperty.prop_sup_iff]
        exact Or.inr hzero
    | mem hP =>
        rw [ObjectProperty.prop_iSup_iff]
        refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
        simp only [ObjectProperty.extensionProductIter_zero,
          ObjectProperty.prop_sup_iff]
        exact Or.inl hP
    | ext hT _ _ ihX ihY =>
        rw [ObjectProperty.prop_iSup_iff] at ihX ihY ⊢
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ihX
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ihY
        refine ⟨n + (m + 1), ?_⟩
        rw [ObjectProperty.extensionProductIter_add' P₀ rfl]
        exact (ObjectProperty.extensionProduct_iff (P₀.extensionProductIter n)
          (P₀.extensionProductIter m) _).2 ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hT, hn, hm⟩
  · have hP₀ : P₀ ≤ ExtensionClosure P := by
        intro E hE
        rcases (ObjectProperty.prop_sup_iff P (IsZero (C := C)) E).mp hE with hP | hzero
        · exact .mem hP
        · exact .zero hzero
    have hIter : ∀ n, P₀.extensionProductIter n ≤ ExtensionClosure P := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
          rw [ObjectProperty.extensionProductIter_zero]
          exact hP₀
      | succ n ih =>
          rw [ObjectProperty.extensionProductIter_succ]
          intro E hE
          obtain ⟨X, Y, f, g, h, hT, hX, hY⟩ :=
            (ObjectProperty.extensionProduct_iff P₀
              (P₀.extensionProductIter n) E).mp hE
          exact .ext hT (hP₀ X hX) (ih Y hY)
    refine iSup_le fun n => ?_
    exact hIter n

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.ExtensionClosure.extensionProductIter_le_triangEnvelopeIter
statement:
theorem extensionProductIter_le_triangEnvelopeIter (P : ObjectProperty C) (n : ℕ) :
    P.extensionProductIter n ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter n
proof:
:= by
  rw [ObjectProperty.triangEnvelopeIter]
  refine (ObjectProperty.monotone_extensionProductIter ?_ n).trans
    (ObjectProperty.le_retractClosure _)
  calc
    P ≤ P.shiftClosure ℤ := ObjectProperty.le_shiftClosure _
    _ ≤ (P.shiftClosure ℤ).binaryProductsClosure := ObjectProperty.le_limitsClosure _ _
    _ ≤ (P.shiftClosure ℤ).binaryProductsClosure.retractClosure :=
      ObjectProperty.le_retractClosure _

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.ExtensionClosure.generationTime_singleton_le_of_mem_extensionProductIter
statement:
theorem generationTime_singleton_le_of_mem_extensionProductIter
    (P : ObjectProperty C) {X : C} (n : ℕ)
    (hX : P.extensionProductIter n X) :
    P.generationTime (ObjectProperty.singleton X) ≤ (n : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  apply (ObjectProperty.generationTime_le_coe_iff P (ObjectProperty.singleton X) n).2
  rw [ObjectProperty.singleton_le_iff]
  exact extensionProductIter_le_triangEnvelopeIter P n X hX

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.generationTime_top_of_bot_left_of_nonempty_right
statement:
private lemma generationTime_top_of_bot_left_of_nonempty_right (Q : ObjectProperty C)
    (hQ : Q.Nonempty) : (⊥ : ObjectProperty C).generationTime Q = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply (generationTime_eq_top_iff ⊥ Q).2
  intro n hn
  rw [triangEnvelopeIter_bot_of_not_nonempty ⊥ n
    ((ObjectProperty.not_nonempty_iff_eq_bot (⊥ : ObjectProperty C)).mpr rfl)] at hn
  exact ((ObjectProperty.not_nonempty_iff_eq_bot Q).mpr (le_antisymm hn bot_le)) hQ

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.generationTime_zero_of_bot_right
statement:
private lemma generationTime_zero_of_bot_right (P : ObjectProperty C) :
    P.generationTime ⊥ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (generationTime_eq_zero_iff P ⊥).2
  exact bot_le

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.generationTime_add_one_submultiplicative
statement:
theorem generationTime_add_one_submultiplicative (P Q R : ObjectProperty C) :
    P.generationTime R + 1 ≤ (P.generationTime Q + 1) * (Q.generationTime R + 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hP : P.Nonempty
  · letI := hP
    set a := P.generationTime Q
    set b := Q.generationTime R
    set c := P.generationTime R
    by_cases ha : a = ⊤
    · simp [a, ha]
    by_cases hb : b = ⊤
    · simp [a, b, hb]
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp ha
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hb
    have hQ : Q ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter m := by
      apply (generationTime_le_coe_iff P Q m).1
      simp [a, hm]
    have hR : R ≤ Q.triangEnvelopeIter n := by
      apply (generationTime_le_coe_iff Q R n).1
      simp [b, hn]
    have hcomp : (P.triangEnvelopeIter m).triangEnvelopeIter n ≤
        P.triangEnvelopeIter (m * n + m + n) := triangEnvelopeIter_compose P m n
    have hreach : R ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter (m * n + m + n) := by
      exact hR.trans ((monotone_triangEnvelopeIter hQ n).trans hcomp)
    have hc : c ≤ (m * n + m + n : ℕ∞) := by
      apply (generationTime_le_coe_iff P R (m * n + m + n)).2 hreach
    calc
      c + 1 ≤ (m * n + m + n : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
        simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hc 1
      _ = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
        exact_mod_cast (show m * n + m + n + 1 = (m + 1) * (n + 1) by
          rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
          omega)
      _ = (a + 1) * (b + 1) := by rw [← hm, ← hn]; simp
  · have hPbot : P = ⊥ := (ObjectProperty.not_nonempty_iff_eq_bot P).mp hP
    subst P
    by_cases hQ : Q.Nonempty
    · have ha : (⊥ : ObjectProperty C).generationTime Q = ⊤ :=
        generationTime_top_of_bot_left_of_nonempty_right Q hQ
      simp [ha]
    · have hQbot : Q = ⊥ := (ObjectProperty.not_nonempty_iff_eq_bot Q).mp hQ
      subst Q
      by_cases hR : R.Nonempty
      · have hb : (⊥ : ObjectProperty C).generationTime R = ⊤ :=
          generationTime_top_of_bot_left_of_nonempty_right R hR
        simp [hb]
      · have hRbot : R = ⊥ := (ObjectProperty.not_nonempty_iff_eq_bot R).mp hR
        subst R
        simp [generationTime_zero_of_bot_right]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_of_classical_of_rouquierDim_ne_top
statement:
theorem isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_of_classical_of_rouquierDim_ne_top
    (P : ObjectProperty C) (hP : P.IsClassicalTriangulatedGenerator)
    (hD : rouquierDim C ≠ ⊤) : P.IsStrongTriangulatedGenerator
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := (rouquierDim_ne_top_iff_exists_strong C).mp hD
  exact ObjectProperty.isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_of_isClassical_of_singleton_strong
    P G hP hG

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.generationTime_ne_top_of_classical_of_rouquierDim_ne_top
statement:
theorem generationTime_ne_top_of_classical_of_rouquierDim_ne_top
    (P : ObjectProperty C) (hP : P.IsClassicalTriangulatedGenerator)
    (hD : rouquierDim C ≠ ⊤) : P.generationTime ⊤ ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  (ObjectProperty.isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_iff_generationTime_ne_top P).1
    (isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_of_classical_of_rouquierDim_ne_top P hP hD)

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.generationTime_le_coe_iff
statement:
theorem generationTime_le_coe_iff (P Q : ObjectProperty C) (n : ℕ) :
    P.generationTime Q ≤ n ↔ Q ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hne : ({m | Q ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter m} : Set ℕ).Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨m, hm, hmeq⟩ := csInf_mem (hne.image (fun m : ℕ ↦ (m : ℕ∞)))
      have hmn : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ n := hmeq.trans_le h
      exact hm.trans (P.monotone'_triangEnvelopeIter (by exact_mod_cast hmn))
    · exfalso
      rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
      rw [generationTime, hne, Set.image_empty, sInf_empty, top_le_iff] at h
      exact ENat.coe_ne_top n h
  · intro h
    exact sInf_le ⟨n, h, rfl⟩

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.generationTime_antitone_left
statement:
theorem generationTime_antitone_left {P P' : ObjectProperty C} (h : P ≤ P')
    (Q : ObjectProperty C) : P'.generationTime Q ≤ P.generationTime Q
proof:
:=
  sInf_le_sInf (Set.image_mono fun m hm ↦ hm.trans (monotone_triangEnvelopeIter h m))

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.generationTime_mono_right
statement:
theorem generationTime_mono_right (P : ObjectProperty C) {Q Q' : ObjectProperty C}
    (h : Q ≤ Q') : P.generationTime Q ≤ P.generationTime Q'
proof:
:=
  sInf_le_sInf (Set.image_mono fun _ hm ↦ h.trans hm)

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.generationTime_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem generationTime_eq_zero_iff (P Q : ObjectProperty C) :
    P.generationTime Q = 0 ↔ Q ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter 0
proof:
:= by
  have := generationTime_le_coe_iff P Q 0
  rwa [Nat.cast_zero, nonpos_iff_eq_zero] at this

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.generationTime_eq_zero_iff'
statement:
theorem generationTime_eq_zero_iff' (P Q : ObjectProperty C) :
    P.generationTime Q = 0 ↔ Q ≤ (P.shiftClosure ℤ).binaryProductsClosure.retractClosure
proof:
:= by
  rw [generationTime_eq_zero_iff, triangEnvelopeIter_zero]

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.generationTime_self
statement: theorem generationTime_self (P : ObjectProperty C) : P.generationTime P = 0
proof:
:=
  (generationTime_eq_zero_iff P P).2 (P.le_triangEnvelopeIter 0)

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.generationTime_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem generationTime_eq_top_iff (P Q : ObjectProperty C) :
    P.generationTime Q = ⊤ ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, ¬ Q ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h n hn
    have := (generationTime_le_coe_iff P Q n).2 hn
    rw [h, top_le_iff] at this
    exact ENat.coe_ne_top n this
  · intro h
    have hempty : {m | Q ≤ P.triangEnvelopeIter m} = (∅ : Set ℕ) :=
      Set.subset_empty_iff.1 fun m hm ↦ h m hm
    rw [generationTime, hempty, Set.image_empty, sInf_empty]

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_iff_generationTime_ne_top
statement:
theorem isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_iff_generationTime_ne_top (P : ObjectProperty C) :
    P.IsStrongTriangulatedGenerator ↔ P.generationTime ⊤ ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hs h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_iff P).1 hs
    exact (generationTime_eq_top_iff P ⊤).1 h n (top_le_iff.2 hn)
  · by_contra hcon
    exact h ((generationTime_eq_top_iff P ⊤).2 fun n hn ↦
      hcon ((isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_iff P).2 ⟨n, top_le_iff.1 hn⟩))

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isClassicalTriangulatedGenerator_of_generationTime_ne_top
statement:
theorem isClassicalTriangulatedGenerator_of_generationTime_ne_top (P : ObjectProperty C)
    (h : P.generationTime ⊤ ≠ ⊤) : P.IsClassicalTriangulatedGenerator
proof:
:=
  ((isStrongTriangulatedGenerator_iff_generationTime_ne_top P).2 h).isClassicalTriangulatedGenerator

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.generationTime_map_le
statement:
theorem generationTime_map_le (F : C ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    (P Q : ObjectProperty C) :
    (P.map F).generationTime (Q.map F) ≤ P.generationTime Q
proof:
:= by
  apply sInf_le_sInf
  rintro _ ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨n, (map_monotone hn F).trans (triangEnvelopeIter_map_le F P n), rfl⟩

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.triangEnvelopeIter_isoClosure
statement:
private lemma triangEnvelopeIter_isoClosure (P : ObjectProperty C) (n : ℕ) :
    P.isoClosure.triangEnvelopeIter n = P.triangEnvelopeIter n
proof:
:= by
  have hs : P.isoClosure.shiftClosure ℤ = P.shiftClosure ℤ := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (shiftClosure_le_iff _ _).2 ((isoClosure_le_iff _ _).2 P.le_shiftClosure)
    · exact monotone_shiftClosure P.le_isoClosure
  simp only [triangEnvelopeIter, hs]

name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.generationTime_map_eq_of_equiv
statement:
theorem generationTime_map_eq_of_equiv (E : C ≌ D) [E.functor.CommShift ℤ]
    [E.functor.IsTriangulated] (P Q : ObjectProperty C) :
    (P.map E.functor).generationTime (Q.map E.functor) = P.generationTime Q
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (generationTime_map_le E.functor P Q)
  letI := E.commShiftInverse ℤ
  letI := E.commShift_of_functor ℤ
  letI := E.toAdjunction.isTriangulated_rightAdjoint
  apply le_sInf
  rintro _ ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
  apply (generationTime_le_coe_iff P Q n).2
  intro X hX
  have hmap : ∀ Y, P.map E.functor Y → P.isoClosure (E.inverse.obj Y) := by
    rintro Y ⟨Z, hZ, ⟨e⟩⟩
    exact ⟨Z, hZ, ⟨(E.inverse.mapIso e).symm.trans (E.unitIso.app Z).symm⟩⟩
  have h := triangEnvelopeIter_map_obj_of_le E.inverse _ _ hmap (E.functor.obj X) n
    (hn _ (Q.prop_map_obj E.functor hX))
  rw [triangEnvelopeIter_isoClosure] at h
  exact (P.triangEnvelopeIter n).prop_of_iso (E.unitIso.app X).symm h

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.rouquierDim_le_of_retract_coverage
statement:
theorem rouquierDim_le_of_retract_coverage (F : C ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    (hCover : ∀ Y : D, ∃ X : C, Nonempty (Retract Y (F.obj X))) :
    rouquierDim D ≤ rouquierDim C
proof:
:= by
  unfold rouquierDim
  refine le_iInf fun G => le_sInf ?_
  rintro _ ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
  apply (rouquierDim_le_coe_iff D n).2
  refine ⟨F.obj G,
    singleton_triangEnvelopeIter_top_of_retract_coverage F hCover G n (top_le_iff.mp hn)⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.rouquierDim_le_of_essSurj
statement:
theorem rouquierDim_le_of_essSurj (F : C ⥤ D)
    [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated] [F.EssSurj] :
    rouquierDim D ≤ rouquierDim C
proof:
:= by
  apply rouquierDim_le_of_retract_coverage F
  intro Y
  let X := F.objPreimage Y
  exact ⟨X, ⟨(F.objObjPreimageIso Y).symm.retract⟩⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.rouquierDim_eq_of_equiv
statement:
theorem rouquierDim_eq_of_equiv (E : C ≌ D) [E.functor.CommShift ℤ]
    [E.functor.IsTriangulated] : rouquierDim C = rouquierDim D
proof:
:= by
  letI := E.commShiftInverse ℤ
  letI := E.commShift_of_functor ℤ
  letI := E.toAdjunction.isTriangulated_rightAdjoint
  exact le_antisymm (rouquierDim_le_of_essSurj E.inverse) (rouquierDim_le_of_essSurj E.functor)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.Families.TriangulatedFiberFamily.pullK₀_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pullK₀_of {s t : B} (f : s ⟶ t) (E : F.Fiber t) :

proof:

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.Families.TriangulatedFiberFamily.pullK₀_id
statement:

theorem pullK₀_id (b : B) :
    F.pullK₀ (𝟙 b) = AddMonoidHom.id (K₀ (F.Fiber b))
proof:
:= by
  change K₀.map (F.pull (𝟙 b)) = AddMonoidHom.id (K₀ (F.Fiber b))
  rw [K₀.map_congr (F.pullIdIso b), K₀.map_id]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.Families.TriangulatedFiberFamily.pullK₀_comp
statement:

theorem pullK₀_comp {r s t : B} (f : r ⟶ s) (g : s ⟶ t) :

proof:
:= by
  change K₀.map (F.pull (f ≫ g)) =
    (K₀.map (F.pull f)).comp (K₀.map (F.pull g))
  rw [K₀.map_congr (F.pullCompIso f g), K₀.map_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.Families.TriangulatedFiberFamily.CompatibleClassMaps.class_pull
statement:
theorem class_pull (h : F.CompatibleClassMaps V classMap)
    {s t : B} (f : s ⟶ t) (E : F.Fiber t) :
    classMap s (K₀.of _ ((F.pull f).obj E)) = classMap t (K₀.of _ E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← F.pullK₀_of f E]
  exact h.pull_compatible f _

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.Families.TriangulatedFiberFamily.CompatibleClassMaps.constant
statement:
theorem constant (C : Type w) [Category.{w} C] [Preadditive C]
    [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C]
    (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] (v₀ : K₀ C →+ V) :
    (TriangulatedFiberFamily.constant B C).CompatibleClassMaps V (fun _ ↦ v₀)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro s t f x
  have h : (TriangulatedFiberFamily.constant B C).pullK₀ f =
      AddMonoidHom.id (K₀ C) := by
    ext E
    rw [TriangulatedFiberFamily.pullK₀_of]
    rfl
  rw [h]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Enhancement.homMk_liftedCocycle
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homMk_liftedCocycle {K L : W} (f : K ⟶ L) :
    H0.homMk (C := e.dgCat) (e.liftedCocycle f) =
      e.equiv.inverse.map f
proof:
:=
  (Z0.toH0 e.dgCat).map_preimage _

name: CategoryTheory.Enhancement.counit_conjugate_liftedCocycle
statement:
theorem counit_conjugate_liftedCocycle {K L : W} (f : K ⟶ L) :
    (e.equiv.counitIso.app K).inv ≫
        e.equiv.functor.map
          (H0.homMk (C := e.dgCat) (e.liftedCocycle f)) ≫
        (e.equiv.counitIso.app L).hom =
      f
proof:
:= by
  rw [e.homMk_liftedCocycle]
  rw [← cancel_epi (e.equiv.counitIso.app K).hom,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  exact e.equiv.counit_naturality f

name: CategoryTheory.EvaluationData.TwistConeData.twistK₀Of
statement:
theorem twistK₀Of (X : H0 C) :
    K₀.of (H0 C) (K.twist.h0.obj X) =
      K₀.of (H0 C) X - K₀.of (H0 C) (V.functor.h0.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    K₀.of (H0 C) (K.twist.h0.obj X) =
        K₀.of (H0 C) ((DGFunctor.id C).h0.obj X) -
          K₀.of (H0 C) (V.functor.h0.obj X) :=
      K.functorK₀Of V.evaluation_isClosed X
    _ = K₀.of (H0 C) X - K₀.of (H0 C) (V.functor.h0.obj X) := by
      rw [K₀.of_iso (H0 C) ((DGFunctor.h0IdIso).app X)]
      rfl

name: CategoryTheory.EvaluationData.TwistConeData.twistK₀Map
statement:
theorem twistK₀Map :
    letI : K.twist.h0.CommShift ℤ
proof:
:= K.twistH0CommShift
    letI : K.twist.h0.IsTriangulated := K.twistH0IsTriangulated
    letI : V.functor.h0.CommShift ℤ :=
      DGFunctor.h0CommShift V.functor
    letI : V.functor.h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated V.functor
    K₀.map K.twist.h0 =
      AddMonoidHom.id (K₀ (H0 C)) - K₀.map V.functor.h0 := by
  letI : K.twist.h0.CommShift ℤ := K.twistH0CommShift
  letI : K.twist.h0.IsTriangulated := K.twistH0IsTriangulated
  letI : V.functor.h0.CommShift ℤ :=
    DGFunctor.h0CommShift V.functor
  letI : V.functor.h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated V.functor
  apply K₀.hom_ext
  intro X
  change K₀.of (H0 C) (K.twist.h0.obj X) =
    K₀.of (H0 C) X - K₀.of (H0 C) (V.functor.h0.obj X)
  exact K.twistK₀Of X

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.ConeData.functorK₀Of
statement:
theorem functorK₀Of (hα : IsClosed α) (X : H0 C) :
    K₀.of (H0 D) (K.functor.h0.obj X) =
      K₀.of (H0 D) (G.h0.obj X) - K₀.of (H0 D) (F.h0.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  have h := K₀.of_triangle (H0 D) ((K.triangleFunctor hα).obj X)
    (K.triangleFunctor_obj_mem_distinguishedTriangles hα X)
  change K₀.of (H0 D) (G.h0.obj X) =
    K₀.of (H0 D) (F.h0.obj X) +
      K₀.of (H0 D) (K.functor.h0.obj X) at h
  rw [h]
  abel

name: CategoryTheory.DGFunctor.HomogeneousNatTrans.ConeData.functorK₀Map
statement:
theorem functorK₀Map (hα : IsClosed α) :
    letI : K.functor.h0.CommShift ℤ
proof:
:=
      DGFunctor.h0CommShift K.functor
    letI : K.functor.h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated K.functor
    letI : F.h0.CommShift ℤ :=
      DGFunctor.h0CommShift F
    letI : F.h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated F
    letI : G.h0.CommShift ℤ :=
      DGFunctor.h0CommShift G
    letI : G.h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated G
    K₀.map K.functor.h0 = K₀.map G.h0 - K₀.map F.h0 := by
  letI : K.functor.h0.CommShift ℤ :=
    DGFunctor.h0CommShift K.functor
  letI : K.functor.h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated K.functor
  letI : F.h0.CommShift ℤ :=
    DGFunctor.h0CommShift F
  letI : F.h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated F
  letI : G.h0.CommShift ℤ :=
    DGFunctor.h0CommShift G
  letI : G.h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated G
  apply K₀.hom_ext
  intro X
  change K₀.of (H0 D) (K.functor.h0.obj X) =
    K₀.of (H0 D) (G.h0.obj X) - K₀.of (H0 D) (F.h0.obj X)
  exact K.functorK₀Of hα X

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.TwistConeData.twistK₀Of
statement:
theorem twistK₀Of (X : H0 C) :
    K₀.of (H0 C) (K.twist.h0.obj X) =
      K₀.of (H0 C) X - K₀.of (H0 C) (V.functor.h0.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    K₀.of (H0 C) (K.twist.h0.obj X) =
        K₀.of (H0 C) ((DGFunctor.id C).h0.obj X) -
          K₀.of (H0 C) (V.functor.h0.obj X) :=
      K.functorK₀Of V.evaluation_isClosed X
    _ = K₀.of (H0 C) X - K₀.of (H0 C) (V.functor.h0.obj X) := by
      rw [K₀.of_iso (H0 C) ((DGFunctor.h0IdIso).app X)]
      rfl

name: CategoryTheory.LinearEvaluationData.TwistConeData.twistK₀Map
statement:
theorem twistK₀Map :
    letI : K.twist.h0.CommShift ℤ
proof:
:=
      DGFunctor.h0CommShift K.twist
    letI : K.twist.h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated K.twist
    letI : V.functor.h0.CommShift ℤ :=
      DGFunctor.h0CommShift V.functor
    letI : V.functor.h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated V.functor
    K₀.map K.twist.h0 =
      AddMonoidHom.id (K₀ (H0 C)) - K₀.map V.functor.h0 := by
  letI : K.twist.h0.CommShift ℤ :=
    DGFunctor.h0CommShift K.twist
  letI : K.twist.h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated K.twist
  letI : V.functor.h0.CommShift ℤ :=
    DGFunctor.h0CommShift V.functor
  letI : V.functor.h0.IsTriangulated := DGFunctor.h0IsTriangulated V.functor
  apply K₀.hom_ext
  intro X
  change K₀.of (H0 C) (K.twist.h0.obj X) =
    K₀.of (H0 C) X - K₀.of (H0 C) (V.functor.h0.obj X)
  exact K.twistK₀Of X

name: CategoryTheory.H0.homComplex_homologyEulerChar_eq_chiHom
statement:
theorem homComplex_homologyEulerChar_eq_chiHom (X Y : C) :
    (DGLinear.homComplex k X Y).homologyEulerChar =
      chiHom k (H0 C) (show H0 C from X) (show H0 C from Y)
proof:
:= by
  apply finsum_congr
  intro i
  change (i.negOnePow : ℤ) *
      Module.finrank k ((DGLinear.homComplex k X Y).homology i) =
    (i.negOnePow : ℤ) *
      Module.finrank k ((show H0 C from X) ⟶ (show H0 C from Y)⟦i⟧)
  rw [(homologyShiftLinearEquiv (k := k) X Y i).finrank_eq]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.map_eq_smul_add_smul
statement:
theorem map_eq_smul_add_smul (g : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    g z = z.re • g 1 + z.im • g Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  have hz : z = z.re • (1 : ℂ) + z.im • Complex.I := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  conv_lhs => rw [hz]
  rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul]

name: PeriodDomain.mem_orthogonalityLocus_iff_centralCharge_eq_zero

name: PeriodDomain.mem_positivePlanesAway_iff_centralCharge_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mem_positivePlanesAway_iff_centralCharge_ne_zero {x y : M} (hxy : IsPositiveFrame Q x y)
    (Δ : Set M) :
    framePlane (x, y) ∈ positivePlanesAway Q Δ ↔ ∀ δ ∈ Δ, centralCharge Q x y δ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, hcut⟩ δ hδ hz
    exact hcut δ hδ ((mem_orthogonalityLocus_iff_centralCharge_eq_zero hxy).mpr hz)
  · intro h
    exact ⟨hxy, fun δ hδ hw =>
      h δ hδ ((mem_orthogonalityLocus_iff_centralCharge_eq_zero hxy).mp hw)⟩

name: Mukai.mem_orthogonalityLocus_iff_expCharge_eq_zero

theorem mem_orthogonalityLocus_iff_expCharge_eq_zero (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (hω : 0 < b ω ω)
    {δ : RealExtension V} :
    PeriodDomain.framePlane (expRe b β ω, expIm b β ω) ∈
      PeriodDomain.orthogonalityLocus (realForm b) δ ↔
      expCharge b β ω δ = 0
proof:
:=
  PeriodDomain.mem_orthogonalityLocus_iff_centralCharge_eq_zero (isPositiveFrame_exp b β ω hb hω)

name: Mukai.mem_positivePlanesAway_iff_expCharge_ne_zero
statement:

        PeriodDomain.positivePlanesAway (realForm b) Δ ↔
      ∀ δ ∈ Δ, expCharge b β ω δ ≠ 0

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.mem_alignmentLocus

theorem mem_alignmentLocus (p : P) (v w : N) :

proof: := Iff.rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.mem_positiveRayLocus
statement:
theorem mem_positiveRayLocus (p : P) (v w : N) :
    p ∈ Z.positiveRayLocus v w ↔

proof:
:=

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.positiveRayLocus_subset_alignmentLocus
statement:
theorem positiveRayLocus_subset_alignmentLocus (v w : N) :
    Z.positiveRayLocus v w ⊆ Z.alignmentLocus v w
proof:
:= by
  rintro p ⟨-, r, -, hr⟩
  rw [mem_alignmentLocus, alignmentValue]
  simp only [re, im]
  rw [hr]
  simp
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.zeroLocus_subset_alignmentLocus_left
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_subset_alignmentLocus_left (v w : N) :
    Z.zeroLocus v ⊆ Z.alignmentLocus v w
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [mem_alignmentLocus, alignmentValue]
  have hz := (mem_zeroLocus Z p v).mp hp
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re hz
  have him := congrArg Complex.im hz
  simp only [Complex.zero_re, Complex.zero_im] at hre him
  simp only [re, im]
  rw [hre, him]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.zeroLocus_subset_alignmentLocus_right
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_subset_alignmentLocus_right (v w : N) :
    Z.zeroLocus w ⊆ Z.alignmentLocus v w
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [mem_alignmentLocus, alignmentValue]
  have hz := (mem_zeroLocus Z p w).mp hp
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re hz
  have him := congrArg Complex.im hz
  simp only [Complex.zero_re, Complex.zero_im] at hre him
  simp only [re, im]
  rw [hre, him]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_eq_neg_im_mul_conj
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_eq_neg_im_mul_conj (p : P) (v w : N) :
    Z.alignmentValue p v w =
      -((Z.charge p v) * conj (Z.charge p w)).im
proof:
:= by
  simp only [alignmentValue, re, im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]

proof:
:= by
  rw [alignmentValue_add_right, alignmentValue_zsmul_right, add_zero]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentLocus_add_zsmul_right
statement:
theorem alignmentLocus_add_zsmul_right (n : ℤ) (v w : N) :
    Z.alignmentLocus v (w + n • v) = Z.alignmentLocus v w
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [mem_alignmentLocus, alignmentValue_add_zsmul_right]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_add_nsmul_right
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_add_nsmul_right (p : P) (n : ℕ) (v w : N) :
    Z.alignmentValue p v (w + n • v) = Z.alignmentValue p v w
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [succ_nsmul, ← add_assoc, alignmentValue_add_right, ih, alignmentValue_self, add_zero]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_linearAct
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_linearAct (g : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ) (p : P) (v w : N) :
    (Z.linearAct g).alignmentValue p v w = realDet g * Z.alignmentValue p v w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [alignmentValue, re, im, linearAct_charge, realDet]
  rw [map_eq_smul_add_smul g (Z.charge p v), map_eq_smul_add_smul g (Z.charge p w)]
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_re,
    Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul,
    sub_zero, add_zero]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentLocus_linearAct
statement:
theorem alignmentLocus_linearAct {g : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ} (hg : realDet g ≠ 0) (v w : N) :
    (Z.linearAct g).alignmentLocus v w = Z.alignmentLocus v w
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [mem_alignmentLocus, alignmentValue_linearAct, mul_eq_zero]
  exact or_iff_right hg

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue_smul
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_smul (c : ℂ) (p : P) (v w : N) :
    (Z.smul c).alignmentValue p v w = Complex.normSq c * Z.alignmentValue p v w
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul, alignmentValue_linearAct, realDet_mulLeft]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentLocus_smul
statement:
theorem alignmentLocus_smul {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (v w : N) :
    (Z.smul c).alignmentLocus v w = Z.alignmentLocus v w
proof:
:=
  Z.alignmentLocus_linearAct (by
    rw [realDet_mulLeft]
    exact fun h => hc (Complex.normSq_eq_zero.mp h)) v w

statement:

proof: := rfl
