name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.continuous_pair
statement: theorem continuous_pair : Continuous fun p : D × D => S.pair p.1 p.2
proof:
:=
  (LinearMap.toContinuousBilinearMap S.intersection).continuous₂

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.continuous_expPairMap
statement: theorem continuous_expPairMap : Continuous S.expPairMap
proof:
:= by
  have hb := S.continuous_pair
  have hbb : Continuous fun p : D × D => S.pair p.1 p.1 :=
    hb.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_fst)
  have hww : Continuous fun p : D × D => S.pair p.2 p.2 :=
    hb.comp (continuous_snd.prodMk continuous_snd)
  refine Continuous.prodMk ?_ ?_
  · exact continuous_const.prodMk
      (continuous_fst.prodMk ((hbb.sub hww).div_const 2))
  · exact continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_snd.prodMk hb)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.scale_bound
statement:
private theorem scale_bound {c : ℝ} {u : D} (hu : u ≠ 0)
    (hle : c ≤ -(S.pair (‖u‖⁻¹ • u) (‖u‖⁻¹ • u))) : S.pair u u ≤ -c * ‖u‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hnu : (0 : ℝ) < ‖u‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hu
  have hval : S.pair (‖u‖⁻¹ • u) (‖u‖⁻¹ • u) = (‖u‖⁻¹) ^ 2 * S.pair u u := by
    simp only [DivisorSpace.pair, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [hval] at hle
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (sq_nonneg ‖u‖)
  have hrw : -((‖u‖⁻¹) ^ 2 * S.pair u u) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 = -(S.pair u u) := by
    have hne : (‖u‖ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hnu
    field_simp
  rw [hrw] at h2
  linarith

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.exists_ampleLower
statement:
theorem exists_ampleLower {K : Set (D × D)} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ K, 0 < S.pair p.2 p.2) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ ∀ p ∈ K, a ≤ S.pair p.2 p.2
proof:
:= by
  rcases K.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
  · exact ⟨1, one_pos, by simp⟩
  · obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀, hmin⟩ := hK.exists_isMinOn hne
      (S.continuous_pair.comp (continuous_snd.prodMk continuous_snd)).continuousOn
    exact ⟨S.pair p₀.2 p₀.2, hpos p₀ hp₀, fun p hp => isMinOn_iff.mp hmin _ hp⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.exists_uniform_negDefinite
proof:
:= by
  have horthC : Continuous fun z : (D × D) × D => S.pair z.2 z.1.2 :=
    S.continuous_pair.comp (continuous_snd.prodMk (continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst))
  have hclosed : IsClosed {z : (D × D) × D | S.pair z.2 z.1.2 = 0} :=
    isClosed_eq horthC continuous_const
  set T : Set ((D × D) × D) :=
    (K ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : D) 1) ∩ {z | S.pair z.2 z.1.2 = 0} with hTdef
  have hTcompact : IsCompact T := (hK.prod (isCompact_sphere (0 : D) 1)).inter_right hclosed
  have hmemT : ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ v : D, ‖v‖ = 1 → S.pair v p.2 = 0 →
      ((p, v) : (D × D) × D) ∈ T := by
    intro p hp v hv hvo
    exact ⟨⟨hp, by simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm] using hv⟩, hvo⟩
  rcases T.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hTe | hTne
  · refine ⟨1, one_pos, fun p hp x hx => ?_⟩
    have hx0 : x = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      have hnu : (0 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
      have hnorm : ‖‖x‖⁻¹ • x‖ = 1 := by
        rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm]
        field_simp
      have horth : S.pair (‖x‖⁻¹ • x) p.2 = 0 := by
        simp only [DivisorSpace.pair, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        simp only [DivisorSpace.pair] at hx
        rw [hx, mul_zero]
      have hmem := hmemT p hp _ hnorm horth
      rw [hTe] at hmem
      exact hmem
    simp [hx0, DivisorSpace.pair]
  · obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hmin⟩ :=
      hTcompact.exists_isMinOn hTne
        ((S.continuous_pair.comp (continuous_snd.prodMk continuous_snd)).neg).continuousOn
    have hz₀K : z₀.1 ∈ K := hz₀.1.1
    have hz₀norm : ‖z₀.2‖ = 1 := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm] using hz₀.1.2
    have hz₀ne : z₀.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc
      rw [hc, norm_zero] at hz₀norm
      exact zero_ne_one hz₀norm
    have hz₀neg : S.pair z₀.2 z₀.2 < 0 :=
      (h.of_pair_pos (hpos z₀.1 hz₀K)).neg_definite z₀.2
        (by rw [S.pair_comm]; exact hz₀.2) hz₀ne
    refine ⟨-(S.pair z₀.2 z₀.2), by linarith, fun p hp x hx => ?_⟩
    rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hxne
    · simp [DivisorSpace.pair]
    · refine scale_bound hxne ?_
      have hnu : (0 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hxne
      have hnorm : ‖‖x‖⁻¹ • x‖ = 1 := by
        rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm]
        field_simp
      have horth : S.pair (‖x‖⁻¹ • x) p.2 = 0 := by
        simp only [DivisorSpace.pair, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        simp only [DivisorSpace.pair] at hx
        rw [hx, mul_zero]
      exact isMinOn_iff.mp hmin _ (hmemT p hp _ hnorm horth)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.expPlaneRegion_carrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expPlaneRegion_carrier (h : S.HodgeDefinite H) {K : Set (D × D)} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ K, 0 < S.pair p.2 p.2) :
    (expPlaneRegion h hK hpos).carrier =
      (fun q : Mukai.RealExtension D × Mukai.RealExtension D =>
        Submodule.span ℝ ({q.1, q.2} : Set (Mukai.RealExtension D))) '' (S.expPairMap '' K)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.finite_orthogonalClasses_expPlaneRegion
statement:
theorem finite_orthogonalClasses_expPlaneRegion (h : S.HodgeDefinite H) {K : Set (D × D)}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hpos : ∀ p ∈ K, 0 < S.pair p.2 p.2)
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℝ (Mukai.RealExtension D)) :
    ((expPlaneRegion h hK hpos).orthogonalClasses
      ∩ (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range b) : Set (Mukai.RealExtension D))).Finite
proof:
:=
  PeriodDomain.PlaneRegion.finite_orthogonalClasses_inter _ b

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.finite_walls_meeting_expFamily
statement:
theorem finite_walls_meeting_expFamily (h : S.HodgeDefinite H) {K : Set (D × D)}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hpos : ∀ p ∈ K, 0 < S.pair p.2 p.2)
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℝ (Mukai.RealExtension D)) :
    {δ : Mukai.RealExtension D |
        PeriodDomain.IsSphericalClass (Mukai.realForm S.intersection) δ ∧
        (∃ p ∈ K, S.expPlane p.1 p.2 ∈
          PeriodDomain.orthogonalityLocus (Mukai.realForm S.intersection) δ) ∧
        δ ∈ (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range b) :
              Set (Mukai.RealExtension D))}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Finite.subset (finite_orthogonalClasses_expPlaneRegion h hK hpos b) ?_
  rintro δ ⟨hsph, ⟨p, hp, hwall⟩, hlat⟩
  refine ⟨⟨hsph, ?_⟩, hlat⟩
  exact ⟨S.expPlane p.1 p.2, ⟨S.expPairMap p, ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, hwall⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.isPositivePlane_expPlane
statement:
theorem isPositivePlane_expPlane (S : DivisorSpace D) (B omega : D)
    (homega : 0 < S.pair omega omega) :
    PeriodDomain.IsPositivePlane (Mukai.realForm S.intersection) (expPlane S B omega)
proof:
:=
  Mukai.isPositiveFrame_exp S.intersection B omega (fun x y => S.pair_comm x y) homega

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.finite_walls_through_expPlane
statement:
theorem finite_walls_through_expPlane (h : S.HodgeDefinite H) (B omega : D)
    (homega : 0 < S.pair omega omega)
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℝ (Mukai.RealExtension D)) :
    {δ : Mukai.RealExtension D |
        PeriodDomain.IsSphericalClass (Mukai.realForm S.intersection) δ ∧
        expPlane S B omega ∈ PeriodDomain.orthogonalityLocus (Mukai.realForm S.intersection) δ ∧
        δ ∈ (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range b) : Set (Mukai.RealExtension D))}.Finite
proof:
:=
  PeriodDomain.finite_orthogonalityLoci_through (hasSignatureTwo_of_hodgeDefinite h)
    (isPositivePlane_expPlane S B omega homega) b

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.DivisorSpace.finite_sphericalOrthogonal_expPlane
statement:
theorem finite_sphericalOrthogonal_expPlane (h : S.HodgeDefinite H) (B omega : D)
    (homega : 0 < S.pair omega omega)
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℝ (Mukai.RealExtension D)) :
    (PeriodDomain.sphericalOrthogonal (Mukai.realForm S.intersection) (expPlane S B omega)
      ∩ (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range b) : Set (Mukai.RealExtension D))).Finite
proof:
:=
  PeriodDomain.finite_sphericalOrthogonal_inter (hasSignatureTwo_of_hodgeDefinite h)
    (isPositivePlane_expPlane S B omega homega) b

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.toNumClass_rk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toNumClass_rk (E : N) :
    (Dc.toNumClass E).rk = Dc.hyperplaneSquare * Dc.rank E
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.toNumClass_deg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toNumClass_deg (E : N) : (Dc.toNumClass E).deg = Dc.degree E
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.toNumClass_ch2
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toNumClass_ch2 (E : N) : (Dc.toNumClass E).ch2 = Dc.chTwo E
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.toNumClassHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toNumClassHom_apply (E : N) : Dc.toNumClassHom E = Dc.toNumClass E
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.discr_toNumClass
statement:
@[simp]
theorem discr_toNumClass (E : N) :
    Wall.NumClass.discr (Dc.toNumClass E) = Dc.discr E
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Wall.NumClass.discr_eq, toNumClass_rk, toNumClass_deg, toNumClass_ch2,
    ChargeCoordinates.discr]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.stCharge_toNumClass
statement:
theorem stCharge_toNumClass (b a : ℝ) (E : N) :
    Wall.stCharge b a (Dc.toNumClass E) = (Dc.twistByScalar b).centralCharge a E
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext
  · rw [Wall.stCharge_re, ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge_re]
    simp only [Wall.reZ, toNumClass_rk, toNumClass_deg, toNumClass_ch2,
      twistByScalar_chTwo, twistByScalar_rank, twistByScalar_hyperplaneSquare]
    ring
  · rw [Wall.stCharge_im, ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge_im]
    simp only [Wall.imZ, toNumClass_rk, toNumClass_deg, twistByScalar_degree]
    ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.stWallFamily_charge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stWallFamily_charge (p : ℝ × ℝ) (E : N) :
    Dc.stWallFamily.charge p E = Wall.stCharge p.1 p.2 (Dc.toNumClass E)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.stWallFamily_alignmentValue
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stWallFamily_alignmentValue (p : ℝ × ℝ) (E F : N) :
    Dc.stWallFamily.alignmentValue p E F =
      Wall.wallExpr p.1 p.2 (Dc.toNumClass E) (Dc.toNumClass F)
proof:
:= by
  simp [stWallFamily]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.centralCharge_twist
statement:
theorem centralCharge_twist (B : D) (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    (ch.twist S B).centralCharge S P E =
      ch.centralCharge S ⟨P.B + B, P.omega⟩ E
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : S.pair P.B B = S.pair B P.B := S.pair_comm P.B B
  rw [centralCharge_apply, centralCharge_apply]
  simp only [twist_rank, twist_chOne, twist_chTwo, DivisorSpace.pair, map_add, map_sub,
    map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hcomm ⊢
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      zero_mul, one_mul, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero, sub_zero]
  · linear_combination (-(ch.rank E) / 2) * hcomm
  · ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.sliceCoordinates_rank
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sliceCoordinates_rank (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (uu : U) (E : N) :
    (T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).rank E = ch.rank E
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.sliceCoordinates_degree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sliceCoordinates_degree (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (uu : U) (E : N) :
    (T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).degree E = S.pair T.H (ch.chOne E)
proof:
:= by
  show S.pair T.H (ch.chOne E - ch.rank E • T.transverse uu) = _
  simp only [DivisorSpace.pair, map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [show S.intersection T.H (T.transverse uu) = 0 from T.orthogonal uu]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.sliceCoordinates_chTwo
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sliceCoordinates_chTwo (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (uu : U) (E : N) :
    (T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).chTwo E =
      ch.chTwo E - S.pair (T.transverse uu) (ch.chOne E)
        + S.pair (T.transverse uu) (T.transverse uu) * ch.rank E / 2
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.sliceCoordinates_hyperplaneSquare
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sliceCoordinates_hyperplaneSquare (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (uu : U) :
    (T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).hyperplaneSquare = S.pair T.H T.H
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.parameters_ofST
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parameters_ofST (uu : U) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    T.parameters (Point.ofST uu p) =
      ⟨p.1 • T.H + T.transverse uu, p.2 • T.H⟩
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.chargeFamily_reindex_ofST
statement:
theorem chargeFamily_reindex_ofST (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (uu : U) :
    (T.chargeFamily ch).reindex (Point.ofST uu) =
      (T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).stWallFamily
proof:
:= by
  ext p E
  rw [Wall.ChargeFamily.reindex_charge, ChargeCoordinates.stWallFamily_charge,
    ChargeCoordinates.stCharge_toNumClass]
  show ch.centralCharge S (T.parameters (Point.ofST uu p)) E
      = ((((ch.twist S (T.transverse uu)).coordinatesAt S T.H).twistByScalar
          p.1).centralCharge p.2) E
  rw [← ChernCharacter.centralCharge_rankOne_eq (ch.twist S (T.transverse uu)) S T.H p.2 p.1 E,
    ChernCharacter.centralCharge_twist]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.alignmentValue_ofST
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_ofST (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (uu : U) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (v w : N) :
    (T.chargeFamily ch).alignmentValue (Point.ofST uu p) v w =
      Wall.wallExpr p.1 p.2 ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
        ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (T.chargeFamily ch).alignmentValue (Point.ofST uu p) v w
        = ((T.chargeFamily ch).reindex (Point.ofST uu)).alignmentValue p v w from rfl,
    T.chargeFamily_reindex_ofST ch uu, ChargeCoordinates.stWallFamily_alignmentValue]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.alignmentLocus_ofST_iff_circle
statement:
theorem alignmentLocus_ofST_iff_circle (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (uu : U) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (ht : p.2 ≠ 0) (v w : N) :
    Point.ofST uu p ∈ T.alignmentLocus ch v w ↔
      Wall.minA ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
            ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) * (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2)
          + 2 * Wall.minB ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
            ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) * p.1
          + 2 * Wall.minC ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
            ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [OrthogonalSlice.alignmentLocus, Wall.ChargeFamily.mem_alignmentLocus, T.alignmentValue_ofST]
  exact Wall.wall_iff_circle ht _ _

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.alignmentLocus_ofST_circle_eq
statement:
theorem alignmentLocus_ofST_circle_eq (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (uu : U) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (ht : p.2 ≠ 0) {v w : N}
    (hA : Wall.minA ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
      ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) ≠ 0) :
    Point.ofST uu p ∈ T.alignmentLocus ch v w ↔
      (Wall.minA ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
              ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) * p.1
            + Wall.minB ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
              ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w)) ^ 2
          + (Wall.minA ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
              ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) * p.2) ^ 2
        = Wall.minB ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
              ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) ^ 2
          - 2 * Wall.minA ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
              ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w)
            * Wall.minC ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
              ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [OrthogonalSlice.alignmentLocus, Wall.ChargeFamily.mem_alignmentLocus, T.alignmentValue_ofST]
  exact Wall.wall_circle_eq ht hA

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.alignmentLocus_ofST_line_eq
statement:
theorem alignmentLocus_ofST_line_eq (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (uu : U) {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (ht : p.2 ≠ 0) {v w : N}
    (hA : Wall.minA ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
      ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) = 0)
    (hB : Wall.minB ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
      ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w) ≠ 0) :
    Point.ofST uu p ∈ T.alignmentLocus ch v w ↔
      p.1 = -(Wall.minC ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
          ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w))
        / Wall.minB ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass v)
          ((T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).toNumClass w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [OrthogonalSlice.alignmentLocus, Wall.ChargeFamily.mem_alignmentLocus, T.alignmentValue_ofST]
  exact Wall.wall_line_eq ht hA hB

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.discr_sliceCoordinates
statement:
theorem discr_sliceCoordinates (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (uu : U) (E : N) :
    (T.sliceCoordinates ch uu).discr E =
      S.pair T.H (ch.chOne E) ^ 2
        - 2 * S.pair T.H T.H * ch.rank E * ch.chTwo E
        + 2 * S.pair T.H T.H * ch.rank E * S.pair (T.transverse uu) (ch.chOne E)
        - S.pair T.H T.H * ch.rank E ^ 2
          * S.pair (T.transverse uu) (T.transverse uu)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ChargeCoordinates.discr, T.sliceCoordinates_degree,
    T.sliceCoordinates_rank, T.sliceCoordinates_chTwo,
    T.sliceCoordinates_hyperplaneSquare]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.barDiscriminant_parameters
statement:
theorem barDiscriminant_parameters (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (p : Point U) (E : N) :
    ch.barDiscriminant S (T.parameters p) E =
      p.t ^ 2 * (T.sliceCoordinates ch p.u).discr E
proof:
:= by
  have hHG : S.pair T.H (T.transverse p.u) = 0 := T.orthogonal p.u
  have hGH : S.pair (T.transverse p.u) T.H = 0 := by
    rw [S.pair_comm]; exact hHG
  simp only [DivisorSpace.pair] at hHG hGH
  simp only [ChernCharacter.barDiscriminant, ChernCharacter.twist_chOne,
    ChernCharacter.twist_chTwo, parameters_B, parameters_omega,
    T.discr_sliceCoordinates, DivisorSpace.pair, map_add, map_sub, map_smul,
    LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hHG, hGH]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.discr_sliceCoordinates_nonneg
statement:
theorem discr_sliceCoordinates_nonneg (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (p : Point U)
    (ht : p.t ≠ 0) (h : S.HodgeIndex (T.parameters p).omega) {E : N}
    (hΔ : 0 ≤ ch.discriminant S E) :
    0 ≤ (T.sliceCoordinates ch p.u).discr E
proof:
:= by
  have hbar : 0 ≤ ch.barDiscriminant S (T.parameters p) E :=
    ChernCharacter.barDiscriminant_nonneg_of_discriminant_nonneg ch S _ h E hΔ
  rw [T.barDiscriminant_parameters ch p E] at hbar
  have hts : 0 < p.t ^ 2 := by positivity
  refine le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ hts
  rw [mul_zero]
  exact hbar

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.discr_toNumClass_sliceCoordinates_nonneg
statement:
theorem discr_toNumClass_sliceCoordinates_nonneg (ch : ChernCharacter N D)
    (p : Point U) (ht : p.t ≠ 0) (h : S.HodgeIndex (T.parameters p).omega) {E : N}
    (hΔ : 0 ≤ ch.discriminant S E) :
    0 ≤ Wall.NumClass.discr ((T.sliceCoordinates ch p.u).toNumClass E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ChargeCoordinates.discr_toNumClass]
  exact T.discr_sliceCoordinates_nonneg ch p ht h hΔ

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.OrthogonalSlice.alignmentValue_eq
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_eq (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (p : Point U) (v w : N) :
    (T.chargeFamily ch).alignmentValue p v w =
      T.reFormula ch p v * T.imFormula ch p w -
        T.imFormula ch p v * T.reFormula ch p w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Wall.ChargeFamily.alignmentValue, Wall.ChargeFamily.re,
    Wall.ChargeFamily.im, T.charge_re, T.charge_im]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.chargeFamily_alignmentValue
statement:
theorem chargeFamily_alignmentValue (p : ℝ × ℝ) (v w : NumClass) :
    chargeFamily.alignmentValue p v w =
      reZ p.1 p.2 v * imZ p.1 p.2 w - imZ p.1 p.2 v * reZ p.1 p.2 w
proof:
:= by
  simp [ChargeFamily.alignmentValue, ChargeFamily.re, ChargeFamily.im]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.alignmentValue_div_alpha
statement:
theorem alignmentValue_div_alpha (α β : ℝ) (v w : NumClass) :
    reZ α β v * imZ α β w - imZ α β v * reZ α β w =
      α * (reZ α β v * (imZ α β w / α) - (imZ α β v / α) * reZ α β w) ∨ α = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hα : α = 0
  · exact Or.inr hα
  · refine Or.inl ?_
    field_simp

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.discr_eq_selfPairing
statement:
theorem discr_eq_selfPairing (v : NumClass) :
    discr v = Mukai.selfPairing (LinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) (v.deg0, v.deg1, v.deg2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Mukai.selfPairing_mk]
  show v.deg1 ^ 2 - 2 * v.deg0 * v.deg2 = v.deg1 * v.deg1 - 2 * (v.deg0 * v.deg2)
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.Q_zero_alpha
statement:
theorem Q_zero_alpha (β : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    Q 0 β v = 4 * (betaTwist β v).deg2 ^ 2
      - 6 * (betaTwist β v).deg1 * (betaTwist β v).deg3
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.Q_zero_beta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Q_zero_beta (α : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    Q α 0 v = α ^ 2 * discr v + 4 * v.deg2 ^ 2 - 6 * v.deg1 * v.deg3
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q, betaTwist_zero]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.nu_zero_alpha
statement:
theorem nu_zero_alpha (β : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    nu 0 β v = (betaTwist β v).deg2 / (betaTwist β v).deg1
proof:
:= by
  rw [nu]
  norm_num

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.tiltFamily_eq_exp
statement:
theorem tiltFamily_eq_exp :
    tiltFamily
      = ((Exp.chargeFamily 2).reindex (Exp.stChart ∘ _root_.Prod.swap)).pullback
          (surfaceVec.toAddMonoidHom.comp threefoldTruncate)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tiltFamily, stChargeFamily_eq, ChargeFamily.pullback_reindex,
    ChargeFamily.pullback_pullback, ChargeFamily.reindex_reindex]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.tiltFamily_charge_eq_exp
statement:
theorem tiltFamily_charge_eq_exp (p : ℝ × ℝ) (v : Threefold.NumClass) :
    tiltFamily.charge p v
      = Exp.charge 2 (Exp.stChart p.swap) (surfaceVec (threefoldTruncate v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tiltFamily_eq_exp]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.threefoldTruncate_apply
statement:
theorem threefoldTruncate_apply (v : Threefold.NumClass) :
    threefoldTruncate v =
      (Threefold.NumClass.deg0 v, Threefold.NumClass.deg1 v,
        Threefold.NumClass.deg2 v)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.rk_threefoldTruncate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rk_threefoldTruncate (v : Threefold.NumClass) :
    NumClass.rk (threefoldTruncate v) = Threefold.NumClass.deg0 v
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.deg_threefoldTruncate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem deg_threefoldTruncate (v : Threefold.NumClass) :
    NumClass.deg (threefoldTruncate v) = Threefold.NumClass.deg1 v
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.ch2_threefoldTruncate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ch2_threefoldTruncate (v : Threefold.NumClass) :
    NumClass.ch2 (threefoldTruncate v) = Threefold.NumClass.deg2 v
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.tiltFamily_charge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tiltFamily_charge (p : ℝ × ℝ) (v : Threefold.NumClass) :
    tiltFamily.charge p v = stCharge p.2 p.1 (threefoldTruncate v)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.tiltFamily_re
statement:
theorem tiltFamily_re (α β : ℝ) (v : Threefold.NumClass) :
    tiltFamily.re (α, β) v =
      -(Threefold.NumClass.deg2 (betaTwist β v)
        - α ^ 2 / 2 * Threefold.NumClass.deg0 v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ChargeFamily.re, tiltFamily_charge, stCharge_re, reZ,
    threefoldTruncate_apply, Threefold.betaTwist, NumClass.rk, NumClass.deg,
    NumClass.ch2, Threefold.NumClass.deg0, Threefold.NumClass.deg1,
    Threefold.NumClass.deg2]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.tiltFamily_im
statement:
theorem tiltFamily_im (α β : ℝ) (v : Threefold.NumClass) :
    tiltFamily.im (α, β) v = α * Threefold.NumClass.deg1 (betaTwist β v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ChargeFamily.im, tiltFamily_charge, stCharge_im, imZ,
    threefoldTruncate_apply, Threefold.betaTwist, NumClass.rk, NumClass.deg,
    Threefold.NumClass.deg0, Threefold.NumClass.deg1]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.nu_eq_tilt_slope
statement:
theorem nu_eq_tilt_slope (α β : ℝ) (v : Threefold.NumClass)
    (h : 0 < tiltFamily.im (α, β) v) :
    Threefold.nu α β v =
      α * (-(tiltFamily.re (α, β) v) / tiltFamily.im (α, β) v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tiltFamily_im] at h
  rw [tiltFamily_re, tiltFamily_im]
  have hα : α ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_mul] at h
    exact lt_irrefl 0 h
  have hd : Threefold.NumClass.deg1 (betaTwist β v) ≠ 0 := by
    rintro hz
    rw [hz, mul_zero] at h
    exact lt_irrefl 0 h
  rw [Threefold.nu]
  field_simp

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.chargeSlope_tilt
statement:
theorem chargeSlope_tilt (α β : ℝ) (v : Threefold.NumClass)
    (h : 0 < tiltFamily.im (α, β) v) :
    chargeSlope (tiltFamily.charge (α, β) v)
      = ((Threefold.nu α β v / α : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have him : 0 < (tiltFamily.charge (α, β) v).im := h
  have hα : α ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [tiltFamily_im, zero_mul] at h
    exact lt_irrefl 0 h
  have key : Threefold.nu α β v / α
      = -(tiltFamily.re (α, β) v) / tiltFamily.im (α, β) v := by
    rw [nu_eq_tilt_slope α β v h]
    field_simp
  rw [chargeSlope_of_im_pos him, key]
  simp only [ChargeFamily.re, ChargeFamily.im]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.rotatedTiltFamily_alignmentLocus_eq_preimage
statement:
theorem rotatedTiltFamily_alignmentLocus_eq_preimage (v w : Threefold.NumClass) :
    rotatedTiltFamily.alignmentLocus v w =
      _root_.Prod.swap ⁻¹'
        stChargeFamily.alignmentLocus (threefoldTruncate v)
          (threefoldTruncate w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotatedTiltFamily, ChargeFamily.phaseRotate_alignmentLocus, tiltFamily,
    ChargeFamily.pullback_alignmentLocus, ChargeFamily.reindex_alignmentLocus]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.rotatedTiltFamily_alignmentValue
statement:
theorem rotatedTiltFamily_alignmentValue (p : ℝ × ℝ) (v w : Threefold.NumClass) :
    rotatedTiltFamily.alignmentValue p v w =
      stChargeFamily.alignmentValue p.swap (threefoldTruncate v)
        (threefoldTruncate w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotatedTiltFamily, ChargeFamily.phaseRotate_alignmentValue, tiltFamily,
    ChargeFamily.pullback_alignmentValue]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.exp_rotation_one_half
statement:
private theorem exp_rotation_one_half :
    Complex.exp (-(Real.pi * (1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = -Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  have h : (-(Real.pi * (1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.I
      = ((-(Real.pi / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [h, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg,
    Real.cos_pi_div_two, Real.sin_pi_div_two]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.exists_tilt_alignmentValue_ne_threefold
statement:
theorem exists_tilt_alignmentValue_ne_threefold :
    ∃ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (v w : Threefold.NumClass),
      tiltFamily.alignmentValue p v w = 0 ∧
        Threefold.chargeFamily.alignmentValue p v w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(1, 0), (0, 1, 1, 0), (0, 1, 1, 1), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ChargeFamily.alignmentValue, tiltFamily_re, tiltFamily_im,
      tiltFamily_re, tiltFamily_im]
    norm_num [Threefold.betaTwist, Threefold.NumClass.deg0,
      Threefold.NumClass.deg1, Threefold.NumClass.deg2]
  · rw [Threefold.chargeFamily_alignmentValue]
    norm_num [Threefold.reZ, Threefold.imZ, Threefold.NumClass.deg0,
      Threefold.NumClass.deg1, Threefold.NumClass.deg2, Threefold.NumClass.deg3]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Tilt.exists_chargeSlope_rotatedTiltFamily_ne
statement:
theorem exists_chargeSlope_rotatedTiltFamily_ne :
    ∃ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (v : Threefold.NumClass),
      chargeSlope (rotatedTiltFamily.charge p v)
        ≠ chargeSlope (tiltFamily.charge p v)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(1, 0), (0, 1, 1, 0), ?_⟩
  have hre : (tiltFamily.charge ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))
      ((0, 1, 1, 0) : Threefold.NumClass)).re = -1 := by
    have := tiltFamily_re 1 0 ((0, 1, 1, 0) : Threefold.NumClass)
    rw [ChargeFamily.re] at this
    rw [this]
    norm_num [Threefold.betaTwist, Threefold.NumClass.deg0,
      Threefold.NumClass.deg1, Threefold.NumClass.deg2]
  have him : (tiltFamily.charge ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))
      ((0, 1, 1, 0) : Threefold.NumClass)).im = 1 := by
    have := tiltFamily_im 1 0 ((0, 1, 1, 0) : Threefold.NumClass)
    rw [ChargeFamily.im] at this
    rw [this]
    norm_num [Threefold.betaTwist, Threefold.NumClass.deg0,
      Threefold.NumClass.deg1]
  have hz : tiltFamily.charge ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))
      ((0, 1, 1, 0) : Threefold.NumClass) = -1 + Complex.I := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · rw [hre]; norm_num
    · rw [him]; norm_num
  have hrot : rotatedTiltFamily.charge ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))
      ((0, 1, 1, 0) : Threefold.NumClass) = 1 + Complex.I := by
    rw [rotatedTiltFamily, ChargeFamily.phaseRotate, ChargeFamily.smul_charge,
      exp_rotation_one_half, hz]
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  rw [hrot, hz, chargeSlope_of_im_pos (by simp), chargeSlope_of_im_pos (by simp)]
  have hne : (-(1 + Complex.I).re / (1 + Complex.I).im : ℝ)
      ≠ (-(-1 + Complex.I).re / (-1 + Complex.I).im : ℝ) := by norm_num
  exact_mod_cast hne

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.betaTwist_deg0
statement:
@[simp] theorem betaTwist_deg0 (β : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    (betaTwist β v).deg0 = v.deg0
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.betaTwist_deg1
statement:
@[simp] theorem betaTwist_deg1 (β : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    (betaTwist β v).deg1 = v.deg1 - β * v.deg0
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.betaTwist_deg2
statement:
@[simp] theorem betaTwist_deg2 (β : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    (betaTwist β v).deg2 = v.deg2 - β * v.deg1 + β ^ 2 / 2 * v.deg0
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.betaTwist_deg3
statement:
@[simp] theorem betaTwist_deg3 (β : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    (betaTwist β v).deg3 =
      v.deg3 - β * v.deg2 + β ^ 2 / 2 * v.deg1 - β ^ 3 / 6 * v.deg0
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.betaTwist_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem betaTwist_zero (v : NumClass) : betaTwist 0 v = v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [betaTwist, deg0, deg1, deg2, deg3]
  norm_num

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.betaTwist_eq_exp
statement:
theorem betaTwist_eq_exp (β : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    threefoldVec (betaTwist β v) = Exp.twist 3 β (threefoldVec v)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    norm_num [Exp.twist_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Nat.factorial,
      threefoldVec, betaTwist, deg0, deg1, deg2, deg3] <;> ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.betaTwist_betaTwist
statement:
theorem betaTwist_betaTwist (β₁ β₂ : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    betaTwist β₁ (betaTwist β₂ v) = betaTwist (β₁ + β₂) v
proof:
:= by
  apply threefoldVec.injective
  rw [betaTwist_eq_exp, betaTwist_eq_exp, Exp.twist_twist, betaTwist_eq_exp]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.reZ_eq_betaTwist
statement:
theorem reZ_eq_betaTwist (α β : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    reZ α β v = reZ α 0 (betaTwist β v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reZ, betaTwist, deg0, deg1, deg2, deg3]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.imZ_eq_betaTwist
statement:
theorem imZ_eq_betaTwist (α β : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    imZ α β v = imZ α 0 (betaTwist β v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [imZ, betaTwist, deg0, deg1, deg2, deg3]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.charge_re
statement:
@[simp]
theorem charge_re (α β : ℝ) (v : NumClass) : (charge α β v).re = reZ α β v
proof:
:= by
  simp [charge]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.charge_im
statement:
@[simp]
theorem charge_im (α β : ℝ) (v : NumClass) : (charge α β v).im = imZ α β v
proof:
:= by
  simp [charge]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Threefold.chargeFamily_charge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chargeFamily_charge (p : ℝ × ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    chargeFamily.charge p v = charge p.1 p.2 v
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.stCharge_re
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stCharge_re (s t : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    (stCharge s t v).re = reZ s t v
proof:
:= by
  simp [stCharge]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.stCharge_im
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stCharge_im (s t : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    (stCharge s t v).im = imZ s t v
proof:
:= by

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.stChargeFamily_charge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stChargeFamily_charge (p : ℝ × ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    stChargeFamily.charge p v =
      Complex.ofReal (reZ p.1 p.2 v) +
        Complex.I * Complex.ofReal (imZ p.1 p.2 v)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.expCoeff_add
proof:
:= by
  simp only [expCoeff, neg_add, add_pow, div_eq_mul_inv, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  have hji : j ≤ i := by simpa using hj
  have key : (i.choose j : K) * ((j.factorial : K) * ((i - j).factorial : K)) =
      (i.factorial : K) := by
    have h := Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hji
    push_cast [← h]
    ring
  have h1 : (j.factorial : K) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero j)
  have h2 : ((i - j).factorial : K) ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero (i - j))
  have h3 : (i.factorial : K) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero i)
  field_simp
  linear_combination ((-x) ^ j * (-y) ^ (i - j)) * key

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.convolution_convolution
statement:
private theorem convolution_convolution {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (x y : K) (d : ℕ → K) (i : ℕ) :
    convolution x (convolution y d) i = convolution (x + y) d i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [convolution, Finset.mul_sum, ← mul_assoc]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm' (t' := range (i + 1)) (s' := fun j => Finset.Ico j (i + 1))
    (by intro k j; simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_Ico]; omega)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  have hji : j ≤ i := by simpa using hj
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
  have hlen : i + 1 - j = i - j + 1 := by omega
  rw [hlen, expCoeff_add]
  calc
    ∑ a ∈ range (i - j + 1), expCoeff x (i - (j + a)) * expCoeff y (j + a - j) =
        ∑ a ∈ range (i - j + 1),
          (fun b => expCoeff x b * expCoeff y (i - j - b)) (i - j + 1 - 1 - a) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
      have ha' : a < i - j + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp ha
      congr 2 <;> omega
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_range_reflect
      (fun b : ℕ => expCoeff x b * expCoeff y (i - j - b)) (i - j + 1)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.twist_apply
statement:
theorem twist_apply (m : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (d : HDeg m) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    twist m β d i = ∑ j : Fin (i.val + 1),
      (-β) ^ (i.val - j.val) / ((i.val - j.val).factorial : ℝ) *
        d ⟨j.val, by have
proof:
:= j.isLt; have := i.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  rw [twist, convolution, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  have h : j.val < m + 1 := by have := j.isLt; have := i.isLt; omega
  simp only [expCoeff, degrees, dif_pos h]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.twist_twist
statement:
theorem twist_twist (m : ℕ) (β γ : ℝ) (d : HDeg m) :
    twist m β (twist m γ d) = twist m (β + γ) d
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change convolution β (degrees m (twist m γ d)) i =
    convolution (β + γ) (degrees m d) i
  rw [← convolution_convolution β γ (degrees m d) i]
  unfold convolution
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  have h : j < m + 1 := by have := i.isLt; simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj; omega
  simp only [degrees, dif_pos h, twist]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.twist_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem twist_zero (m : ℕ) (d : HDeg m) : twist m 0 d = d
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [twist, convolution]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i.val]
  · simp [expCoeff, degrees, i.isLt]
  · intro j hj hne
    have h : i.val - j ≠ 0 := by simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj; omega
    simp [expCoeff, zero_pow h]
  · simp

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.charge_convolution
statement:
private theorem charge_convolution (m : ℕ) (w : ℂ) (d : HDeg m) :
    charge m w d = -convolution w (fun j => (degrees m d j : ℂ)) m
proof:
:= by
  rw [charge_apply, ofMoments, convolution,
    ← Finset.sum_range_reflect
      (fun j => expCoeff w (m - j) * (degrees m d j : ℂ)) (m + 1)]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  have hjm : j ≤ m := by simpa using hj
  have hsub : m - (m + 1 - 1 - j) = j := by omega
  have hlt : m + 1 - 1 - j < m + 1 := by omega
  simp only [moments, dif_pos hjm, degrees, dif_pos hlt, hsub, expCoeff, coeff]
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  rw [neg_pow]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.charge_twist
statement:
theorem charge_twist (m : ℕ) (w : ℂ) (β : ℝ) (d : HDeg m) :
    charge m w (twist m β d) = charge m (w + β) d
proof:
:= by
  rw [charge_convolution, charge_convolution,
    ← convolution_convolution w (β : ℂ) (fun j => (degrees m d j : ℂ)) m]
  congr 1
  unfold convolution
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  have h : j < m + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
  simp only [degrees, dif_pos h, twist, convolution, expCoeff]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_eq_exp
statement:
theorem ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_eq_exp (D : ChargeCoordinates N) (β : ℝ) (E : N) :
    ![(D.twistByScalar β).hyperplaneSquare * (D.twistByScalar β).rank E,
      (D.twistByScalar β).degree E, (D.twistByScalar β).chTwo E] =
      Exp.twist 2 β ![D.hyperplaneSquare * D.rank E, D.degree E, D.chTwo E]
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    norm_num [Exp.twist_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Nat.factorial,
      ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar] <;> ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.twist_rankOne_eq_exp
statement:
theorem ChernCharacter.twist_rankOne_eq_exp (ch : ChernCharacter N D)
    (S : DivisorSpace D) (H : D) (β : ℝ) (E : N) :
    ![S.pair H H * (ch.twist S (β • H)).rank E,
      S.pair H ((ch.twist S (β • H)).chOne E), (ch.twist S (β • H)).chTwo E] =
      Exp.twist 2 β ![S.pair H H * ch.rank E, S.pair H (ch.chOne E), ch.chTwo E]
proof:
:= by
  have h := ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_eq_exp (ch.coordinatesAt S H) β E
  simp only [ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_hyperplaneSquare, ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_rank,
    ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_degree, ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_chTwo] at h
  rw [← h]
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar, ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt,
      DivisorSpace.pair, map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] <;> ring_nf
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.expCharge_eq_ofMoments
statement:
theorem expCharge_eq_ofMoments (S : DivisorSpace D) (P : StabilityParameters D)
    (v : Mukai.RealExtension D) :
    Mukai.expCharge S.intersection P.B P.omega v
      = Exp.ofMoments 2 (tripleMoments S P v)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ∀ x y : D, S.intersection x y = S.intersection y x := fun x y => S.pair_comm x y
  obtain ⟨r, c, s⟩ := v
  rw [Mukai.expCharge_apply _ _ _ hb]
  simp only [Exp.ofMoments, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Exp.coeff,
    tripleMoments, cPair, cSelf]
  norm_num [Nat.factorial]
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      DivisorSpace.pair, hb P.omega P.B] <;> ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.expCharge_rankOne_eq_charge
statement:
theorem expCharge_rankOne_eq_charge (S : DivisorSpace D) (H : D) (a b : ℝ)
    (v : Mukai.RealExtension D) :
    Mukai.expCharge S.intersection (StabilityParameters.rankOne H a b).B
        (StabilityParameters.rankOne H a b).omega v
      = Exp.charge 2 (Exp.alphaBetaChart (a, b))
          ![S.pair H H * v.1, S.pair H v.2.1, v.2.2]
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ∀ x y : D, S.intersection x y = S.intersection y x := fun x y => S.pair_comm x y
  obtain ⟨r, c, s⟩ := v
  rw [Mukai.expCharge_apply _ _ _ hb]
  simp only [Exp.charge, AddMonoidHom.mk'_apply, Exp.ofMoments, Exp.moments, Exp.coeff,
    Exp.alphaBetaChart, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero,
    StabilityParameters.rankOne]
  norm_num [Nat.factorial, DivisorSpace.pair]
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      pow_two, hb H c] <;> ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.centralCharge_eq_expCharge
statement:
theorem centralCharge_eq_expCharge (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (S : DivisorSpace D)
    (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    ch.centralCharge S P E
      = Mukai.expCharge S.intersection P.B P.omega (ch.toRealExtension E)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ∀ x y : D, S.intersection x y = S.intersection y x := fun x y => S.pair_comm x y
  rw [ChernCharacter.centralCharge_apply, Mukai.expCharge_apply _ _ _ hb]
  simp only [ChernCharacter.toRealExtension_apply, DivisorSpace.pair]
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      hb P.omega P.B] <;> ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.centralCharge_eq_ofMoments
statement:
theorem centralCharge_eq_ofMoments (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (S : DivisorSpace D)
    (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    ch.centralCharge S P E = Exp.ofMoments 2 (tripleMoments S P (ch.toRealExtension E))
proof:
:= by
  rw [centralCharge_eq_expCharge, expCharge_eq_ofMoments]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.moments_apply
statement:
theorem moments_apply (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (S : DivisorSpace D)
    (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    moments ch S P E = tripleMoments S P (ch.toRealExtension E)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.moments_rankOne
statement:
theorem moments_rankOne (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (S : DivisorSpace D) (H : D)
    (a b : ℝ) (E : N) :
    moments ch S (StabilityParameters.rankOne H a b) E
      = Exp.moments 2 (Exp.alphaBetaChart (a, b))
          ![S.pair H H * ch.rank E, S.pair H (ch.chOne E), ch.chTwo E]
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  have hb : ∀ x y : D, S.intersection x y = S.intersection y x := fun x y => S.pair_comm x y
  match j with
  | 0 => simp [moments, tripleMoments, Exp.moments]
  | 1 =>
    simp only [moments, tripleMoments, Exp.moments, cPair, StabilityParameters.rankOne,
      Exp.alphaBetaChart, DivisorSpace.pair, ChernCharacter.toRealExtension_apply,
      map_smul, smul_eq_mul, LinearMap.smul_apply, dif_pos (by omega : (1:ℕ) ≤ 2), pow_one]
    norm_num
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  | 2 =>
    simp only [moments, tripleMoments, Exp.moments, cSelf, StabilityParameters.rankOne,
      Exp.alphaBetaChart, DivisorSpace.pair, ChernCharacter.toRealExtension_apply,
      map_smul, smul_eq_mul, LinearMap.smul_apply, dif_pos (by omega : (2:ℕ) ≤ 2)]
    norm_num
    apply Complex.ext <;>
      simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
        pow_two] <;> ring
  | (k+3) => simp [moments, tripleMoments, Exp.moments]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.centralCharge_rankOne_eq_charge
statement:
theorem centralCharge_rankOne_eq_charge (ch : ChernCharacter N D) (S : DivisorSpace D)
    (H : D) (a b : ℝ) (E : N) :
    ch.centralCharge S (StabilityParameters.rankOne H a b) E
      = Exp.charge 2 (Exp.alphaBetaChart (a, b))
          ![S.pair H H * ch.rank E, S.pair H (ch.chOne E), ch.chTwo E]
proof:
:= by
  rw [centralCharge_eq_expCharge, expCharge_rankOne_eq_charge]
  simp [ChernCharacter.toRealExtension_apply]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.coeff_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem coeff_zero : coeff 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [coeff]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.coeff_one

proof: := by simp [coeff]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.coeff_two

proof: := by norm_num [coeff, Nat.factorial]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.coeff_three
statement: theorem coeff_three : coeff 3 = -(1 / 6)
proof: := by norm_num [coeff, Nat.factorial]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.ofMoments_add
statement:
theorem ofMoments_add (m : ℕ) (mu nu : ℕ → ℂ) :
    ofMoments m (mu + nu) = ofMoments m mu + ofMoments m nu
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ofMoments, Pi.add_apply, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, neg_add]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.moments_add
statement:
theorem moments_add (m : ℕ) (w : ℂ) (d e : HDeg m) :
    moments m w (d + e) = moments m w d + moments m w e
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  by_cases h : j ≤ m <;> simp [moments, h, mul_add]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.charge_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem charge_apply (m : ℕ) (w : ℂ) (d : HDeg m) :
    charge m w d = ofMoments m (moments m w d)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Exp.chargeFamily_charge
statement:
@[simp] theorem chargeFamily_charge (m : ℕ) (w : ℂ) (d : HDeg m) :
    (chargeFamily m).charge w d = charge m w d
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.stCharge_eq_exp
statement:
theorem stCharge_eq_exp (s t : ℝ) (v : NumClass) :
    stCharge s t v = Exp.charge 2 (Exp.stChart (s, t)) ![v.rk, v.deg, v.ch2]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Exp.charge, AddMonoidHom.mk'_apply, Exp.ofMoments, Exp.moments, Exp.coeff,
    Exp.stChart, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero]
  norm_num [Nat.factorial]
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp [stCharge, reZ, imZ, pow_two, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
      Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im] <;> ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.threefold_charge_eq_exp
statement:
theorem threefold_charge_eq_exp (a b : ℝ) (v : Threefold.NumClass) :
    Threefold.charge a b v
      = Exp.charge 3 (Exp.alphaBetaChart (a, b)) ![v.deg0, v.deg1, v.deg2, v.deg3]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Exp.charge, AddMonoidHom.mk'_apply, Exp.ofMoments, Exp.moments, Exp.coeff,
    Exp.alphaBetaChart, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero]
  norm_num [Nat.factorial]
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp [Threefold.charge, Threefold.reZ, Threefold.imZ, pow_two, pow_three,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im] <;> ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.stChargeFamily_eq
statement:
theorem stChargeFamily_eq :
    stChargeFamily
      = ((Exp.chargeFamily 2).reindex Exp.stChart).pullback surfaceVec.toAddMonoidHom
proof:
:= by
  apply ChargeFamily.ext
  intro p
  ext v
  exact stCharge_eq_exp p.1 p.2 v

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.threefold_chargeFamily_eq
statement:
theorem threefold_chargeFamily_eq :
    Threefold.chargeFamily
      = ((Exp.chargeFamily 3).reindex Exp.alphaBetaChart).pullback
          threefoldVec.toAddMonoidHom
proof:
:= by
  apply ChargeFamily.ext
  intro p
  ext v
  exact threefold_charge_eq_exp p.1 p.2 v

name: Mukai.expChargeHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expChargeHom_apply (v : RealExtension V) :
    expChargeHom b β ω v = expCharge b β ω v
proof: := rfl

name: Mukai.expChargeLinearMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expChargeLinearMap_apply (v : RealExtension V) :
    expChargeLinearMap b β ω v = expCharge b β ω v
proof: := rfl

name: Mukai.expCharge_apply
statement:
theorem expCharge_apply (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) (r : ℝ) (c : V) (s : ℝ) :
    expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)
      = Complex.ofReal (b β c - s - r * (b β β - b ω ω) / 2)
        + Complex.ofReal (b ω c - r * b β ω) * Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  refine Complex.ext ?_ ?_
  · simp [expCharge, PeriodDomain.centralCharge, polar_realForm b hb, realPairing, expRe, expIm]
    ring
  · simp [expCharge, PeriodDomain.centralCharge, polar_realForm b hb, realPairing, expRe, expIm]

name: Mukai.neg_of_expCharge_eq_zero
statement:
theorem neg_of_expCharge_eq_zero
    (hsig : PeriodDomain.HasSignatureTwo (realForm b)) (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (hω : 0 < b ω ω) {v : RealExtension V} (hv : expCharge b β ω v = 0) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) :
    realForm b v < 0
proof:
:=
  PeriodDomain.neg_of_centralCharge_eq_zero hsig (isPositiveFrame_exp b β ω hb hω) hv hv0

name: Mukai.expCharge_ne_zero_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem expCharge_ne_zero_of_nonneg
    (hsig : PeriodDomain.HasSignatureTwo (realForm b)) (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (hω : 0 < b ω ω) {v : RealExtension V} (hv : 0 ≤ realForm b v) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) :
    expCharge b β ω v ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  PeriodDomain.centralCharge_ne_zero_of_nonneg hsig (isPositiveFrame_exp b β ω hb hω) hv hv0

name: Mukai.expCharge_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expCharge_zero : Mukai.expCharge b β ω 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  (expChargeHom b β ω).map_zero

name: Mukai.expCharge_add
statement:
theorem expCharge_add (v w : Mukai.RealExtension V) :
    Mukai.expCharge b β ω (v + w) =
      Mukai.expCharge b β ω v + Mukai.expCharge b β ω w
proof:
:=
  (expChargeHom b β ω).map_add v w

name: Mukai.expCharge_neg
statement:
theorem expCharge_neg (v : Mukai.RealExtension V) :
    Mukai.expCharge b β ω (-v) = -Mukai.expCharge b β ω v
proof:
:=
  (expChargeHom b β ω).map_neg v

name: Mukai.continuous_bilin
statement:
theorem continuous_bilin (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) :
    Continuous fun p : V × V => b p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  have h := QuadraticMap.continuous_polar (LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b)
  have heq : (fun p : V × V => polar (⇑(LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b)) p.1 p.2 / 2)
      = fun p : V × V => b p.1 p.2 := by
    funext p
    rw [LinearMap.BilinMap.polar_toQuadraticMap, hb p.2 p.1]
    ring
  rw [← heq]
  exact h.div_const 2

name: Mukai.pairingDet_exp
statement:
theorem pairingDet_exp (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) (β ω β' ω' : V) :
    PeriodDomain.pairingDet (realForm b) (expRe b β ω) (expIm b β ω)
        (expRe b β' ω') (expIm b β' ω')
      = (b β β' - (b β' β' - b ω' ω') / 2 - (b β β - b ω ω) / 2) * b ω ω'
        - (b β ω' - b β' ω') * (b ω β' - b β ω)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PeriodDomain.pairingDet, polar_realForm b hb, polar_realForm b hb, polar_realForm b hb,
    polar_realForm b hb]
  simp only [realPairing, pairing, expRe, expIm]
  ring

name: Mukai.segment_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem segment_zero : segment β ω β' ω' 0 = (β, ω)
proof: := by simp [segment]

name: Mukai.segment_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem segment_one : segment β ω β' ω' 1 = (β', ω')
proof: := by simp [segment]

name: Mukai.pos_segment
statement:
theorem pos_segment (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) (hω : 0 < b ω ω) (hω' : 0 < b ω' ω')
    (hcone : 0 < b ω ω') {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 < b (segment β ω β' ω' t).2 (segment β ω β' ω' t).2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := ht
  have hexp : b ((1 - t) • ω + t • ω') ((1 - t) • ω + t • ω')
      = (1 - t) * (1 - t) * b ω ω + 2 * ((1 - t) * t) * b ω ω' + t * t * b ω' ω' := by
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      hb ω' ω]
    ring
  simp only [segment]
  rw [hexp]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h0 with rfl | ht0
  · simpa using hω
  · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with rfl | ht1
    · simpa using hω'
    · have h2 : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith
      have p1 : 0 < (1 - t) * (1 - t) * b ω ω := mul_pos (mul_pos h2 h2) hω
      have hmid : 0 < 2 * ((1 - t) * t) := by
        have := mul_pos h2 ht0
        linarith
      have p2 : 0 < 2 * ((1 - t) * t) * b ω ω' := mul_pos hmid hcone
      have p3 : 0 < t * t * b ω' ω' := mul_pos (mul_pos ht0 ht0) hω'
      linarith

name: Mukai.continuous_pathDet
statement:
theorem continuous_pathDet (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) :
    Continuous (pathDet b β ω β' ω')
proof:
:= by
  have hbc := continuous_bilin b hb
  have hseg : Continuous (segment β ω β' ω') := by
    unfold segment
    fun_prop
  have hf : Continuous fun t : ℝ => (segment β ω β' ω' t).1 := hseg.fst
  have hg : Continuous fun t : ℝ => (segment β ω β' ω' t).2 := hseg.snd
  have key : ∀ f g : ℝ → V, Continuous f → Continuous g →
      Continuous fun t => b (f t) (g t) := fun f g hf hg => hbc.comp (hf.prodMk hg)
  unfold pathDet
  simp only [pairingDet_exp b hb]
  have h1 := key _ _ (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => β) hf
  have h2 := key _ _ hf hf
  have h3 := key _ _ hg hg
  have h4 := key _ _ (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => β) hg
  have h5 := key _ _ hf hg
  have h6 := key _ _ (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => ω) hg
  have h7 := key _ _ (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => ω) hf
  exact (((h1.sub ((h2.sub h3).div_const 2)).sub continuous_const).mul h6).sub
    ((h4.sub h5).mul (h7.sub continuous_const))

name: Mukai.pathDet_zero
statement:
theorem pathDet_zero (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) :
    pathDet b β ω β' ω' 0 = (b ω ω) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pathDet, segment_zero]
  exact pairingDet_exp_self b β ω hb

name: Mukai.pathDet_one
statement:
theorem pathDet_one : pathDet b β ω β' ω' 1 =
    PeriodDomain.pairingDet (realForm b) (expRe b β ω) (expIm b β ω)
      (expRe b β' ω') (expIm b β' ω')
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pathDet, segment_one]

name: Mukai.mem_positiveFramesPlus_exp_of_sameCone
statement:
theorem mem_positiveFramesPlus_exp_of_sameCone
    (hsig : PeriodDomain.HasSignatureTwo (realForm b)) (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (hω : 0 < b ω ω) (hω' : 0 < b ω' ω') (hcone : 0 < b ω ω') :
    (expRe b β' ω', expIm b β' ω') ∈
      PeriodDomain.positiveFramesPlus (realForm b) (expRe b β ω) (expIm b β ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, PeriodDomain.IsPositiveFrame (realForm b)
      (expRe b (segment β ω β' ω' t).1 (segment β ω β' ω' t).2)
      (expIm b (segment β ω β' ω' t).1 (segment β ω β' ω' t).2) := fun t ht =>
    isPositiveFrame_exp b _ _ hb (pos_segment b β ω β' ω' hb hω hω' hcone ht)
  have hne : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, pathDet b β ω β' ω' t ≠ 0 := fun t ht =>
    PeriodDomain.pairingDet_ne_zero hsig (isPositiveFrame_exp b β ω hb hω) (hpair t ht)
  have h0 : 0 < pathDet b β ω β' ω' 0 := by
    rw [pathDet_zero b β ω β' ω' hb]
    positivity
  have h1 : 0 < pathDet b β ω β' ω' 1 := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy (pathDet b β ω β' ω' 1) 0 with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exfalso
      have hsub := intermediate_value_Icc' (zero_le_one (α := ℝ))
        (continuous_pathDet b β ω β' ω' hb).continuousOn
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hc0⟩ := hsub ⟨le_of_lt hlt, le_of_lt h0⟩
      exact hne c hc hc0
    · exact absurd heq (hne 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_refl 1⟩)
    · exact hgt
  refine ⟨isPositiveFrame_exp b β' ω' hb hω', ?_⟩
  rwa [← pathDet_one b β ω β' ω']

name: Mukai.mem_positiveFramesPlus_exp_of_sameCone_of_sigPos
statement:
theorem mem_positiveFramesPlus_exp_of_sameCone_of_sigPos (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (hsigPos : sigPos (LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b) = 1)
    (hsigNeg : sigNeg (LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b) + 1 = Module.finrank ℝ V)
    (hω : 0 < b ω ω) (hω' : 0 < b ω' ω') (hcone : 0 < b ω ω') :
    (expRe b β' ω', expIm b β' ω') ∈
      PeriodDomain.positiveFramesPlus (realForm b) (expRe b β ω) (expIm b β ω)
proof:
:=
  mem_positiveFramesPlus_exp_of_sameCone b β ω β' ω'
    (hasSignatureTwo_realForm b hb hsigPos hsigNeg) hb hω hω' hcone

name: Mukai.im_expCharge
statement:
theorem im_expCharge (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) (r : ℝ) (c : V) (s : ℝ) :
    (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).im = b ω c - r * b β ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [expCharge_apply b β ω hb]
  simp

name: Mukai.im_expCharge_eq_apply_sub_smul
statement:
theorem im_expCharge_eq_apply_sub_smul (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (r : ℝ) (c : V) (s : ℝ) :
    (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).im = b ω (c - r • β)
proof:
:= by
  rw [im_expCharge b β ω hb]
  simp only [map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hb ω β]

name: Mukai.apply_sub_smul_eq_zero_of_im_eq_zero
statement:
theorem apply_sub_smul_eq_zero_of_im_eq_zero (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    {r : ℝ} {c : V} {s : ℝ} (him : (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).im = 0) :
    b ω (c - r • β) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← im_expCharge_eq_apply_sub_smul b β ω hb r c s]
  exact him

name: Mukai.im_expCharge_pos
statement:
theorem im_expCharge_pos (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    {r : ℝ} {c : V} {s : ℝ} (h : 0 < b ω (c - r • β)) :
    0 < (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).im
proof:
:= by
  rw [im_expCharge_eq_apply_sub_smul b β ω hb]
  exact h

name: Mukai.im_expCharge_nonneg
statement:
theorem im_expCharge_nonneg (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    {r : ℝ} {c : V} {s : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ b ω (c - r • β)) :
    0 ≤ (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).im
proof:
:= by
  rw [im_expCharge_eq_apply_sub_smul b β ω hb]
  exact h

name: Mukai.two_mul_re_expCharge
statement:
theorem two_mul_re_expCharge (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) (r : ℝ) (c : V) (s : ℝ) :
    2 * r * (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).re
      = -b (c - r • β) (c - r • β) + 2 * realForm b (r, c, s) + r ^ 2 * b ω ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [expCharge_apply b β ω hb, realForm_apply]
  simp only [map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    realPairing_apply, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re,
    Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_im]
  rw [hb c β]
  ring

name: Mukai.two_mul_re_expCharge_ge
statement:
theorem two_mul_re_expCharge_ge (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (hsigPos : sigPos (LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b) = 1) (hω : 0 < b ω ω)
    {r : ℝ} {c : V} {s : ℝ} (him : (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).im = 0) :
    2 * realForm b (r, c, s) + r ^ 2 * b ω ω
      ≤ 2 * r * (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).re
proof:
:= by
  have horth : polar (⇑(LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b)) ω (c - r • β) = 0 := by
    rw [LinearMap.BilinMap.polar_toQuadraticMap, hb (c - r • β) ω,
      apply_sub_smul_eq_zero_of_im_eq_zero b β ω hb him]
    ring
  have hnonpos : LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b (c - r • β) ≤ 0 :=
    PeriodDomain.nonpos_of_sigPos_eq_one _ hsigPos (u := ω) (by simpa using hω) horth
  rw [two_mul_re_expCharge b β ω hb]
  simp only [LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap_apply] at hnonpos
  linarith

name: Mukai.re_expCharge_pos_of_boundary_margin
statement:
theorem re_expCharge_pos_of_boundary_margin (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (hsigPos : sigPos (LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b) = 1) (hω : 0 < b ω ω)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {c : V} {s : ℝ}
    (him : (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).im = 0)
    (hmargin : 0 < 2 * realForm b (r, c, s) + r ^ 2 * b ω ω) :
    0 < (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).re
proof:
:= by
  have hge := two_mul_re_expCharge_ge b β ω hb hsigPos hω him
  nlinarith

name: Mukai.re_expCharge_pos_of_lower_bound
statement:
theorem re_expCharge_pos_of_lower_bound (δ : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (hsigPos : sigPos (LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b) = 1) (hω : 0 < b ω ω)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {c : V} {s : ℝ}
    (him : (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).im = 0)
    (hv : -δ ≤ realForm b (r, c, s))
    (hthreshold : 2 * δ < r ^ 2 * b ω ω) :
    0 < (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).re
proof:
:= by
  apply re_expCharge_pos_of_boundary_margin b β ω hb hsigPos hω hr him
  linarith

name: Mukai.re_expCharge_pos_of_lower_bound_of_one_le_rank
statement:
theorem re_expCharge_pos_of_lower_bound_of_one_le_rank (δ : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (hsigPos : sigPos (LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b) = 1) (hω : 0 < b ω ω)
    (hωδ : 2 * δ < b ω ω) {r : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) {c : V} {s : ℝ}
    (him : (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).im = 0)
    (hv : -δ ≤ realForm b (r, c, s)) :
    0 < (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).re
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < r := by linarith
  have hsq : b ω ω ≤ r ^ 2 * b ω ω := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r - 1)]
  exact re_expCharge_pos_of_lower_bound b β ω δ hb hsigPos hω hr0 him hv
    (lt_of_lt_of_le hωδ hsq)

name: Mukai.re_expCharge_pos_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem re_expCharge_pos_of_nonneg (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (hsigPos : sigPos (LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b) = 1) (hω : 0 < b ω ω)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {c : V} {s : ℝ}
    (him : (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).im = 0) (hv : 0 ≤ realForm b (r, c, s)) :
    0 < (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).re
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < r ^ 2 * b ω ω := by positivity
  exact re_expCharge_pos_of_lower_bound b β ω 0 hb hsigPos hω hr him (by simpa using hv)
    (by simpa using hpos)

name: Mukai.re_expCharge_pos_of_neg_one
statement:
theorem re_expCharge_pos_of_neg_one (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x)
    (hsigPos : sigPos (LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap b) = 1) (hω : 2 < b ω ω)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) {c : V} {s : ℝ}
    (him : (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).im = 0) (hv : -1 ≤ realForm b (r, c, s)) :
    0 < (expCharge b β ω (r, c, s)).re
proof:
:= by
  have hω0 : 0 < b ω ω := by linarith
  exact re_expCharge_pos_of_lower_bound_of_one_le_rank b β ω 1 hb hsigPos hω0
    (by simpa using hω) hr him (by simpa using hv)

name: Mukai.realPairing_expRe_expRe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realPairing_expRe_expRe : realPairing b (expRe b β ω) (expRe b β ω) = b ω ω
proof:
:= by
  simp [expRe, realPairing]
  ring

name: Mukai.realPairing_expIm_expIm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realPairing_expIm_expIm : realPairing b (expIm b β ω) (expIm b β ω) = b ω ω
proof:
:= by
  simp [expIm, realPairing]

name: Mukai.realPairing_expRe_expIm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realPairing_expRe_expIm : realPairing b (expRe b β ω) (expIm b β ω) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [expRe, expIm, realPairing]

name: Mukai.realPairing_expIm_expRe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realPairing_expIm_expRe (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) :
    realPairing b (expIm b β ω) (expRe b β ω) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← realPairing_comm b hb, realPairing_expRe_expIm]

name: Mukai.realForm_smul_add_smul
statement:
theorem realForm_smul_add_smul (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) (s t : ℝ) :
    realForm b (s • expRe b β ω + t • expIm b β ω) = (s ^ 2 + t ^ 2) * b ω ω / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : realForm b (s • expRe b β ω + t • expIm b β ω)
      = realPairing b (s • expRe b β ω + t • expIm b β ω)
          (s • expRe b β ω + t • expIm b β ω) / 2 := realForm_apply b _
  rw [hexp]
  have hbil : realPairing b (s • expRe b β ω + t • expIm b β ω)
      (s • expRe b β ω + t • expIm b β ω)
      = s * s * realPairing b (expRe b β ω) (expRe b β ω)
        + s * t * realPairing b (expRe b β ω) (expIm b β ω)
        + t * s * realPairing b (expIm b β ω) (expRe b β ω)
        + t * t * realPairing b (expIm b β ω) (expIm b β ω) := by
    simp only [← realBilin_apply, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [hbil, realPairing_expRe_expRe, realPairing_expIm_expIm, realPairing_expRe_expIm,
    realPairing_expIm_expRe b β ω hb]
  ring

name: Mukai.expRe_ne_zero
statement: theorem expRe_ne_zero : expRe b β ω ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have : (expRe b β ω).1 = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
  simp [expRe] at this

name: Mukai.isPositiveFrame_exp
statement:
theorem isPositiveFrame_exp (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) (hω : 0 < b ω ω) :
    PeriodDomain.IsPositiveFrame (realForm b) (expRe b β ω) (expIm b β ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hindep : LinearIndependent ℝ ![expRe b β ω, expIm b β ω] := by
    rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
    intro s t hst
    have hfst : s = 0 := by
      have h1 : (s • expRe b β ω + t • expIm b β ω).1 = 0 := by rw [hst]; rfl
      simpa [expRe, expIm] using h1
    refine ⟨hfst, ?_⟩
    by_contra ht
    have hval := realForm_smul_add_smul b β ω hb s t
    rw [hst, map_zero, hfst] at hval
    have hpos : 0 < (0 ^ 2 + t ^ 2) * b ω ω / 2 := by positivity
    rw [← hval] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl _ hpos
  constructor
  · have hrange : ({expRe b β ω, expIm b β ω} : Set (RealExtension V))
        = Set.range ![expRe b β ω, expIm b β ω] := by
      ext z
      simp
      tauto
    rw [PeriodDomain.framePlane_mk, PeriodDomain.pairSpan, hrange]
    simpa using finrank_span_eq_card hindep
  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩ hv0
    rw [PeriodDomain.framePlane_mk, PeriodDomain.pairSpan, Submodule.mem_span_pair] at hv
    obtain ⟨s, t, rfl⟩ := hv
    rw [restrict_apply, realForm_smul_add_smul b β ω hb]
    have hst : s ≠ 0 ∨ t ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      exact hv0 (Subtype.ext (by simp [hcon.1, hcon.2]))
    rcases hst with hs | ht
    · have : 0 < s ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h2 : 0 ≤ t ^ 2 := sq_nonneg t
      nlinarith
    · have : 0 < t ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h2 : 0 ≤ s ^ 2 := sq_nonneg s
      nlinarith

name: Mukai.pairingDet_exp_self
statement:
theorem pairingDet_exp_self (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) :
    PeriodDomain.pairingDet (realForm b) (expRe b β ω) (expIm b β ω)
      (expRe b β ω) (expIm b β ω) = (b ω ω) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [PeriodDomain.pairingDet, polar_realForm b hb, polar_realForm b hb, polar_realForm b hb,
    polar_realForm b hb, realPairing_expRe_expRe, realPairing_expIm_expIm,
    realPairing_expRe_expIm, realPairing_expIm_expRe b β ω hb]
  ring

name: Mukai.mem_positiveFramesPlus_exp
statement:
theorem mem_positiveFramesPlus_exp (hb : ∀ x y : V, b x y = b y x) (hω : 0 < b ω ω) :
    (expRe b β ω, expIm b β ω) ∈
      PeriodDomain.positiveFramesPlus (realForm b) (expRe b β ω) (expIm b β ω)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isPositiveFrame_exp b β ω hb hω, ?_⟩
  rw [pairingDet_exp_self b β ω hb]
  positivity

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.mukaiVector_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mukaiVector_apply (t : SqrtTodd D) (E : N) :
    ch.mukaiVector S t E =
      (ch.rank E, ch.chOne E + ch.rank E • t.divisor,
        ch.chTwo E + S.pair t.divisor (ch.chOne E) + ch.rank E * t.number)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.mukaiVector_trivial
statement:
theorem mukaiVector_trivial (E : N) :
    ch.mukaiVector S SqrtTodd.trivial E = ch.toRealExtension E
proof:
:= by
  simp [SqrtTodd.trivial, DivisorSpace.pair]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.mukaiVector_k3
statement:
theorem mukaiVector_k3 (E : N) :
    ch.mukaiVector S SqrtTodd.k3 E =
      (ch.rank E, ch.chOne E, ch.chTwo E + ch.rank E)
proof:
:= by
  simp [SqrtTodd.k3, DivisorSpace.pair]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.centralCharge_eq_expChargeHom
statement:
theorem centralCharge_eq_expChargeHom (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    ch.centralCharge S P E =
      Mukai.expChargeHom S.intersection P.B P.omega (ch.toRealExtension E)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ∀ x y : D, S.intersection x y = S.intersection y x := fun x y => S.pair_comm x y
  rw [Mukai.expChargeHom_apply, toRealExtension_apply,
    Mukai.expCharge_apply _ _ _ hb, centralCharge_apply]
  simp only [DivisorSpace.pair]
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      zero_mul, one_mul, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero, sub_zero]
  · ring
  · linear_combination (ch.rank E) * hb P.B P.omega

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.mukaiCharge_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mukaiCharge_apply (t : SqrtTodd D) (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    ch.mukaiCharge S t P E =
      Mukai.expCharge S.intersection P.B P.omega (ch.mukaiVector S t E)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.mukaiCharge_trivial
statement:
theorem mukaiCharge_trivial (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    ch.mukaiCharge S SqrtTodd.trivial P E = ch.centralCharge S P E
proof:
:= by
  rw [mukaiCharge_apply, mukaiVector_trivial, ch.centralCharge_eq_expChargeHom S P E,
    Mukai.expChargeHom_apply]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.mukaiCharge_eq_centralCharge_add
statement:
theorem mukaiCharge_eq_centralCharge_add (t : SqrtTodd D) (P : StabilityParameters D)
    (E : N) :
    ch.mukaiCharge S t P E =
      ch.centralCharge S P E
        + Complex.ofReal (ch.rank E * S.pair P.B t.divisor
            - S.pair t.divisor (ch.chOne E) - ch.rank E * t.number)
        + Complex.I * Complex.ofReal (ch.rank E * S.pair P.omega t.divisor)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ∀ x y : D, S.intersection x y = S.intersection y x := fun x y => S.pair_comm x y
  rw [mukaiCharge_apply, mukaiVector_apply, Mukai.expCharge_apply _ _ _ hb,
    centralCharge_apply]
  simp only [DivisorSpace.pair, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      zero_mul, one_mul, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero, sub_zero]
  · ring
  · linear_combination (ch.rank E) * hb P.omega P.B

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.mukaiCharge_k3
statement:
theorem mukaiCharge_k3 (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    ch.mukaiCharge S SqrtTodd.k3 P E =
      ch.centralCharge S P E - Complex.ofReal (ch.rank E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mukaiCharge_eq_centralCharge_add]
  simp only [SqrtTodd.k3_divisor, SqrtTodd.k3_number, DivisorSpace.pair, map_zero,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero, mul_one, zero_sub, sub_zero]
  push_cast
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.mukaiChargeFamily_charge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mukaiChargeFamily_charge (t : SqrtTodd D) (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    (ch.mukaiChargeFamily S t).charge P E = ch.mukaiCharge S t P E
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.mukaiChargeFamily_trivial
statement:
theorem mukaiChargeFamily_trivial :
    ch.mukaiChargeFamily S SqrtTodd.trivial = ch.fullChargeFamily S
proof:
:= by
  ext P E
  rw [mukaiChargeFamily_charge, fullChargeFamily_charge, mukaiCharge_trivial]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.toRealExtension_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toRealExtension_apply (E : N) :
    ch.toRealExtension E = (ch.rank E, ch.chOne E, ch.chTwo E)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.twist_rank
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twist_rank (S : DivisorSpace D) (B : D) (E : N) :
    (ch.twist S B).rank E = ch.rank E
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.twist_chOne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twist_chOne (S : DivisorSpace D) (B : D) (E : N) :
    (ch.twist S B).chOne E = ch.chOne E - ch.rank E • B
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.twist_chTwo
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twist_chTwo (S : DivisorSpace D) (B : D) (E : N) :
    (ch.twist S B).chTwo E =
      ch.chTwo E - S.pair B (ch.chOne E) + S.pair B B * ch.rank E / 2
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_rank
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinatesAt_rank (S : DivisorSpace D) (H : D) (E : N) :
    (ch.coordinatesAt S H).rank E = ch.rank E
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_degree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinatesAt_degree (S : DivisorSpace D) (H : D) (E : N) :
    (ch.coordinatesAt S H).degree E = S.pair H (ch.chOne E)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_chTwo
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinatesAt_chTwo (S : DivisorSpace D) (H : D) (E : N) :
    (ch.coordinatesAt S H).chTwo E = ch.chTwo E
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_hyperplaneSquare
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinatesAt_hyperplaneSquare (S : DivisorSpace D) (H : D) :
    (ch.coordinatesAt S H).hyperplaneSquare = S.pair H H
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.chargeCoordinates_rank
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chargeCoordinates_rank (S : DivisorSpace D) (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    (ch.chargeCoordinates S P).rank E = ch.rank E
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.chargeCoordinates_degree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chargeCoordinates_degree (S : DivisorSpace D) (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    (ch.chargeCoordinates S P).degree E =
      S.pair P.omega (ch.chOne E - ch.rank E • P.B)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.chargeCoordinates_chTwo
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chargeCoordinates_chTwo (S : DivisorSpace D) (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    (ch.chargeCoordinates S P).chTwo E =
      ch.chTwo E - S.pair P.B (ch.chOne E)
        + S.pair P.B P.B * ch.rank E / 2
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.chargeCoordinates_hyperplaneSquare
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chargeCoordinates_hyperplaneSquare
    (S : DivisorSpace D) (P : StabilityParameters D) :
    (ch.chargeCoordinates S P).hyperplaneSquare = S.pair P.omega P.omega
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.Pullback.centralCharge_eq
statement:
theorem centralCharge_eq (h : Pullback source target)
    (S : DivisorSpace D) (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : L) :
    source.centralCharge S P E = target.centralCharge S P (h.map E)
proof:
:=
  ChargeCoordinates.Pullback.centralCharge_eq (h.chargeCoordinates S P) 1 E

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.centralCharge_apply_twisted
statement:
theorem centralCharge_apply_twisted
    (S : DivisorSpace D) (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    ch.centralCharge S P E =
      -Complex.ofReal ((ch.twist S P.B).chTwo E)
        + Complex.ofReal (S.pair P.omega P.omega * ch.rank E / 2)
        + Complex.I * Complex.ofReal
            (S.pair P.omega ((ch.twist S P.B).chOne E))
proof:
:= by
  simp [centralCharge, ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge_apply, chargeCoordinates,
    DivisorSpace.pair]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChernCharacter.centralCharge_apply
statement:
theorem centralCharge_apply
    (S : DivisorSpace D) (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    ch.centralCharge S P E =
      Complex.ofReal
          (-ch.chTwo E + S.pair P.B (ch.chOne E)
            - (S.pair P.B P.B - S.pair P.omega P.omega) * ch.rank E / 2)
        + Complex.I * Complex.ofReal
            (S.pair P.omega (ch.chOne E) - S.pair P.omega P.B * ch.rank E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [centralCharge_apply_twisted]
  simp only [twist_chOne, twist_chTwo, DivisorSpace.pair, map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  ring
