name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.subobject_isZero_iff_eq_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subobject_isZero_iff_eq_bot {E : A} (B : Subobject E) :
    IsZero (B : A) ↔ B = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hB
    have harrow : B.arrow = 0 := zero_of_source_iso_zero _ hB.isoZero
    rwa [← Subobject.mk_arrow B, Subobject.mk_eq_bot_iff_zero]
  · rintro rfl
    exact (isZero_zero A).of_iso Subobject.botCoeIsoZero

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.subobject_ne_bot_of_not_isZero
statement:
theorem subobject_ne_bot_of_not_isZero {E : A} {B : Subobject E}
    (hB : ¬IsZero (B : A)) : B ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  fun h => hB ((subobject_isZero_iff_eq_bot B).2 h)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.subobject_not_isZero_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem subobject_not_isZero_of_ne_bot {E : A} {B : Subobject E}
    (hB : B ≠ ⊥) : ¬IsZero (B : A)
proof:
:=
  fun h => hB ((subobject_isZero_iff_eq_bot B).1 h)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.subobject_top_ne_bot_of_not_isZero
statement:
theorem subobject_top_ne_bot_of_not_isZero {E : A} (hE : ¬IsZero E) :
    (⊤ : Subobject E) ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hE
  have htop : IsZero ((⊤ : Subobject E) : A) :=
    (subobject_isZero_iff_eq_bot _).2 h
  exact htop.of_iso (asIso (⊤ : Subobject E).arrow).symm

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.subobject_ofLE_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subobject_ofLE_bot {E : A} (S : Subobject E) (h : ⊥ ≤ S) :
    Subobject.ofLE ⊥ S h = 0
proof:
:=
  zero_of_source_iso_zero _ Subobject.botCoeIsoZero

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.cokernel_not_isZero_of_ne_top
statement:
theorem cokernel_not_isZero_of_ne_top {E : A} {B : Subobject E}
    (hB : B ≠ ⊤) : ¬IsZero (cokernel B.arrow)
proof:
:= by
  intro hcoker
  haveI : Epi B.arrow := Preadditive.epi_of_isZero_cokernel B.arrow hcoker
  haveI : IsIso B.arrow := isIso_of_mono_of_epi B.arrow
  exact hB (Subobject.eq_top_of_isIso_arrow B)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.imageSubobject_epi_comp
statement:
theorem imageSubobject_epi_comp {X Y Z : A} (e : X ⟶ Y) [Epi e]
    (f : Y ⟶ Z) : imageSubobject (e ≫ f) = imageSubobject f
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (imageSubobject_comp_le e f)
  have hle := imageSubobject_comp_le e f
  haveI : Mono (Subobject.ofLE _ _ hle) := by
    apply (mono_comp_iff_of_mono _ (imageSubobject f).arrow).mp
    rw [Subobject.ofLE_arrow]
    infer_instance
  haveI : Epi (Subobject.ofLE _ _ hle) :=
    imageSubobject_comp_le_epi_of_epi e f
  haveI : IsIso (Subobject.ofLE _ _ hle) :=
    isIso_of_mono_of_epi _
  exact Subobject.le_of_comm (inv (Subobject.ofLE _ _ hle)) (by
    rw [IsIso.inv_comp_eq, Subobject.ofLE_arrow])

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.imageSubobject_eq_top_of_epi
statement:
theorem imageSubobject_eq_top_of_epi {X Y : A} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Epi f] :
    imageSubobject f = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (imageSubobject f).arrow :=
    epi_of_epi_fac (imageSubobject_arrow_comp f)
  haveI : IsIso (imageSubobject f).arrow :=
    isIso_of_mono_of_epi _
  exact Subobject.eq_top_of_isIso_arrow _

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.pullback_obj_injective_of_epi
statement:
theorem pullback_obj_injective_of_epi {X Y : A} (p : X ⟶ Y) [Epi p] :
    Function.Injective (Subobject.pullback p).obj
proof:
:= by
  intro B₁ B₂ h
  haveI : Epi (Subobject.pullbackπ p B₁) := by
    rw [← (Subobject.isPullback p B₁).isoPullback_hom_fst]
    infer_instance
  haveI : Epi (Subobject.pullbackπ p B₂) := by
    rw [← (Subobject.isPullback p B₂).isoPullback_hom_fst]
    infer_instance
  calc
    B₁ = imageSubobject (Subobject.pullbackπ p B₁ ≫ B₁.arrow) := by
      rw [imageSubobject_epi_comp, imageSubobject_mono, Subobject.mk_arrow]
    _ = imageSubobject (((Subobject.pullback p).obj B₁).arrow ≫ p) := by
      rw [(Subobject.isPullback p B₁).w]
    _ = imageSubobject (((Subobject.pullback p).obj B₂).arrow ≫ p) := by rw [h]
    _ = imageSubobject (Subobject.pullbackπ p B₂ ≫ B₂.arrow) := by
      rw [← (Subobject.isPullback p B₂).w]
    _ = B₂ := by
      rw [imageSubobject_epi_comp, imageSubobject_mono, Subobject.mk_arrow]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.FiniteLength.mem_cone_smul
statement:
theorem mem_cone_smul {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane) : (r : ℂ) * z ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane
proof:
:= by
  rcases hz with him | ⟨him, hre⟩
  · exact Or.inl (by simpa using mul_pos hr him)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨by simp [him], by simpa using mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hr hre⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.FiniteLength.mem_cone_sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact absurd hs (by simp)
  | insert a t ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
    rcases t.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ht
    · simpa using hf a (by simp)
    · exact add_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane (hf a (by simp))
        (ih ht fun i hi => hf i (by simp [hi]))

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.FiniteLength.chargeOf_apply
statement:
theorem chargeOf_apply (w : Fin n → ℂ) (m : Fin n → ℤ) :
    chargeOf w m = ∑ i, (m i : ℂ) * w i
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.FiniteLength.chargeOf_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chargeOf_single (w : Fin n → ℂ) (i : Fin n) :
    chargeOf w (Pi.single i 1) = w i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [chargeOf_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp
  · intro j _ hj
    simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj]
  · simp

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.FiniteLength.eq_chargeOf
statement:
theorem eq_chargeOf (Z : (Fin n → ℤ) →+ ℂ) :
    Z = chargeOf fun i => Z (Pi.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun m => ?_
  have key : Z m = ∑ i, Z (Pi.single i (m i)) := by
    rw [← map_sum, Finset.univ_sum_single]
  rw [key, chargeOf_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  have hsingle : Pi.single (M := fun _ : Fin n => ℤ) i (m i) = m i • Pi.single i 1 := by
    ext j
    rcases eq_or_ne i j with rfl | hij
    · simp
    · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)]
  rw [hsingle, map_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.FiniteLength.existsUnique_charge
statement:
theorem existsUnique_charge (w : Fin n → ℂ) :
    ∃! Z : (Fin n → ℤ) →+ ℂ, ∀ i, Z (Pi.single i 1) = w i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨chargeOf w, fun i => chargeOf_single w i, fun Z hZ => ?_⟩
  rw [eq_chargeOf Z]
  simp only [hZ]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.FiniteLength.mem_cone_natCombination
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set s : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.filter fun i => m i ≠ 0 with hs
  have hsne : s.Nonempty := by
    rcases Function.ne_iff.mp hm with ⟨i, hi⟩
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    simp only [hs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    simpa using hi
  have hrestrict : (∑ i, (m i : ℂ) * w i) = ∑ i ∈ s, (m i : ℂ) * w i := by
    refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) ?_).symm
    intro i _ hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_not] at hi
    simp [hi]
  rw [hrestrict]
  refine mem_cone_sum hsne fun i hi => ?_
  simp only [hs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (m i : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi
  simpa using mem_cone_smul hpos (hw i)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.FiniteLength.chargeOf_mem_cone
statement:
theorem chargeOf_mem_cone {w : Fin n → ℂ} (hw : ∀ i, w i ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane)
    {m : Fin n → ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    chargeOf w (fun i => (m i : ℤ)) ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane
proof:
:= by
  rw [chargeOf_apply]
  simpa using mem_cone_natCombination hw hm

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.FiniteLength.chargeOf_ne_zero
statement:
theorem chargeOf_ne_zero {w : Fin n → ℂ} (hw : ∀ i, w i ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane)
    {m : Fin n → ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    chargeOf w (fun i => (m i : ℤ)) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  semiClosedUpperHalfPlane_ne_zero (chargeOf_mem_cone hw hm)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.lt_phase_iff_slopeOfPhase_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  have hmem : π * β ∈ Set.Ioc (-π) π :=
    Set.mem_Ioc.mpr ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
  set z : ℂ := Complex.cos ((π * β : ℝ) : ℂ) + Complex.sin ((π * β : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    with hz_def
  have hargz : Complex.arg z = π * β := Complex.arg_cos_add_sin_mul_I hmem
  have hsin : 0 < Real.sin (π * β) := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)
  have hr : (0 : ℝ) < (D.rank E : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hE
  have hwne : D.charge E ≠ 0 := D.charge_ne_zero_of_rank_pos hE
  have hwarg : 0 < Complex.arg (D.charge E) := D.arg_pos_of_rank_pos hE
  have hzne : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, Complex.arg_zero] at hargz
    nlinarith
  have hcross : phaseCross z (D.charge E)
      = (D.rank E : ℝ) * Real.cos (π * β) + (D.degree E : ℝ) * Real.sin (π * β) := by
    simp only [phaseCross, hz_def, WeakSlopeData.charge_re, WeakSlopeData.charge_im,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.cos_ofReal_re,
      Complex.sin_ofReal_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.cos_ofReal_im,
      Complex.sin_ofReal_im]
    ring
  have harith : (0 : ℝ) < (D.rank E : ℝ) * Real.cos (π * β) + (D.degree E : ℝ) * Real.sin (π * β)
      ↔ slopeOfPhase β < D.slope E := by
    rw [slopeOfPhase, WeakSlopeData.slope, ← neg_div, div_lt_div_iff₀ hsin hr]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith
  rw [← harith, ← hcross]
  rw [WeakSlopeData.phase, lt_div_iff₀ hpi]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine phaseCross_pos_of_arg_lt (by rw [hargz]; nlinarith) hzne hwne ?_
    rw [hargz]; linarith [h]
  · intro h
    have := arg_lt_of_phaseCross_pos hzne hwne hwarg h
    rw [hargz] at this
    linarith

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.phase_le_iff_le_slopeOfPhase
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_lt, ← not_lt, not_iff_not]
  exact D.lt_phase_iff_slopeOfPhase_lt hE hβ0 hβ1

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SlopeData.lt_phase_iff_slopeOfPhase_lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [toStabilityFunction_phase]
  simpa using D.toWeakSlopeData.lt_phase_iff_slopeOfPhase_lt hE hβ0 hβ1

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SlopeData.phase_le_iff_le_slopeOfPhase
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_lt, ← not_lt, not_iff_not]
  exact D.lt_phase_iff_slopeOfPhase_lt hE hβ0 hβ1

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.AbelianHNFiltration.map_restrictChain
statement:
theorem map_restrictChain (F : AbelianHNFiltration Z E) (k : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ F.n)
    (j : ℕ) (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    (Subobject.map (F.chain ⟨k, by lia⟩).arrow).obj (F.restrictChain k hkn j hjk) =
      F.chain ⟨j, by lia⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictChain, Subobject.map_mk]
  simp only [Subobject.ofLE_arrow, Subobject.mk_arrow]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.AbelianHNFiltration.restrictChain_le
statement:
theorem restrictChain_le (F : AbelianHNFiltration Z E) (k : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ F.n)
    {j₁ j₂ : ℕ} (hj : j₁ ≤ j₂) (hjk : j₂ ≤ k) :
    F.restrictChain k hkn j₁ (hj.trans hjk) ≤ F.restrictChain k hkn j₂ hjk
proof:
:=
  Subobject.mk_le_mk_of_comm
    (Subobject.ofLE (F.chain ⟨j₁, by lia⟩) (F.chain ⟨j₂, by lia⟩)
      (F.chain_strictMono.monotone (Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr hj)))
    (Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE _ _ _ _ _)

statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrict_n (F : AbelianHNFiltration Z E) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.AbelianHNFiltration.ofIso_phiPlus

theorem ofIso_phiPlus (F : AbelianHNFiltration Z E) {E' : A} (e : E ≅ E') :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.isZero_mem_hnTors
statement: theorem isZero_mem_hnTors {E : A} (hE : IsZero E) : E ∈ hnTors Z β
proof: := Or.inl hE

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.isZero_mem_hnFree
statement: theorem isZero_mem_hnFree {E : A} (hE : IsZero E) : E ∈ hnFree Z β
proof: := Or.inl hE

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.mem_hnTors_iff_forall
statement:
theorem mem_hnTors_iff_forall (hHN : Z.HasHNProperty) {E : A} (hE : ¬IsZero E) :
    E ∈ hnTors Z β ↔ ∀ F : AbelianHNFiltration Z E, β < F.phiMinus
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G⟩ := hHN E hE
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨F, hF⟩) K
    · exact absurd h hE
    · rwa [AbelianHNFiltration.phiMinus_eq K F]
  · exact fun h => Or.inr ⟨G, h G⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.mem_hnFree_iff_forall
statement:
theorem mem_hnFree_iff_forall (hHN : Z.HasHNProperty) {E : A} (hE : ¬IsZero E) :
    E ∈ hnFree Z β ↔ ∀ F : AbelianHNFiltration Z E, F.phiPlus ≤ β
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G⟩ := hHN E hE
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨F, hF⟩) K
    · exact absurd h hE
    · rwa [AbelianHNFiltration.phiPlus_eq K F]
  · exact fun h => Or.inr ⟨G, h G⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.isZero_of_mem_hnTors_of_mem_hnFree
statement:
theorem isZero_of_mem_hnTors_of_mem_hnFree {E : A}
    (hT : E ∈ hnTors Z β) (hF : E ∈ hnFree Z β) : IsZero E
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hE
  obtain ⟨F, hmin⟩ : ∃ F : AbelianHNFiltration Z E, β < F.phiMinus := by
    rcases hT with h0 | h; · exact absurd h0 hE
    · exact h
  obtain ⟨K, hmax⟩ : ∃ K : AbelianHNFiltration Z E, K.phiPlus ≤ β := by
    rcases hF with h0 | h; · exact absurd h0 hE
    · exact h
  have hKF : K.phiPlus = F.phiPlus := AbelianHNFiltration.phiPlus_eq K F
  have := F.phiMinus_le_phiPlus
  rw [hKF] at hmax
  linarith

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.hom_eq_zero_of_mem_hnTors_of_semistable
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hmin⟩ : ∃ F : AbelianHNFiltration Z E, β < F.phiMinus := by
    rcases hT with h0 | h; · exact absurd h0 hE
    · exact h
  exact AbelianHNFiltration.hom_eq_zero_to_semistable_of_phase_lt_phiMinus F hB
    (by linarith) f

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.StabilityFunction.hom_eq_zero_of_mem_hnTors_of_mem_hnFree
statement:
theorem hom_eq_zero_of_mem_hnTors_of_mem_hnFree (hHN : Z.HasHNProperty)
    {E B : A} (hT : E ∈ hnTors Z β) (hFr : B ∈ hnFree Z β) (f : E ⟶ B) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hE : IsZero E
  · exact hE.eq_zero_of_src f
  by_cases hI : IsZero ((imageSubobject f : A))
  · rw [← imageSubobject_arrow_comp f, hI.eq_zero_of_src (imageSubobject f).arrow,
      comp_zero]
  have hB : ¬IsZero B := by
    intro hzero
    apply hI
    rw [hzero.eq_zero_of_tgt f, imageSubobject_zero]
    simp
  obtain ⟨F, hmin⟩ : ∃ F : AbelianHNFiltration Z E, β < F.phiMinus := by
    rcases hT with h0 | h; · exact absurd h0 hE
    · exact h
  obtain ⟨G, hmax⟩ : ∃ G : AbelianHNFiltration Z B, G.phiPlus ≤ β := by
    rcases hFr with h0 | h; · exact absurd h0 hB
    · exact h
  obtain ⟨K⟩ := hHN _ hI
  have hquot : F.phiMinus ≤ K.phiMinus :=
    F.phiMinus_le_of_epi K (factorThruImageSubobject f)
  have hsub : K.phiPlus ≤ G.phiPlus :=
    K.phiPlus_le_of_mono G (imageSubobject f).arrow
  have hKrange := K.phiMinus_le_phiPlus
  exfalso
  linarith

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.chargeSlope_add_mem_uIcc
statement:
theorem chargeSlope_add_mem_uIcc {z w : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ closedUpperHalfPlane)
    (hw : w ∈ closedUpperHalfPlane) :
    min (chargeSlope z) (chargeSlope w) ≤ chargeSlope (z + w) ∧
      chargeSlope (z + w) ≤ max (chargeSlope z) (chargeSlope w)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total (chargeSlope z) (chargeSlope w) with h | h
  · obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := chargeSlope_le_add_le_of_le hz hw h
    exact ⟨by rw [min_eq_left h]; exact h₁, by rw [max_eq_right h]; exact h₂⟩
  · obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := chargeSlope_le_add_le_of_le hw hz h
    rw [add_comm] at h₁ h₂
    exact ⟨by rw [min_eq_right h]; exact h₁, by rw [max_eq_left h]; exact h₂⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.charge_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane
statement:
theorem charge_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane (E : A) :
    W.charge E ∈ closedUpperHalfPlane
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : IsZero E
  · rw [W.map_zero E h]
    exact Or.inr ⟨Complex.zero_im, le_of_eq Complex.zero_re⟩
  · exact W.charge_mem E h

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.AbelianWeakHNFiltration.charge_chain_succ
statement:
theorem charge_chain_succ (j : Fin F.n) :
    W.charge (F.chain j.succ : A) =
      W.charge (F.chain j.castSucc : A) + W.charge (F.factor j)
proof:
:=
  W.additive _ (StabilityFunction.shortExact_of_mono
    (Subobject.ofLE (F.chain j.castSucc) (F.chain j.succ)
      (le_of_lt (F.chain_strictMono j.castSucc_lt_succ))))

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.AbelianWeakHNFiltration.μ_le_slope_chain_and_le_μPlus
statement:
theorem μ_le_slope_chain_and_le_μPlus :
    ∀ k : ℕ, (hk : 0 < k) → (hkn : k ≤ F.n) →
      F.μ ⟨k - 1, by lia⟩ ≤ W.slope (F.chain ⟨k, by lia⟩ : A) ∧
        W.slope (F.chain ⟨k, by lia⟩ : A) ≤ F.μPlus
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro hk; exact absurd hk (lt_irrefl 0)
  | succ k ih =>
      intro _ hkn
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
      · 
        have h := F.μ_chain_one
        refine ⟨le_of_eq ?_, le_of_eq h⟩
        rw [h]
        rfl
      · 
        obtain ⟨ihlow, ihhigh⟩ := ih hk (by lia)
        set j : Fin F.n := ⟨k, by lia⟩ with hj
        have hcast : F.chain j.castSucc = F.chain ⟨k, by lia⟩ :=
          congrArg F.chain (Fin.ext (by simp [hj]))
        have hsucc : F.chain j.succ = F.chain ⟨k + 1, by lia⟩ :=
          congrArg F.chain (Fin.ext (by simp [hj]))
        have hadd : W.charge (F.chain ⟨k + 1, by lia⟩ : A) =
            W.charge (F.factor j) + W.charge (F.chain ⟨k, by lia⟩ : A) := by
          rw [← hsucc, F.charge_chain_succ j, hcast, add_comm]
        have hfactor : W.slope (F.factor j) = F.μ j := F.factor_slope j
        have hle : W.slope (F.factor j) ≤ W.slope (F.chain ⟨k, by lia⟩ : A) := by
          rw [hfactor]
          refine le_trans (le_of_lt (F.μ_anti (Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr ?_))) ihlow
          simp
          lia
        obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := chargeSlope_le_add_le_of_le
          (W.charge_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane (F.factor j))
          (W.charge_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane (F.chain ⟨k, by lia⟩ : A)) hle
        rw [← hadd] at h₁ h₂
        refine ⟨?_, le_trans h₂ ihhigh⟩
        rw [show (⟨k + 1 - 1, by lia⟩ : Fin F.n) = j from Fin.ext (by simp [hj]),
          ← hfactor]
        exact h₁

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.AbelianWeakHNFiltration.slope_le_μPlus
statement: theorem slope_le_μPlus : W.slope E ≤ F.μPlus
proof:
:= by
  have hn := F.nonempty
  have h := (F.μ_le_slope_chain_and_le_μPlus F.n hn le_rfl).2
  rwa [F.chain_top, W.slope_eq_of_iso (asIso (⊤ : Subobject E).arrow)] at h

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.AbelianWeakHNFiltration.μMinus_le_slope
statement: theorem μMinus_le_slope : F.μMinus ≤ W.slope E
proof:
:= by
  have hn := F.nonempty
  have h := (F.μ_le_slope_chain_and_le_μPlus F.n hn le_rfl).1
  rwa [F.chain_top, W.slope_eq_of_iso (asIso (⊤ : Subobject E).arrow)] at h

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.lt_slope_of_mem_hnTors
statement:
theorem lt_slope_of_mem_hnTors (hHN : W.HasHNProperty) {E : A} (hE : ¬IsZero E)
    (h : E ∈ hnTors W μ₀) : μ₀ < W.slope E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := hHN E hE
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le ((mem_hnTors_iff_forall hHN hE).mp h F) F.μMinus_le_slope

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.slope_le_of_mem_hnFree
statement:
theorem slope_le_of_mem_hnFree (hHN : W.HasHNProperty) {E : A} (hE : ¬IsZero E)
    (h : E ∈ hnFree W μ₀) : W.slope E ≤ μ₀
proof:
:=
  le_trans (Classical.choice (hHN E hE)).slope_le_μPlus
    ((mem_hnFree_iff_forall hHN hE).mp h _)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.chargeSlope_of_im_pos
statement:
theorem chargeSlope_of_im_pos {z : ℂ} (h : 0 < z.im) :
    chargeSlope z = ((-z.re / z.im : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)
proof:
:=
  if_pos h

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.chargeSlope_of_im_nonpos
statement: theorem chargeSlope_of_im_nonpos {z : ℂ} (h : ¬0 < z.im) : chargeSlope z = ⊤
proof:
:=
  if_neg h

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.chargeSlope_ne_top_iff
statement: theorem chargeSlope_ne_top_iff {z : ℂ} : chargeSlope z ≠ ⊤ ↔ 0 < z.im
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra him
    exact h (chargeSlope_of_im_nonpos him)
  · intro him
    rw [chargeSlope_of_im_pos him]
    exact WithTop.coe_ne_top

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.chargeSlope_lt_top_iff
statement: theorem chargeSlope_lt_top_iff {z : ℂ} : chargeSlope z < ⊤ ↔ 0 < z.im
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
  exact chargeSlope_ne_top_iff

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.im_pos_of_chargeSlope_lt
statement:
theorem im_pos_of_chargeSlope_lt {z w : ℂ} (h : chargeSlope z < chargeSlope w) :
    0 < z.im
proof:
:=
  chargeSlope_lt_top_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le h le_top)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.im_nonneg_of_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane
statement:
theorem im_nonneg_of_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ closedUpperHalfPlane) : 0 ≤ z.im
proof:
:= by
  rcases hz with h | ⟨h, _⟩
  · exact h.le
  · exact h.ge

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.re_nonpos_of_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane_of_im_eq_zero
statement:
theorem re_nonpos_of_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane_of_im_eq_zero {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ closedUpperHalfPlane) (him : z.im = 0) : z.re ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hz with h | ⟨_, h⟩
  · exact absurd him h.ne'
  · exact h

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.chargeSlope_le_add_le_of_le
statement:
theorem chargeSlope_le_add_le_of_le {z w : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ closedUpperHalfPlane)
    (hw : w ∈ closedUpperHalfPlane) (h : chargeSlope z ≤ chargeSlope w) :
    chargeSlope z ≤ chargeSlope (z + w) ∧ chargeSlope (z + w) ≤ chargeSlope w
proof:
:= by
  have him : (z + w).im = z.im + w.im := by simp
  have hre : (z + w).re = z.re + w.re := by simp
  by_cases hzim : 0 < z.im
  · by_cases hwim : 0 < w.im
    · have hsum : 0 < (z + w).im := by rw [him]; positivity
      have hcross : -z.re * w.im ≤ -w.re * z.im := by
        rw [chargeSlope_of_im_pos hzim, chargeSlope_of_im_pos hwim] at h
        have h' : -z.re / z.im ≤ -w.re / w.im := by exact_mod_cast h
        exact (div_le_div_iff₀ hzim hwim).1 h'
      rw [chargeSlope_of_im_pos hzim, chargeSlope_of_im_pos hwim,
        chargeSlope_of_im_pos hsum]
      constructor
      · exact_mod_cast (div_le_div_iff₀ hzim hsum).2 (by rw [him, hre]; nlinarith)
      · exact_mod_cast (div_le_div_iff₀ hsum hwim).2 (by rw [him, hre]; nlinarith)
    · 
      have hwim0 : w.im = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hwim)
        (im_nonneg_of_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane hw)
      have hwre : w.re ≤ 0 :=
        re_nonpos_of_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane_of_im_eq_zero hw hwim0
      have hsum : 0 < (z + w).im := by rw [him, hwim0, add_zero]; exact hzim
      rw [chargeSlope_of_im_pos hzim, chargeSlope_of_im_nonpos hwim,
        chargeSlope_of_im_pos hsum]
      refine ⟨?_, le_top⟩
      have : -z.re / z.im ≤ -(z + w).re / (z + w).im := by
        rw [him, hwim0, add_zero, hre]
        exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hzim).2 (by linarith)
      exact_mod_cast this
  · 
    have hzim0 : z.im = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hzim)
      (im_nonneg_of_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane hz)
    rw [chargeSlope_of_im_nonpos hzim] at h
    have hwtop : chargeSlope w = ⊤ := top_le_iff.mp h
    have hwim : ¬0 < w.im := by
      intro hpos
      rw [chargeSlope_of_im_pos hpos] at hwtop
      exact WithTop.coe_ne_top hwtop
    have hwim0 : w.im = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hwim)
      (im_nonneg_of_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane hw)
    have hsum : ¬0 < (z + w).im := by rw [him, hzim0, hwim0]; simp
    rw [chargeSlope_of_im_nonpos hzim, chargeSlope_of_im_nonpos hsum, hwtop]
    exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.chargeSlope_add_lt_of_lt
statement:
theorem chargeSlope_add_lt_of_lt {z w : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ closedUpperHalfPlane)
    (h : chargeSlope w < chargeSlope z) : chargeSlope (z + w) < chargeSlope z
proof:
:= by
  have him : (z + w).im = z.im + w.im := by simp
  have hre : (z + w).re = z.re + w.re := by simp
  have hwim : 0 < w.im := im_pos_of_chargeSlope_lt h
  by_cases hzim : 0 < z.im
  · have hsum : 0 < (z + w).im := by rw [him]; positivity
    have hcross : -w.re * z.im < -z.re * w.im := by
      rw [chargeSlope_of_im_pos hzim, chargeSlope_of_im_pos hwim] at h
      have h' : -w.re / w.im < -z.re / z.im := by exact_mod_cast h
      exact (div_lt_div_iff₀ hwim hzim).1 h'
    rw [chargeSlope_of_im_pos hzim, chargeSlope_of_im_pos hsum]
    exact_mod_cast (div_lt_div_iff₀ hsum hzim).2 (by rw [him, hre]; nlinarith)
  · have hzim0 : z.im = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hzim)
      (im_nonneg_of_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane hz)
    have hsum : 0 < (z + w).im := by rw [him, hzim0, zero_add]; exact hwim
    rw [chargeSlope_of_im_nonpos hzim, chargeSlope_of_im_pos hsum]
    exact WithTop.coe_lt_top _

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.charge_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem charge_apply (E : A) : W.charge E = W.Z (K₀Ab.of E)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.charge_mem
statement:
theorem charge_mem (E : A) (hE : ¬IsZero E) :
    W.charge E ∈ closedUpperHalfPlane
proof:
:=
  W.nonzero_mem E hE

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.map_zero
statement: theorem map_zero (E : A) (hE : IsZero E) : W.charge E = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [charge_apply, K₀Ab.of_isZero hE]
  exact W.Z.map_zero

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.map_iso
statement: theorem map_iso {E F : A} (e : E ≅ F) : W.charge E = W.charge F
proof:
:= by
  rw [charge_apply, charge_apply, K₀Ab.of_iso e]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.additive
statement:
theorem additive (S : ShortComplex A) (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    W.charge S.X₂ = W.charge S.X₁ + W.charge S.X₃
proof:
:= by
  rw [charge_apply, charge_apply, charge_apply, K₀Ab.of_shortExact S hS, map_add]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.slope_eq_chargeSlope
statement: theorem slope_eq_chargeSlope (E : A) : W.slope E = chargeSlope (W.charge E)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.slope_of_im_pos
statement:
theorem slope_of_im_pos {E : A} (h : 0 < (W.charge E).im) :
    W.slope E = ((-(W.charge E).re / (W.charge E).im : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)
proof:
:=
  chargeSlope_of_im_pos h

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.slope_of_im_nonpos
statement: theorem slope_of_im_nonpos {E : A} (h : ¬0 < (W.charge E).im) : W.slope E = ⊤
proof:
:=
  chargeSlope_of_im_nonpos h

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.slope_eq_top_of_charge_eq_zero
statement:
theorem slope_eq_top_of_charge_eq_zero {E : A} (h : W.charge E = 0) :
    W.slope E = ⊤
proof:
:=
  chargeSlope_of_im_nonpos (by rw [h]; simp)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.slope_eq_of_iso
statement: theorem slope_eq_of_iso {E F : A} (e : E ≅ F) : W.slope E = W.slope F
proof:
:= by
  rw [slope_eq_chargeSlope, slope_eq_chargeSlope, W.map_iso e]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.IsStable.isSemistable
statement: theorem IsStable.isSemistable {E : A} (h : W.IsStable E) : W.IsSemistable E
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h.1, fun B hB => ?_⟩
  by_cases htop : B = ⊤
  · subst htop
    exact le_of_eq (W.slope_eq_of_iso (asIso (⊤ : Subobject E).arrow))
  · exact (h.2 B hB htop).le

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.isSemistable_of_iso
statement:
theorem isSemistable_of_iso {E F : A} (e : E ≅ F) (h : W.IsSemistable E) :
    W.IsSemistable F
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hF => h.1 (hF.of_iso e), fun B hB => ?_⟩
  let B' : Subobject E := Subobject.mk (B.arrow ≫ e.inv)
  have hB' : ¬IsZero (B' : A) := fun hzero =>
    hB (hzero.of_iso (Subobject.underlyingIso (B.arrow ≫ e.inv)).symm)
  have hle := h.2 B' hB'
  rw [W.slope_eq_of_iso (Subobject.underlyingIso (B.arrow ≫ e.inv))] at hle
  rwa [W.slope_eq_of_iso e] at hle

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.isSemistable_iff_of_iso
statement:
theorem isSemistable_iff_of_iso {E F : A} (e : E ≅ F) :
    W.IsSemistable E ↔ W.IsSemistable F
proof:
:=
  ⟨W.isSemistable_of_iso e, W.isSemistable_of_iso e.symm⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.slope_le_of_epi
statement:
theorem slope_le_of_epi {E Q : A} (p : E ⟶ Q) [Epi p] (hE : W.IsSemistable E)
    (hQ : ¬IsZero Q) : W.slope E ≤ W.slope Q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hker : IsZero (kernel p)
  · haveI : Mono p := Preadditive.mono_of_kernel_zero
      (zero_of_source_iso_zero _ hker.isoZero)
    haveI : IsIso p := isIso_of_mono_of_epi p
    exact le_of_eq (W.slope_eq_of_iso (asIso p))
  have hkerle : W.slope (kernel p) ≤ W.slope E := by
    calc W.slope (kernel p)
        = W.slope (kernelSubobject p : A) :=
          W.slope_eq_of_iso (kernelSubobjectIso p).symm
      _ ≤ W.slope E := hE.2 _ fun hzero =>
          hker (hzero.of_iso (kernelSubobjectIso p).symm)
  have hshort : (ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι p) p (kernel.condition p)).ShortExact :=
    ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (ShortComplex.exact_kernel p) inferInstance inferInstance
  have hsum : W.charge E = W.charge (kernel p) + W.charge Q := W.additive _ hshort
  have hkmem := W.charge_mem (kernel p) hker
  have hqmem := W.charge_mem Q hQ
  rcases le_total (W.slope (kernel p)) (W.slope Q) with hle | hle
  · 
    have := (chargeSlope_le_add_le_of_le hkmem hqmem hle).2
    rwa [← hsum] at this
  · 
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hle with heq | hlt
    · have := (chargeSlope_le_add_le_of_le hqmem hkmem (le_of_eq heq)).2
      rw [add_comm, ← hsum] at this
      exact heq ▸ this
    · exfalso
      have hstrict := chargeSlope_add_lt_of_lt hkmem hlt
      rw [← hsum] at hstrict
      exact absurd hkerle (not_le.mpr hstrict)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.hom_eq_zero_of_semistable_slope_gt
statement:
theorem hom_eq_zero_of_semistable_slope_gt {E F : A} (hE : W.IsSemistable E)
    (hF : W.IsSemistable F) (hslope : W.slope F < W.slope E) (f : E ⟶ F) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hf
  have himage : ¬IsZero (image f) := by
    intro hzero
    apply hf
    have hι : image.ι f = 0 := zero_of_source_iso_zero _ hzero.isoZero
    rw [← image.fac f, hι, comp_zero]
  have hsource := W.slope_le_of_epi (factorThruImage f) hE himage
  have htarget : W.slope (image f) ≤ W.slope F := by
    calc W.slope (image f)
        = W.slope (imageSubobject f : A) :=
          W.slope_eq_of_iso (imageSubobjectIso f).symm
      _ ≤ W.slope F := hF.2 _ fun hzero =>
          himage (hzero.of_iso (imageSubobjectIso f).symm)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hsource.trans htarget)) hslope

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.SameSlopeOrder.lt_iff
statement:
theorem lt_iff (h : SameSlopeOrder D E) (X Y : A) :
    D.topSlope X < D.topSlope Y ↔ E.topSlope X < E.topSlope Y
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [lt_iff_not_ge] using
    not_congr (WeakSlopeData.SameSlopeOrder.le_iff h Y X)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.SameSlopeOrder.isSemistable_iff
statement:
theorem isSemistable_iff (h : SameSlopeOrder D E) (X : A) :
    D.toWeakStabilityFunction.IsSemistable X ↔
      E.toWeakStabilityFunction.IsSemistable X
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hX, hs⟩
    exact ⟨hX, fun B hB =>
      (WeakSlopeData.SameSlopeOrder.le_iff h (B : A) X).mp (hs B hB)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hX, hs⟩
    exact ⟨hX, fun B hB =>
      (WeakSlopeData.SameSlopeOrder.le_iff h (B : A) X).mpr (hs B hB)⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.SameSlopeOrder.hasHNProperty
statement:
theorem hasHNProperty (h : WeakSlopeData.SameSlopeOrder D E)
    (hD : D.toWeakStabilityFunction.HasHNProperty) :
    E.toWeakStabilityFunction.HasHNProperty
proof:
:= by
  intro X hX
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := hD X hX
  exact ⟨F.changeSlopeOrder h⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.rank_eq_zero_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem rank_eq_zero_of_shortExact {S : ShortComplex A} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h : D.rank S.X₂ = 0) : D.rank S.X₁ = 0 ∧ D.rank S.X₃ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hadd := D.rank_additive S hS
  have h1 : 0 ≤ D.rank S.X₁ := D.rank_nonneg S.X₁
  have h3 : 0 ≤ D.rank S.X₃ := D.rank_nonneg S.X₃
  omega

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.topSlope_eq_top_iff_rank_eq_zero
statement:
theorem topSlope_eq_top_iff_rank_eq_zero {E : A} :
    D.topSlope E = ⊤ ↔ D.rank E = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, D.topSlope_of_rank_zero⟩
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (D.rank_nonneg E) with hpos | hzero
  · rw [D.topSlope_of_rank_pos hpos] at h
    exact absurd h WithTop.coe_ne_top
  · exact hzero.symm

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.topSlope_ne_top_iff_rank_pos
statement:
theorem topSlope_ne_top_iff_rank_pos {E : A} :
    D.topSlope E ≠ ⊤ ↔ 0 < D.rank E
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, topSlope_eq_top_iff_rank_eq_zero]
  exact ⟨fun h => lt_of_le_of_ne (D.rank_nonneg E) (Ne.symm h), fun h => ne_of_gt h⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.topSlope_le_topSlope_iff_slope_le
statement:
theorem topSlope_le_topSlope_iff_slope_le {E F : A} (hE : 0 < D.rank E)
    (hF : 0 < D.rank F) : D.topSlope E ≤ D.topSlope F ↔ D.slope E ≤ D.slope F
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.topSlope_of_rank_pos hE, D.topSlope_of_rank_pos hF]
  exact WithTop.coe_le_coe

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.phase_le_iff_topSlope_le
statement:
theorem phase_le_iff_topSlope_le {E F : A} (hE : 0 < D.rank E) (hF : 0 < D.rank F) :
    D.phase E ≤ D.phase F ↔ D.topSlope E ≤ D.topSlope F
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.topSlope_le_topSlope_iff_slope_le hE hF]
  exact D.phase_le_iff_slope_le hE hF

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.topSlope_lt_topSlope_of_rank_pos_of_rank_zero
statement:
theorem topSlope_lt_topSlope_of_rank_pos_of_rank_zero {E F : A}
    (hE : 0 < D.rank E) (hF : D.rank F = 0) : D.topSlope E < D.topSlope F
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.topSlope_of_rank_pos hE, D.topSlope_of_rank_zero hF]
  exact WithTop.coe_lt_top _

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.μMinus_eq_top_of_rank_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hn := F.nonempty
  set last : Fin F.n := ⟨F.n - 1, by lia⟩ with hlastdef
  have hlast : F.chain last.succ = ⊤ := by
    have hindex : last.succ = ⟨F.n, by lia⟩ := Fin.ext (by simp [hlastdef]; lia)
    rw [hindex, F.chain_top]
  set i := Subobject.ofLE (F.chain last.castSucc) (F.chain last.succ)
    (le_of_lt (F.chain_strictMono last.castSucc_lt_succ)) with hidef
  have hSE := StabilityFunction.shortExact_of_mono i
  have hmid : D.rank ((F.chain last.succ : Subobject E) : A) = 0 := by
    rw [hlast, D.rank_iso (asIso (⊤ : Subobject E).arrow)]
    exact h
  have hfactor : D.rank (cokernel i) = 0 :=
    (D.rank_eq_zero_of_shortExact hSE hmid).2
  rw [AbelianWeakHNFiltration.μMinus, ← F.factor_slope last]
  exact D.topSlope_of_rank_zero hfactor

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.mem_hnTors_of_rank_zero
statement:
theorem mem_hnTors_of_rank_zero
    (hHN : D.toWeakStabilityFunction.HasHNProperty) {μ₀ : WithTop ℝ} (hμ : μ₀ ≠ ⊤)
    {E : A} (hE : ¬IsZero E) (h : D.rank E = 0) :
    E ∈ WeakStabilityFunctionOn.hnTors D.toWeakStabilityFunction μ₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := hHN E hE
  refine Or.inr ⟨F, ?_⟩
  rw [D.μMinus_eq_top_of_rank_zero F h]
  exact Ne.lt_top hμ

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.SlopeData.toWeakSlopeData_topSlope_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem toWeakSlopeData_topSlope_eq_top_iff {E : A} :
    D.toWeakSlopeData.topSlope E = ⊤ ↔ D.rank E = 0
proof:
:=
  D.toWeakSlopeData.topSlope_eq_top_iff_rank_eq_zero

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.AbelianWeakHNFiltration.μ_mem_range
statement:
theorem μ_mem_range (F : AbelianWeakHNFiltration W E) (i : Fin F.n) :
    F.μMinus ≤ F.μ i ∧ F.μ i ≤ F.μPlus
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact F.μ_anti.antitone (Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr (by lia))
  · exact F.μ_anti.antitone (Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr (by lia))

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.AbelianWeakHNFiltration.μMinus_le_μPlus
statement:
theorem μMinus_le_μPlus (F : AbelianWeakHNFiltration W E) :
    F.μMinus ≤ F.μPlus
proof:
:=
  (F.μ_mem_range ⟨0, F.nonempty⟩).1

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.AbelianWeakHNFiltration.factor_not_isZero
statement:
theorem factor_not_isZero (F : AbelianWeakHNFiltration W E) (j : Fin F.n) :
    ¬IsZero (F.factor j)
proof:
:= fun hzero => by
  let f := Subobject.ofLE (F.chain j.castSucc) (F.chain j.succ)
    (le_of_lt (F.chain_strictMono j.castSucc_lt_succ))
  haveI : Epi f := Preadditive.epi_of_isZero_cokernel f hzero
  haveI : IsIso f := isIso_of_mono_of_epi f
  have hle : F.chain j.succ ≤ F.chain j.castSucc :=
    Subobject.le_of_comm (inv f) (by simp [f])
  exact (not_le_of_gt (F.chain_strictMono j.castSucc_lt_succ)) hle

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.AbelianWeakHNFiltration.ofSemistable_μPlus

theorem ofSemistable_μPlus {E : A} (hE : W.IsSemistable E) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.AbelianWeakHNFiltration.ofSemistable_μMinus

theorem ofSemistable_μMinus {E : A} (hE : W.IsSemistable E) :

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.slope_cokernel_ofLE_congr
statement:
theorem slope_cokernel_ofLE_congr {E : A} {A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ : Subobject E}
    (hA : A₁ = A₂) (hB : B₁ = B₂) {h₁ : A₁ ≤ B₁} {h₂ : A₂ ≤ B₂} :
    W.slope (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE A₁ B₁ h₁)) =
      W.slope (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE A₂ B₂ h₂))
proof:
:= by
  subst A₂
  subst B₂
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.isSemistable_cokernel_ofLE_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst A₂

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.slope_cokernel_mapMono_eq
statement:
theorem slope_cokernel_mapMono_eq {X Y : A} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Mono f]
    {S T : Subobject X} (h : S ≤ T) :
    W.slope (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE ((Subobject.map f).obj S)
      ((Subobject.map f).obj T) ((Subobject.map f).monotone h))) =
      W.slope (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE S T h))
proof:
:=
  W.slope_eq_of_iso (StabilityFunction.Subobject.cokernelMapMonoIso f h)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.isSemistable_cokernel_mapMono_iff
statement:
theorem isSemistable_cokernel_mapMono_iff {X Y : A} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Mono f]
    {S T : Subobject X} (h : S ≤ T) :
    W.IsSemistable (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE ((Subobject.map f).obj S)
      ((Subobject.map f).obj T) ((Subobject.map f).monotone h))) ↔
      W.IsSemistable (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE S T h))
proof:
:=
  ⟨W.isSemistable_of_iso (StabilityFunction.Subobject.cokernelMapMonoIso f h),
   W.isSemistable_of_iso (StabilityFunction.Subobject.cokernelMapMonoIso f h).symm⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.exists_subobject_hnTors_cokernel_hnFree
statement:
theorem exists_subobject_hnTors_cokernel_hnFree (hHN : W.HasHNProperty) (E : A) :
    ∃ T : Subobject E,
      ((T : A) ∈ hnTors W μ₀) ∧ (cokernel T.arrow ∈ hnFree W μ₀)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hE : IsZero E
  · exact ⟨⊥,
      Or.inl ((StabilityFunction.subobject_isZero_iff_eq_bot (⊥ : Subobject E)).2 rfl),
      Or.inl (IsZero.of_epi_eq_zero (cokernel.π (⊥ : Subobject E).arrow)
        (hE.eq_zero_of_src _))⟩
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := hHN E hE
  obtain ⟨k, hkn, hlow, hhigh⟩ := F.exists_crossIndex μ₀
  refine ⟨F.chain ⟨k, by lia⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
    · exact Or.inl ((StabilityFunction.subobject_isZero_iff_eq_bot _).2 F.chain_bot)
    · refine Or.inr ⟨F.restrict k hk hkn, ?_⟩
      rw [F.restrict_μMinus k hk hkn]
      exact hlow ⟨k - 1, by lia⟩ (by lia)
  · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hkn with rfl | hklt
    · refine Or.inl ?_
      haveI : Epi (F.chain ⟨F.n, by lia⟩).arrow := by
        rw [show F.chain ⟨F.n, by lia⟩ = ⊤ from F.chain_top]
        infer_instance
      exact isZero_cokernel_of_epi _
    · refine Or.inr ⟨F.tailAt k hklt, ?_⟩
      rw [F.tailAt_μPlus k hklt]
      exact hhigh ⟨k, hklt⟩ le_rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityFunctionOn.exists_shortExact_hnTors_hnFree
statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_hnTors_hnFree (hHN : W.HasHNProperty) (E : A) :
    ∃ (T Q : A) (i : T ⟶ E) (p : E ⟶ Q) (w : i ≫ p = 0),
      T ∈ hnTors W μ₀ ∧ Q ∈ hnFree W μ₀ ∧ (ShortComplex.mk i p w).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hQ⟩ :=
    exists_subobject_hnTors_cokernel_hnFree (μ₀ := μ₀) hHN E
  exact ⟨(T : A), cokernel T.arrow, T.arrow, cokernel.π T.arrow,
    cokernel.condition _, hT, hQ, StabilityFunction.shortExact_of_mono T.arrow⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.rank_zero

statement: theorem rank_iso {E F : A} (e : E ≅ F) : D.rank E = D.rank F

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.charge_re
statement: @[simp] theorem charge_re (E : A) : (D.charge E).re = -(D.degree E : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.charge_im
statement: @[simp] theorem charge_im (E : A) : (D.charge E).im = (D.rank E : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.charge_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane
statement:
theorem charge_mem_closedUpperHalfPlane {E : A} (hE : ¬IsZero E) :
    D.charge E ∈ closedUpperHalfPlane
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (D.rank_nonneg E) with hpos | hzero
  · left
    simpa using (by exact_mod_cast hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (D.rank E : ℝ))
  · right
    refine ⟨by simpa using (by exact_mod_cast hzero.symm : ((D.rank E : ℤ) : ℝ) = 0), ?_⟩
    have hdeg : 0 ≤ D.degree E := D.degree_nonneg_of_rank_zero E hE hzero.symm
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (D.degree E : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdeg
    simpa using this

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.toWeakStabilityFunction_Z
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toWeakStabilityFunction_Z (E : A) :
    D.toWeakStabilityFunction.Z (K₀Ab.of E) = D.charge E
proof:
:= by

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.phase_eq_arg_div_pi
statement:
theorem phase_eq_arg_div_pi (E : A) :
    D.phase E = arg (D.toWeakStabilityFunction.Z (K₀Ab.of E)) / Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  rw [phase, toWeakStabilityFunction_Z]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.phaseCross_charge
statement:
theorem phaseCross_charge (E F : A) :
    phaseCross (D.charge E) (D.charge F)
      = (D.rank E : ℝ) * (D.degree F : ℝ) - (D.degree E : ℝ) * (D.rank F : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [phaseCross, charge_re, charge_im]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.charge_ne_zero_of_rank_pos
statement: theorem charge_ne_zero_of_rank_pos {E : A} (hE : 0 < D.rank E) : D.charge E ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have him : (D.charge E).im = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
  rw [charge_im] at him
  have : (0 : ℝ) < (D.rank E : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hE
  linarith

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.arg_pos_of_rank_pos
statement: theorem arg_pos_of_rank_pos {E : A} (hE : 0 < D.rank E) : 0 < arg (D.charge E)
proof:
:= by
  refine arg_pos_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane ?_
  left
  have : (0 : ℝ) < (D.rank E : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hE
  simpa using this

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.phase_le_iff_slope_le
statement:
theorem phase_le_iff_slope_le {E F : A} (hE : 0 < D.rank E) (hF : 0 < D.rank F) :
    D.phase E ≤ D.phase F ↔ D.slope E ≤ D.slope F
proof:
:= by
  have hEr : (0 : ℝ) < (D.rank E : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hE
  have hFr : (0 : ℝ) < (D.rank F : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hF
  have hcross : 0 ≤ phaseCross (D.charge E) (D.charge F) ↔ D.slope E ≤ D.slope F := by
    rw [phaseCross_charge, slope, slope, div_le_div_iff₀ hEr hFr]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
  have harg : arg (D.charge E) ≤ arg (D.charge F) ↔ D.slope E ≤ D.slope F := by
    refine ⟨fun h => hcross.mp ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · refine phaseCross_nonneg_of_arg_le ?_ (D.charge_ne_zero_of_rank_pos hE)
        (D.charge_ne_zero_of_rank_pos hF) h
      simpa using hEr.le
    · exact arg_le_of_phaseCross_nonneg (D.charge_ne_zero_of_rank_pos hE)
        (D.charge_ne_zero_of_rank_pos hF) (D.arg_pos_of_rank_pos hF) (hcross.mpr h)
  have hpi : (0 : ℝ) < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  rw [phase, phase]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine harg.mp ?_
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hpi.le
    rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hpi), div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hpi)] at hmul
  · intro h
    have hle := harg.mpr h
    gcongr

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakSlopeData.congrFiltration_n
statement:
@[simp]
theorem congrFiltration_n {Z : A}
    (G : AbelianWeakHNFiltration D.toWeakStabilityFunction Z) :
