name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.ChernCharacterSurface.discriminantDegree_eq_numericalVariety
statement:
theorem discriminantDegree_eq_numericalVariety
    {D : FiniteCohomology k X} {C : D.LinearConnectingSystem}
    (I : IntersectionContext D C 2) {F : Coh X}
    (P : Coh.TwoTermPerfectDeterminantData F)
    {A : Type v} {N : Type w} [CommRing A] [Algebra ℚ A]
    [AddCommGroup N] (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N) (E : N)
    (hrank : V.rank E = virtualRank P)
    (hc₁ : V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.chComp E 1) =
      (I.surfaceIntersectionPairing (picardFirstChernClass P)
        (picardFirstChernClass P) : ℤ))
    (hch₂ : V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2) =
      chernCharacterTwoDegree I P) :
    discriminantDegree I P = V.ring.degree (V.discriminant E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [V.degree_discriminant, hrank, hc₁, hch₂]
  simp only [discriminantDegree]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.picardMixedDifference_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem picardMixedDifference_nil (f : Pic X → ℤ) :
    picardMixedDifference [] f = f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.picardMixedDifference_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem picardMixedDifference_cons (L : Pic X)
    (classes : List (Pic X)) (f : Pic X → ℤ) :
    picardMixedDifference (L :: classes) f =
      picardDifference L (picardMixedDifference classes f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.picardDifference_comm
statement:
theorem picardDifference_comm (L M : Pic X) (f : Pic X → ℤ) :
    picardDifference L (picardDifference M f) =
      picardDifference M (picardDifference L f)
proof:
:= by
  funext N
  simp only [picardDifference]
  have harg : N * L * M = N * M * L := by ac_rfl
  rw [harg]
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.picardMixedDifference_eq_of_perm
statement:
theorem picardMixedDifference_eq_of_perm
    {classes classes' : List (Pic X)} (h : classes.Perm classes')
    (f : Pic X → ℤ) :
    picardMixedDifference classes f = picardMixedDifference classes' f
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons L _ ih => simpa only [picardMixedDifference_cons] using congrArg (picardDifference L) ih
  | swap L M classes =>
      simp only [picardMixedDifference_cons]
      exact (picardDifference_comm L M (picardMixedDifference classes f)).symm
  | trans _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.picardCoefficient_eq_of_perm
statement:
theorem picardCoefficient_eq_of_perm
    {classes classes' : List (Pic X)} (h : classes.Perm classes')
    (f : Pic X → ℤ) :
    picardCoefficient classes f = picardCoefficient classes' f
proof:
:= by
  rw [picardCoefficient, picardCoefficient, picardMixedDifference_eq_of_perm h f]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.picardDifference_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem picardDifference_one (f : Pic X → ℤ) : picardDifference 1 f = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext L
  simp [picardDifference]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.picardDifference_mul_direction
statement:
theorem picardDifference_mul_direction (L M : Pic X)
    (f : Pic X → ℤ) :
    picardDifference (L * M) f =
      picardDifference L f + picardDifference M f +
        picardDifference L (picardDifference M f)
proof:
:= by
  funext N
  simp only [picardDifference, Pi.add_apply, mul_assoc]
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.picardCoefficient_cons_mul
statement:
theorem picardCoefficient_cons_mul (classes : List (Pic X))
    (L M : Pic X) (f : Pic X → ℤ)
    (hf : PicardDegreeLE (classes.length + 1) f) :
    picardCoefficient ((L * M) :: classes) f =
      picardCoefficient (L :: classes) f + picardCoefficient (M :: classes) f
proof:
:= by
  have hcorrection :
      picardCoefficient (L :: M :: classes) f = 0 := by
    apply hf
    simp [Nat.add_assoc]
  change picardDifference (L * M) (picardMixedDifference classes f) 1 = _
  rw [picardDifference_mul_direction]
  change picardCoefficient (L :: classes) f + picardCoefficient (M :: classes) f +
      picardCoefficient (L :: M :: classes) f = _
  rw [hcorrection, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.picardCoefficient_middle_mul
statement:
theorem picardCoefficient_middle_mul (before after : List (Pic X))
    (L M : Pic X) (f : Pic X → ℤ)
    (hf : PicardDegreeLE (before.length + after.length + 1) f) :
    picardCoefficient (before ++ (L * M) :: after) f =
      picardCoefficient (before ++ L :: after) f +
        picardCoefficient (before ++ M :: after) f
proof:
:= by
  calc
    picardCoefficient (before ++ (L * M) :: after) f =
        picardCoefficient ((L * M) :: (before ++ after)) f :=
      picardCoefficient_eq_of_perm List.perm_middle f
    _ = picardCoefficient (L :: (before ++ after)) f +
        picardCoefficient (M :: (before ++ after)) f := by
      apply picardCoefficient_cons_mul
      simpa [List.length_append, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using hf
    _ = picardCoefficient (before ++ L :: after) f +
        picardCoefficient (before ++ M :: after) f := by
      rw [picardCoefficient_eq_of_perm List.perm_middle.symm f,
        picardCoefficient_eq_of_perm List.perm_middle.symm f]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.picardCoefficientAddHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem picardCoefficientAddHom_apply (before after : List (Pic X))
    (f : Pic X → ℤ)
    (hf : PicardDegreeLE (before.length + after.length + 1) f)
    (L : Additive (Pic X)) :
    picardCoefficientAddHom before after f hf L =
      picardCoefficient (before ++ L.toMul :: after) f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.picardCoefficient_middle_zpow
statement:
theorem picardCoefficient_middle_zpow (before after : List (Pic X))
    (L : Pic X) (m : ℤ) (f : Pic X → ℤ)
    (hf : PicardDegreeLE (before.length + after.length + 1) f) :
    picardCoefficient (before ++ (L ^ m) :: after) f =
      m * picardCoefficient (before ++ L :: after) f
proof:
:= by
  have h := (picardCoefficientAddHom before after f hf).map_zsmul m (Additive.ofMul L)
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.picardMonomial_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem picardMonomial_zero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (L : ι → Pic X) : picardMonomial L 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [picardMonomial]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.picardMonomial_add
statement:
theorem picardMonomial_add {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (L : ι → Pic X) (m n : NumericalPolynomial.Lattice ι) :
    picardMonomial L (m + n) = picardMonomial L m * picardMonomial L n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [picardMonomial, Pi.add_apply, zpow_add]
  exact Finset.prod_mul_distrib

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.mixedDifference_picardPolynomial
statement:
theorem mixedDifference_picardPolynomial {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (f : Pic X → ℤ) (L : ι → Pic X)
    (directions : List (NumericalPolynomial.Lattice ι))
    (n : NumericalPolynomial.Lattice ι) :
    mixedDifference directions (picardPolynomial f L) n =
      picardMixedDifference (directions.map (picardMonomial L)) f
        (picardMonomial L n)
proof:
:= by
  induction directions generalizing n with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v directions ih =>
      simp only [mixedDifference_cons, difference_apply, List.map_cons,
        picardMixedDifference_cons, picardDifference]
      rw [ih (n + v), ih n, picardMonomial_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.picardMonomial_coordinateDirection
statement:
@[simp]
theorem picardMonomial_coordinateDirection {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (L : ι → Pic X) (i : ι) :
    picardMonomial L (coordinateDirection i) = L i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold picardMonomial coordinateDirection
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single i]
  · simp
  · intro j _ hji
    simp [hji]
  · simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.topCoefficient_picardPolynomial
statement:
theorem topCoefficient_picardPolynomial {d : ℕ}
    (f : Pic X → ℤ) (L : Fin d → Pic X) :
    topCoefficient (fun i : Fin d ↦ coordinateDirection i) (picardPolynomial f L) =
      picardCoefficient (List.ofFn L) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [topCoefficient, coefficient, mixedDifference_picardPolynomial, picardCoefficient]
  rw [picardMonomial_zero]
  rw [List.map_ofFn]
  have hdirections :
      (picardMonomial L ∘ fun i : Fin d ↦ coordinateDirection i) = L := by
    funext i
    exact picardMonomial_coordinateDirection L i
  rw [hdirections]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.TwistContext.eulerFunction_eq_picardPolynomial
statement:
theorem eulerFunction_eq_picardPolynomial (P : TwistContext D F d)
    (r : ℕ) (L : Fin r → Pic X) :
    eulerFunction D (P.twistFamily r L) = picardPolynomial P.eulerPic L
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  exact (P.realization r L n).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.TwistContext.picardDegreeLE
statement:
theorem picardDegreeLE (P : TwistContext D F d) (C : D.LinearConnectingSystem) :
    PicardDegreeLE d P.eulerPic
proof:
:= by
  intro classes hlength
  let L : Fin (d + 1) → Pic X :=
    fun i ↦ classes.get (Fin.cast hlength.symm i)
  have hs : DegreeLE d (picardPolynomial P.eulerPic L) := by
    rw [← P.eulerFunction_eq_picardPolynomial (d + 1) L]
    exact snapper D C (P.twistFamily (d + 1) L) d
      (P.geometricInduction (d + 1) L)
  have hzero := congrFun
    (hs (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (d + 1) ↦ coordinateDirection i)) (by simp)) 0
  have hcoefficient : picardCoefficient (List.ofFn L) P.eulerPic = 0 := by
    rw [← topCoefficient_picardPolynomial]
    exact hzero
  rw [← List.ofFn_get classes]
  rw [List.ofFn_congr hlength]
  exact hcoefficient

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.picardDegreeLE
statement:
theorem picardDegreeLE (P : IntersectionContext D C d) :
    PicardDegreeLE d P.eulerPic
proof:
:=
  P.twists.picardDegreeLE C

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.picardIntersectionNumber_eq_coefficient
statement:
theorem picardIntersectionNumber_eq_coefficient (P : IntersectionContext D C d)
    (L : Fin d → Pic X) :
    P.picardIntersectionNumber L = picardCoefficient (List.ofFn L) P.eulerPic
proof:
:= by
  rw [picardIntersectionNumber, P.twists.eulerFunction_eq_picardPolynomial]
  exact topCoefficient_picardPolynomial P.eulerPic L

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.picardIntersectionList_ofFn
statement:
@[simp]
theorem picardIntersectionList_ofFn (P : IntersectionContext D C d)
    (L : Fin d → Pic X) :
    P.picardIntersectionList (List.ofFn L) = P.picardIntersectionNumber L
proof:
:= by
  rw [picardIntersectionNumber_eq_coefficient]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.picardIntersectionNumber_congr
statement:
theorem picardIntersectionNumber_congr (P : IntersectionContext D C d)
    {L M : Fin d → Pic X} (h : ∀ i, L i = M i) :
    P.picardIntersectionNumber L = P.picardIntersectionNumber M
proof:
:= by
  have hLM : L = M := funext h
  subst M
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.picardIntersectionNumber_comp_perm
statement:
theorem picardIntersectionNumber_comp_perm (P : IntersectionContext D C d)
    (L : Fin d → Pic X) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) :
    P.picardIntersectionNumber (L ∘ σ) = P.picardIntersectionNumber L
proof:
:= by
  rw [picardIntersectionNumber_eq_coefficient, picardIntersectionNumber_eq_coefficient]
  exact picardCoefficient_eq_of_perm (σ.ofFn_comp_perm L) P.eulerPic

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.picardIntersectionList_eq_of_perm
statement:
theorem picardIntersectionList_eq_of_perm (P : IntersectionContext D C d)
    {classes classes' : List (Pic X)} (h : classes.Perm classes') :
    P.picardIntersectionList classes = P.picardIntersectionList classes'
proof:
:=
  picardCoefficient_eq_of_perm h P.eulerPic

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.picardIntersectionList_middle_mul
statement:
theorem picardIntersectionList_middle_mul (P : IntersectionContext D C d)
    (before after : List (Pic X)) (L M : Pic X)
    (hlength : before.length + after.length + 1 = d) :
    P.picardIntersectionList (before ++ (L * M) :: after) =
      P.picardIntersectionList (before ++ L :: after) +
        P.picardIntersectionList (before ++ M :: after)
proof:
:= by
  apply picardCoefficient_middle_mul
  simpa [hlength] using P.picardDegreeLE

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.picardIntersectionList_middle_zpow
statement:
theorem picardIntersectionList_middle_zpow (P : IntersectionContext D C d)
    (before after : List (Pic X)) (L : Pic X) (m : ℤ)
    (hlength : before.length + after.length + 1 = d) :
    P.picardIntersectionList (before ++ (L ^ m) :: after) =
      m * P.picardIntersectionList (before ++ L :: after)
proof:
:= by
  apply picardCoefficient_middle_zpow
  simpa [hlength] using P.picardDegreeLE

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.picardIntersectionList_middle_one
statement:
theorem picardIntersectionList_middle_one (P : IntersectionContext D C d)
    (before after : List (Pic X)) :
    P.picardIntersectionList (before ++ (1 : Pic X) :: after) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold picardIntersectionList
  rw [picardCoefficient_eq_of_perm List.perm_middle P.eulerPic]
  simp [picardCoefficient]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber_eq_picard
statement:
theorem cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber_eq_picard (P : IntersectionContext D C d)
    (divisors : Fin d → CartierDivisor X) :
    P.cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber divisors =
      P.picardIntersectionNumber fun i ↦ CartierDivisor.toPic (divisors i)
proof:
:= by
  apply P.picardIntersectionNumber_congr
  intro i
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber_eq_of_principalEquivalent
statement:
theorem cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber_eq_of_principalEquivalent
    (P : IntersectionContext D C d) {divisors divisors' : Fin d → CartierDivisor X}
    (h : ∀ i, CartierDivisor.toClass X (divisors i) =
      CartierDivisor.toClass X (divisors' i)) :
    P.cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber divisors =
      P.cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber divisors'
proof:
:= by
  unfold cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber cartierClassIntersectionNumber
  apply P.picardIntersectionNumber_congr
  intro i
  dsimp
  rw [h i]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber_add_principal
statement:
theorem cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber_add_principal
    (P : IntersectionContext D C d) (divisors : Fin d → CartierDivisor X)
    (f : Fin d → Additive X.functionFieldˣ) :
    P.cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber
        (fun i ↦ divisors i + CartierDivisor.principal X (f i)) =
      P.cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber divisors
proof:
:= by
  apply P.cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber_eq_of_principalEquivalent
  intro i
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber_comp_perm
statement:
theorem cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber_comp_perm
    (P : IntersectionContext D C d) (divisors : Fin d → CartierDivisor X)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) :
    P.cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber (divisors ∘ σ) =
      P.cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber divisors
proof:
:= by
  rw [cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber_eq_picard,
    cartierDivisorIntersectionNumber_eq_picard]
  exact P.picardIntersectionNumber_comp_perm
    (fun i ↦ CartierDivisor.toPic (divisors i)) σ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.point_normalization
statement:
theorem point_normalization (P : IntersectionContext D C 0)
    (L : Fin 0 → Pic X) :
    P.picardIntersectionNumber L = P.eulerPic 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [picardIntersectionNumber_eq_coefficient]
  simp [picardCoefficient]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.curve_intersection_eq
statement:
theorem curve_intersection_eq (P : IntersectionContext D C 1)
    (L : Pic X) :
    P.picardIntersectionNumber (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ L) = P.eulerPic L - P.eulerPic 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [picardIntersectionNumber_eq_coefficient]
  simp [picardCoefficient, picardMixedDifference, picardDifference]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.picardIntersectionNumber_fin2
statement:
theorem picardIntersectionNumber_fin2 (P : IntersectionContext D C 2)
    (L M : Pic X) :
    P.picardIntersectionNumber ![L, M] = P.surfaceIntersectionNumber L M
proof:
:= by
  rw [picardIntersectionNumber_eq_coefficient]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.surfaceIntersectionNumber_eq
statement:
theorem surfaceIntersectionNumber_eq (P : IntersectionContext D C 2)
    (L M : Pic X) :
    P.surfaceIntersectionNumber L M =
      P.eulerPic (L * M) - P.eulerPic L - P.eulerPic M + P.eulerPic 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [surfaceIntersectionNumber, picardCoefficient, picardMixedDifference,
    picardDifference, mul_comm]
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.surfaceIntersectionPairing_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem surfaceIntersectionPairing_apply (P : IntersectionContext D C 2)
    (L M : Pic X) :
    P.surfaceIntersectionPairing (Additive.ofMul L) (Additive.ofMul M) =
      P.surfaceIntersectionNumber L M
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectionTheory.Number.IntersectionContext.surfaceIntersectionPairing_symm
statement:
theorem surfaceIntersectionPairing_symm (P : IntersectionContext D C 2)
    (L M : Pic X) :
    P.surfaceIntersectionPairing (Additive.ofMul L) (Additive.ofMul M) =
      P.surfaceIntersectionPairing (Additive.ofMul M) (Additive.ofMul L)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [surfaceIntersectionPairing_apply, surfaceIntersectionNumber]
  exact picardCoefficient_eq_of_perm (List.Perm.swap L M []).symm P.eulerPic

name: AlgebraicGeometry.EnriquesSurface.IsotropicCollection.isIsotropicSequence
statement:
theorem isIsotropicSequence :
    IntegralLattice.IsIsotropicSequence T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing T.classes
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i
    change T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing
      (Additive.ofMul (T.bundles i).toPic) (Additive.ofMul (T.bundles i).toPic) = 0
    rw [IntersectionContext.surfaceIntersectionPairing_apply,
      ← IntersectionContext.picardIntersectionNumber_fin2]
    exact T.self_isotropic i
  · intro i j hij
    change T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing
      (Additive.ofMul (T.bundles i).toPic) (Additive.ofMul (T.bundles j).toPic) = 1
    rw [IntersectionContext.surfaceIntersectionPairing_apply,
      ← IntersectionContext.picardIntersectionNumber_fin2]
    exact T.pairwise_one i j hij

name: AlgebraicGeometry.EnriquesSurface.IsotropicCollection.bundleClass_ne
statement:
theorem bundleClass_ne {i j : Fin 10} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (T.bundles i).toPic ≠ (T.bundles j).toPic
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hpair := T.pairwise_one i j hij
  have hself := T.self_isotropic i
  have hcongr :
      T.intersection.picardIntersectionNumber
          ![(T.bundles i).toPic, (T.bundles j).toPic] =
        T.intersection.picardIntersectionNumber
          ![(T.bundles i).toPic, (T.bundles i).toPic] := by
    apply T.intersection.picardIntersectionNumber_congr
    intro a
    fin_cases a
    · rfl
    · exact heq.symm
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.EnriquesSurface.IsotropicCollection.fano_intersection_bundle
statement:
theorem fano_intersection_bundle (i : Fin 10) :
    T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing T.fanoClass (T.classes i) = 3
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := T.isIsotropicSequence.pairing_sum_left i
  have hnorm :
      T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing ((3 : ℤ) • T.fanoClass) (T.classes i) =
        T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing T.sumClass (T.classes i) := by
    simpa [fanoClass, classes, sumClass] using
      T.fano_normalization (T.bundles i).toPic
  rw [_root_.map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hnorm
  have hsum' :
      T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing T.sumClass (T.classes i) = 9 := by
    norm_num at hsum
    rw [sumClass, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    exact hsum
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.EnriquesSurface.IsotropicCollection.bundle_intersection_fano
statement:
theorem bundle_intersection_fano (i : Fin 10) :
    T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing (T.classes i) T.fanoClass = 3
proof:
:= by
  change T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing
    (Additive.ofMul (T.bundles i).toPic) (Additive.ofMul T.fano.toPic) = 3
  rw [T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing_symm]
  simpa [classes, fanoClass] using T.fano_intersection_bundle i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.EnriquesSurface.IsotropicCollection.fano_self_intersection
statement:
theorem fano_self_intersection :
    T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing T.fanoClass T.fanoClass = 10
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm :
      T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing ((3 : ℤ) • T.fanoClass) T.fanoClass =
        T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing T.sumClass T.fanoClass := by
    simpa [fanoClass, sumClass, classes] using T.fano_normalization T.fano.toPic
  have hsum :
      T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing T.sumClass T.fanoClass = 30 := by
    calc
      T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing T.sumClass T.fanoClass =
          ∑ i, T.intersection.surfaceIntersectionPairing (T.classes i) T.fanoClass := by
        rw [sumClass, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
      _ = ∑ _i : Fin 10, (3 : ℤ) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ T.bundle_intersection_fano i
      _ = 30 := by norm_num
  rw [_root_.map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hnorm
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmoothProperVariety.IsEnriquesSurface.canonicalSheaf_tensor_self_iso_unit
statement:
theorem canonicalSheaf_tensor_self_iso_unit :
    Nonempty
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorObj C.canonicalSheaf C.canonicalSheaf ≅
        (Scheme.structureSheafCoh X).obj)
proof:
:= by
  have hsq :
      (C.canonicalLineBundle.tensor C.canonicalLineBundle).toPic =
        (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleData.unit X).toPic := by
    rw [Scheme.Modules.LineBundleData.toPic_tensor,
      Scheme.Modules.LineBundleData.unit_toPic, ← pow_two]
    exact h.canonicalClass_sq_eq_one
  exact (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleData.toPic_eq_iff _ _).1 hsq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmoothProperVariety.IsEnriquesSurface.antiCanonicalClass_eq_canonicalClass

name: AlgebraicGeometry.EnriquesSurface.isExceptional_of_extComparison
statement:
theorem isExceptional_of_extComparison (L : LineBundleData Y)
    (comparison : ExtComparison (k := k) L)
    (hTwo : IsZero
      ((Cohomology.coherentH Y 2).obj (Scheme.structureSheafCoh Y))) :
    IsExceptional k L.boundedDerivedObject
proof:
:= by
  let hEnriques : SmoothProperVariety.IsEnriquesSurface k Y C := inferInstance
  constructor
  · intro n hn f
    by_cases hOne : n = 1
    · subst n
      letI : Subsingleton
          ((Cohomology.coherentH Y 1).obj (Scheme.structureSheafCoh Y)) :=
        AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hEnriques.h1_vanishing
      apply comparison.ext_one.some.injective
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    by_cases hTwoDegree : n = 2
    · subst n
      letI : Subsingleton
          ((Cohomology.coherentH Y 2).obj (Scheme.structureSheafCoh Y)) :=
        AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hTwo
      apply comparison.ext_two.some.injective
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    exact comparison.outside_surface_range n (by omega) f
  · exact comparison.endomorphisms

name: Mukai.span_int_range_prod
statement:
private theorem span_int_range_prod {M M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M]
    [AddCommGroup M'] [Module ℝ M'] {κ κ' : Type*}
    (c : Module.Basis κ ℝ M) (c' : Module.Basis κ' ℝ M') :
    Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (c.prod c'))
      = (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range c)).prod (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range c'))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro x ⟨k, rfl⟩
    cases k with
    | inl i =>
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Module.Basis.prod_apply_inl_fst]
          exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
        · rw [Module.Basis.prod_apply_inl_snd]
          exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | inr j =>
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Module.Basis.prod_apply_inr_fst]
          exact Submodule.zero_mem _
        · rw [Module.Basis.prod_apply_inr_snd]
          exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, y⟩ ⟨hx, hy⟩
    have hsplit : ((x, y) : M × M') = (x, 0) + (0, y) := by simp
    rw [hsplit]
    refine Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ?_
    · have hmap : (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range c)).map (LinearMap.inl ℤ M M')
          ≤ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (c.prod c')) := by
        rw [Submodule.map_span]
        refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
        rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨Sum.inl i, ?_⟩
        simp
      exact hmap ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    · have hmap : (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range c')).map (LinearMap.inr ℤ M M')
          ≤ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (c.prod c')) := by
        rw [Submodule.map_span]
        refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
        rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨Sum.inr j, ?_⟩
        simp
      exact hmap ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩

proof:

  congr 1 <;> [skip; congr 1] <;>

    (f : N →ₗ[ℤ] V) (hf : ∀ x y : N, bR (f x) (f y) = (bZ x y : ℝ))
    (u w : MukaiLattice N) :
    realPairing bR (extendMap f u) (extendMap f w) = ((pairing bZ u w : ℤ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [realPairing, extendMap, pairing, hf]
  push_cast

name: Mukai.isSphericalClass_extendMap
statement:
theorem isSphericalClass_extendMap (bZ : N →ₗ[ℤ] N →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ) (bR : V →ₗ[ℝ] V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (f : N →ₗ[ℤ] V) (hf : ∀ x y : N, bR (f x) (f y) = (bZ x y : ℝ))
    (hb : ∀ x y : V, bR x y = bR y x) {δ : MukaiLattice N} (hδ : IsSpherical bZ δ) :
    PeriodDomain.IsSphericalClass (realForm bR) (extendMap f δ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PeriodDomain.IsSphericalClass, polar_realForm bR hb,
    realPairing_extendMap bZ bR f hf]
  rw [IsSpherical, selfPairing] at hδ
  rw [hδ]
  norm_num

name: Mukai.finite_sphericalOrthogonal_integralExtension

theorem finite_sphericalOrthogonal_integralExtension
    (hsig : PeriodDomain.HasSignatureTwo (realForm b)) {W : Submodule ℝ (RealExtension V)}
    (hW : PeriodDomain.IsPositivePlane (realForm b) W) (v : Module.Basis ι ℝ V) :
    (PeriodDomain.sphericalOrthogonal (realForm b) W ∩
      (integralExtension (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range v)) : Set (RealExtension V))).Finite
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_range_extendBasis v]
  exact PeriodDomain.finite_sphericalOrthogonal_inter hsig hW (extendBasis v)

name: Mukai.finite_orthogonalClasses_integralExtension
statement:
theorem finite_orthogonalClasses_integralExtension (R : PeriodDomain.PlaneRegion (realForm b))
    (v : Module.Basis ι ℝ V) :
    (R.orthogonalClasses ∩
      (integralExtension (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range v)) : Set (RealExtension V))).Finite
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_range_extendBasis v]
  exact R.finite_orthogonalClasses_inter (extendBasis v)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.sqrtToddComp_one
statement: theorem sqrtToddComp_one (hK3 : IsK3 V) : V.sqrtToddComp 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [NumericalVarietyData.sqrtToddComp, sqrtComp_one, hK3.toddComp_one, mul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.degree_sqrtToddComp_two
statement:
theorem degree_sqrtToddComp_two (hK3 : IsK3 V) :
    V.ring.degree (V.sqrtToddComp 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  show V.ring.degree (algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) * V.toddComp 2
    - algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 8) * (V.toddComp 1 * V.toddComp 1)) = 1
  rw [hK3.toddComp_one, mul_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero,
    NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul, hK3.degree_toddComp_two]
  norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiComp_one
statement: theorem mukaiComp_one (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) : V.mukaiComp E 1 = V.chComp E 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mukaiComp, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one]
  simp [K3.sqrtToddComp_one hK3]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiComp_two
statement:
theorem mukaiComp_two (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    V.mukaiComp E 2 =
      V.chComp E 2 + algebraMap ℚ A (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.sqrtToddComp 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [mukaiComp, Finset.sum_range_succ, K3.sqrtToddComp_one hK3, V.chComp_zero]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.degree_mukaiComp_two
statement:
theorem degree_mukaiComp_two (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    V.ring.degree (V.mukaiComp E 2) = mukaiS V E
proof:
:= by
  rw [mukaiComp_two hK3, map_add, NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul,
    K3.degree_sqrtToddComp_two hK3, mukaiS]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiVector_fst_eq
statement: theorem mukaiVector_fst_eq (E : N) : (D.mukaiVector E).1 = V.rank E
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.b_mukaiVector_snd_eq_degree
statement:
theorem b_mukaiVector_snd_eq_degree (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :
    ((D.b (D.mukaiVector E).2.1 (D.c₁ F) : ℤ) : ℚ) =
      V.ring.degree (V.mukaiComp E 1 * V.chComp F 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mukaiComp_one hK3]
  exact D.b_spec E F

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiVector_thd_eq_degree
statement:
theorem mukaiVector_thd_eq_degree (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    (((D.mukaiVector E).2.2 : ℤ) : ℚ) = V.ring.degree (V.mukaiComp E 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_mukaiComp_two hK3]
  exact mukaiSInt_spec V hHRR hK3 E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.mukaiComp_mem
statement: theorem mukaiComp_mem (E : N) (i : ℕ) : V.mukaiComp E i ∈ V.ring.piece i
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j hj ↦ ?_
  have hji : j ≤ i := by
    simpa using Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (mem_range.mp hj)
  have h := V.ring.mul_mem_piece (V.chComp_mem E j) (V.sqrtToddComp_mem (i - j))
  rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hji] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.mukaiComp_add
statement:
theorem mukaiComp_add (E F : N) (i : ℕ) :
    V.mukaiComp (E + F) i = V.mukaiComp E i + V.mukaiComp F i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mukaiComp, V.chComp_add, add_mul]
  exact Finset.sum_add_distrib

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.mukaiClass_add
statement:
theorem mukaiClass_add (E F : N) :
    V.mukaiClass (E + F) = V.mukaiClass E + V.mukaiClass F
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mukaiClass, V.mukaiComp_add]
  exact Finset.sum_add_distrib

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.mukaiComp_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mukaiComp_zero (E : N) :
    V.mukaiComp E 0 = algebraMap ℚ A (V.rank E : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [mukaiComp, V.chComp_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.degree_mukaiComp_mul_mukaiComp_eq_zero
statement:
theorem degree_mukaiComp_mul_mukaiComp_eq_zero (E F : N) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i + j ≠ n) :
    V.ring.degree (V.mukaiComp E i * V.mukaiComp F j) = 0
proof:
:=
  V.ring.degree_eq_zero_of_mem hij
    (V.ring.mul_mem_piece (V.mukaiComp_mem E i) (V.mukaiComp_mem F j))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.mukaiDual_add
statement:
theorem mukaiDual_add (E F : N) :
    V.mukaiDual (E + F) = V.mukaiDual E + V.mukaiDual F
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mukaiDual, V.mukaiComp_add, smul_add]
  exact Finset.sum_add_distrib

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiDual_eq
statement:
theorem mukaiDual_eq (E : N) :
    V.mukaiDual E = V.mukaiComp E 0 - V.mukaiComp E 1 + V.mukaiComp E 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [NumericalVarietyData.mukaiDual, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiClass_eq
statement:
theorem mukaiClass_eq (E : N) :
    V.mukaiClass E = V.mukaiComp E 0 + V.mukaiComp E 1 + V.mukaiComp E 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [NumericalVarietyData.mukaiClass, Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiIntegral_eq
statement:
theorem mukaiIntegral_eq (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :
    mukaiIntegral V E F =
      (V.rank E : ℚ) * mukaiS V F - V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.chComp F 1)
        + (V.rank F : ℚ) * mukaiS V E
proof:
:= by
  have z : ∀ i j : ℕ, i + j ≠ 2 →
      V.ring.degree (V.mukaiComp E i * V.mukaiComp F j) = 0 :=
    fun i j h ↦ V.degree_mukaiComp_mul_mukaiComp_eq_zero E F h
  rw [mukaiIntegral, mukaiDual_eq, mukaiClass_eq]
  simp only [sub_mul, add_mul, mul_add, map_add, map_sub]
  rw [z 0 0 (by norm_num), z 0 1 (by norm_num), z 1 0 (by norm_num), z 1 2 (by norm_num),
    z 2 1 (by norm_num), z 2 2 (by norm_num)]
  rw [mukaiComp_zero, mukaiComp_zero, mukaiComp_one hK3, mukaiComp_one hK3,
    NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul, degree_mukaiComp_two hK3]
  have hlast : V.ring.degree (V.mukaiComp E 2 * algebraMap ℚ A (V.rank F : ℚ)) =
      (V.rank F : ℚ) * mukaiS V E := by
    rw [mul_comm, NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul, degree_mukaiComp_two hK3]
  rw [hlast]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.chi₂_eq_mukaiIntegral
statement:
theorem chi₂_eq_mukaiIntegral (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :
    V.chi₂ E F = mukaiIntegral V E F
proof:
:= by
  rw [chi₂_eq_neg_mukaiPairing V hK3, mukaiIntegral_eq hK3, mukaiPairing]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiIntegral_comm
statement:
theorem mukaiIntegral_comm (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :
    mukaiIntegral V E F = mukaiIntegral V F E
proof:
:= by
  rw [mukaiIntegral_eq hK3, mukaiIntegral_eq hK3, mul_comm (V.chComp E 1)]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiIntegral_self
statement:
theorem mukaiIntegral_self (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    mukaiIntegral V E E = -mukaiSelfPairing V E
proof:
:= by
  rw [mukaiIntegral_eq hK3, mukaiSelfPairing]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiIntegral_self_eq
statement:
theorem mukaiIntegral_self_eq (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    mukaiIntegral V E E = 2 * (V.rank E : ℚ) ^ 2 - V.ring.degree (V.discriminant E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mukaiIntegral_self hK3, mukaiSelfPairing_eq V]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiIntegral_eq_neg_mukaiPairing
statement:
theorem mukaiIntegral_eq_neg_mukaiPairing (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :
    mukaiIntegral V E F = -mukaiPairing V E F
proof:
:= by
  rw [mukaiIntegral_eq hK3, mukaiPairing]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.pairing_eq_neg_mukaiIntegral
statement:
theorem pairing_eq_neg_mukaiIntegral (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :
    ((Mukai.pairing D.b (D.mukaiVector E) (D.mukaiVector F) : ℤ) : ℚ) = -mukaiIntegral V E F
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.pairing_mukaiVector hHRR hK3, mukaiIntegral_eq_neg_mukaiPairing hK3, neg_neg]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.sqrtComp_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sqrtComp_zero (f : ℕ → A) : sqrtComp f 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.sqrtComp_one
statement:
theorem sqrtComp_one (f : ℕ → A) :
    sqrtComp f 1 = algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) * f 1
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.sqrtComp_eq_zero_of_four_lt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sqrtComp_eq_zero_of_four_lt (f : ℕ → A) {i : ℕ} (hi : 4 < i) :
    sqrtComp f i = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, i = k + 5 := ⟨i - 5, by omega⟩
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.am_quarter
statement: private theorem am_quarter : algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 4) = algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_pow]; norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.am_eighth
statement: private theorem am_eighth : algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 8) = algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_pow]; norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.am_sixteenth
statement: private theorem am_sixteenth : algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 16) = algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_pow]; norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.am_three_sixteenths
statement:
private theorem am_three_sixteenths :
    algebraMap ℚ A (3 / 16) = 3 * algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_pow, show (3 : A) = algebraMap ℚ A 3 from (map_ofNat _ 3).symm, ← map_mul]
  norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.am_five_128
statement:
private theorem am_five_128 :
    algebraMap ℚ A (5 / 128) = 5 * algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) ^ 7
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_pow, show (5 : A) = algebraMap ℚ A 5 from (map_ofNat _ 5).symm, ← map_mul]
  norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.am_half_add
statement: private theorem am_half_add : algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) + algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_add]; norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.sqrtComp_convolution
statement:
theorem sqrtComp_convolution (f : ℕ → A) (hf : f 0 = 1) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ 4) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (i + 1), sqrtComp f j * sqrtComp f (i - j) = f i
proof:
:= by
  have hh := am_half_add (A := A)
  obtain _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | i := i
  · simpa [sqrtComp] using hf.symm
  · norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, sqrtComp]
    linear_combination (f 1) * hh
  · norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, sqrtComp, am_eighth]
    linear_combination (f 2 - algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) ^ 2 * (f 1 * f 1)) * hh
  · norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, sqrtComp, am_quarter, am_eighth, am_sixteenth]
    linear_combination (f 3) * hh
  · norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, sqrtComp, am_quarter, am_eighth, am_sixteenth,
      am_three_sixteenths, am_five_128]
    linear_combination
      (f 4 - algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) ^ 2 * (f 2 * f 2)
        + 2 * algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) ^ 3 * (f 1 * f 1 * f 2)
        - 5 * algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) ^ 6 * (f 1 * f 1 * f 1 * f 1)
        - 2 * algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) ^ 5 * (f 1 * f 1 * f 1 * f 1)) * hh
  · exact absurd hi (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.sqrtComp_mem
statement:
theorem sqrtComp_mem {n : ℕ} (R : NumericalRingData n A) (f : ℕ → A)
    (hf : ∀ j, f j ∈ R.piece j) (i : ℕ) : sqrtComp f i ∈ R.piece i
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ (q : ℚ) {j : ℕ} {x : A}, x ∈ R.piece j →
      algebraMap ℚ A q * x ∈ R.piece j :=
    fun q _ _ hx => by simpa using R.mul_mem_piece (R.algebraMap_mem_piece_zero q) hx
  match i with
  | 0 => simpa [sqrtComp] using R.one_mem_piece_zero
  | 1 => exact hc _ (hf 1)
  | 2 =>
    refine Submodule.sub_mem _ (hc _ (hf 2)) (hc _ ?_)
    simpa using R.mul_mem_piece (hf 1) (hf 1)
  | 3 =>
    refine Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.sub_mem _ (hc _ (hf 3)) (hc _ ?_)) (hc _ ?_)
    · simpa using R.mul_mem_piece (hf 1) (hf 2)
    · simpa using R.mul_mem_piece (R.mul_mem_piece (hf 1) (hf 1)) (hf 1)
  | 4 =>
    refine Submodule.sub_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.sub_mem _
      (Submodule.sub_mem _ (hc _ (hf 4)) (hc _ ?_)) (hc _ ?_)) (hc _ ?_)) (hc _ ?_)
    · simpa using R.mul_mem_piece (hf 1) (hf 3)
    · simpa using R.mul_mem_piece (hf 2) (hf 2)
    · simpa using R.mul_mem_piece (R.mul_mem_piece (hf 1) (hf 1)) (hf 2)
    · simpa using
        R.mul_mem_piece (R.mul_mem_piece (R.mul_mem_piece (hf 1) (hf 1)) (hf 1)) (hf 1)
  | _ + 5 => simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.sqrtToddComp_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sqrtToddComp_zero (V : NumericalVarietyData n A N) : V.sqrtToddComp 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.sqrtToddComp_mem
statement:
theorem sqrtToddComp_mem (V : NumericalVarietyData n A N) (i : ℕ) :
    V.sqrtToddComp i ∈ V.ring.piece i
proof:
:=
  sqrtComp_mem V.ring V.toddComp V.toddComp_mem i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.sqrtToddComp_convolution
statement:
theorem sqrtToddComp_convolution (V : NumericalVarietyData n A N) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ 4) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (i + 1), V.sqrtToddComp j * V.sqrtToddComp (i - j) = V.toddComp i
proof:
:=
  sqrtComp_convolution V.toddComp V.toddComp_zero hi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneRel_ne_zero
statement: theorem rankOneRel_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : rankOneRel n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  pow_ne_zero _ Polynomial.X_ne_zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOnePB_dim
statement: theorem rankOnePB_dim (n : ℕ) : (rankOnePB n).dim = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankOnePB, AdjoinRoot.powerBasis_dim, rankOneRel, Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOnePB_gen
statement: theorem rankOnePB_gen (n : ℕ) : (rankOnePB n).gen = rankOneH n
proof:
:=
  AdjoinRoot.powerBasis_gen _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOnePB_basis_apply
statement:
theorem rankOnePB_basis_apply (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (rankOnePB n).dim) :
    (rankOnePB n).basis i = rankOneH n ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(rankOnePB n).basis_eq_pow, rankOnePB_gen]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneH_pow_succ_eq_zero
statement: theorem rankOneH_pow_succ_eq_zero (n : ℕ) : rankOneH n ^ (n + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change AdjoinRoot.root (rankOneRel n) ^ (n + 1) = 0
  rw [← AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root (rankOneRel n)]
  simp [rankOneRel]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneH_pow_eq_zero
statement: theorem rankOneH_pow_eq_zero (n : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hk : n < k) : rankOneH n ^ k = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = n + 1 + m := ⟨k - (n + 1), by omega⟩
  rw [pow_add, rankOneH_pow_succ_eq_zero, zero_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneW_le
statement: theorem rankOneW_le (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (rankOnePB n).dim) : rankOneW n i ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  have h := i.isLt
  have hd := rankOnePB_dim n
  show (i : ℕ) ≤ n
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.lt_rankOnePB_dim
statement: theorem lt_rankOnePB_dim (n : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) : k < (rankOnePB n).dim
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankOnePB_dim]
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOnePB_basis_eq_pow
statement:
theorem rankOnePB_basis_eq_pow (n : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (rankOnePB n).basis (rankOneIdx n hk) = rankOneH n ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankOnePB_basis_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneH_pow_mem_piece
statement:
theorem rankOneH_pow_mem_piece (n k : ℕ) :
    rankOneH n ^ k ∈ gradedPiece (⇑(rankOnePB n).basis) (rankOneW n) k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k ≤ n
  · have hmem := mem_gradedPiece (b := ⇑(rankOnePB n).basis) (w := rankOneW n) (rankOneIdx n hk)
    rwa [rankOnePB_basis_eq_pow] at hmem
  · rw [rankOneH_pow_eq_zero n (by omega)]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOne_one_mem
statement:
theorem rankOne_one_mem (n : ℕ) :
    (1 : RankOneRing n) ∈ gradedPiece (⇑(rankOnePB n).basis) (rankOneW n) 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := rankOneH_pow_mem_piece n 0
  rwa [pow_zero] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOne_mul_mem
statement:
theorem rankOne_mul_mem (n : ℕ) (p q : Fin (rankOnePB n).dim) :
    (rankOnePB n).basis p * (rankOnePB n).basis q
      ∈ gradedPiece (⇑(rankOnePB n).basis) (rankOneW n) (rankOneW n p + rankOneW n q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankOnePB_basis_apply, rankOnePB_basis_apply, ← pow_add]
  exact rankOneH_pow_mem_piece n _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOne_algebraMap_mul_mem
statement:
theorem rankOne_algebraMap_mul_mem (n : ℕ) {i : ℕ} {x : RankOneRing n} (q : ℚ)
    (hx : x ∈ gradedPiece (⇑(rankOnePB n).basis) (rankOneW n) i) :
    algebraMap ℚ (RankOneRing n) q * x
      ∈ gradedPiece (⇑(rankOnePB n).basis) (rankOneW n) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Algebra.smul_def]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneDegree_basis_of_ne
statement:
theorem rankOneDegree_basis_of_ne (n : ℕ) (d : ℚ) (i : Fin (rankOnePB n).dim)
    (hi : rankOneW n i ≠ n) : rankOneDegree n d ((rankOnePB n).basis i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hne : i ≠ rankOneIdx n (le_refl n) := fun h => hi (by rw [h]; rfl)
  show (d • (rankOnePB n).basis.coord (rankOneIdx n (le_refl n))) ((rankOnePB n).basis i) = 0
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self]
  simp [hne]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneDegree_basis_top
statement:
theorem rankOneDegree_basis_top (n : ℕ) (d : ℚ) :
    rankOneDegree n d ((rankOnePB n).basis (rankOneIdx n (le_refl n))) = d
proof:
:= by
  show (d • (rankOnePB n).basis.coord (rankOneIdx n (le_refl n)))
    ((rankOnePB n).basis (rankOneIdx n (le_refl n))) = d
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneDegree_pow
statement:
theorem rankOneDegree_pow (n : ℕ) (d : ℚ) (k : ℕ) :
    rankOneDegree n d (rankOneH n ^ k) = if k = n then d else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hle : k ≤ n
  · rw [← rankOnePB_basis_eq_pow n hle]
    by_cases hk : k = n
    · 
      have hidx : rankOneIdx n hle = rankOneIdx n (le_refl n) := by
        simp only [rankOneIdx, Fin.mk.injEq]
        exact hk
      rw [if_pos hk, hidx]
      exact rankOneDegree_basis_top n d
    · rw [if_neg hk]
      exact rankOneDegree_basis_of_ne n d _ hk
  · rw [rankOneH_pow_eq_zero n (by omega), map_zero, if_neg (by omega)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneDegree_algebraMap_mul_pow
statement:
theorem rankOneDegree_algebraMap_mul_pow (n : ℕ) (d q : ℚ) (k : ℕ) :
    rankOneDegree n d (algebraMap ℚ (RankOneRing n) q * rankOneH n ^ k)
      = q * if k = n then d else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Algebra.smul_def, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, rankOneDegree_pow]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneDegree_sum_mul_sum
statement:
theorem rankOneDegree_sum_mul_sum (n : ℕ) (d : ℚ) (c t : ℕ → ℚ) :
    rankOneDegree n d
        ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), algebraMap ℚ (RankOneRing n) (c i) * rankOneH n ^ i)
          * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), algebraMap ℚ (RankOneRing n) (t j) * rankOneH n ^ j)
      = d * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c i * t (n - i)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ i j : ℕ,
      rankOneDegree n d ((algebraMap ℚ (RankOneRing n) (c i) * rankOneH n ^ i)
          * (algebraMap ℚ (RankOneRing n) (t j) * rankOneH n ^ j))
        = c i * t j * if i + j = n then d else 0 := by
    intro i j
    rw [show (algebraMap ℚ (RankOneRing n) (c i) * rankOneH n ^ i)
          * (algebraMap ℚ (RankOneRing n) (t j) * rankOneH n ^ j)
        = algebraMap ℚ (RankOneRing n) (c i * t j) * rankOneH n ^ (i + j) by
      rw [map_mul, pow_add]; ring]
    rw [rankOneDegree_algebraMap_mul_pow]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  have hin : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hterm i j]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (n - i)]
  · rw [if_pos (show i + (n - i) = n by omega)]
    ring
  · intro b _ hb
    rw [if_neg (show i + b ≠ n by omega), mul_zero]
  · intro hmem
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (show n - i < n + 1 by omega)) hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneCh_mem
statement:
theorem rankOneCh_mem (n : ℕ) (chCoeff : N → ℕ → ℚ) (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    rankOneCh n chCoeff E i ∈ gradedPiece (⇑(rankOnePB n).basis) (rankOneW n) i
proof:
:=
  rankOne_algebraMap_mul_mem n _ (rankOneH_pow_mem_piece n i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneCh_sum
statement:
theorem rankOneCh_sum (n : ℕ) (chCoeff : N → ℕ → ℚ) (E : N) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), rankOneCh n chCoeff E i)
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          algebraMap ℚ (RankOneRing n) (chCoeff E i) * rankOneH n ^ i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneTodd_mem
statement:
theorem rankOneTodd_mem (n : ℕ) (toddCoeff : ℕ → ℚ) (j : ℕ) :
    rankOneTodd n toddCoeff j ∈ gradedPiece (⇑(rankOnePB n).basis) (rankOneW n) j
proof:
:=
  rankOne_algebraMap_mul_mem n _ (rankOneH_pow_mem_piece n j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneTodd_sum
statement:
theorem rankOneTodd_sum (n : ℕ) (toddCoeff : ℕ → ℚ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), rankOneTodd n toddCoeff j)
      = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          algebraMap ℚ (RankOneRing n) (toddCoeff j) * rankOneH n ^ j
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.rankOneNumericalVariety_satisfiesHRR
statement:
theorem rankOneNumericalVariety_satisfiesHRR
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℚ) [AddCommGroup N]
    (rankHom : N →+ ℤ) (chiHom : N →+ ℤ) (chCoeff : N → ℕ → ℚ)
    (toddCoeff : ℕ → ℚ)
    (hchZero : ∀ E : N, chCoeff E 0 = (rankHom E : ℚ))
    (hchAdd : ∀ (E F : N) (i : ℕ), chCoeff (E + F) i = chCoeff E i + chCoeff F i)
    (htoddZero : toddCoeff 0 = 1)
    (hchi : ∀ E : N, (chiHom E : ℚ)
      = d * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), chCoeff E i * toddCoeff (n - i)) :
    (rankOneNumericalVariety n d rankHom chiHom chCoeff toddCoeff
      hchZero hchAdd htoddZero).SatisfiesHRR where
  eq E
proof:
:= by
    show (chiHom E : ℚ) = rankOneDegree n d _
    rw [hchi E, rankOneCh_sum, rankOneTodd_sum, rankOneDegree_sum_mul_sum]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.toNumClass_rk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toNumClass_rk (E : N) :
    (toNumClass V P E).rk = ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) * (V.rank E : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.toNumClass_deg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toNumClass_deg (E : N) : (toNumClass V P E).deg = ((degH V P E : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.toNumClass_ch2
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toNumClass_ch2 (E : N) :
    (toNumClass V P E).ch2 = ((V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.toNumClass_add
statement:
theorem toNumClass_add (E F : N) :
    toNumClass V P (E + F)
      = ((toNumClass V P E).rk + (toNumClass V P F).rk,
          (toNumClass V P E).deg + (toNumClass V P F).deg,
          (toNumClass V P E).ch2 + (toNumClass V P F).ch2)
proof:
:= by
  have hch : V.chComp (E + F) 2 = V.chComp E 2 + V.chComp F 2 := V.chComp_add E F 2
  simp only [toNumClass, Wall.NumClass.rk, Wall.NumClass.deg, Wall.NumClass.ch2,
    degH_add, map_add, hch, Prod.mk.injEq]
  push_cast
  refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.toNumClassHom_apply
statement:

theorem toNumClassHom_apply (E : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.wallChargeFamily_charge
statement:

theorem wallChargeFamily_charge (p : ℝ × ℝ) (E : N) :

proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.wallChargeFamily_alignmentValue
statement:

theorem wallChargeFamily_alignmentValue (p : ℝ × ℝ) (E F : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.discr_toNumClass
statement:
theorem discr_toNumClass (E : N) :
    Wall.NumClass.discr (toNumClass V P E) = ((discrH V P E : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Wall.NumClass.discr_eq, toNumClass_rk, toNumClass_deg, toNumClass_ch2,
    discrH_eq]
  push_cast
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.toNumClass_ne_zero_of_rank_ne_zero
statement:
theorem toNumClass_ne_zero_of_rank_ne_zero {E : N} (hr : V.rank E ≠ 0) :
    toNumClass V P E ≠ (0, 0, 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) * (V.rank E : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) = 0 :=
    congrArg (fun w => Wall.NumClass.rk w) h
  have hH : (0 : ℚ) < V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) := P.degree_pow_pos
  have h2 : (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) * (V.rank E : ℚ) : ℚ) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h1
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with hc | hc
  · exact absurd hc (ne_of_gt hH)
  · exact hr (by exact_mod_cast hc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.discr_toNumClass_nonneg
statement:
theorem discr_toNumClass_nonneg {E : N} (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)
    (hI : HodgeIndexStatement V P) (hE : B.Semistable E) :
    0 ≤ Wall.NumClass.discr (toNumClass V P E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [discr_toNumClass]
  exact_mod_cast discrH_nonneg B hI hE

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.charge_ne_zero_of_semistable
statement:
theorem charge_ne_zero_of_semistable {E : N} (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)
    (hI : HodgeIndexStatement V P) (hE : B.Semistable E)
    (hne : toNumClass V P E ≠ (0, 0, 0)) {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ¬(Wall.reZ s t (toNumClass V P E) = 0 ∧ Wall.imZ s t (toNumClass V P E) = 0)
proof:
:=
  Wall.charge_ne_zero_of_discr_nonneg ht hne (discr_toNumClass_nonneg B hI hE)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.wall_eq_of_meet_of_semistable
statement:
theorem wall_eq_of_meet_of_semistable {E : N} (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)
    (hI : HodgeIndexStatement V P) (hE : B.Semistable E) (hr : V.rank E ≠ 0)
    {s t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) {w₁ w₂ : Wall.NumClass}
    (h₁ : Wall.wallExpr s t (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0)
    (h₂ : Wall.wallExpr s t (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0)
    (hn₁ : ¬(Wall.minA (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0 ∧ Wall.minB (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0
      ∧ Wall.minC (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0))
    (hn₂ : ¬(Wall.minA (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0 ∧ Wall.minB (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0
      ∧ Wall.minC (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0))
    {s' t' : ℝ} (ht' : t' ≠ 0) :
    Wall.wallExpr s' t' (toNumClass V P E) w₁ = 0
      ↔ Wall.wallExpr s' t' (toNumClass V P E) w₂ = 0
proof:
:=
  Wall.wall_eq_of_meet_of_discr_nonneg ht (toNumClass_ne_zero_of_rank_ne_zero V P hr)
    (discr_toNumClass_nonneg B hI hE) h₁ h₂ hn₁ hn₂ ht'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.walls_nested_of_semistable
statement:
theorem walls_nested_of_semistable {E : N} (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)
    (hI : HodgeIndexStatement V P) (hE : B.Semistable E)
    (hrk : (toNumClass V P E).rk ≠ 0) {w₁ w₂ : Wall.NumClass}
    (hA₁ : Wall.minA (toNumClass V P E) w₁ ≠ 0)
    (hA₂ : Wall.minA (toNumClass V P E) w₂ ≠ 0)
    (hR₁ : 0 ≤ Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₁)
    (hR₂ : 0 ≤ Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₂)
    (hfam : 0 < Wall.wallOffset (toNumClass V P E) w₁
      * Wall.wallOffset (toNumClass V P E) w₂) :
    (Wall.wallCentre (toNumClass V P E) w₁
          - Wall.wallCentre (toNumClass V P E) w₂) ^ 2
        ≤ Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₁
          + Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₂ ∧
      4 * Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₁
          * Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₂
        ≤ ((Wall.wallCentre (toNumClass V P E) w₁
              - Wall.wallCentre (toNumClass V P E) w₂) ^ 2
          - Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₁
          - Wall.wallRadiusSq (toNumClass V P E) w₂) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  Wall.walls_nested_of_discr_nonneg hrk (discr_toNumClass_nonneg B hI hE)
    hA₁ hA₂ hR₁ hR₂ hfam

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.toNumClass_k3
statement:
theorem toNumClass_k3 (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (E : SurfaceNum) :
    Surface.toNumClass (k3NumericalVariety d) (k3Polarization d hd) E
      = ((2 * (d : ℝ) * (E 0 : ℝ)), (2 * (d : ℝ) * (E 1 : ℝ)),
          ((E 2 : ℝ) * (2 * (d : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  have hHsq : (k3NumericalVariety d).ring.degree ((k3Polarization d hd).cls ^ 2)
      = 2 * (d : ℚ) := surfaceDegree_Hsq _
  have hch2 : (k3NumericalVariety d).ring.degree ((k3NumericalVariety d).chComp E 2)
      = (E 2 : ℚ) * (2 * (d : ℚ)) := by
    show (surfaceNumericalRing (2 * (d : ℚ))).degree
      (algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (k3ChCoeff E 2) * H ^ 2) = _
    rw [NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul, surfaceDegree_Hsq]
    rfl
  have hrank : ((k3NumericalVariety d).rank E : ℚ) = (E 0 : ℚ) := rfl
  simp only [Surface.toNumClass, hHsq, hch2, hrank, degH_k3 d hd E, Prod.mk.injEq]
  push_cast
  refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.k3WallChargeFamily_charge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem k3WallChargeFamily_charge (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (s t : ℝ) (E : SurfaceNum) :
    (k3WallChargeFamily d hd).charge (s, t) E =
      Wall.stCharge s t
        ((2 * (d : ℝ) * (E 0 : ℝ)),
          (2 * (d : ℝ) * (E 1 : ℝ)),
          ((E 2 : ℝ) * (2 * (d : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [k3WallChargeFamily, Surface.wallChargeFamily_charge,
    toNumClass_k3]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.discr_toNumClass_k3
statement:
theorem discr_toNumClass_k3 (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (E : SurfaceNum) :
    Wall.NumClass.discr
        (Surface.toNumClass (k3NumericalVariety d) (k3Polarization d hd) E)
      = 4 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2 * (E 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 - 8 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2 * (E 0 : ℝ) * (E 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Wall.NumClass.discr_eq, toNumClass_k3 d hd E]
  show (2 * (d : ℝ) * (E 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2
    - 2 * (2 * (d : ℝ) * (E 0 : ℝ)) * ((E 2 : ℝ) * (2 * (d : ℝ))) = _
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.twistCoeff_zero_beta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twistCoeff_zero_beta (m : ℕ) : twistCoeff 0 m = if m = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · simp [twistCoeff, hm]
  · simp [twistCoeff, hm, zero_pow hm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.twistCoeff_add
statement:
theorem twistCoeff_add (β₁ β₂ : ℚ) (m : ℕ) :
    twistCoeff (β₁ + β₂) m
      = ∑ a ∈ range (m + 1), twistCoeff β₁ a * twistCoeff β₂ (m - a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twistCoeff]
  have hneg : -(β₁ + β₂) = (-β₁) + (-β₂) := by ring
  rw [hneg, add_pow, div_eq_mul_inv, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
  have ham : a ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp ha)
  have key : (m.choose a : ℚ) * ((a.factorial : ℚ) * ((m - a).factorial : ℚ))
      = (m.factorial : ℚ) := by
    have h := Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial ham
    push_cast [← h]; ring
  have h1 : (a.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h2 : ((m - a).factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h3 : (m.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp
  linear_combination ((-β₁) ^ a * (-β₂) ^ (m - a)) * key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.twist_add_beta
statement:
theorem twist_add_beta (H : A) (β₁ β₂ : ℚ) (c : ℕ → A) (i : ℕ) :
    twist H (β₁ + β₂) c i = twist H β₁ (twist H β₂ c) i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twist]
  have expand : ∀ k ∈ range (i + 1),
      algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff β₁ (i - k)) * (∑ j ∈ range (k + 1),
          algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff β₂ (k - j)) * c j * H ^ (k - j)) * H ^ (i - k)
        = ∑ j ∈ range (k + 1),
          algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff β₁ (i - k) * twistCoeff β₂ (k - j))
            * c j * H ^ (i - j) := by
    intro k hk
    have hki : k ≤ i := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
    have hjk : j ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
    have hpow : H ^ (k - j) * H ^ (i - k) = H ^ (i - j) := by
      rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
    rw [map_mul]
    calc algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff β₁ (i - k))
          * (algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff β₂ (k - j)) * c j * H ^ (k - j)) * H ^ (i - k)
        = algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff β₁ (i - k)) * algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff β₂ (k - j))
            * c j * (H ^ (k - j) * H ^ (i - k)) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hpow]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl expand]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm' (t' := range (i + 1)) (s' := fun j => Finset.Ico j (i + 1))
    (by intro k j; simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_Ico]; omega)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  have hji : j ≤ i := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
  
  have hrefl : ∑ a ∈ range (i - j + 1), twistCoeff β₁ (i - j - a) * twistCoeff β₂ a
      = ∑ a ∈ range (i - j + 1), twistCoeff β₁ a * twistCoeff β₂ (i - j - a) :=
    calc ∑ a ∈ range (i - j + 1), twistCoeff β₁ (i - j - a) * twistCoeff β₂ a
        = ∑ a ∈ range (i - j + 1),
            (fun b : ℕ => twistCoeff β₁ b * twistCoeff β₂ (i - j - b))
              (i - j + 1 - 1 - a) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
          have hai : a < i - j + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp ha
          simp only
          congr 2
          omega
      _ = ∑ a ∈ range (i - j + 1), twistCoeff β₁ a * twistCoeff β₂ (i - j - a) :=
          Finset.sum_range_reflect
            (fun b : ℕ => twistCoeff β₁ b * twistCoeff β₂ (i - j - b)) (i - j + 1)
  have hscalar : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico j (i + 1), twistCoeff β₁ (i - k) * twistCoeff β₂ (k - j)
      = twistCoeff (β₁ + β₂) (i - j) := by
    rw [twistCoeff_add β₁ β₂ (i - j), Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
    have hlen : i + 1 - j = i - j + 1 := by omega
    rw [hlen]
    refine Eq.trans ?_ hrefl
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
    have hai : a < i - j + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp ha
    congr 2 <;> omega
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← map_sum, hscalar]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.twist_algebraMap_mul
statement:
theorem twist_algebraMap_mul (H : A) (β : ℚ) (c : ℕ → A) (i : ℕ) :
    twist (algebraMap ℚ A β * H) 1 c i = twist H β c i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twist]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  have hcoeff : twistCoeff 1 (i - j) * β ^ (i - j) = twistCoeff β (i - j) := by
    unfold twistCoeff
    have hfactorial : ((i - j).factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
    rw [← mul_pow]
    ring
  rw [mul_pow, ← map_pow]
  calc
    algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff 1 (i - j)) * c j *
          (algebraMap ℚ A (β ^ (i - j)) * H ^ (i - j)) =
        algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff 1 (i - j) * β ^ (i - j)) * c j * H ^ (i - j) := by
          rw [map_mul]
          ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hcoeff]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.BField.pow_mem
statement: theorem pow_mem (B : BField R) (i : ℕ) : B.cls ^ i ∈ R.piece i
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simpa using R.one_mem_piece_zero
  | succ i ih => simpa [pow_succ] using R.mul_mem_piece ih B.cls_mem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.BField.along_cls
statement:
@[simp]
theorem along_cls (P : Polarization R) (β : ℚ) :
    (along P β).cls = algebraMap ℚ A β * P.cls
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBComp_eq
statement:
theorem chBComp_eq (B : BField V.ring) (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBComp V B E i =
      ∑ j ∈ range (i + 1),
        algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff 1 (i - j)) * V.chComp E j * B.cls ^ (i - j)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBComp_mem
statement:
theorem chBComp_mem (B : BField V.ring) (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBComp V B E i ∈ V.ring.piece i
proof:
:= by
  rw [chBComp_eq]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j hj => ?_
  have hji : j ≤ i := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
  have h0 : algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff 1 (i - j)) * V.chComp E j ∈ V.ring.piece j := by
    have := V.ring.mul_mem_piece (V.ring.algebraMap_mem_piece_zero (twistCoeff 1 (i - j)))
      (V.chComp_mem E j)
    simpa using this
  have := V.ring.mul_mem_piece h0 (B.pow_mem (i - j))
  rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hji] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBComp_add
statement:
theorem chBComp_add (B : BField V.ring) (E F : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBComp V B (E + F) i = chBComp V B E i + chBComp V B F i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chBComp_eq, V.chComp_add, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBComp_zero
statement:
theorem chBComp_zero (B : BField V.ring) (E : N) :
    chBComp V B E 0 = V.chComp E 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [chBComp, twist, twistCoeff]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBComp_one
statement:
theorem chBComp_one (B : BField V.ring) (E : N) :
    chBComp V B E 1 = V.chComp E 1 - V.chComp E 0 * B.cls
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [chBComp, twist, twistCoeff, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBComp_two
statement:
theorem chBComp_two (B : BField V.ring) (E : N) :
    chBComp V B E 2 =
      V.chComp E 2 - V.chComp E 1 * B.cls
        + algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) * V.chComp E 0 * B.cls ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [chBComp, twist, twistCoeff, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBetaComp_eq
statement:
theorem chBetaComp_eq (β : ℚ) (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBetaComp V P β E i
      = ∑ j ∈ range (i + 1),
        algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff β (i - j)) * V.chComp E j * P.cls ^ (i - j)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBetaComp_mem
statement:
theorem chBetaComp_mem (β : ℚ) (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBetaComp V P β E i ∈ V.ring.piece i
proof:
:= by
  rw [chBetaComp_eq]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j hj => ?_
  have hji : j ≤ i := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
  have h0 : algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff β (i - j)) * V.chComp E j ∈ V.ring.piece j := by
    have := V.ring.mul_mem_piece (V.ring.algebraMap_mem_piece_zero (twistCoeff β (i - j)))
      (V.chComp_mem E j)
    simpa using this
  have := V.ring.mul_mem_piece h0 (P.pow_mem (i - j))
  rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hji] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBetaComp_add
statement:
theorem chBetaComp_add (β : ℚ) (E F : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBetaComp V P β (E + F) i = chBetaComp V P β E i + chBetaComp V P β F i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chBetaComp_eq, V.chComp_add, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBetaComp_zero_beta
statement:
theorem chBetaComp_zero_beta (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBetaComp V P 0 E i = V.chComp E i
proof:
:= by
  rw [chBetaComp_eq, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp
  · intro j hj hne
    have hji : j ≤ i := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
    have : i - j ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp [twistCoeff_zero_beta, this]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.self_mem_range_succ i) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBetaComp_add_beta
statement:
theorem chBetaComp_add_beta (β₁ β₂ : ℚ) (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBetaComp V P (β₁ + β₂) E i = twist P.cls β₁ (chBetaComp V P β₂ E) i
proof:
:=
  twist_add_beta P.cls β₁ β₂ (V.chComp E) i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.chBComp_along_eq_chBetaComp
statement:
theorem chBComp_along_eq_chBetaComp (β : ℚ) (E : N) (i : ℕ) :
    chBComp V (BField.along P β) E i = chBetaComp V P β E i
proof:
:= by
  exact twist_algebraMap_mul P.cls β (V.chComp E) i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.twist_degree_eq_exp
statement:
theorem twist_degree_eq_exp (R : NumericalRingData n A) (H : A) (β : ℚ)
    (c : ℕ → A) (m : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => (R.degree (twist H β c i * H ^ (n - i.val)) : ℝ)) =
      Exp.twist m (β : ℝ)
        (fun i => (R.degree (c i * H ^ (n - i.val)) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rw [Exp.twist_apply, twist, Finset.sum_mul, map_sum, Rat.cast_sum,
    ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  have hpow : H ^ (i.val - j.val) * H ^ (n - i.val) = H ^ (n - j.val) := by
    rw [← pow_add]
    congr 1
    have := i.isLt
    have := j.isLt
    omega
  rw [show algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff β (i.val - j.val)) * c j *
        H ^ (i.val - j.val) * H ^ (n - i.val) =
      algebraMap ℚ A (twistCoeff β (i.val - j.val)) * (c j * H ^ (n - j.val)) by
        rw [← hpow]; ring,
    R.degree_algebraMap_mul]
  simp only [twistCoeff]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.sqrtTodd_divisor

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.mukaiCharge_of_isK3
statement:
theorem mukaiCharge_of_isK3 (hK3 : K3.IsK3 V) (P : StabilityParameters D) (E : N) :
    R.chernCharacter.mukaiCharge R.divisorSpace (R.sqrtTodd (V := V)) P E =

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalDataB_along_degree
statement:
theorem ofNumericalDataB_along_degree (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)
    (P : Polarization V.ring) (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    (ofNumericalDataB V P (BField.along P β)).degree E =
      ((ofNumericalData V P).twistByScalar (β : ℝ)).degree E
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ofNumericalDataB_degree, ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_degree,
    ofNumericalData_degree, ofNumericalData_rank]
  rw [chBComp_one, BField.along_cls, V.chComp_zero, sub_mul, map_sub]
  have hdeg : V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls) = degH V P E := by
    simp [degH]
  rw [hdeg]
  have hscalar :
      algebraMap ℚ A (V.rank E : ℚ) * (algebraMap ℚ A β * P.cls) * P.cls =
        algebraMap ℚ A (β * (V.rank E : ℚ)) * P.cls ^ 2 := by
    rw [map_mul]
    ring
  rw [hscalar, NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul]
  push_cast
  rw [ofNumericalData_hyperplaneSquare]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalDataB_along_chTwo
statement:
theorem ofNumericalDataB_along_chTwo (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)
    (P : Polarization V.ring) (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    (ofNumericalDataB V P (BField.along P β)).chTwo E =
      ((ofNumericalData V P).twistByScalar (β : ℝ)).chTwo E
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ofNumericalDataB_chTwo, ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_chTwo,
    ofNumericalData_chTwo, ofNumericalData_degree, ofNumericalData_rank]
  rw [chBComp_two, BField.along_cls, V.chComp_zero, map_add, map_sub]
  have hlinear :
      V.chComp E 1 * (algebraMap ℚ A β * P.cls) =
        algebraMap ℚ A β * (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls) := by ring
  rw [hlinear, NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul]
  have hdeg : V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls) = degH V P E := by
    simp [degH]
  rw [hdeg]
  have hquadratic :
      algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) * algebraMap ℚ A (V.rank E : ℚ) *
          (algebraMap ℚ A β * P.cls) ^ 2 =
        algebraMap ℚ A ((1 / 2) * (V.rank E : ℚ) * β ^ 2) * P.cls ^ 2 := by
    simp only [mul_pow, map_mul, map_pow]
    ring
  rw [hquadratic, NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul]
  push_cast
  rw [ofNumericalData_hyperplaneSquare]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.WeakStabilityCondition.StabilityCondition.Wall.Divisorial.ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge_ofNumericalDataB_along_eq
statement:
theorem centralCharge_ofNumericalDataB_along_eq (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)
    (P : Polarization V.ring) (a : ℝ) (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    (ofNumericalDataB V P (BField.along P β)).centralCharge a E =
      ((ofNumericalData V P).twistByScalar (β : ℝ)).centralCharge a E
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge, AddMonoidHom.mk'_apply]
  rw [ofNumericalDataB_along_degree, ofNumericalDataB_along_chTwo]
  simp only [ofNumericalDataB_hyperplaneSquare, ofNumericalDataB_rank,
    ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_hyperplaneSquare,
    ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_rank, ofNumericalData_hyperplaneSquare,
    ofNumericalData_rank]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.RealDivisorClass.pair_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pair_tmul (a b : ℝ) (x y : S.piece 1) :
    (divisorSpace S).pair (a ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x) (b ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y) =
      ((S.degree (x.1 * y.1) : ℚ) : ℝ) * (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [divisorSpace, intersection, DivisorSpace.pair,
    LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul,
    RationalDivisorClass.intersection, LinearMap.mk₂_apply]
  rw [← Rat.cast_smul_eq_qsmul ℝ]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.extendDivisorClass_tmul
statement:

theorem extendDivisorClass_tmul (a : ℝ) (x : S.piece 1) :

proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.extendDivisorClass_ofRational
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extendDivisorClass_ofRational (x : S.piece 1) :

      R.divisorClass x
proof:
:= by
  simp [RealDivisorClass.ofRational]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.extendDivisorClass_unique
statement:
theorem extendDivisorClass_unique
    (f : RealDivisorClass S →ₗ[ℝ] D)
    (hf : ∀ x : S.piece 1,
      f (RealDivisorClass.ofRational S x) = R.divisorClass x) :
    f = R.extendDivisorClass
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module ℚ D := Module.compHom D (algebraMap ℚ ℝ)
  apply TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.ext
  intro a x
  calc
    f (a ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x) = f (a • RealDivisorClass.ofRational S x) := by
      apply congrArg f
      simpa only [RealDivisorClass.ofRational] using
        (TensorProduct.tmul_eq_smul_one_tmul a x)
    _ = a • f (RealDivisorClass.ofRational S x) := by rw [map_smul]
    _ = a • R.divisorClass x := by rw [hf]
    _ = R.extendDivisorClass (a ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x) :=
      (R.extendDivisorClass_tmul a x).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.pair_extendDivisorClass
statement:
theorem pair_extendDivisorClass (x y : RealDivisorClass S) :
    R.divisorSpace.pair (R.extendDivisorClass x) (R.extendDivisorClass y) =
      (RealDivisorClass.divisorSpace S).pair x y
proof:
:= by
  let realizedForm : LinearMap.BilinForm ℝ (RealDivisorClass S) :=
    R.divisorSpace.intersection.compl₁₂ R.extendDivisorClass R.extendDivisorClass
  have hform : realizedForm = RealDivisorClass.intersection S := by
    apply TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.ext
    intro a x
    apply TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.ext
    intro b y
    simp only [realizedForm, LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply,
      extendDivisorClass_tmul, RealDivisorClass.intersection,
      LinearMap.BilinForm.baseChange_tmul]
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    change b * (a * R.divisorSpace.pair (R.divisorClass x) (R.divisorClass y)) =
      (RationalDivisorClass.intersection S x y) • (a * b)
    rw [R.intersection_eq]
    simp only [RationalDivisorClass.intersection, LinearMap.mk₂_apply]
    rw [← Rat.cast_smul_eq_qsmul ℝ]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  change realizedForm x y = RealDivisorClass.intersection S x y
  rw [hform]
