name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.ScalarExtension.centralCharge_eq_realization
statement:
theorem centralCharge_eq_realization
    (P : StabilityParameters (RealDivisorClass V.ring)) (E : N) :
    (chernCharacter (V := V)).centralCharge
        (RealDivisorClass.divisorSpace V.ring) P E =
      R.chernCharacter.centralCharge R.divisorSpace
        (R.realizeParameters P) E
proof:
:= by
  rw [ChernCharacter.centralCharge_apply, ChernCharacter.centralCharge_apply]
  simp only [chernCharacter_rank, chernCharacter_chTwo,
    NumericalRealization.chernCharacter_rank,
    NumericalRealization.chernCharacter_chTwo,
    NumericalRealization.realizeParameters]
  rw [← map_chernCharacter_chOne R E]
  rw [R.pair_extendDivisorClass P.B
      ((chernCharacter (V := V)).chOne E)]
  rw [R.pair_extendDivisorClass P.B P.B]
  rw [R.pair_extendDivisorClass P.omega P.omega]
  rw [R.pair_extendDivisorClass P.omega
      ((chernCharacter (V := V)).chOne E)]
  rw [R.pair_extendDivisorClass P.omega P.B]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.toNumClass_eq_ofNumericalData
statement:
theorem toNumClass_eq_ofNumericalData (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)
    (P : Polarization V.ring) (E : N) :
    Surface.toNumClass V P E =
      (ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalData V P).toNumClass E
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) * (V.rank E : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
      = ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) : ℚ) : ℝ) * ((V.rank E : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    push_cast
    ring
  simp only [Surface.toNumClass, ChargeCoordinates.toNumClass,
    ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalData_rank, ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalData_degree,
    ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalData_chTwo,
    ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalData_hyperplaneSquare]
  rw [h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.nonneg_degree_discriminant
statement:
theorem nonneg_degree_discriminant (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)
    (hE : B.Semistable E) : 0 ≤ V.ring.degree (V.discriminant E)
proof:
:= by
  have h := B.nonneg E hE
  rwa [discDegH_eq] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.discrH_nonneg
statement:
theorem discrH_nonneg (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P) (hI : HodgeIndexStatement V P)
    (hE : B.Semistable E) : 0 ≤ discrH V P E
proof:
:= by
  have hH : 0 < V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) := P.degree_pow_pos
  have hD := nonneg_degree_discriminant B hE
  rw [V.degree_discriminant] at hD
  have hidx := hI.index_le E
  rw [discrH_eq]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hH.le hD, hidx, hH]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.chi₂_self_le
statement:
theorem chi₂_self_le (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P) (hK3 : IsK3 V)
    (hE : B.Semistable E) : V.chi₂ E E ≤ 2 * (V.rank E : ℚ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [chi₂_self V hK3]
  linarith [Surface.nonneg_degree_discriminant B hE]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiSelfPairing_ge
statement:
theorem mukaiSelfPairing_ge (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P) (hE : B.Semistable E) :
    -2 * (V.rank E : ℚ) ^ 2 ≤ mukaiSelfPairing V E
proof:
:= by
  rw [mukaiSelfPairing_eq]
  linarith [Surface.nonneg_degree_discriminant B hE]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.neg_two_le_mukaiSelfPairing_of_rank_le_one
statement:
theorem neg_two_le_mukaiSelfPairing_of_rank_le_one (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)
    (hE : B.Semistable E) (hr : V.rank E ^ 2 ≤ 1) : -2 ≤ mukaiSelfPairing V E
proof:
:= by
  have h := mukaiSelfPairing_ge B hE
  have hr' : ((V.rank E : ℚ)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hr
  nlinarith [h, hr']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.chi₂_self_le_two_of_rank_le_one
statement:
theorem chi₂_self_le_two_of_rank_le_one (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P) (hK3 : IsK3 V)
    (hE : B.Semistable E) (hr : V.rank E ^ 2 ≤ 1) : V.chi₂ E E ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := chi₂_self_le B hK3 hE
  have hr' : ((V.rank E : ℚ)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hr
  nlinarith [h, hr']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.neg_two_le_selfPairing_mukaiVector_of_rank_le_one
statement:
theorem neg_two_le_selfPairing_mukaiVector_of_rank_le_one (D : IntegralMukaiData V Λ)
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)
    (hE : B.Semistable E) (hr : V.rank E ^ 2 ≤ 1) :
    -2 ≤ Mukai.selfPairing D.b (D.mukaiVector E)
proof:
:=
  (D.neg_two_le_selfPairing_mukaiVector_iff hHRR hK3 E).mpr
    (chi₂_self_le_two_of_rank_le_one B hK3 hE hr)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.k3HodgeIndex
statement:
theorem k3HodgeIndex (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    HodgeIndexStatement (k3NumericalVariety d) (k3Polarization d hd) where
  index_le E
proof:
:= by
    have hHsq : (k3NumericalVariety d).ring.degree ((k3Polarization d hd).cls ^ 2)
        = 2 * (d : ℚ) := surfaceDegree_Hsq _
    have hc₁ : (k3NumericalVariety d).ring.degree
        ((k3NumericalVariety d).chComp E 1 * (k3NumericalVariety d).chComp E 1)
          = (E 1 : ℚ) * (E 1 : ℚ) * (2 * (d : ℚ)) := by
      show (surfaceNumericalRing (2 * (d : ℚ))).degree
        (algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (k3ChCoeff E 1) * H
          * (algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (k3ChCoeff E 1) * H)) = _
      rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, ← map_mul, ← pow_two H,
        NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul, surfaceDegree_Hsq]
      rfl
    rw [degH_k3 d hd E, hHsq, hc₁]
    exact le_of_eq (by ring)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarization.pow_mem
statement: theorem pow_mem (P : Polarization R) (i : ℕ) : P.cls ^ i ∈ R.piece i
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simpa using R.one_mem_piece_zero
  | succ i ih => simpa [pow_succ] using R.mul_mem_piece ih P.cls_mem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.degH_add
statement: theorem degH_add (E F : N) : degH V P (E + F) = degH V P E + degH V P F
proof:
:= by
  simp only [degH, V.chComp_add, add_mul, map_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.degHHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degHHom_apply (E : N) : degHHom V P E = degH V P E
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.slopeH_eq
statement: theorem slopeH_eq (E : N) : slopeH V P E = degH V P E / (V.rank E : ℚ)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.discDegH_mul_mem
statement:
theorem discDegH_mul_mem (hn : 2 ≤ n) (E : N) :
    V.discriminant E * P.cls ^ (n - 2) ∈ V.ring.piece n
proof:
:= by
  have h := V.ring.mul_mem_piece (V.discriminant_mem_piece_two E) (P.pow_mem (n - 2))
  rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hn] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.discDegH_eq
statement: theorem discDegH_eq (E : N) : discDegH V P E = V.ring.degree (V.discriminant E)
proof:
:= by
  simp [discDegH]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.discrH_eq
statement:
theorem discrH_eq (E : N) :
    discrH V P E = degH V P E ^ 2
      - 2 * V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) * (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.discrH_eq_selfPairing
statement:
theorem discrH_eq_selfPairing (E : N) :
    discrH V P E
      = Mukai.selfPairing (LinearMap.mul ℚ ℚ)
          (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) * (V.rank E : ℚ), degH V P E,
            V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Mukai.selfPairing_mk, discrH_eq]
  show _ = degH V P E * degH V P E
    - 2 * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) * (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2))
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.tc0
statement: private theorem tc0 (β : ℚ) : twistCoeff β 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [twistCoeff]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.tc1
statement: private theorem tc1 (β : ℚ) : twistCoeff β 1 = -β
proof:
:= by
  simp [twistCoeff]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.tc2
statement: private theorem tc2 (β : ℚ) : twistCoeff β 2 = β ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistCoeff]
  norm_num [Nat.factorial]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.tc3
statement: private theorem tc3 (β : ℚ) : twistCoeff β 3 = -(β ^ 3) / 6
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistCoeff]
  norm_num [Nat.factorial]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.degH1Beta_eq
statement:
theorem degH1Beta_eq (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    degH1Beta V P β E =
      V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2)
        - β * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [degH1Beta, chBetaComp_eq, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  simp only [Nat.sub_self, Nat.sub_zero, tc0, tc1, V.chComp_zero, map_one, one_mul]
  rw [add_mul, map_add]
  rw [show algebraMap ℚ A (-β) * algebraMap ℚ A ((V.rank E : ℤ) : ℚ) * P.cls ^ 1 * P.cls ^ 2
      = algebraMap ℚ A (-β * ((V.rank E : ℤ) : ℚ)) * P.cls ^ 3 from by
    rw [map_mul]; ring]
  rw [show V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 0 * P.cls ^ 2 = V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2 from by ring]
  rw [NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.degH2Beta_eq
statement:
theorem degH2Beta_eq (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    degH2Beta V P β E =
      V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * P.cls)
        - β * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2)
        + β ^ 2 / 2 * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [degH2Beta, chBetaComp_eq, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  simp only [Nat.sub_self, Nat.sub_zero, show (2 : ℕ) - 1 = 1 from rfl, tc0, tc1, tc2,
    V.chComp_zero, map_one, one_mul]
  rw [add_mul, add_mul, map_add, map_add]
  rw [show algebraMap ℚ A (β ^ 2 / 2) * algebraMap ℚ A ((V.rank E : ℤ) : ℚ) * P.cls ^ 2
        * P.cls
      = algebraMap ℚ A (β ^ 2 / 2 * ((V.rank E : ℤ) : ℚ)) * P.cls ^ 3 from by
    rw [map_mul]; ring]
  rw [show algebraMap ℚ A (-β) * V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 1 * P.cls
      = algebraMap ℚ A (-β) * (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2) from by ring]
  rw [show V.chComp E 2 * P.cls ^ 0 * P.cls = V.chComp E 2 * P.cls from by ring]
  rw [NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul, NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.deg3Beta_eq
statement:
theorem deg3Beta_eq (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    deg3Beta V P β E =
      V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 3)
        - β * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * P.cls)
        + β ^ 2 / 2 * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2)
        - β ^ 3 / 6 * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [deg3Beta, chBetaComp_eq, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  simp only [Nat.sub_self, Nat.sub_zero, show (3 : ℕ) - 1 = 2 from rfl,
    show (3 : ℕ) - 2 = 1 from rfl, tc0, tc1, tc2, tc3, V.chComp_zero, map_one, one_mul]
  rw [map_add, map_add, map_add]
  rw [show algebraMap ℚ A (-(β ^ 3) / 6) * algebraMap ℚ A ((V.rank E : ℤ) : ℚ) * P.cls ^ 3
      = algebraMap ℚ A (-(β ^ 3) / 6 * ((V.rank E : ℤ) : ℚ)) * P.cls ^ 3 from by
    rw [map_mul]]
  rw [show algebraMap ℚ A (β ^ 2 / 2) * V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2
      = algebraMap ℚ A (β ^ 2 / 2) * (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2) from by ring]
  rw [show algebraMap ℚ A (-β) * V.chComp E 2 * P.cls ^ 1
      = algebraMap ℚ A (-β) * (V.chComp E 2 * P.cls) from by ring]
  rw [show V.chComp E 3 * P.cls ^ 0 = V.chComp E 3 from by ring]
  rw [NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul, NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul,
    NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.toNumClass_deg0
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNumClass_deg0 (E : N) :
    (toNumClass V P E).deg0 = ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.toNumClass_deg1
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNumClass_deg1 (E : N) :
    (toNumClass V P E).deg1 = ((V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.toNumClass_deg2
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNumClass_deg2 (E : N) :
    (toNumClass V P E).deg2 = ((V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * P.cls) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.toNumClass_deg3
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNumClass_deg3 (E : N) :
    (toNumClass V P E).deg3 = ((V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 3) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.toNumClass_add
statement:
theorem toNumClass_add (E F : N) :
    toNumClass V P (E + F) = toNumClass V P E + toNumClass V P F
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : V.chComp (E + F) 1 = V.chComp E 1 + V.chComp F 1 := V.chComp_add E F 1
  have h2 : V.chComp (E + F) 2 = V.chComp E 2 + V.chComp F 2 := V.chComp_add E F 2
  have h3 : V.chComp (E + F) 3 = V.chComp E 3 + V.chComp F 3 := V.chComp_add E F 3
  simp only [toNumClass, h1, h2, h3, add_mul, map_add, Prod.mk_add_mk, Prod.mk.injEq]
  push_cast
  exact ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring, by ring⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.toNumClassHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNumClassHom_apply (E : N) :
    toNumClassHom V P E = toNumClass V P E
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.wallChargeFamily_charge
statement:
@[simp] theorem wallChargeFamily_charge (p : ℝ × ℝ) (E : N) :
    (wallChargeFamily V P).charge p E =
      Wall.Threefold.charge p.1 p.2 (toNumClass V P E)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.betaTwist_toNumClass
statement:
theorem betaTwist_toNumClass (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    Wall.Threefold.betaTwist (β : ℝ) (toNumClass V P E) =
      (((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ),
        ((degH1Beta V P β E : ℚ) : ℝ),
        ((degH2Beta V P β E : ℚ) : ℝ),
        ((deg3Beta V P β E : ℚ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [degH1Beta_eq, degH2Beta_eq, deg3Beta_eq]
  simp only [Wall.Threefold.betaTwist, toNumClass_deg0, toNumClass_deg1,
    toNumClass_deg2, toNumClass_deg3, Prod.mk.injEq]
  push_cast
  exact ⟨trivial, by ring, by ring, by ring⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.discr_betaTwist_toNumClass
statement:
theorem discr_betaTwist_toNumClass (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    Wall.Threefold.discr (Wall.Threefold.betaTwist (β : ℝ) (toNumClass V P E)) =
      ((discrHBeta V P E : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [betaTwist_toNumClass, ← discrHBeta_beta_inert V P β E, degH1Beta, degH2Beta]
  simp only [Wall.Threefold.discr, Wall.Threefold.NumClass.deg0,
    Wall.Threefold.NumClass.deg1, Wall.Threefold.NumClass.deg2]
  push_cast
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.Q_toNumClass
statement:
theorem Q_toNumClass (α β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    Wall.Threefold.Q (α : ℝ) (β : ℝ) (toNumClass V P E) = ((Q V P α β E : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Wall.Threefold.Q, discr_betaTwist_toNumClass, betaTwist_toNumClass,
    Threefold.Q, ← discrHBeta_beta_inert V P β E, degH1Beta, degH2Beta]
  simp only [Wall.Threefold.NumClass.deg1, Wall.Threefold.NumClass.deg2,
    Wall.Threefold.NumClass.deg3]
  push_cast
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.nu_toNumClass
statement:
theorem nu_toNumClass (α β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    Wall.Threefold.nu (α : ℝ) (β : ℝ) (toNumClass V P E) = ((nu V P α β E : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Wall.Threefold.nu, betaTwist_toNumClass, Threefold.nu]
  simp only [Wall.Threefold.NumClass.deg1, Wall.Threefold.NumClass.deg2,
    toNumClass_deg0]
  push_cast
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.Q_toNumClass_nonneg
statement:
theorem Q_toNumClass_nonneg (B : BMTData V P) {α β : ℚ} {E : N} (hα : 0 < α)
    (hE : B.TiltSemistable α β E) :
    0 ≤ Wall.Threefold.Q (α : ℝ) (β : ℝ) (toNumClass V P E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q_toNumClass]
  exact_mod_cast B.nonneg α β E hα hE

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarised.surface_toNumClass_eq
statement:
theorem surface_toNumClass_eq (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)
    (P : Polarization V.ring) (E : N) :
    Surface.toNumClass V P E =
      (hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 2 E 0, hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 2 E 1,
        hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 2 E 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 2 E 0 =
      ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) * (V.rank E : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    show ((V.ring.degree (corrComp V (unitCorr A) E 0 * P.cls ^ (2 - 0)) : ℚ) : ℝ) = _
    rw [hDegrees_zero V P E, mul_comm]
  have h1 : hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 2 E 1 = ((degH V P E : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    show ((V.ring.degree (corrComp V (unitCorr A) E 1 * P.cls ^ (2 - 1)) : ℚ) : ℝ) = _
    rw [corrComp_unitCorr]
    rfl
  have h2 : hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 2 E 2 =
      ((V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    show ((V.ring.degree (corrComp V (unitCorr A) E 2 * P.cls ^ (2 - 2)) : ℚ) : ℝ) = _
    rw [corrComp_unitCorr]
    norm_num
  rw [h0, h1, h2]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarised.threefold_toNumClass_eq
statement:
theorem threefold_toNumClass_eq (V : NumericalVarietyData 3 A N)
    (P : Polarization V.ring) (E : N) :
    Threefold.toNumClass V P E =
      (hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 3 E 0, hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 3 E 1,
        hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 3 E 2, hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 3 E 3)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 3 E 0 =
      ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    show ((V.ring.degree (corrComp V (unitCorr A) E 0 * P.cls ^ (3 - 0)) : ℚ) : ℝ) = _
    rw [hDegrees_zero V P E, mul_comm]
  have h1 : hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 3 E 1 =
      ((V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    show ((V.ring.degree (corrComp V (unitCorr A) E 1 * P.cls ^ (3 - 1)) : ℚ) : ℝ) = _
    rw [corrComp_unitCorr]
  have h2 : hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 3 E 2 =
      ((V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * P.cls) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    show ((V.ring.degree (corrComp V (unitCorr A) E 2 * P.cls ^ (3 - 2)) : ℚ) : ℝ) = _
    rw [corrComp_unitCorr]
    norm_num
  have h3 : hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 3 E 3 =
      ((V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 3) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    show ((V.ring.degree (corrComp V (unitCorr A) E 3 * P.cls ^ (3 - 3)) : ℚ) : ℝ) = _
    rw [corrComp_unitCorr]
    norm_num
  rw [h0, h1, h2, h3]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarised.surfaceVec_toNumClass
statement:
theorem surfaceVec_toNumClass (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)
    (P : Polarization V.ring) (E : N) :
    surfaceVec (Surface.toNumClass V P E) = hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 2 E
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  rw [surface_toNumClass_eq V P E]
  fin_cases k <;> simp [surfaceVec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarised.surface_wallChargeFamily_eq
statement:
theorem surface_wallChargeFamily_eq (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)
    (P : Polarization V.ring) :
    Surface.wallChargeFamily V P =
      (wallChargeFamily V P (unitCorr A) 2).reindex Exp.stChart
proof:
:= by
  apply ChargeFamily.ext
  intro p
  ext E
  rw [Surface.wallChargeFamily_charge, stCharge_eq_exp]
  show _ = Exp.charge 2 (Exp.stChart p) (hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) 2 E)
  rw [← surfaceVec_toNumClass V P E]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.rankOneParameters_B
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rankOneParameters_B (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (R.rankOneParameters P p).B = p.1 • R.realizePolarization P
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.rankOneParameters_omega
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rankOneParameters_omega (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (R.rankOneParameters P p).omega = p.2 • R.realizePolarization P
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.pair_realizePolarization_chOne
statement:
theorem pair_realizePolarization_chOne (E : N) :
    R.divisorSpace.pair (R.realizePolarization P) (R.chernCharacter.chOne E) =
      ((degH V P E : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  change R.divisorSpace.pair
      (R.divisorClass ⟨P.cls, P.cls_mem⟩)
      (R.divisorClass ⟨V.chComp E 1, V.chComp_mem E 1⟩) = _
  rw [R.intersection_eq]
  unfold degH
  rw [show (2 : ℕ) - 1 = 1 from rfl, pow_one, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.pair_realizePolarization_self
statement:
theorem pair_realizePolarization_self :
    R.divisorSpace.pair (R.realizePolarization P) (R.realizePolarization P) =

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.wallChargeFamily_charge_eq_centralCharge
statement:
theorem wallChargeFamily_charge_eq_centralCharge (p : ℝ × ℝ) (E : N) :
    (wallChargeFamily V P).charge p E =
      R.chernCharacter.centralCharge R.divisorSpace (R.rankOneParameters P p) E
proof:
:= by
  rw [wallChargeFamily_charge, rankOneParameters,
    ChernCharacter.centralCharge_rankOne_eq]
  apply Complex.ext
  · rw [Wall.stCharge_re, ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge_re]
    simp only [ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_chTwo,
      ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_hyperplaneSquare,
      ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_rank, ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_chTwo,
      ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_degree, ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_rank,
      ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_hyperplaneSquare, chernCharacter_rank,
      chernCharacter_chTwo, R.pair_realizePolarization_chOne,
      R.pair_realizePolarization_self, Wall.reZ, toNumClass_rk, toNumClass_deg,
      toNumClass_ch2]
    push_cast
    ring
  · rw [Wall.stCharge_im, ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge_im]
    simp only [ChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar_degree,
      ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_degree,
      ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_rank, ChernCharacter.coordinatesAt_hyperplaneSquare,
      chernCharacter_rank, R.pair_realizePolarization_chOne,
      R.pair_realizePolarization_self, Wall.imZ, toNumClass_rk, toNumClass_deg]
    push_cast
    ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.degH_k3
statement:
theorem degH_k3 (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (E : SurfaceNum) :
    degH (k3NumericalVariety d) (k3Polarization d hd) E = 2 * (d : ℚ) * (E 1 : ℚ)
proof:

      (algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (k3ChCoeff E 1) * H * H ^ 1) = _

    NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul, surfaceDegree_Hsq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.discrHBeta_eq_selfPairing
statement:
theorem discrHBeta_eq_selfPairing (E : N) :
    discrHBeta V P E
      = Mukai.selfPairing (LinearMap.mul ℚ ℚ)
          (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ), degH1Beta V P 0 E,
            degH2Beta V P 0 E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Mukai.selfPairing_mk, discrHBeta]
  show _ = degH1Beta V P 0 E * degH1Beta V P 0 E
    - 2 * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ) * degH2Beta V P 0 E)
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.degH1Beta_zero_beta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degH1Beta_zero_beta (E : N) :
    degH1Beta V P 0 E = V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [degH1Beta, chBetaComp_zero_beta]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.degH2Beta_zero_beta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degH2Beta_zero_beta (E : N) :
    degH2Beta V P 0 E = V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * P.cls)
proof:
:= by
  rw [degH2Beta, chBetaComp_zero_beta]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.deg3Beta_zero_beta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem deg3Beta_zero_beta (E : N) :
    deg3Beta V P 0 E = V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [deg3Beta, chBetaComp_zero_beta]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.degH1Beta_eq_sub
statement:
theorem degH1Beta_eq_sub (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    degH1Beta V P β E
      = degH1Beta V P 0 E - β * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  have key : chBetaComp V P β E 1 * P.cls ^ 2
      = algebraMap ℚ A (-(β * (V.rank E : ℚ))) * P.cls ^ 3
        + V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2 := by
    rw [chBetaComp_eq, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one, V.chComp_zero]
    norm_num [twistCoeff, Nat.factorial, map_neg, map_mul]
    ring
  rw [degH1Beta, key, map_add, NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul,
    degH1Beta_zero_beta]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.degH2Beta_eq_sub
statement:
theorem degH2Beta_eq_sub (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    degH2Beta V P β E
      = degH2Beta V P 0 E - β * degH1Beta V P 0 E
        + β ^ 2 / 2 * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  have key : chBetaComp V P β E 2 * P.cls
      = algebraMap ℚ A (β ^ 2 / 2 * (V.rank E : ℚ)) * P.cls ^ 3
        + algebraMap ℚ A (-β) * (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2)
        + V.chComp E 2 * P.cls := by
    rw [chBetaComp_eq, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
      Finset.sum_range_one, V.chComp_zero]
    norm_num [twistCoeff, Nat.factorial, map_neg, map_mul]
    ring
  rw [degH2Beta, key, map_add, map_add, NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul,
    NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul, degH2Beta_zero_beta, degH1Beta_zero_beta]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.discrHBeta_beta_inert
statement:
theorem discrHBeta_beta_inert (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    (degH1Beta V P β E) ^ 2
        - 2 * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ)) * (degH2Beta V P β E)
      = discrHBeta V P E
proof:
:= by
  rw [discrHBeta, degH1Beta_eq_sub V P β E, degH2Beta_eq_sub V P β E]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.discrHBeta_zero_beta
statement:
theorem discrHBeta_zero_beta (E : N) :
    discrHBeta V P E
      = (V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2)) ^ 2
        - 2 * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ))
          * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * P.cls)
proof:
:= by
  rw [discrHBeta, degH1Beta_zero_beta, degH2Beta_zero_beta]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.Q_zero_beta
statement:
theorem Q_zero_beta (α : ℚ) (E : N) :
    Q V P α 0 E
      = α ^ 2 * ((V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2)) ^ 2
          - 2 * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ))
            * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * P.cls))
        + 4 * (V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * P.cls)) ^ 2
        - 6 * (V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * P.cls ^ 2))
          * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q, discrHBeta_zero_beta, degH1Beta_zero_beta, degH2Beta_zero_beta, deg3Beta_zero_beta]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.nu_zero_alpha
statement:
theorem nu_zero_alpha (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    nu V P 0 β E = degH2Beta V P β E / degH1Beta V P β E
proof:
:= by
  rw [nu]
  norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.Q_zero_alpha
statement:
theorem Q_zero_alpha (β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    Q V P 0 β E
      = 4 * (degH2Beta V P β E) ^ 2 - 6 * (degH1Beta V P β E) * (deg3Beta V P β E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.pair_chOne_self

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.barDiscriminant_rankOneParameters
statement:
theorem barDiscriminant_rankOneParameters (p : ℝ × ℝ) (E : N) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.barDiscriminant_rankOneParameters_nonneg
statement:
theorem barDiscriminant_rankOneParameters_nonneg {E : N} (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.chernCharacter_chOne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.twist_chOne_eq
statement:
theorem twist_chOne_eq (B : BField V.ring) (E : N) :
    (R.chernCharacter.twist R.divisorSpace (R.realizeBField B)).chOne E =
      R.divisorClass ⟨chBComp V B E 1, chBComp_mem V B E 1⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [ChernCharacter.twist_chOne]
  change R.divisorClass ⟨V.chComp E 1, V.chComp_mem E 1⟩ -
      (V.rank E : ℝ) • R.divisorClass ⟨B.cls, B.cls_mem⟩ =
    R.divisorClass ⟨chBComp V B E 1, chBComp_mem V B E 1⟩
  have htwist :
      (⟨chBComp V B E 1, chBComp_mem V B E 1⟩ : V.ring.piece 1) =
        ⟨V.chComp E 1, V.chComp_mem E 1⟩ -
          (V.rank E : ℚ) • ⟨B.cls, B.cls_mem⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change chBComp V B E 1 =
      V.chComp E 1 - (V.rank E : ℚ) • B.cls
    rw [chBComp_one, V.chComp_zero]
    rw [Algebra.smul_def]
  rw [htwist, map_sub]
  have hcast : (((V.rank E : ℤ) : ℚ) : ℝ) = (V.rank E : ℝ) := by
    norm_cast
  rw [R.map_rat_smul, hcast]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.twist_chTwo_eq
statement:
theorem twist_chTwo_eq (B : BField V.ring) (E : N) :
    (R.chernCharacter.twist R.divisorSpace (R.realizeBField B)).chTwo E =
      ((V.ring.degree (chBComp V B E 2) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ChernCharacter.twist_chTwo]
  simp only [chernCharacter_chTwo, chernCharacter_chOne, chernCharacter_rank,
    realizeBField]
  rw [R.intersection_eq, R.intersection_eq, chBComp_two, V.chComp_zero,
    map_add, map_sub]
  have hcomm : B.cls * V.chComp E 1 = V.chComp E 1 * B.cls := by ring
  rw [hcomm]
  have hquadratic :
      algebraMap ℚ A (1 / 2) * algebraMap ℚ A (V.rank E : ℚ) * B.cls ^ 2 =
        algebraMap ℚ A ((1 / 2) * (V.rank E : ℚ)) * B.cls ^ 2 := by
    rw [map_mul]
  rw [hquadratic, NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul, ← pow_two]
  push_cast
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.parameters_omega_square
statement:
theorem parameters_omega_square (P : Polarization V.ring)
    (B : BField V.ring) (a : ℝ) :
    R.divisorSpace.pair (R.parameters P B a).omega (R.parameters P B a).omega =
      a ^ 2 * ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 2) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  change R.divisorSpace.pair
      (a • R.divisorClass ⟨P.cls, P.cls_mem⟩)
      (a • R.divisorClass ⟨P.cls, P.cls_mem⟩) = _
  have hpair := R.intersection_eq
    (⟨P.cls, P.cls_mem⟩ : V.ring.piece 1) ⟨P.cls, P.cls_mem⟩
  change R.divisorSpace.intersection
      (R.divisorClass ⟨P.cls, P.cls_mem⟩)
      (R.divisorClass ⟨P.cls, P.cls_mem⟩) = _ at hpair
  simp only [DivisorSpace.pair, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hpair]
  simp only [pow_two]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.parameters_pair_twist_chOne
statement:
theorem parameters_pair_twist_chOne (P : Polarization V.ring)
    (B : BField V.ring) (a : ℝ) (E : N) :
    R.divisorSpace.pair (R.parameters P B a).omega
        ((R.chernCharacter.twist R.divisorSpace (R.realizeBField B)).chOne E) =
      a * ((V.ring.degree (chBComp V B E 1 * P.cls) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.twist_chOne_eq]
  change R.divisorSpace.pair
      (a • R.divisorClass ⟨P.cls, P.cls_mem⟩)
      (R.divisorClass ⟨chBComp V B E 1, chBComp_mem V B E 1⟩) = _
  have hpair := R.intersection_eq
    (⟨P.cls, P.cls_mem⟩ : V.ring.piece 1)
    ⟨chBComp V B E 1, chBComp_mem V B E 1⟩
  change R.divisorSpace.intersection
      (R.divisorClass ⟨P.cls, P.cls_mem⟩)
      (R.divisorClass ⟨chBComp V B E 1, chBComp_mem V B E 1⟩) = _ at hpair
  simp only [DivisorSpace.pair, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hpair]
  rw [mul_comm P.cls (chBComp V B E 1)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.centralCharge_eq_ofNumericalDataB
statement:
theorem centralCharge_eq_ofNumericalDataB
    (P : Polarization V.ring) (B : BField V.ring) (a : ℝ) (E : N) :
    R.chernCharacter.centralCharge R.divisorSpace (R.parameters P B a) E =
      (ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalDataB V P B).centralCharge a E
proof:
:= by
  rw [ChernCharacter.centralCharge_apply_twisted,
    ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge_apply]
  rw [show (R.parameters P B a).B = R.realizeBField B from rfl]
  rw [R.twist_chTwo_eq,
    R.parameters_omega_square, R.parameters_pair_twist_chOne]
  simp only [ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalDataB_rank,
    ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalDataB_degree,
    ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalDataB_chTwo,
    ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalDataB_hyperplaneSquare,
    chernCharacter_rank]
  push_cast
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarised.corrComp_unitCorr
statement:
theorem corrComp_unitCorr (V : NumericalVarietyData n A N) (E : N) (k : ℕ) :
    corrComp V (unitCorr A) E k = V.chComp E k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [corrComp, Finset.sum_eq_single k]
  · simp [unitCorr]
  · intro j hj hjk
    have hj' : j < k + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
    have : k - j ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp [unitCorr, this]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.self_mem_range_succ k) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarised.corrComp_sqrtToddComp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarised.corrComp_add

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarised.hDegrees_zero
statement:
theorem hDegrees_zero (V : NumericalVarietyData n A N) (P : Polarization V.ring)
    (E : N) :
    V.ring.degree (corrComp V (unitCorr A) E 0 * P.cls ^ (n - 0))
      = (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : corrComp V (unitCorr A) E 0 = algebraMap ℚ A (V.rank E : ℚ) := by
    rw [corrComp_unitCorr, V.chComp_zero]
  rw [hc, Nat.sub_zero, NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarised.hDegrees_one
statement:
theorem hDegrees_one (V : NumericalVarietyData n A N) (P : Polarization V.ring)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (E : N) :
    hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) n E ⟨1, by omega⟩ = ((degH V P E : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  show ((V.ring.degree (corrComp V (unitCorr A) E 1 * P.cls ^ (n - 1)) : ℚ) : ℝ) = _
  rw [corrComp_unitCorr]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarised.ratio_aux
statement: private theorem ratio_aux (d D r : ℝ) (hD : D ≠ 0) : d / r = D * (d / (r * D))
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne r 0 with h | h
  · simp [h]
  · field_simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarised.slopeH_eq_degree_mul_ratio
statement:
theorem slopeH_eq_degree_mul_ratio (V : NumericalVarietyData n A N)
    (P : Polarization V.ring) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (E : N) :
    ((slopeH V P E : ℚ) : ℝ)
      = ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ n) : ℚ) : ℝ)
          * (hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) n E ⟨1, by omega⟩
              / hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) n E ⟨0, by omega⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ n) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast P.degree_pow_pos
  have h1 := hDegrees_one V P hn E
  have h0 : hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) n E ⟨0, by omega⟩
      = ((V.rank E : ℚ) : ℝ) * ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ n) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    show ((V.ring.degree (corrComp V (unitCorr A) E 0 * P.cls ^ (n - 0)) : ℚ) : ℝ) = _
    rw [hDegrees_zero V P E]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [h0, h1, slopeH, Rat.cast_div]
  exact ratio_aux _ _ _ (ne_of_gt hD)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Polarised.slopeH_ne_ratio_of_degree_ne_one
statement:
theorem slopeH_ne_ratio_of_degree_ne_one (V : NumericalVarietyData n A N)
    (P : Polarization V.ring) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (E : N)
    (hdeg : V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ n) ≠ 1) (hne : slopeH V P E ≠ 0) :
    ((slopeH V P E : ℚ) : ℝ)
      ≠ hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) n E ⟨1, by omega⟩
          / hDegrees V P (unitCorr A) n E ⟨0, by omega⟩
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ n) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast P.degree_pow_pos
  have key := slopeH_eq_degree_mul_ratio V P hn E
  rw [← h] at key
  have hs : ((slopeH V P E : ℚ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast hne
  have hcancel : ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ n) : ℚ) : ℝ) * ((slopeH V P E : ℚ) : ℝ)
      = 1 * ((slopeH V P E : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [one_mul]
    exact key.symm
  have hone : ((V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ n) : ℚ) : ℝ) = 1 := mul_right_cancel₀ hs hcancel
  exact hdeg (by exact_mod_cast hone)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.pair_realizePolarization_divisorClass
statement:
theorem pair_realizePolarization_divisorClass (x : V.ring.piece 1) :
    R.divisorSpace.pair (R.realizePolarization P) (R.divisorClass x)
      = ((V.ring.degree (P.cls * x.1) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  change R.divisorSpace.pair
      (R.divisorClass ⟨P.cls, P.cls_mem⟩) (R.divisorClass x) = _
  rw [R.intersection_eq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.pair_realizePolarization_add_smul
statement:
theorem pair_realizePolarization_add_smul (x y : V.ring.piece 1) (r : ℝ) :
    R.divisorSpace.pair (R.realizePolarization P)
        (R.divisorClass x + r • R.divisorClass y)
      = ((V.ring.degree (P.cls * x.1) : ℚ) : ℝ)
        + r * ((V.ring.degree (P.cls * y.1) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [DivisorSpace.pair_apply, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
    ← DivisorSpace.pair_apply, ← DivisorSpace.pair_apply,
    R.pair_realizePolarization_divisorClass P x,
    R.pair_realizePolarization_divisorClass P y]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.hDegrees_sqrtToddComp_eq_mukaiVector
statement:
theorem hDegrees_sqrtToddComp_eq_mukaiVector (E : N) :
    Polarised.hDegrees V P V.sqrtToddComp 2 E
      = ![R.divisorSpace.pair (R.realizePolarization P) (R.realizePolarization P)
            * (R.chernCharacter.mukaiVector R.divisorSpace (R.sqrtTodd (V := V)) E).1,
          R.divisorSpace.pair (R.realizePolarization P)
            (R.chernCharacter.mukaiVector R.divisorSpace (R.sqrtTodd (V := V)) E).2.1,
          (R.chernCharacter.mukaiVector R.divisorSpace (R.sqrtTodd (V := V)) E).2.2]
proof:
:= by
  have hsq := R.pair_realizePolarization_self P
  funext k
  fin_cases k
  · 
    show ((V.ring.degree (Polarised.corrComp V V.sqrtToddComp E 0 * P.cls ^ (2 - 0)) : ℚ) : ℝ)
      = _
    rw [Polarised.corrComp_sqrtToddComp, V.mukaiComp_zero,
      NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul]
    simp only [ChernCharacter.mukaiVector_apply, chernCharacter_rank, hsq]
    push_cast
    ring
  · 
    show ((V.ring.degree (Polarised.corrComp V V.sqrtToddComp E 1 * P.cls ^ (2 - 1)) : ℚ) : ℝ)
      = _
    have hmu : Polarised.corrComp V V.sqrtToddComp E 1
        = algebraMap ℚ A (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.sqrtToddComp 1 + V.chComp E 1 := by
      rw [Polarised.corrComp_sqrtToddComp, NumericalVarietyData.mukaiComp,
        Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one, V.chComp_zero,
        V.sqrtToddComp_zero, mul_one]
    simp only [ChernCharacter.mukaiVector_apply, chernCharacter_rank,
      chernCharacter_chOne, sqrtTodd_divisor]
    rw [R.pair_realizePolarization_add_smul P, hmu, pow_one, add_mul, map_add,
      mul_assoc, NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul,
      show V.sqrtToddComp 1 * P.cls = P.cls * V.sqrtToddComp 1 from by ring,
      show V.chComp E 1 * P.cls = P.cls * V.chComp E 1 from by ring]
    push_cast
    ring
  · 
    show ((V.ring.degree (Polarised.corrComp V V.sqrtToddComp E 2 * P.cls ^ (2 - 2)) : ℚ) : ℝ)
      = _
    have hmu : Polarised.corrComp V V.sqrtToddComp E 2
        = algebraMap ℚ A (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.sqrtToddComp 2
          + V.chComp E 1 * V.sqrtToddComp 1 + V.chComp E 2 := by
      rw [Polarised.corrComp_sqrtToddComp, NumericalVarietyData.mukaiComp,
        Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one,
        V.chComp_zero, V.sqrtToddComp_zero, mul_one]
    simp only [ChernCharacter.mukaiVector_apply, chernCharacter_rank, chernCharacter_chOne,
      chernCharacter_chTwo, sqrtTodd_divisor, sqrtTodd_number]
    rw [pow_zero, mul_one, hmu, map_add, map_add,
      NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul]
    show _ = ((V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2) : ℚ) : ℝ)
        + R.divisorSpace.pair
            (R.divisorClass ⟨V.sqrtToddComp 1, V.sqrtToddComp_mem 1⟩)
            (R.divisorClass ⟨V.chComp E 1, V.chComp_mem E 1⟩)
        + (V.rank E : ℝ) * ((V.ring.degree (V.sqrtToddComp 2) : ℚ) : ℝ)
    rw [R.intersection_eq,
      show V.chComp E 1 * V.sqrtToddComp 1 = V.sqrtToddComp 1 * V.chComp E 1 from by ring]
    push_cast
    ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.wallChargeFamily_sqrtToddComp_eq_mukaiCharge
statement:
theorem wallChargeFamily_sqrtToddComp_eq_mukaiCharge (p : ℝ × ℝ) (E : N) :
    (Polarised.wallChargeFamily V P V.sqrtToddComp 2).charge (Wall.Exp.stChart p) E
      = R.chernCharacter.mukaiCharge R.divisorSpace (R.sqrtTodd (V := V))
          (R.rankOneParameters P p) E
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polarised.wallChargeFamily_charge, ChernCharacter.mukaiCharge_apply,
    rankOneParameters, expCharge_rankOne_eq_charge,
    ← R.hDegrees_sqrtToddComp_eq_mukaiVector P E]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.wallChargeFamily_sqrtToddComp_eq_mukaiCharge_k3
statement:
theorem wallChargeFamily_sqrtToddComp_eq_mukaiCharge_k3 (hK3 : K3.IsK3 V)
    (p : ℝ × ℝ) (E : N) :
    (Polarised.wallChargeFamily V P V.sqrtToddComp 2).charge (Wall.Exp.stChart p) E
      = R.chernCharacter.centralCharge R.divisorSpace (R.rankOneParameters P p) E
        - Complex.ofReal ((V.rank E : ℤ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.wallChargeFamily_sqrtToddComp_eq_mukaiCharge P p E,
    R.mukaiCharge_of_isK3 hK3]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.hDegrees_sqrtToddComp_k3
statement:
theorem hDegrees_sqrtToddComp_k3 {V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N}
    (P : Polarization V.ring) (hK3 : K3.IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    Polarised.hDegrees V P V.sqrtToddComp 2 E
      = Polarised.hDegrees V P (Polarised.unitCorr A) 2 E
        + ![0, 0, (((V.rank E : ℤ) : ℚ) : ℝ)]
proof:
:= by
  have hone : V.sqrtToddComp 1 = 0 := K3.sqrtToddComp_one hK3
  funext k
  fin_cases k
  · show ((V.ring.degree (Polarised.corrComp V V.sqrtToddComp E 0 * P.cls ^ (2 - 0)) : ℚ) : ℝ)
      = ((V.ring.degree (Polarised.corrComp V (Polarised.unitCorr A) E 0
          * P.cls ^ (2 - 0)) : ℚ) : ℝ) + _
    rw [Polarised.corrComp_sqrtToddComp, Polarised.corrComp_unitCorr, V.mukaiComp_zero,
      V.chComp_zero]
    show _ = _ + (0 : ℝ)
    rw [add_zero]
  · have hmu : Polarised.corrComp V V.sqrtToddComp E 1 = V.chComp E 1 := by
      rw [Polarised.corrComp_sqrtToddComp, NumericalVarietyData.mukaiComp,
        Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one, V.sqrtToddComp_zero, mul_one,
        show (1 : ℕ) - 0 = 1 from rfl, hone, mul_zero, zero_add]
    show ((V.ring.degree (Polarised.corrComp V V.sqrtToddComp E 1 * P.cls ^ (2 - 1)) : ℚ) : ℝ)
      = ((V.ring.degree (Polarised.corrComp V (Polarised.unitCorr A) E 1
          * P.cls ^ (2 - 1)) : ℚ) : ℝ) + _
    rw [hmu, Polarised.corrComp_unitCorr]
    show _ = _ + (0 : ℝ)
    rw [add_zero]
  · have hmu : Polarised.corrComp V V.sqrtToddComp E 2
        = algebraMap ℚ A (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.sqrtToddComp 2 + V.chComp E 2 := by
      rw [Polarised.corrComp_sqrtToddComp, NumericalVarietyData.mukaiComp,
        Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one,
        V.chComp_zero, V.sqrtToddComp_zero, mul_one,
        show (2 : ℕ) - 1 = 1 from rfl, hone, mul_zero, add_zero]
    show ((V.ring.degree (Polarised.corrComp V V.sqrtToddComp E 2 * P.cls ^ (2 - 2)) : ℚ) : ℝ)
      = ((V.ring.degree (Polarised.corrComp V (Polarised.unitCorr A) E 2
          * P.cls ^ (2 - 2)) : ℚ) : ℝ) + _
    rw [hmu, Polarised.corrComp_unitCorr, pow_zero, mul_one, mul_one, map_add,
      NumericalRingData.degree_algebraMap_mul, K3.degree_sqrtToddComp_two hK3, mul_one]
    show ((_ + _ : ℚ) : ℝ) = _ + (((V.rank E : ℤ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
    push_cast
    ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.wallChargeFamily_sqrtToddComp_sub_unitCorr_k3
statement:
theorem wallChargeFamily_sqrtToddComp_sub_unitCorr_k3
    {V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N} (P : Polarization V.ring) (hK3 : K3.IsK3 V)
    (p : ℝ × ℝ) (E : N) :
    (Polarised.wallChargeFamily V P V.sqrtToddComp 2).charge (Wall.Exp.stChart p) E
      = (wallChargeFamily V P).charge p E - (((V.rank E : ℤ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hrank : (Wall.Exp.charge 2 (Wall.Exp.stChart p))
      ![0, 0, (((V.rank E : ℤ) : ℚ) : ℝ)] = -((((V.rank E : ℤ) : ℚ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Wall.Exp.charge_apply, Wall.Exp.ofMoments]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one]
    norm_num [Wall.Exp.moments, Wall.Exp.coeff, Nat.factorial]
  rw [Polarised.surface_wallChargeFamily_eq V P, Wall.ChargeFamily.reindex_charge,
    Polarised.wallChargeFamily_charge, Polarised.wallChargeFamily_charge,
    hDegrees_sqrtToddComp_k3 P hK3 E, map_add, hrank]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.tiltFamily_im_toNumClass
statement:
theorem tiltFamily_im_toNumClass (α β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    Wall.Tilt.tiltFamily.im ((α : ℝ), (β : ℝ)) (toNumClass V P E)
      = ((α * degH1Beta V P β E : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Wall.Tilt.tiltFamily_im, betaTwist_toNumClass]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.tiltFamily_re_toNumClass
statement:
theorem tiltFamily_re_toNumClass (α β : ℚ) (E : N) :
    Wall.Tilt.tiltFamily.re ((α : ℝ), (β : ℝ)) (toNumClass V P E)
      = -((degH2Beta V P β E
            - (α ^ 2 / 2) * (V.ring.degree (P.cls ^ 3) * (V.rank E : ℚ)) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Wall.Tilt.tiltFamily_re, betaTwist_toNumClass, toNumClass_deg0]
  simp only [Wall.Threefold.NumClass.deg2]
  push_cast
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.nu_eq_tiltFamily_slope
statement:
theorem nu_eq_tiltFamily_slope (α β : ℚ) (E : N)
    (h : 0 < α * degH1Beta V P β E) :
    ((nu V P α β E : ℚ) : ℝ)
      = (α : ℝ)
          * (-(Wall.Tilt.tiltFamily.re ((α : ℝ), (β : ℝ)) (toNumClass V P E))
              / Wall.Tilt.tiltFamily.im ((α : ℝ), (β : ℝ)) (toNumClass V P E))
proof:
:= by
  have him : 0 < Wall.Tilt.tiltFamily.im ((α : ℝ), (β : ℝ)) (toNumClass V P E) := by
    rw [tiltFamily_im_toNumClass]
    exact_mod_cast h
  rw [← nu_toNumClass V P α β E]
  exact Wall.Tilt.nu_eq_tilt_slope (α : ℝ) (β : ℝ) (toNumClass V P E) him

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.chargeSlope_tiltFamily_toNumClass
statement:
theorem chargeSlope_tiltFamily_toNumClass (α β : ℚ) (E : N)
    (h : 0 < α * degH1Beta V P β E) :
    CategoryTheory.Triangulated.chargeSlope
        (Wall.Tilt.tiltFamily.charge ((α : ℝ), (β : ℝ)) (toNumClass V P E))
      = (((nu V P α β E : ℚ) / (α : ℝ) : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have him : 0 < Wall.Tilt.tiltFamily.im ((α : ℝ), (β : ℝ)) (toNumClass V P E) := by
    rw [tiltFamily_im_toNumClass]
    exact_mod_cast h
  rw [Wall.Tilt.chargeSlope_tilt (α : ℝ) (β : ℝ) (toNumClass V P E) him,
    nu_toNumClass V P α β E]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.hodgeIndexStatement_of_hodgeDefinite

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.discriminantC_nonneg_of_semistable
statement:
theorem discriminantC_nonneg_of_semistable {E : N} (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)
    (hE : B.Semistable E) (Q : StabilityParameters D) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    0 ≤ R.chernCharacter.discriminantC R.divisorSpace Q C E
proof:
:=
  le_trans (R.discriminant_nonneg_of_semistable P B hE)
    (ChernCharacter.discriminant_le_discriminantC _ _ Q hC E)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.hasQuadraticSupportProperty_semistable
statement:
theorem hasQuadraticSupportProperty_semistable (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)
    (Q : StabilityParameters D) (hω : R.divisorSpace.HodgeDefinite Q.omega)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    Support.HasQuadraticSupportProperty (R.divisorSpace.realCentralCharge Q)
      (R.chernCharacter.toRealExtension '' {E : N | B.Semistable E})
proof:
:=
  R.chernCharacter.hasQuadraticSupportProperty_image R.divisorSpace Q hω C _
    fun _ hE => R.discriminantC_nonneg_of_semistable P B hE Q hC

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.NumericalRealization.hasSupportProperty_semistable
statement:
theorem hasSupportProperty_semistable (B : BogomolovGiesekerData V P)

    Support.HasSupportProperty (R.divisorSpace.realCentralCharge Q)
      (R.chernCharacter.toRealExtension '' {E : N | B.Semistable E})
proof:
:=
  (R.hasQuadraticSupportProperty_semistable P B Q hω hC).hasSupportProperty

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Threefold.chi_eq
statement:
theorem chi_eq (hV : V.SatisfiesHRR) (E : N) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ)
      = (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.toddComp 3)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.toddComp 2)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * V.toddComp 1)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 3)
proof:
:= by
  have h := V.chi_eq_sum hV E
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add] at h
  simp only [show (3 : ℕ) - 0 = 3 from rfl, show (3 : ℕ) - 1 = 2 from rfl,
    show (3 : ℕ) - 2 = 1 from rfl, show (3 : ℕ) - 3 = 0 from rfl] at h
  rw [h, V.chComp_zero, V.ring.degree_algebraMap_mul, V.toddComp_zero, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.CalabiYauThreefold.chi_eq
statement:
theorem chi_eq (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hCY : IsCalabiYau V) (E : N) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ)
      = V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.toddComp 2)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Threefold.chi_eq V hHRR E, hCY.toddComp_one, hCY.degree_toddComp_three]
  simp only [mul_zero, map_zero]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.CalabiYauThreefold.chi_eq_of_chComp_eq
statement:
theorem chi_eq_of_chComp_eq (E F : N)
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hCY : IsCalabiYau V)
    (h₁ : V.chComp E 1 = V.chComp F 1)
    (h₃ : V.chComp E 3 = V.chComp F 3) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ) = (V.chi F : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chi_eq V hHRR hCY E, chi_eq V hHRR hCY F, h₁, h₃]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.chi_eq
statement:
theorem chi_eq (hV : V.SatisfiesHRR) (E : N) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ)
      = (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.toddComp 2)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.toddComp 1)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := V.chi_eq_sum hV E
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add] at h
  simp only [show (2 : ℕ) - 0 = 2 from rfl, show (2 : ℕ) - 1 = 1 from rfl,
    show (2 : ℕ) - 2 = 0 from rfl] at h
  rw [h, V.chComp_zero, V.ring.degree_algebraMap_mul, V.toddComp_zero, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.discriminant_mem_piece_two
statement:
theorem discriminant_mem_piece_two (E : N) :
    V.discriminant E ∈ V.ring.piece 2
proof:
:= by
  exact V.discriminant_mem_piece_two E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.degree_discriminant
statement:
theorem degree_discriminant (E : N) :
    V.ring.degree (V.discriminant E)
      = V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.chComp E 1)
        - 2 * (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2)
proof:
:= by
  exact V.degree_discriminant E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Fourfold.chi_eq
statement:
theorem chi_eq (hV : V.SatisfiesHRR) (E : N) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ)
      = (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.toddComp 4)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.toddComp 3)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * V.toddComp 2)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 3 * V.toddComp 1)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 4)
proof:
:= by
  have h := V.chi_eq_sum hV E
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add] at h
  simp only [show (4 : ℕ) - 0 = 4 from rfl, show (4 : ℕ) - 1 = 3 from rfl,
    show (4 : ℕ) - 2 = 2 from rfl, show (4 : ℕ) - 3 = 1 from rfl,
    show (4 : ℕ) - 4 = 0 from rfl] at h
  rw [h, V.chComp_zero, V.ring.degree_algebraMap_mul, V.toddComp_zero, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.CalabiYauFourfold.chi_eq
statement:
theorem chi_eq (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hCY : IsCalabiYau V) (E : N) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ)
      = 2 * (V.rank E : ℚ)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2 * V.toddComp 2)
        + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 4)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fourfold.chi_eq V hHRR E, hCY.toddComp_one, hCY.toddComp_three,
    hCY.degree_toddComp_four]
  simp only [mul_zero, map_zero]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.mukaiSInt_spec
statement:
theorem mukaiSInt_spec (V : NumericalVarietyData 2 A N)
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    (mukaiSInt V E : ℚ) = mukaiS V E
proof:
:= by
  have h := chi_eq_rank_add_mukaiS V hHRR hK3 E
  rw [mukaiSInt]
  push_cast
  linarith

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.IntegralMukaiData.b_comm_on_realized
statement:
theorem b_comm_on_realized (E F : N) :
    D.b (D.c₁ E) (D.c₁ F) = D.b (D.c₁ F) (D.c₁ E)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (D.b (D.c₁ E) (D.c₁ F) : ℚ) = (D.b (D.c₁ F) (D.c₁ E) : ℚ) := by
    rw [D.b_spec, D.b_spec, mul_comm]
  exact_mod_cast h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.IntegralMukaiData.b_c₁_add
statement:
theorem b_c₁_add (E F G : N) :
    D.b (D.c₁ (E + F)) (D.c₁ G)
      = D.b (D.c₁ E) (D.c₁ G) + D.b (D.c₁ F) (D.c₁ G)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (D.b (D.c₁ (E + F)) (D.c₁ G) : ℚ)
      = (D.b (D.c₁ E) (D.c₁ G) : ℚ) + (D.b (D.c₁ F) (D.c₁ G) : ℚ) := by
    rw [D.b_spec, D.b_spec, D.b_spec, V.chComp_add, add_mul, map_add]
  exact_mod_cast h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.IntegralMukaiData.mukaiVector_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mukaiVector_fst (E : N) : (D.mukaiVector E).1 = V.rank E
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.IntegralMukaiData.mukaiVector_snd_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mukaiVector_snd_fst (E : N) : (D.mukaiVector E).2.1 = D.c₁ E
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.IntegralMukaiData.mukaiVector_snd_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mukaiVector_snd_snd (E : N) :
    (D.mukaiVector E).2.2 = mukaiSInt V E
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.IntegralMukaiData.pairing_mukaiVector
statement:
theorem pairing_mukaiVector (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :
    ((Mukai.pairing D.b (D.mukaiVector E) (D.mukaiVector F) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = mukaiPairing V E F
proof:
:= by
  rw [mukaiVector, mukaiVector, Mukai.pairing_mk, mukaiPairing]
  push_cast
  rw [D.b_spec, mukaiSInt_spec V hHRR hK3, mukaiSInt_spec V hHRR hK3]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.IntegralMukaiData.selfPairing_mukaiVector
statement:
theorem selfPairing_mukaiVector (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    ((Mukai.selfPairing D.b (D.mukaiVector E) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = mukaiSelfPairing V E
proof:
:= by
  rw [Mukai.selfPairing_eq_pairing, D.pairing_mukaiVector hHRR hK3,
    mukaiPairing_self V]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.IntegralMukaiData.chi₂_eq_neg_pairing
statement:
theorem chi₂_eq_neg_pairing (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :
    V.chi₂ E F
      = -((Mukai.pairing D.b (D.mukaiVector E) (D.mukaiVector F) : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.pairing_mukaiVector hHRR hK3, chi₂_eq_neg_mukaiPairing V hK3]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.IntegralMukaiData.selfPairing_mukaiVector_eq_neg_chi₂
statement:
theorem selfPairing_mukaiVector_eq_neg_chi₂
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    ((Mukai.selfPairing D.b (D.mukaiVector E) : ℤ) : ℚ) = -V.chi₂ E E
proof:
:= by
  rw [Mukai.selfPairing_eq_pairing, D.chi₂_eq_neg_pairing hHRR hK3]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.IntegralMukaiData.neg_two_le_selfPairing_mukaiVector_iff
statement:
theorem neg_two_le_selfPairing_mukaiVector_iff
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    -2 ≤ Mukai.selfPairing D.b (D.mukaiVector E) ↔ V.chi₂ E E ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← @Int.cast_le ℚ, D.selfPairing_mukaiVector_eq_neg_chi₂ hHRR hK3]
  push_cast
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.IntegralMukaiData.isSpherical_mukaiVector_iff
statement:
theorem isSpherical_mukaiVector_iff
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    Mukai.IsSpherical D.b (D.mukaiVector E) ↔ V.chi₂ E E = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Mukai.isSpherical_iff, ← @Int.cast_inj ℚ,
    D.selfPairing_mukaiVector_eq_neg_chi₂ hHRR hK3]
  push_cast
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.IntegralMukaiData.isIsotropic_mukaiVector_iff
statement:
theorem isIsotropic_mukaiVector_iff
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    Mukai.IsIsotropic D.b (D.mukaiVector E) ↔ V.chi₂ E E = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Mukai.isIsotropic_iff, ← @Int.cast_inj ℚ,
    D.selfPairing_mukaiVector_eq_neg_chi₂ hHRR hK3]
  push_cast
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.IntegralMukaiData.expectedDim_mukaiVector
statement:
theorem expectedDim_mukaiVector
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    (Mukai.expectedDim D.b (D.mukaiVector E) : ℚ) = 2 - V.chi₂ E E
proof:
:= by
  rw [Mukai.expectedDim]
  push_cast
  rw [D.selfPairing_mukaiVector_eq_neg_chi₂ hHRR hK3]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.c₁Hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem c₁Hom_apply (E : N) : D.c₁Hom E = D.c₁ E
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.mukaiVectorHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mukaiVectorHom_apply (E : N) :
    D.mukaiVectorHom E = D.toIntegralMukaiData.mukaiVector E
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.mukaiForm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mukaiForm_apply (E F : N) :
    D.mukaiForm E F = Mukai.pairing D.b (D.toIntegralMukaiData.mukaiVector E)
      (D.toIntegralMukaiData.mukaiVector F)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.mukaiForm_comm
statement: theorem mukaiForm_comm (E F : N) : D.mukaiForm E F = D.mukaiForm F E
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mukaiForm_apply, Mukai.pairing, IntegralMukaiData.mukaiVector]
  rw [D.toIntegralMukaiData.b_comm_on_realized E F]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.mukaiForm_eq_neg_chi₂
statement:
theorem mukaiForm_eq_neg_chi₂
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :
    (D.mukaiForm E F : ℚ) = -V.chi₂ E F
proof:
:= by
  rw [mukaiForm_apply,
    D.toIntegralMukaiData.chi₂_eq_neg_pairing hHRR hK3 E F, neg_neg]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.mukaiVectorIsometry_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mukaiVectorIsometry_apply (E : N) :
    D.mukaiVectorIsometry E = D.toIntegralMukaiData.mukaiVector E
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.pairing_mukaiVector_eq_of_preservesEuler
statement:
theorem pairing_mukaiVector_eq_of_preservesEuler (D : IntegralMukaiData V Λ)
    (D' : IntegralMukaiData V' Λ')
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hHRR' : V'.SatisfiesHRR)
    (hK3 : IsK3 V) (hK3' : IsK3 V') (φ : N →+ N')
    (hφ : PreservesEuler V V' φ) (E F : N) :
    Mukai.pairing D'.b (D'.mukaiVector (φ E)) (D'.mukaiVector (φ F))
      = Mukai.pairing D.b (D.mukaiVector E) (D.mukaiVector F)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : ((Mukai.pairing D'.b (D'.mukaiVector (φ E)) (D'.mukaiVector (φ F)) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = ((Mukai.pairing D.b (D.mukaiVector E) (D.mukaiVector F) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    have h1 := D'.chi₂_eq_neg_pairing hHRR' hK3' (φ E) (φ F)
    have h2 := D.chi₂_eq_neg_pairing hHRR hK3 E F
    have h3 := hφ E F
    linarith
  exact_mod_cast hq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.selfPairing_mukaiVector_eq_of_preservesEuler
statement:
theorem selfPairing_mukaiVector_eq_of_preservesEuler (D : IntegralMukaiData V Λ)
    (D' : IntegralMukaiData V' Λ')
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hHRR' : V'.SatisfiesHRR)
    (hK3 : IsK3 V) (hK3' : IsK3 V') (φ : N →+ N')
    (hφ : PreservesEuler V V' φ) (E : N) :
    Mukai.selfPairing D'.b (D'.mukaiVector (φ E))
      = Mukai.selfPairing D.b (D.mukaiVector E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Mukai.selfPairing_eq_pairing, Mukai.selfPairing_eq_pairing]
  exact pairing_mukaiVector_eq_of_preservesEuler D D' hHRR hHRR' hK3 hK3' φ hφ E E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.isSpherical_mukaiVector_iff_of_preservesEuler
statement:
theorem isSpherical_mukaiVector_iff_of_preservesEuler (D : IntegralMukaiData V Λ)
    (D' : IntegralMukaiData V' Λ')
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hHRR' : V'.SatisfiesHRR)
    (hK3 : IsK3 V) (hK3' : IsK3 V') (φ : N →+ N')
    (hφ : PreservesEuler V V' φ) (E : N) :
    Mukai.IsSpherical D'.b (D'.mukaiVector (φ E))
      ↔ Mukai.IsSpherical D.b (D.mukaiVector E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Mukai.isSpherical_iff, Mukai.isSpherical_iff,
    selfPairing_mukaiVector_eq_of_preservesEuler D D' hHRR hHRR' hK3 hK3' φ hφ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.isometryOfPreservesEuler_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isometryOfPreservesEuler_apply (D : AdditiveMukaiData V Λ)
    (D' : AdditiveMukaiData V' Λ')
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hHRR' : V'.SatisfiesHRR)
    (hK3 : IsK3 V) (hK3' : IsK3 V') (φ : N →+ N')
    (hφ : PreservesEuler V V' φ) (E : N) :
    isometryOfPreservesEuler D D' hHRR hHRR' hK3 hK3' φ hφ E = φ E
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.pairing_mukaiVector_eq_on_realized
statement:
theorem pairing_mukaiVector_eq_on_realized (C : Correspondence 𝒳 𝒴 𝒲) (K : 𝒲)
    [C.pull.CommShift ℤ] [(C.tensor.obj K).CommShift ℤ] [C.push.CommShift ℤ]
    [C.pull.IsTriangulated] [(C.tensor.obj K).IsTriangulated]
    [C.push.IsTriangulated]
    (R : K₀.Realization 𝒳 N) (R' : K₀.Realization 𝒴 N')
    (φ : N →+ N') (hd : R.Descends R' (C.transform K) φ)
    (D : IntegralMukaiData V Λ) (D' : IntegralMukaiData V' Λ')
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hHRR' : V'.SatisfiesHRR)
    (hK3 : IsK3 V) (hK3' : IsK3 V')
    (hφ : PreservesEuler V V' φ) (x y : K₀ 𝒳) :
    Mukai.pairing D'.b (D'.mukaiVector (R' (C.transformK₀ K x)))
        (D'.mukaiVector (R' (C.transformK₀ K y)))
      = Mukai.pairing D.b (D.mukaiVector (R x)) (D.mukaiVector (R y))
proof:
:= by
  have hx : R' (C.transformK₀ K x) = φ (R x) := by
    rw [Correspondence.transformK₀_eq]; exact hd x
  have hy : R' (C.transformK₀ K y) = φ (R y) := by
    rw [Correspondence.transformK₀_eq]; exact hd y
  rw [hx, hy]
  exact pairing_mukaiVector_eq_of_preservesEuler D D' hHRR hHRR' hK3 hK3' φ hφ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.mukaiForm_eq_on_realized
statement:
theorem mukaiForm_eq_on_realized (C : Correspondence 𝒳 𝒴 𝒲) (K : 𝒲)
    [C.pull.CommShift ℤ] [(C.tensor.obj K).CommShift ℤ] [C.push.CommShift ℤ]
    [C.pull.IsTriangulated] [(C.tensor.obj K).IsTriangulated]
    [C.push.IsTriangulated]
    (R : K₀.Realization 𝒳 N) (R' : K₀.Realization 𝒴 N')
    (φ : N →+ N') (hd : R.Descends R' (C.transform K) φ)
    (D : AdditiveMukaiData V Λ) (D' : AdditiveMukaiData V' Λ')
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hHRR' : V'.SatisfiesHRR)
    (hK3 : IsK3 V) (hK3' : IsK3 V')
    (hφ : PreservesEuler V V' φ) (x y : K₀ 𝒳) :
    D'.mukaiForm (R' (C.transformK₀ K x)) (R' (C.transformK₀ K y))
      = D.mukaiForm (R x) (R y)
proof:
:=
  pairing_mukaiVector_eq_on_realized C K R R' φ hd D.toIntegralMukaiData
    D'.toIntegralMukaiData hHRR hHRR' hK3 hK3' hφ x y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.numericalCharge_apply
statement:
theorem numericalCharge_apply (E : N) :
    D.numericalCharge bR f β ω E
      = Mukai.expCharge bR β ω (Mukai.extendMap f (D.mukaiVectorHom E))
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.numericalCharge_add
statement:
theorem numericalCharge_add (E F : N) :
    D.numericalCharge bR f β ω (E + F)
      = D.numericalCharge bR f β ω E + D.numericalCharge bR f β ω F
proof:
:= by
  simp only [numericalCharge, Mukai.expCharge, map_add, Mukai.extendMap_add]
  exact PeriodDomain.centralCharge_add _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.numericalChargeHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem numericalChargeHom_apply (E : N) :
    D.numericalChargeHom bR f β ω E = D.numericalCharge bR f β ω E
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.numericalCharge_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem numericalCharge_zero : D.numericalCharge bR f β ω 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  (D.numericalChargeHom bR f β ω).map_zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.realForm_extendMap_mukaiVector
statement:
theorem realForm_extendMap_mukaiVector
    (hf : ∀ x y : Λ, bR (f x) (f y) = ((D.b x) y : ℝ)) (E : N) :
    Mukai.realForm bR (Mukai.extendMap f (D.mukaiVectorHom E)) = (D.mukaiForm E E : ℝ) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Mukai.realForm_apply, Mukai.realPairing_extendMap D.b bR f hf, D.mukaiForm_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.mukaiForm_neg_of_numericalCharge_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mukaiForm_neg_of_numericalCharge_eq_zero [FiniteDimensional ℝ W]
    (hsig : PeriodDomain.HasSignatureTwo (Mukai.realForm bR))
    (hb : ∀ x y : W, bR x y = bR y x) (hω : 0 < bR ω ω)
    (hf : ∀ x y : Λ, bR (f x) (f y) = ((D.b x) y : ℝ)) {E : N}
    (hE : D.numericalCharge bR f β ω E = 0)
    (hne : Mukai.extendMap f (D.mukaiVectorHom E) ≠ 0) :
    D.mukaiForm E E < 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := Mukai.neg_of_expCharge_eq_zero bR β ω hsig hb hω hE hne
  rw [realForm_extendMap_mukaiVector hf E] at h
  have : ((D.mukaiForm E E : ℤ) : ℝ) < 0 := by linarith
  exact_mod_cast this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.numericalCharge_ne_zero_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem numericalCharge_ne_zero_of_nonneg [FiniteDimensional ℝ W]
    (hsig : PeriodDomain.HasSignatureTwo (Mukai.realForm bR))
    (hb : ∀ x y : W, bR x y = bR y x) (hω : 0 < bR ω ω)
    (hf : ∀ x y : Λ, bR (f x) (f y) = ((D.b x) y : ℝ)) {E : N}
    (hsq : 0 ≤ D.mukaiForm E E)
    (hne : Mukai.extendMap f (D.mukaiVectorHom E) ≠ 0) :
    D.numericalCharge bR f β ω E ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Mukai.expCharge_ne_zero_of_nonneg bR β ω hsig hb hω ?_ hne
  rw [realForm_extendMap_mukaiVector hf E]
  have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((D.mukaiForm E E : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hsq
  linarith

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.discriminant_eq_selfPairing
statement:
theorem discriminant_eq_selfPairing (E : N) :
    V.discriminant E
      = Mukai.selfPairing (LinearMap.mul A A)
          (algebraMap ℚ A (V.rank E : ℚ), V.chComp E 1, V.chComp E 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Mukai.selfPairing_mk, discriminant]
  show V.chComp E 1 * V.chComp E 1 - algebraMap ℚ A (2 * (V.rank E : ℚ)) * V.chComp E 2
    = V.chComp E 1 * V.chComp E 1
      - 2 * (algebraMap ℚ A (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.chComp E 2)
  rw [map_mul, map_ofNat]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.discriminant_mem_piece_two
statement:
theorem discriminant_mem_piece_two (E : N) :
    V.discriminant E ∈ V.ring.piece 2
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.sub_mem _ ?_ ?_
  · exact V.ring.mul_mem_piece (V.chComp_mem E 1) (V.chComp_mem E 1)
  · exact V.ring.mul_mem_piece (V.ring.algebraMap_mem_piece_zero _) (V.chComp_mem E 2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.degree_discriminant
statement:
theorem degree_discriminant (E : N) :
    V.ring.degree (V.discriminant E)
      = V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.chComp E 1)
        - 2 * (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [discriminant, map_sub, V.ring.degree_algebraMap_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.mukaiForm_eq_zero_iff_chi₂_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mukaiForm_eq_zero_iff_chi₂_eq_zero
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E F : N) :
    D.mukaiForm E F = 0 ↔ V.chi₂ E F = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := D.mukaiForm_eq_neg_chi₂ hHRR hK3 E F
    rw [h] at this
    simpa using this.symm
  · intro h
    have := D.mukaiForm_eq_neg_chi₂ hHRR hK3 E F
    rw [h] at this
    exact_mod_cast this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.ker_le_leftRadical
statement:
theorem ker_le_leftRadical (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) :
    AddSubgroup.toIntSubmodule D.mukaiVectorHom.ker ≤ V.leftRadical
proof:
:= by
  intro E hE
  rw [V.mem_leftRadical_iff]
  intro F
  rw [← D.mukaiForm_eq_zero_iff_chi₂_eq_zero hHRR hK3]
  have hE' : D.mukaiVectorHom E = 0 := AddMonoidHom.mem_ker.mp hE
  show Mukai.pairingBilin D.b (D.mukaiVectorHom E) (D.mukaiVectorHom F) = 0
  rw [hE', map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.AdditiveMukaiData.detectsRadical_of
statement:
theorem detectsRadical_of
    (hpoint : ∃ E : N, D.mukaiVectorHom E = (0, 0, 1))
    (hline : ∃ (E : N) (s : ℤ), D.mukaiVectorHom E = (1, 0, s))
    (hb : ∀ c : Λ, (∀ F : N, D.b c (D.c₁ F) = 0) → c = 0) :
    D.DetectsRadical
proof:
:= by
  intro E hE
  have hpair : ∀ F : N,
      Mukai.pairing D.b (D.mukaiVectorHom E) (D.mukaiVectorHom F) = 0 := hE
  obtain ⟨Ept, hpt⟩ := hpoint
  obtain ⟨Eln, s', hln⟩ := hline
  have hr : (D.mukaiVectorHom E).1 = 0 := by
    have := hpair Ept
    rw [hpt] at this
    simp only [Mukai.pairing, map_zero] at this
    linarith
  have hs : (D.mukaiVectorHom E).2.2 = 0 := by
    have := hpair Eln
    rw [hln] at this
    simp only [Mukai.pairing, map_zero] at this
    rw [hr] at this
    linarith
  have hc : (D.mukaiVectorHom E).2.1 = 0 := by
    refine hb _ fun F => ?_
    have := hpair F
    simp only [Mukai.pairing] at this
    rw [hr, hs] at this
    simpa using this
  refine Prod.ext hr (Prod.ext hc hs)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.chi₂_eq_sum
statement:
theorem chi₂_eq_sum (E F : N) :
    V.chi₂ E F
      = ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1 - i),
          (-1 : ℚ) ^ i * V.ring.degree
            (V.chComp E i * V.chComp F j * V.toddComp (n - i - j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [chi₂]
  simp only [chDual, ch, todd]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  have hi' : i < n + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
  rw [Finset.sum_mul, map_sum]
  
  have hwiden :
      ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1 - i), (-1 : ℚ) ^ i * V.ring.degree
            (V.chComp E i * V.chComp F j * V.toddComp (n - i - j))
        = ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), (-1 : ℚ) ^ i * V.ring.degree
            (V.chComp E i * V.chComp F j * V.toddComp (n - i - j)) := by
    have hsub : range (n + 1 - i) ⊆ range (n + 1) := fun x hx =>
      Finset.mem_range.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hx) (Nat.sub_le _ _))
    refine Finset.sum_subset hsub fun j _ hj => ?_
    have hj' : n + 1 - i ≤ j := by simpa using hj
    rw [V.degree_chComp_mul_chComp_mul_toddComp_eq_zero E F (by omega), mul_zero]
  rw [hwiden]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (n - i - j)]
  · rw [smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  · intro k _ hk
    exact V.degree_smul_chComp_mul_chComp_mul_toddComp_eq_zero _ E F (by omega)
  · intro hmem
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.chi₂_eq
statement:
theorem chi₂_eq (E F : N) :
    V.chi₂ E F
      = (V.rank E : ℚ) * (V.rank F : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.toddComp 2)
        + (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp F 1 * V.toddComp 1)
        - (V.rank F : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.toddComp 1)
        + (V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp F 2)
        + (V.rank F : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2)
        - V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.chComp F 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [V.chi₂_eq_sum]
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  
  
  simp only [show (2 : ℕ) - 0 - 0 = 2 from rfl, show (2 : ℕ) - 0 - 1 = 1 from rfl,
    show (2 : ℕ) - 0 - 2 = 0 from rfl]
  simp only [pow_zero, pow_one, neg_one_sq, one_mul, V.chComp_zero, V.toddComp_zero, mul_one]
  simp only [V.degree_algebraMap_mul_mul, V.degree_mul_algebraMap_mul,
    V.ring.degree_algebraMap_mul, V.degree_mul_algebraMap]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.chi₂_eq_chi_of_isStructureSheafLike
statement:
theorem chi₂_eq_chi_of_isStructureSheafLike (hV : V.SatisfiesHRR) (E F : N)
    (hr : V.rank E = 1) (h₁ : V.chComp E 1 = 0) (h₂ : V.chComp E 2 = 0) :
    V.chi₂ E F = (V.chi F : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hchi := V.chi_eq_sum hV F
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add] at hchi
  simp only [show (2 : ℕ) - 0 = 2 from rfl, show (2 : ℕ) - 1 = 1 from rfl,
    show (2 : ℕ) - 2 = 0 from rfl] at hchi
  rw [chi₂_eq V, hchi, V.chComp_zero, V.ring.degree_algebraMap_mul, V.toddComp_zero,
    mul_one, hr, h₁, h₂]
  simp only [Int.cast_one, one_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.chi₂_sub_chi₂_swap
statement:
theorem chi₂_sub_chi₂_swap (E F : N) :
    V.chi₂ E F - V.chi₂ F E
      = 2 * ((V.rank E : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp F 1 * V.toddComp 1)
          - (V.rank F : ℚ) * V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 1 * V.toddComp 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [chi₂_eq V, chi₂_eq V, mul_comm (V.chComp F 1) (V.chComp E 1)]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Surface.chi₂_symm_of_toddComp_one_eq_zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.mem_leftRadical_iff
statement:
theorem mem_leftRadical_iff (E : N) :
    E ∈ V.leftRadical ↔ ∀ F : N, V.chi₂ E F = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftRadical]
  change E ∈ (V.eulerPairing).ker ↔ _
  rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker]
  constructor
  · intro h F
    simpa using DFunLike.congr_fun h F
  · intro h
    ext F
    simpa using h F

  rw [mem_leftRadical_iff, mem_rightRadical_iff]

  · intro h F
    rw [hSymm F E]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.numericalPairing_left_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem numericalPairing_left_nondegenerate
    (hSymm : IsEulerPairingSymmetric V)
    (x : NumericalQuotient V)
    (hx : ∀ y : NumericalQuotient V, V.numericalPairing hSymm x y = 0) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  revert hx
  refine Submodule.Quotient.induction_on _ x fun E hx => ?_
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, mem_leftRadical_iff]
  intro F
  simpa using hx (Submodule.Quotient.mk F)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.numericalPairing_right_nondegenerate

    y = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply V.numericalPairing_left_nondegenerate hSymm y
  intro x
  rw [V.numericalPairing_symm hSymm]
  exact hy x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.numericalPairing_ker_eq_bot
statement:
theorem numericalPairing_ker_eq_bot
    (hSymm : IsEulerPairingSymmetric V) :

proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    rw [AddSubgroup.mem_bot]
    apply V.numericalPairing_left_nondegenerate hSymm x
    intro y
    have hzero := AddMonoidHom.mem_ker.mp hx
    simpa using DFunLike.congr_fun hzero y
  · exact bot_le

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.pairing_mukaiVector_eq_on_realized_of_categorical
statement:
theorem pairing_mukaiVector_eq_on_realized_of_categorical
    (C : Correspondence 𝒳 𝒴 𝒲) (K : 𝒲)
    [C.pull.CommShift ℤ] [(C.tensor.obj K).CommShift ℤ] [C.push.CommShift ℤ]
    [C.pull.IsTriangulated] [(C.tensor.obj K).IsTriangulated]
    [C.push.IsTriangulated]
    (R : K₀.Realization 𝒳 N) (R' : K₀.Realization 𝒴 N')
    (E : K₀.EulerForm 𝒳) (E' : K₀.EulerForm 𝒴)
    (φ : N →+ N') (hsurj : Function.Surjective R)
    (hRR : IsRiemannRoch V R E) (hRR' : IsRiemannRoch V' R' E')
    (hΦ : E.Preserves E' (C.transform K))
    (hd : R.Descends R' (C.transform K) φ)
    (D : IntegralMukaiData V Λ) (D' : IntegralMukaiData V' Λ')
    (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hHRR' : V'.SatisfiesHRR)
    (hK3 : IsK3 V) (hK3' : IsK3 V')
    (x y : K₀ 𝒳) :
    Mukai.pairing D'.b (D'.mukaiVector (R' (C.transformK₀ K x)))
        (D'.mukaiVector (R' (C.transformK₀ K y)))
      = Mukai.pairing D.b (D.mukaiVector (R x))
        (D.mukaiVector (R y))
proof:
:=
  pairing_mukaiVector_eq_on_realized C K R R' φ hd D D' hHRR hHRR' hK3 hK3'
    (preservesEuler_of_descends hsurj hRR hRR' hΦ hd) x y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.chi_eq
statement:
theorem chi_eq (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ) = 2 * (V.rank E : ℚ) + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := V.chi_eq_sum hHRR E
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add] at h
  simp only [show (2 : ℕ) - 0 = 2 from rfl, show (2 : ℕ) - 1 = 1 from rfl,
    show (2 : ℕ) - 2 = 0 from rfl] at h
  rw [h, V.chComp_zero, V.ring.degree_algebraMap_mul, V.toddComp_zero, mul_one,
    hK3.toddComp_one, hK3.degree_toddComp_two, mul_zero, map_zero]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.K3.chi_eq_rank_add_mukaiS
statement:
theorem chi_eq_rank_add_mukaiS (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hK3 : IsK3 V) (E : N) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ) = (V.rank E : ℚ) + mukaiS V E
proof:
:= by
  rw [chi_eq V hHRR hK3 E, mukaiS]
  ring

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.degree_ch_mul_todd
statement:
theorem degree_ch_mul_todd (E : N) :
    V.ring.degree (V.ch E * V.todd)
      = ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1),
          V.ring.degree (V.chComp E i * V.toddComp (n - i))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ch, todd]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  have hin : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_single (n - i) (fun b _ hb => ?_) (fun hmem => ?_)
  · refine V.degree_chComp_mul_toddComp_eq_zero E fun hib => hb ?_
    omega
  · exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.NumericalVarietyData.chi_eq_sum
statement:
theorem chi_eq_sum (hV : V.SatisfiesHRR) (E : N) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ)
      = ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1),
          V.ring.degree (V.chComp E i * V.toddComp (n - i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [V.hrr hV E, V.degree_ch_mul_todd]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Enriques.chi_eq
statement:
theorem chi_eq (hHRR : V.SatisfiesHRR) (hEnriques : IsEnriques V) (E : N) :
    (V.chi E : ℚ) = (V.rank E : ℚ) + V.ring.degree (V.chComp E 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := V.chi_eq_sum hHRR E
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add] at h
  simp only [show (2 : ℕ) - 0 = 2 from rfl, show (2 : ℕ) - 1 = 1 from rfl,
    show (2 : ℕ) - 2 = 0 from rfl] at h
  rw [h, V.chComp_zero, V.ring.degree_algebraMap_mul, V.toddComp_zero, mul_one,
    hEnriques.toddComp_one, hEnriques.degree_toddComp_two, mul_zero, map_zero]
  ring

statement:
theorem alignmentLocus_ofST_iff_circle (uu : ℝ × ℝ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (ht : p.2 ≠ 0)
    (v w : NumericalClass) :
    OrthogonalSlice.Point.ofST uu p ∈
        antiCanonicalSlice.alignmentLocus numericalRealization.chernCharacter v w ↔
      Wall.minA
            ((antiCanonicalSlice.sliceCoordinates
              numericalRealization.chernCharacter uu).toNumClass v)
            ((antiCanonicalSlice.sliceCoordinates
              numericalRealization.chernCharacter uu).toNumClass w)
            * (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2)
          + 2 * Wall.minB
            ((antiCanonicalSlice.sliceCoordinates
              numericalRealization.chernCharacter uu).toNumClass v)
            ((antiCanonicalSlice.sliceCoordinates
              numericalRealization.chernCharacter uu).toNumClass w) * p.1
          + 2 * Wall.minC
            ((antiCanonicalSlice.sliceCoordinates
              numericalRealization.chernCharacter uu).toNumClass v)
            ((antiCanonicalSlice.sliceCoordinates
              numericalRealization.chernCharacter uu).toNumClass w) = 0
proof:
:=
  OrthogonalSlice.alignmentLocus_ofST_iff_circle antiCanonicalSlice
    numericalRealization.chernCharacter uu ht v w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.k3_mukaiVector_eq_extendMap

theorem k3_mukaiVector_eq_extendMap (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (E : SurfaceNum) :
    (k3Realization d).chernCharacter.mukaiVector (k3Realization d).divisorSpace
        ((k3Realization d).sqrtTodd (V := k3NumericalVariety d)) E
      = Mukai.extendMap k3LatticeMap ((k3IntegralMukaiData d).mukaiVector E)

:= by
  rw [k3Realization_sqrtTodd d hd, ChernCharacter.mukaiVector_k3, mukaiVector_k3]

  · exact k3Realization_chernCharacter_rank d E
  · exact k3Realization_chernCharacter_chOne d E
  · show (k3Realization d).chernCharacter.chTwo E + (k3Realization d).chernCharacter.rank E
      = ((E 0 + 2 * (d : ℤ) * E 2 : ℤ) : ℝ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.k3_extendMap_mem_integralExtension
statement:
theorem k3_extendMap_mem_integralExtension (δ : Mukai.MukaiLattice ℤ) :
    Mukai.extendMap k3LatticeMap δ ∈
      Mukai.integralExtension (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range surfaceDivisorBasis))
proof:
:= by
  have hone : ∀ n : ℤ, ((n : ℝ)) ∈ Submodule.span ℤ ({(1 : ℝ)} : Set ℝ) := by
    intro n
    refine Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨n, ?_⟩
    simp
  have hrange : Set.range (surfaceDivisorBasis : Unit → SurfaceDivisor)
      = ({(1 : ℝ)} : Set ℝ) := by
    simp [surfaceDivisorBasis, Module.Basis.singleton, Set.range_unique]
  refine ⟨hone δ.1, ?_, hone δ.2.2⟩
  show k3LatticeMap δ.2.1 ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range surfaceDivisorBasis)
  rw [hrange, k3LatticeMap_apply]
  exact hone δ.2.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.extendMap_k3LatticeMap_injective
statement:
theorem extendMap_k3LatticeMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (Mukai.extendMap k3LatticeMap)
proof:
:= by
  intro u w h
  have h1 : ((u.1 : ℝ)) = ((w.1 : ℝ)) := congrArg Prod.fst h
  have h2 : ((u.2.1 : ℝ)) = ((w.2.1 : ℝ)) := congrArg (fun z => z.2.1) h
  have h3 : ((u.2.2 : ℝ)) = ((w.2.2 : ℝ)) := congrArg (fun z => z.2.2) h
  exact Prod.ext (Int.cast_injective h1)
    (Prod.ext (Int.cast_injective h2) (Int.cast_injective h3))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.k3_finite_integral_spherical_walls
statement:
theorem k3_finite_integral_spherical_walls (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (b₀ t₀ t₁ : ℝ) (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) :
    {δ : Mukai.MukaiLattice ℤ |
        Mukai.IsSpherical (k3MukaiForm d) δ ∧
        ∃ p ∈ parameterBox b₀ t₀ t₁,
          DivisorSpace.expPlane (surfaceDivisorSpace (2 * (d : ℝ))) p.1 p.2 ∈
            PeriodDomain.orthogonalityLocus
              (Mukai.realForm (surfaceDivisorSpace (2 * (d : ℝ))).intersection)
              (Mukai.extendMap k3LatticeMap δ)}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Finite.of_finite_image ?_
    (Set.injOn_of_injective extendMap_k3LatticeMap_injective)
  refine (k3_finite_walls_meeting_box hd b₀ t₀ t₁ ht₀).subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨δ, ⟨hsph, p, hp, hw⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨k3_isSphericalClass_of_isSpherical d hsph, ⟨p, hp, hw⟩,
    k3_extendMap_mem_integralExtension δ⟩
