statement:
theorem basis_mul_mem (p q : Fin 4) :
    basis p * basis q ∈ gradedPiece (basis : Fin 4 → Ring) weight
      (weight p + weight q)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases p <;> fin_cases q
  · simpa using (mem_gradedPiece (b := (basis : Fin 4 → Ring)) (w := weight) 0)
  · simpa using (mem_gradedPiece (b := (basis : Fin 4 → Ring)) (w := weight) 1)
  · simpa using (mem_gradedPiece (b := (basis : Fin 4 → Ring)) (w := weight) 2)
  · simpa using (mem_gradedPiece (b := (basis : Fin 4 → Ring)) (w := weight) 3)
  · simpa using (mem_gradedPiece (b := (basis : Fin 4 → Ring)) (w := weight) 1)
  · simp
  · simpa using (mem_gradedPiece (b := (basis : Fin 4 → Ring)) (w := weight) 3)
  · simp
  · simpa using (mem_gradedPiece (b := (basis : Fin 4 → Ring)) (w := weight) 2)
  · simpa using (mem_gradedPiece (b := (basis : Fin 4 → Ring)) (w := weight) 3)
  · simp
  · simp
  · simpa using (mem_gradedPiece (b := (basis : Fin 4 → Ring)) (w := weight) 3)
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp

proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.degree_mul
statement:
theorem degree_mul (x y : Ring) :
    degree (x * y) =
      TrivSqZeroExt.fst (TrivSqZeroExt.fst x) *
          TrivSqZeroExt.snd (TrivSqZeroExt.snd y) +
        TrivSqZeroExt.snd (TrivSqZeroExt.fst x) *
          TrivSqZeroExt.fst (TrivSqZeroExt.snd y) +
        TrivSqZeroExt.fst (TrivSqZeroExt.snd x) *
          TrivSqZeroExt.snd (TrivSqZeroExt.fst y) +
        TrivSqZeroExt.snd (TrivSqZeroExt.snd x) *
          TrivSqZeroExt.fst (TrivSqZeroExt.fst y)
proof:
:= by
  change TrivSqZeroExt.snd (TrivSqZeroExt.snd (x * y)) = _
  simp
  abel

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.chComp_mem
statement:
theorem chComp_mem (E : NumericalClass) (i : ℕ) :
    chComp E i ∈ numericalRing.piece i
proof:
:= by
  match i with
  | 0 => exact numericalRing.algebraMap_mem_piece_zero _
  | 1 =>
      exact Submodule.add_mem _
        (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ rulingOneQ_mem)
        (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ rulingTwoQ_mem)
  | 2 => exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ pointQ_mem
  | _ + 3 => exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.chComp_add
statement:
theorem chComp_add (E F : NumericalClass) (i : ℕ) :
    chComp (E + F) i = chComp E i + chComp F i
proof:
:= by
  match i with
  | 0 => simp [chComp]
  | 1 =>
      simp only [chComp]
      change (((E.2.1 + F.2.1 : ℤ) : ℚ) • rulingOneQ +
          ((E.2.2.1 + F.2.2.1 : ℤ) : ℚ) • rulingTwoQ) = _
      push_cast
      module
  | 2 =>
      simp only [chComp]
      change (((E.2.2.2 + F.2.2.2 : ℤ) : ℚ) • pointQ) = _
      push_cast
      rw [add_smul]
  | _ + 3 => simp [chComp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.ch_sum
statement:
theorem ch_sum (E : NumericalClass) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 + 1), chComp E i) =
      ((((E.1 : ℚ), (E.2.1 : ℚ)),
        ((E.2.2.1 : ℚ), (E.2.2.2 : ℚ))) : Ring)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  ext <;> simp [chComp, rulingOneQ, rulingTwoQ, pointQ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.toddComp_mem
statement: theorem toddComp_mem (i : ℕ) : toddComp i ∈ numericalRing.piece i
proof:
:= by
  match i with
  | 0 => exact numericalRing.one_mem_piece_zero
  | 1 => exact Submodule.add_mem _ rulingOneQ_mem rulingTwoQ_mem
  | 2 => exact pointQ_mem
  | _ + 3 => exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.todd_sum
statement:
theorem todd_sum :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 + 1), toddComp i) =
      ((((1 : ℚ), 1), ((1 : ℚ), 1)) : Ring)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  ext <;> norm_num [toddComp, rulingOneQ, rulingTwoQ, pointQ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.numericalVariety_satisfiesHRR
statement: theorem numericalVariety_satisfiesHRR : numericalVariety.SatisfiesHRR
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun E => ?_⟩
  change ((E.1 + E.2.1 + E.2.2.1 + E.2.2.2 : ℤ) : ℚ) =
    degree
      ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 + 1), chComp E i) *
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 + 1), toddComp j))
  rw [ch_sum, todd_sum, degree_mul]
  norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.pieceOne_eq_span_rulings

theorem pieceOne_eq_span_rulings :
    numericalRing.piece 1 =
      Submodule.span ℚ ({rulingOneQ, rulingTwoQ} : Set Ring)
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.divisorClass_map_rat_smul
statement:
theorem divisorClass_map_rat_smul (q : ℚ) (x : numericalRing.piece 1) :
    divisorClass (q • x) = (q : ℝ) • divisorClass x
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> simp [divisorClass]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.divisorClass_intersection
statement:
theorem divisorClass_intersection (x y : numericalRing.piece 1) :
    divisorSpace.pair (divisorClass x) (divisorClass y) =
      ((numericalRing.degree (x.1 * y.1) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x.1 ∈ Submodule.span ℚ
      ({rulingOneQ, rulingTwoQ} : Set Ring) := by
    rw [← pieceOne_eq_span_rulings]
    exact x.2
  have hy : y.1 ∈ Submodule.span ℚ
      ({rulingOneQ, rulingTwoQ} : Set Ring) := by
    rw [← pieceOne_eq_span_rulings]
    exact y.2
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_pair.mp hx
  obtain ⟨c, d, hcd⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_pair.mp hy
  change
    (((TrivSqZeroExt.snd (TrivSqZeroExt.fst x.1) : ℚ) : ℝ) *
        ((TrivSqZeroExt.fst (TrivSqZeroExt.snd y.1) : ℚ) : ℝ) +
      ((TrivSqZeroExt.fst (TrivSqZeroExt.snd x.1) : ℚ) : ℝ) *
        ((TrivSqZeroExt.snd (TrivSqZeroExt.fst y.1) : ℚ) : ℝ)) = _
  rw [← hab, ← hcd]
  change _ = ((degree
    ((a • rulingOneQ + b • rulingTwoQ) *
      (c • rulingOneQ + d • rulingTwoQ)) : ℚ) : ℝ)
  rw [degree_mul]
  simp [rulingOneQ, rulingTwoQ]

proof:

    Surface.NumericalRealization.extendDivisorClass_tmul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.realize_scalarExtendedParameters
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_scalarExtendedParameters (h₁ h₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ) :
    numericalRealization.realizeParameters
        (scalarExtendedParameters h₁ h₂ b₁ b₂) =
      parameters h₁ h₂ b₁ b₂
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg₂ StabilityParameters.mk
  · exact realize_scalarExtendedDivisor b₁ b₂
  · exact realize_scalarExtendedDivisor h₁ h₂

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.charge_eq_scalarExtension
statement:
theorem charge_eq_scalarExtension
    (h₁ h₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ) (E : NumericalClass) :
    charge h₁ h₂ b₁ b₂ E =
      (Surface.ScalarExtension.chernCharacter (V := numericalVariety)).centralCharge
        (Surface.RealDivisorClass.divisorSpace numericalRing)
        (scalarExtendedParameters h₁ h₂ b₁ b₂) E
proof:
:= by
  rw [charge]
  symm
  change
    (Surface.ScalarExtension.chernCharacter (V := numericalVariety)).centralCharge
        (Surface.RealDivisorClass.divisorSpace numericalRing)
        (scalarExtendedParameters h₁ h₂ b₁ b₂) E =
      numericalRealization.chernCharacter.centralCharge
        numericalRealization.divisorSpace (parameters h₁ h₂ b₁ b₂) E
  simpa only [realize_scalarExtendedParameters] using
    (Surface.ScalarExtension.centralCharge_eq_realization numericalRealization
      (scalarExtendedParameters h₁ h₂ b₁ b₂) E)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.omega_square
statement:
theorem omega_square (h₁ h₂ : ℝ) :
    divisorSpace.pair (h₁, h₂) (h₁, h₂) = 2 * h₁ * h₂
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.omega_square_pos
statement:
theorem omega_square_pos {h₁ h₂ : ℝ} (hh₁ : 0 < h₁) (hh₂ : 0 < h₂) :
    0 < divisorSpace.pair (h₁, h₂) (h₁, h₂)
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.centralCharge_apply
statement:
theorem centralCharge_apply (h₁ h₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ) (r c d v : ℤ) :
    charge h₁ h₂ b₁ b₂ (r, c, d, v) =
      Complex.ofReal
          (-(v : ℝ) + b₁ * d + b₂ * c + (h₁ * h₂ - b₁ * b₂) * r)
        + Complex.I * Complex.ofReal
          (h₁ * d + h₂ * c - (h₁ * b₂ + h₂ * b₁) * r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [charge, ChernCharacter.centralCharge_apply]
  simp only [chernCharacter_rank, chernCharacter_chOne, chernCharacter_chTwo]
  simp [parameters, divisorSpace, intersectionForm,
    DivisorSpace.pair]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.charge_eq_numericalBField
statement:
theorem charge_eq_numericalBField
    (a : ℝ) (h₁ h₂ b₁ b₂ : ℚ) (hh₁ : 0 < h₁) (hh₂ : 0 < h₂)
    (E : NumericalClass) :
    charge (a * (h₁ : ℝ)) (a * (h₂ : ℝ)) (b₁ : ℝ) (b₂ : ℝ) E =
      (ChargeCoordinates.ofNumericalDataB numericalVariety
        (polarization h₁ h₂ hh₁ hh₂) (bField b₁ b₂)).centralCharge a E
proof:
:= by
  have hparameters :
      parameters (a * (h₁ : ℝ)) (a * (h₂ : ℝ)) (b₁ : ℝ) (b₂ : ℝ) =
        numericalRealization.parameters
          (polarization h₁ h₂ hh₁ hh₂) (bField b₁ b₂) a := by
    change StabilityParameters.mk ((b₁ : ℝ), (b₂ : ℝ))
        (a * (h₁ : ℝ), a * (h₂ : ℝ)) =
      StabilityParameters.mk
        (numericalRealization.realizeBField (bField b₁ b₂))
        (a • numericalRealization.realizePolarization
          (polarization h₁ h₂ hh₁ hh₂))
    apply congrArg₂ StabilityParameters.mk
    · exact (numericalRealization_bField b₁ b₂).symm
    · rw [numericalRealization_polarization]
      ext <;> simp
  rw [charge, hparameters]
  exact Surface.NumericalRealization.centralCharge_eq_ofNumericalDataB
    numericalRealization (polarization h₁ h₂ hh₁ hh₂) (bField b₁ b₂) a E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.wallSlice_isHodge

  H_square_pos
proof:

    show 0 < divisorSpace.pair segre segre
    rw [segre_square]
    norm_num
  transverse_square_neg u hu := by
    show divisorSpace.pair (antiDiagonal u) (antiDiagonal u) < 0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.not_isHodge_rulingOne
statement:
theorem not_isHodge_rulingOne (T : OrthogonalSlice divisorSpace ℝ)
    (hH : T.H = rulingOne) : ¬ T.IsHodge
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hsq : divisorSpace.pair T.H T.H = 0 := by
    rw [hH]
    exact rulingOne_sq
  have := h.H_square_pos
  rw [hsq] at this
  exact lt_irrefl 0 this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.wallChargeFamily_charge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wallChargeFamily_charge (s u t : ℝ) (E : NumericalClass) :
    wallChargeFamily.charge ⟨s, u, t⟩ E =
      charge t t (s + u) (s - u) E
proof:
:= by
  rw [charge]
  have hparameters :
      wallSlice.parameters ⟨s, u, t⟩ =
        parameters t t (s + u) (s - u) := by
    apply congrArg₂ StabilityParameters.mk
    · change s • segre + antiDiagonalMap u = (s + u, s - u)
      ext <;> simp [antiDiagonalMap, antiDiagonal, segre, sub_eq_add_neg]
    · change t • segre = (t, t)
      ext <;> simp [segre]
  change chernCharacter.centralCharge divisorSpace
      (wallSlice.parameters ⟨s, u, t⟩) E = _
  rw [hparameters]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.SmoothQuadric.antiDiagonal_not_rankOne
statement:
theorem antiDiagonal_not_rankOne {u : ℝ} (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    ¬ ∃ beta : ℝ, antiDiagonal u = beta • segre
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨beta, hbeta⟩
  have h₁ := congrArg Prod.fst hbeta
  have h₂ := congrArg Prod.snd hbeta
  simp [antiDiagonal, segre] at h₁ h₂
  apply hu
  linarith

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surfacePB_basis_idx1

proof:

      = (q : ℝ) • ((surfacePB.basis.coord idx1 x.1 : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.exists_smul_H
statement:
theorem exists_smul_H (h2 : ℚ) (x : (surfaceNumericalRing h2).piece 1) :
    x.1 = (surfacePB.basis.coord idx1 x.1) • H
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x.1 ∈ Submodule.span ℚ ({H} : Set SurfaceRing) := by
    rw [← surfacePieceOne_eq_span]
    exact x.2
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hx
  rw [← ha, coord_idx1_smul_H]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surfaceDivisorClass_intersection
statement:
theorem surfaceDivisorClass_intersection (h2 : ℚ) (x y : (surfaceNumericalRing h2).piece 1) :
    (surfaceDivisorSpace (h2 : ℝ)).pair (surfaceDivisorClass h2 x) (surfaceDivisorClass h2 y) =
      (((surfaceNumericalRing h2).degree (x.1 * y.1) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  set a : ℚ := surfacePB.basis.coord idx1 x.1 with ha
  set b : ℚ := surfacePB.basis.coord idx1 y.1 with hb
  have hxy : x.1 * y.1 = (a * b) • H ^ 2 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [exists_smul_H h2 x, exists_smul_H h2 y]
    rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, ← pow_two]
  show (h2 : ℝ) * (a : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) = _
  rw [hxy]
  show _ = ((surfaceDegree h2 ((a * b) • H ^ 2) : ℚ) : ℝ)
  rw [map_smul, surfaceDegree_Hsq, smul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surfaceHodgeDefinite
statement:
theorem surfaceHodgeDefinite {h2 t : ℝ} (hh2 : 0 < h2) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    (surfaceDivisorSpace h2).HodgeDefinite t where
  H_square_pos
proof:
:= by
    show 0 < h2 * t * t
    rw [mul_assoc]
    exact mul_pos hh2 (mul_self_pos.mpr ht)
  neg_definite x hx hxne := by
    exfalso
    apply hxne
    have hx' : h2 * t * x = 0 := hx
    have hne : h2 * t ≠ 0 := by
      have := ne_of_gt hh2
      exact mul_ne_zero this ht
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hx').resolve_left hne

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.p2DivisorClass_intersection
statement:
theorem p2DivisorClass_intersection
    (x y : p2NumericalVariety.ring.piece 1) :
    p2DivisorSpace.pair (p2DivisorClass x) (p2DivisorClass y) =
      ((p2NumericalVariety.ring.degree (x.1 * y.1) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x.1 ∈ Submodule.span ℚ ({H} : Set SurfaceRing) := by
    rw [← surfacePieceOne_eq_span_H]
    exact x.2
  have hy : y.1 ∈ Submodule.span ℚ ({H} : Set SurfaceRing) := by
    rw [← surfacePieceOne_eq_span_H]
    exact y.2
  obtain ⟨qx, hqx⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hx
  obtain ⟨qy, hqy⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hy
  have hclassx : p2DivisorClass x = (qx : ℝ) := by
    change (((surfaceDegree 1 (x.1 * H) : ℚ) : ℝ)) = _
    rw [← hqx, Algebra.smul_def, mul_assoc,
      surfaceDegree_algebraMap_mul, ← pow_two, surfaceDegree_Hsq]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hclassy : p2DivisorClass y = (qy : ℝ) := by
    change (((surfaceDegree 1 (y.1 * H) : ℚ) : ℝ)) = _
    rw [← hqy, Algebra.smul_def, mul_assoc,
      surfaceDegree_algebraMap_mul, ← pow_two, surfaceDegree_Hsq]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hclassx, hclassy]
  change (qx : ℝ) * (qy : ℝ) = _
  rw [← hqx, ← hqy]
  have hproduct :
      (qx • H) * (qy • H) =
        algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (qx * qy) * H ^ 2 := by
    simp [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul]
    ring
  rw [hproduct, surfaceDegree_algebraMap_mul, surfaceDegree_Hsq]
  push_cast
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.p2ProjectiveCharge_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem p2ProjectiveCharge_apply (a b : ℝ) (E : P2ProjectiveCoordinates) :
    p2ProjectiveCharge a b E =
      -Complex.ofReal ((E.2.1 : ℝ) / 2 + (E.2.2 : ℝ))
        + (b + a * Complex.I) * Complex.ofReal (E.2.1 : ℝ)
        - (b + a * Complex.I) ^ 2 * Complex.ofReal ((E.1 : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    p2ProjectiveCharge a b E =
        (p2ProjectiveChargeCoordinates.twistByScalar b).centralCharge a E := by
      simpa [p2ProjectiveCharge, p2Parameters, p2ProjectiveChargeCoordinates] using
        (ChernCharacter.centralCharge_rankOne_eq p2ProjectiveChernCharacter
          p2DivisorSpace p2Hyperplane a b E)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [ChargeCoordinates.centralCharge_twistByScalar_apply]
      simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.p2ProjectiveCharge_re
statement:
theorem p2ProjectiveCharge_re (a b : ℝ) (E : P2ProjectiveCoordinates) :
    (p2ProjectiveCharge a b E).re =
      -((E.2.1 : ℝ) / 2 + (E.2.2 : ℝ))
        + b * (E.2.1 : ℝ)
        + (a ^ 2 - b ^ 2) * ((E.1 : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [p2ProjectiveCharge_apply]
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.neg_re,
    Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, pow_two]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.p2ProjectiveCharge_im
statement:
theorem p2ProjectiveCharge_im (a b : ℝ) (E : P2ProjectiveCoordinates) :
    (p2ProjectiveCharge a b E).im =
      a * (E.2.1 : ℝ) - (2 * a * b) * ((E.1 : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [p2ProjectiveCharge_apply]
  simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_im,
    Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, pow_two]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.basis_mul_mem
statement:
theorem basis_mul_mem (p q : Fin 5) :
    basis p * basis q ∈ gradedPiece (basis : Fin 5 → Ring) weight (weight p + weight q)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases p <;> fin_cases q <;>
    simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, basis_zero, basis_one, basis_two,
      basis_three, basis_four, one_mul, mul_one, hQ_mul_hQ, e₁Q_mul_e₁Q, e₂Q_mul_e₂Q,
      hQ_mul_e₁Q, e₁Q_mul_hQ, hQ_mul_e₂Q, e₂Q_mul_hQ, e₁Q_mul_e₂Q, e₂Q_mul_e₁Q,
      hQ_mul_pointQ, pointQ_mul_hQ, e₁Q_mul_pointQ, pointQ_mul_e₁Q, e₂Q_mul_pointQ,
      pointQ_mul_e₂Q, pointQ_mul_pointQ, weight_zero, weight_one, weight_two, weight_three,
      weight_four] <;>
    first
      | exact one_mem
      | exact hQ_mem
      | exact e₁Q_mem
      | exact e₂Q_mem
      | exact pointQ_mem
      | exact Submodule.neg_mem _ pointQ_mem
      | exact Submodule.zero_mem _

statement: theorem chComp_mem (E : NumericalClass) (i : ℕ) : chComp E i ∈ numericalRing.piece i
proof:
:= by
  match i with
  | 0 => exact numericalRing.algebraMap_mem_piece_zero _
  | 1 =>
      exact Submodule.add_mem _
        (Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hQ_mem) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ e₁Q_mem))
        (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ e₂Q_mem)
  | 2 => exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ pointQ_mem
  | _ + 3 => exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.chComp_add
statement:
theorem chComp_add (E F : NumericalClass) (i : ℕ) :
    chComp (E + F) i = chComp E i + chComp F i
proof:
:= by
  match i with
  | 0 =>
      simp only [chComp, Pi.add_apply, Int.cast_add, map_add]
  | 1 =>
      simp only [chComp, Pi.add_apply]
      push_cast
      module
  | 2 =>
      simp only [chComp, Pi.add_apply]
      push_cast
      rw [← add_smul]
      congr 1
      ring
  | _ + 3 =>
      simp only [chComp]
      rw [add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.toddComp_mem
statement: theorem toddComp_mem (i : ℕ) : toddComp i ∈ numericalRing.piece i
proof:
:= by
  match i with
  | 0 => exact numericalRing.one_mem_piece_zero
  | 1 =>
      exact Submodule.sub_mem _
        (Submodule.sub_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hQ_mem) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ e₁Q_mem))
        (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ e₂Q_mem)
  | 2 => exact pointQ_mem
  | _ + 3 => exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.ch_sum
statement:
theorem ch_sum (E : NumericalClass) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 + 1), chComp E i) =
      ⟨(E 0 : ℚ), (E 1 : ℚ), (E 2 : ℚ), (E 3 : ℚ),
        ((E 1 : ℚ) + (E 2 : ℚ) + (E 3 : ℚ)) / 2 + (E 4 : ℚ)⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  ext <;> simp only [chComp, Ring.algebraMap_const, Ring.algebraMap_hCoeff,
      Ring.algebraMap_e₁Coeff, Ring.algebraMap_e₂Coeff, Ring.algebraMap_ptCoeff, Ring.add_const, Ring.add_hCoeff, Ring.add_e₁Coeff, Ring.add_e₂Coeff,
      Ring.add_ptCoeff, Ring.smul_const, Ring.smul_hCoeff, Ring.smul_e₁Coeff,
      Ring.smul_e₂Coeff, Ring.smul_ptCoeff,
      hQ_const, hQ_hCoeff, hQ_e₁Coeff, hQ_e₂Coeff, hQ_ptCoeff,
      e₁Q_const, e₁Q_hCoeff, e₁Q_e₁Coeff, e₁Q_e₂Coeff, e₁Q_ptCoeff,
      e₂Q_const, e₂Q_hCoeff, e₂Q_e₁Coeff, e₂Q_e₂Coeff, e₂Q_ptCoeff,
      pointQ_const, pointQ_hCoeff, pointQ_e₁Coeff, pointQ_e₂Coeff, pointQ_ptCoeff] <;> ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.todd_sum
statement:
theorem todd_sum :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 + 1), toddComp j) =
      ⟨(1 : ℚ), (3 / 2 : ℚ), (-1 / 2 : ℚ), (-1 / 2 : ℚ), (1 : ℚ)⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  ext <;> simp [toddComp] <;> ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.numericalVariety_satisfiesHRR
statement: theorem numericalVariety_satisfiesHRR : numericalVariety.SatisfiesHRR
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun E => ?_⟩
  change ((E 0 + 2 * E 1 + E 2 + E 3 + E 4 : ℤ) : ℚ) =
    degree ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 + 1), chComp E i) *
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 + 1), toddComp j))
  rw [ch_sum, todd_sum, degree_apply, Ring.mul_ptCoeff]
  push_cast
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.polarizationClass_mem
statement: theorem polarizationClass_mem (a b c : ℚ) : polarizationClass a b c ∈ numericalRing.piece 1
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.degree_polarizationClass_sq
statement:
theorem degree_polarizationClass_sq (a b c : ℚ) :
    numericalRing.degree (polarizationClass a b c ^ 2) = a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 - c ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  change degree (polarizationClass a b c ^ 2) = _
  rw [pow_two, degree_apply, Ring.mul_ptCoeff]
  simp [polarizationClass]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.intersectionForm_apply

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.pieceOne_eq_span
statement:
theorem pieceOne_eq_span :
    gradedPiece (basis : Fin 5 → Ring) weight 1 =
      Submodule.span ℚ ({hQ, e₁Q, e₂Q} : Set Ring)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradedPiece, weightOne_preimage, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_insert_eq,
    Set.image_singleton, basis_one, basis_two, basis_three]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.const_eq_zero_of_mem_pieceOne
statement:
theorem const_eq_zero_of_mem_pieceOne {x : Ring}
    (hx : x ∈ gradedPiece (basis : Fin 5 → Ring) weight 1) : x.const = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pieceOne_eq_span] at hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rfl
  | zero => rfl
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => simp [ha, hb]
  | smul q a _ ha => simp [ha]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.divisorClass_apply
statement:

theorem divisorClass_apply (x : numericalRing.piece 1) :
    divisorClass x = ((x.1.hCoeff : ℝ), (x.1.e₁Coeff : ℝ), (x.1.e₂Coeff : ℝ))
proof: := rfl

statement:

proof:

  ext <;> simp [divisorClass]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.divisorClass_intersection
statement:
theorem divisorClass_intersection (x y : numericalRing.piece 1) :
    divisorSpace.pair (divisorClass x) (divisorClass y) =
      ((numericalRing.degree (x.1 * y.1) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hx := const_eq_zero_of_mem_pieceOne x.2
  have hy := const_eq_zero_of_mem_pieceOne y.2
  show (x.1.hCoeff : ℝ) * (y.1.hCoeff : ℝ) - (x.1.e₁Coeff : ℝ) * (y.1.e₁Coeff : ℝ)
      - (x.1.e₂Coeff : ℝ) * (y.1.e₂Coeff : ℝ) = _
  show _ = ((degree (x.1 * y.1) : ℚ) : ℝ)
  rw [degree_apply, Ring.mul_ptCoeff, hx, hy]
  push_cast
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.numericalRealization_divisorSpace

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.numericalRealization_polarization

theorem numericalRealization_polarization (a b c : ℚ) (h : 0 < a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 - c ^ 2) :
    numericalRealization.realizePolarization (polarization a b c h) =
      ((a : ℝ), (b : ℝ), (c : ℝ))

  show divisorClass ⟨polarizationClass a b c, polarizationClass_mem a b c⟩ = _
  ext <;> simp [divisorClass, polarizationClass]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.hodgeDefinite
statement:
theorem hodgeDefinite {w : Divisor} (hw : 0 < divisorSpace.pair w w) :
    divisorSpace.HodgeDefinite w where
  H_square_pos
proof:
:= hw
  neg_definite x hx hxne := by
    obtain ⟨p, q, r⟩ := w
    obtain ⟨x₁, x₂, x₃⟩ := x
    have hw' : 0 < p * p - q * q - r * r := hw
    have hx' : p * x₁ - q * x₂ - r * x₃ = 0 := hx
    show x₁ * x₁ - x₂ * x₂ - x₃ * x₃ < 0
    have hp2 : 0 < p * p := by nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg q, mul_self_nonneg r]
    by_cases hz : x₂ = 0 ∧ x₃ = 0
    · exfalso
      obtain ⟨h2, h3⟩ := hz
      subst h2
      subst h3
      have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        rw [h] at hp2
        simp at hp2
      have hx1 : x₁ = 0 := by
        have hpx : p * x₁ = 0 := by linarith
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hpx).resolve_left hp
      exact hxne (by simp [hx1])
    · have hpos : 0 < x₂ * x₂ + x₃ * x₃ := by
        rcases not_and_or.mp hz with h | h
        · have := mul_self_pos.mpr h
          nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg x₃]
        · have := mul_self_pos.mpr h
          nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg x₂]
      have he : p * x₁ = q * x₂ + r * x₃ := by linarith
      have hsq : (p * x₁) * (p * x₁) = (q * x₂ + r * x₃) * (q * x₂ + r * x₃) := by rw [he]
      have hcs : (q * x₂ + r * x₃) * (q * x₂ + r * x₃)
          ≤ (q * q + r * r) * (x₂ * x₂ + x₃ * x₃) := by
        nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (q * x₃ - r * x₂)]
      nlinarith [hsq, hcs, hpos, hw', hp2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.hodgeDefinite_antiCanonical

    divisorSpace.HodgeDefinite

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surface_finite_walls_through_expPlane
statement:
theorem surface_finite_walls_through_expPlane {h2 : ℝ} (hh2 : 0 < h2)
    (B omega : SurfaceDivisor) (homega : omega ≠ 0) :
    {δ : Mukai.RealExtension SurfaceDivisor |
        PeriodDomain.IsSphericalClass
          (Mukai.realForm (surfaceDivisorSpace h2).intersection) δ ∧
        DivisorSpace.expPlane (surfaceDivisorSpace h2) B omega ∈
          PeriodDomain.orthogonalityLocus (Mukai.realForm (surfaceDivisorSpace h2).intersection) δ ∧
        δ ∈ (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range surfaceMukaiBasis) :
              Set (Mukai.RealExtension SurfaceDivisor))}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine DivisorSpace.finite_walls_through_expPlane
    (surfaceHodgeDefinite hh2 one_ne_zero) B omega ?_ surfaceMukaiBasis
  show 0 < h2 * omega * omega
  rw [mul_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.omega_sq_pos_on_parameterBox
statement:
theorem omega_sq_pos_on_parameterBox {h2 : ℝ} (hh2 : 0 < h2) {b₀ t₀ t₁ : ℝ} (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) :
    ∀ p ∈ parameterBox b₀ t₀ t₁, 0 < (surfaceDivisorSpace h2).pair p.2 p.2
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨B, t⟩ hp
  have ht : t₀ ≤ t := hp.2.1
  have htpos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le ht₀ ht
  show 0 < h2 * t * t
  rw [mul_assoc]
  exact mul_pos hh2 (mul_pos htpos htpos)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surface_finite_walls_meeting_box
statement:

        δ ∈ (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range surfaceMukaiBasis) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.k3_finite_walls_meeting_box
statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.isCompact_ampleBox
statement:
theorem isCompact_ampleBox (omega₀ : Divisor) (b₀ t₀ t₁ : ℝ) :
    IsCompact (ampleBox omega₀ b₀ t₀ t₁)
proof:
:=
  (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod
    (isCompact_Icc.image (by continuity))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.omega_sq_pos_on_ampleBox
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨B, omega⟩ ⟨-, t, ht, rfl⟩
  have htpos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le ht₀ ht.1
  have hval : divisorSpace.pair (t • omega₀) (t • omega₀)
      = t ^ 2 * divisorSpace.pair omega₀ omega₀ := by
    simp only [divisorSpace_pair, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [hval]
  have : 0 < t ^ 2 := by positivity
  exact mul_pos this h₀

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.BlowUpPlane.finite_walls_meeting_ampleBox
statement:
theorem finite_walls_meeting_ampleBox {omega₀ : Divisor}
    (h₀ : 0 < divisorSpace.pair omega₀ omega₀) (b₀ : ℝ) {t₀ : ℝ} (t₁ : ℝ) (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) :
    {δ : Mukai.RealExtension Divisor |
        PeriodDomain.IsSphericalClass (Mukai.realForm divisorSpace.intersection) δ ∧
        (∃ p ∈ ampleBox omega₀ b₀ t₀ t₁,
          DivisorSpace.expPlane divisorSpace p.1 p.2 ∈
            PeriodDomain.orthogonalityLocus (Mukai.realForm divisorSpace.intersection) δ) ∧
        δ ∈ (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range mukaiBasis) :
              Set (Mukai.RealExtension Divisor))}.Finite
proof:
:=
  DivisorSpace.finite_walls_meeting_expFamily (hodgeDefinite h₀)
    (isCompact_ampleBox omega₀ b₀ t₀ t₁)
    (omega_sq_pos_on_ampleBox h₀ ht₀) mukaiBasis

    Wall.Spherical.signedRayRegularLocus divisorSpace.intersection
        (Wall.Spherical.latticeSpherical divisorSpace.intersection
          ↑(Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range divisorBasis)))

      = Wall.Spherical.signedRayRegularLocus divisorSpace.intersection
        (Wall.Spherical.rayCandidates divisorSpace.intersection
          (boxRegion h₀ b₀ t₁ ht₀)
          ↑(Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range divisorBasis)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.p4_hDegrees_eq_chCoeff
statement:
theorem p4_hDegrees_eq_chCoeff (k : Fin 5) (E : FourfoldNum) :
    Polarised.hDegrees p4NumericalVariety p4Polarization
        (Polarised.unitCorr (RankOneRing 4)) 4 E k
      = ((fourfoldChCoeff 1 E (k : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : (k : ℕ) ≤ 4 := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp k.isLt
  show ((p4NumericalVariety.ring.degree
      (Polarised.corrComp p4NumericalVariety (Polarised.unitCorr (RankOneRing 4)) E (k : ℕ)
        * p4Polarization.cls ^ (4 - (k : ℕ))) : ℚ) : ℝ) = _
  rw [Polarised.corrComp_unitCorr, p4Polarization_cls, p4_degree_chComp_mul,
    if_pos (show (k : ℕ) + (4 - (k : ℕ)) = 4 by omega), mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.p4_charge
statement:
theorem p4_charge (w : ℂ) (E : FourfoldNum) :
    p4WallChargeFamily.charge w E
      = -(((fourfoldChCoeff 1 E 4 : ℚ) : ℂ)
          - w * ((fourfoldChCoeff 1 E 3 : ℚ) : ℂ)
          + w ^ 2 / 2 * ((fourfoldChCoeff 1 E 2 : ℚ) : ℂ)
          - w ^ 3 / 6 * ((fourfoldChCoeff 1 E 1 : ℚ) : ℂ)
          + w ^ 4 / 24 * ((fourfoldChCoeff 1 E 0 : ℚ) : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [p4WallChargeFamily_charge, Wall.Exp.charge_apply, Wall.Exp.ofMoments]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  simp only [Wall.Exp.moments, Nat.zero_le, Nat.le_refl, dif_pos,
    p4_hDegrees_eq_chCoeff]
  norm_num [Wall.Exp.coeff, Nat.factorial]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.quintic_Q_toNumClass_nonneg

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.k3MukaiForm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem k3MukaiForm_apply (d : ℕ) (x y : ℤ) :
    k3MukaiForm d x y = 2 * (d : ℤ) * x * y
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.mukaiVector_k3
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mukaiVector_k3 (d : ℕ) (E : SurfaceNum) :
    (k3IntegralMukaiData d).mukaiVector E = (E 0, E 1, E 0 + 2 * (d : ℤ) * E 2)
proof:
:= by
  show (_, _, K3.mukaiSInt (k3NumericalVariety d) E) = _
  have : K3.mukaiSInt (k3NumericalVariety d) E = E 0 + 2 * (d : ℤ) * E 2 := by
    show (2 * E 0 + 2 * (d : ℤ) * E 2) - E 0 = _
    ring
  rw [this]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.pairing_mukaiVector_k3
statement:
theorem pairing_mukaiVector_k3 (d : ℕ) (E F : SurfaceNum) :
    Mukai.pairing (k3MukaiForm d)
        ((k3IntegralMukaiData d).mukaiVector E) ((k3IntegralMukaiData d).mukaiVector F)
      = 2 * (d : ℤ) * (E 1) * (F 1)
        - (E 0) * (F 0 + 2 * (d : ℤ) * F 2)
        - (F 0) * (E 0 + 2 * (d : ℤ) * E 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mukaiVector_k3, mukaiVector_k3, Mukai.pairing_mk, k3MukaiForm_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.mukaiPairing_k3
statement:
theorem mukaiPairing_k3 (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (E F : SurfaceNum) :
    ((2 * (d : ℤ) * (E 1) * (F 1)
        - (E 0) * (F 0 + 2 * (d : ℤ) * F 2)
        - (F 0) * (E 0 + 2 * (d : ℤ) * E 2) : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = K3.mukaiPairing (k3NumericalVariety d) E F
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pairing_mukaiVector_k3 d E F]
  exact (k3IntegralMukaiData d).pairing_mukaiVector
    (k3NumericalVariety_satisfiesHRR d hd) (k3_isK3 d hd) E F

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.isSpherical_structureSheaf_k3
statement:

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.abelianTodd_mem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.abelianTodd_sum

    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 + 1), abelianTodd j)
      = 1 + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing 0 * H + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing 0 * H ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.abelianNumericalVariety_satisfiesHRR
statement:
theorem abelianNumericalVariety_satisfiesHRR (d : ℕ) :
    (abelianNumericalVariety d).SatisfiesHRR
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun E => ?_⟩
  show ((2 * (d : ℤ) * E 2 : ℤ) : ℚ) = surfaceDegree (2 * (d : ℚ)) _
  rw [surfaceCh_sum, abelianTodd_sum, surfaceDegree_ch_mul_todd]
  show _ = 2 * (d : ℚ) * ((E 0 : ℚ) * 0 + (E 1 : ℚ) * 0 + (E 2 : ℚ))
  push_cast
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.abelianToddComp_one

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.abelianChiStructureSheaf
statement:

    Surface.chiStructureSheaf (abelianNumericalVariety d) = 0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.abelianChi_eq_of_chComp_two_eq
statement:
theorem abelianChi_eq_of_chComp_two_eq (d : ℕ) (E F : SurfaceNum)
    (h : (abelianNumericalVariety d).chComp E 2 =
      (abelianNumericalVariety d).chComp F 2) :
    (abelianNumericalVariety d).chi E = (abelianNumericalVariety d).chi F
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  have hcoeff : ((E 2 : ℤ) : ℚ) = ((F 2 : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    
    
    have h' : surfaceDegree 1 (algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing ((E 2 : ℤ) : ℚ) * H ^ 2)
        = surfaceDegree 1 (algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing ((F 2 : ℤ) : ℚ) * H ^ 2) :=
      congrArg (fun x => surfaceDegree 1 x) h
    simpa only [surfaceDegree_algebraMap_mul, surfaceDegree_Hsq, mul_one] using h'
  show 2 * (d : ℤ) * E 2 = 2 * (d : ℤ) * F 2
  rw [show E 2 = F 2 from by exact_mod_cast hcoeff]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.k3Todd_mem
statement:
theorem k3Todd_mem (d : ℚ) (i : ℕ) :
    k3Todd d i ∈ gradedPiece (⇑surfacePB.basis) surfaceW i
proof:
:= by
  match i with
  | 0 => exact surface_one_mem
  | 1 => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | 2 => exact algebraMap_mul_mem _ Hsq_mem_piece_two
  | _ + 3 => exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.k3Todd_sum
statement:
theorem k3Todd_sum (d : ℚ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 + 1), k3Todd d j)
      = 1 + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing 0 * H + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (1 / d) * H ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  simp [k3Todd]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.k3NumericalVariety_satisfiesHRR
statement:
theorem k3NumericalVariety_satisfiesHRR (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    (k3NumericalVariety d).SatisfiesHRR
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun E => ?_⟩
  show ((2 * E 0 + 2 * (d : ℤ) * E 2 : ℤ) : ℚ) = surfaceDegree (2 * (d : ℚ)) _
  rw [surfaceCh_sum, k3Todd_sum, surfaceDegree_ch_mul_todd]
  have hdq : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hd
  show _ = 2 * (d : ℚ) * ((E 0 : ℚ) * (1 / (d : ℚ)) + (E 1 : ℚ) * 0 + (E 2 : ℚ))
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.k3_isK3
statement:
theorem k3_isK3 (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    K3.IsK3 (k3NumericalVariety d)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  show surfaceDegree (2 * (d : ℚ)) (algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (1 / (d : ℚ)) * H ^ 2) = 2
  rw [surfaceDegree_algebraMap_mul, surfaceDegree_Hsq]
  have hdq : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hd
  field_simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.chi₂_k3_eq_mukaiIntegral
statement:
theorem chi₂_k3_eq_mukaiIntegral (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (E F : SurfaceNum) :
    (k3NumericalVariety d).chi₂ E F =

          - (E 0) * (F 0 + 2 * (d : ℤ) * F 2)
          - (F 0) * (E 0 + 2 * (d : ℤ) * E 2) : ℤ) : ℚ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.two_lt_dim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surface_one_mem
statement: theorem surface_one_mem : (1 : SurfaceRing) ∈ gradedPiece (⇑surfacePB.basis) surfaceW 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (0 : ℕ) < surfacePB.dim := by rw [surfacePB_dim]; norm_num
  have hb : surfacePB.basis ⟨0, h0⟩ = 1 := by rw [surfacePB_basis_apply]; simp
  have hmem := mem_gradedPiece (b := ⇑surfacePB.basis) (w := surfaceW) ⟨0, h0⟩
  rwa [hb] at hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surface_mul_mem
statement:
theorem surface_mul_mem (p q : Fin surfacePB.dim) :
    surfacePB.basis p * surfacePB.basis q
      ∈ gradedPiece (⇑surfacePB.basis) surfaceW (surfaceW p + surfaceW q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [surfacePB_basis_apply, surfacePB_basis_apply, ← pow_add]
  by_cases hpq : (p : ℕ) + (q : ℕ) < surfacePB.dim
  · have hmem := mem_gradedPiece (b := ⇑surfacePB.basis) (w := surfaceW) ⟨(p : ℕ) + (q : ℕ), hpq⟩
    rwa [surfacePB_basis_apply] at hmem
  · have hd := surfacePB_dim
    have h3 : 3 ≤ (p : ℕ) + (q : ℕ) := by omega
    have hzero : H ^ ((p : ℕ) + (q : ℕ)) = 0 := by
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, (p : ℕ) + (q : ℕ) = 3 + m := ⟨(p : ℕ) + (q : ℕ) - 3, by omega⟩
      rw [hm, pow_add, H_pow_three, zero_mul]
    rw [hzero]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.H_mem_piece_one
statement: theorem H_mem_piece_one : H ∈ gradedPiece (⇑surfacePB.basis) surfaceW 1
proof:

  have h1 : (1 : ℕ) < surfacePB.dim := by rw [surfacePB_dim]; norm_num
  have hb : surfacePB.basis ⟨1, h1⟩ = H := by rw [surfacePB_basis_apply]; simp
  have hmem := mem_gradedPiece (b := ⇑surfacePB.basis) (w := surfaceW) ⟨1, h1⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surfaceDegree_basis_of_ne

theorem surfaceDegree_basis_of_ne (h2 : ℚ) (i : Fin surfacePB.dim) (hi : surfaceW i ≠ 2) :
    surfaceDegree h2 (surfacePB.basis i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hne : i ≠ idx2 := fun h => hi (by rw [h]; rfl)
  show (h2 • surfacePB.basis.coord idx2) (surfacePB.basis i) = 0
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surfaceDegree_basis_two

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surfaceDegree_one
statement: theorem surfaceDegree_one (h2 : ℚ) : surfaceDegree h2 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (0 : ℕ) < surfacePB.dim := by rw [surfacePB_dim]; norm_num
  have hb : surfacePB.basis ⟨0, h0⟩ = 1 := by rw [surfacePB_basis_apply]; simp
  rw [← hb]
  exact surfaceDegree_basis_of_ne h2 _ (by show (0 : ℕ) ≠ 2; decide)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surfaceDegree_H

:= by
  have h1 : (1 : ℕ) < surfacePB.dim := by rw [surfacePB_dim]; norm_num
  have hb : surfacePB.basis ⟨1, h1⟩ = H := by rw [surfacePB_basis_apply]; simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surfaceDegree_algebraMap_mul
statement:
theorem surfaceDegree_algebraMap_mul (h2 q : ℚ) (x : SurfaceRing) :
    surfaceDegree h2 (algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing q * x) = q * surfaceDegree h2 x
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surfaceDegree_normalForm
statement:
theorem surfaceDegree_normalForm (h2 a b c : ℚ) :
    surfaceDegree h2 (algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing a + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing b * H
      + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing c * H ^ 2) = h2 * c
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add, map_add, surfaceDegree_algebraMap_mul, surfaceDegree_algebraMap_mul,
    surfaceDegree_H, surfaceDegree_Hsq, mul_zero, add_zero]
  rw [show algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing a = algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing a * 1 by rw [mul_one],
    surfaceDegree_algebraMap_mul, surfaceDegree_one, mul_zero, zero_add]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.k3ChCoeff_add
statement:
theorem k3ChCoeff_add (E F : SurfaceNum) (i : ℕ) :
    k3ChCoeff (E + F) i = k3ChCoeff E i + k3ChCoeff F i
proof:
:= by
  match i with
  | 0 | 1 => simp only [k3ChCoeff, Pi.add_apply, Int.cast_add]
  | 2 => simp only [k3ChCoeff, Pi.add_apply, Int.cast_add]
  | _ + 3 => simp only [k3ChCoeff, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surfaceCh_mem
statement:
theorem surfaceCh_mem (chCoeff : SurfaceNum → ℕ → ℚ) (E : SurfaceNum) (i : ℕ) :
    surfaceCh chCoeff E i ∈ gradedPiece (⇑surfacePB.basis) surfaceW i
proof:
:= by
  match i with
  | 0 =>
    show algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (chCoeff E 0) ∈ _
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ surface_one_mem
  | 1 => exact algebraMap_mul_mem _ H_mem_piece_one
  | 2 => exact algebraMap_mul_mem _ Hsq_mem_piece_two
  | _ + 3 => exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surfaceCh_add
statement:
theorem surfaceCh_add (chCoeff : SurfaceNum → ℕ → ℚ)
    (hadd : ∀ E F i, chCoeff (E + F) i = chCoeff E i + chCoeff F i)
    (E F : SurfaceNum) (i : ℕ) :
    surfaceCh chCoeff (E + F) i = surfaceCh chCoeff E i + surfaceCh chCoeff F i
proof:
:= by
  match i with
  | 0 =>
    show algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (chCoeff (E + F) 0) = _
    rw [hadd, map_add]
    rfl
  | 1 =>
    show algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (chCoeff (E + F) 1) * H = _
    rw [hadd, map_add, add_mul]
    rfl
  | 2 =>
    show algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (chCoeff (E + F) 2) * H ^ 2 = _
    rw [hadd, map_add, add_mul]
    rfl
  | _ + 3 => show (0 : SurfaceRing) = 0 + 0; rw [add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surfaceCh_sum
statement:
theorem surfaceCh_sum (chCoeff : SurfaceNum → ℕ → ℚ) (E : SurfaceNum) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 + 1), surfaceCh chCoeff E i)
      = algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (chCoeff E 0) + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (chCoeff E 1) * H
        + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (chCoeff E 2) * H ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.surfaceDegree_ch_mul_todd
statement:
theorem surfaceDegree_ch_mul_todd (h2 a b c t₁ t₂ : ℚ) :
    surfaceDegree h2
        ((algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing a + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing b * H
            + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing c * H ^ 2)
          * (1 + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing t₁ * H + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing t₂ * H ^ 2))
      = h2 * (a * t₂ + b * t₁ + c)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod :
      (algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing a + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing b * H
          + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing c * H ^ 2)
        * (1 + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing t₁ * H + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing t₂ * H ^ 2)
      = algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing a + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (b + a * t₁) * H
        + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing (a * t₂ + b * t₁ + c) * H ^ 2 := by
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul]
    linear_combination
      (algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing c * algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing t₁
        + algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing b * algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing t₂) * H_pow_three
        + (algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing c * algebraMap ℚ SurfaceRing t₂) * H_pow_four
  rw [hprod, surfaceDegree_normalForm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.p2ChCoeff_add
statement:
theorem p2ChCoeff_add (E F : SurfaceNum) (i : ℕ) :
    p2ChCoeff (E + F) i = p2ChCoeff E i + p2ChCoeff F i
proof:
:= by
  match i with
  | 0 | 1 => simp only [p2ChCoeff, Pi.add_apply, Int.cast_add]
  | 2 =>
    simp only [p2ChCoeff, Pi.add_apply, Int.cast_add]
    ring
  | _ + 3 => simp only [p2ChCoeff, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.p2Todd_mem
statement: theorem p2Todd_mem (i : ℕ) : p2Todd i ∈ gradedPiece (⇑surfacePB.basis) surfaceW i
proof:
:= by
  match i with
  | 0 => exact surface_one_mem
  | 1 => exact algebraMap_mul_mem _ H_mem_piece_one
  | 2 => exact Hsq_mem_piece_two

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.p2NumericalVariety_satisfiesHRR

  rw [surfaceCh_sum, p2Todd_sum, surfaceDegree_ch_mul_todd]
  show ((E 0 + 2 * E 1 + E 2 : ℤ) : ℚ)
    = 1 * ((E 0 : ℚ) * 1 + (E 1 : ℚ) * (3 / 2) + ((E 1 : ℚ) / 2 + (E 2 : ℚ)))

proof:

  show ((E 0 + 2 * (d : ℤ) * E 2 : ℤ) : ℚ) = surfaceDegree (2 * (d : ℚ)) _
  rw [surfaceCh_sum, enriquesTodd_sum, surfaceDegree_ch_mul_todd]

  show _ = 2 * (d : ℚ) * ((E 0 : ℚ) * (1 / (2 * (d : ℚ))) + (E 1 : ℚ) * 0 + (E 2 : ℚ))

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.fourfoldChi_sum
statement:
theorem fourfoldChi_sum (d : ℚ) (t : ℕ → ℚ) (E : FourfoldNum) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (4 + 1), fourfoldChCoeff d E i * t (4 - i))
      = (E 0 : ℚ) * t 4 + (E 1 : ℚ) * t 3
        + (-(E 1 : ℚ) / 2 + (E 2 : ℚ)) * t 2
        + ((E 1 : ℚ) / 6 - (E 2 : ℚ) + (E 3 : ℚ)) * t 1
        + (-(E 1 : ℚ) / 24 + 7 * (E 2 : ℚ) / 12 - 3 * (E 3 : ℚ) / 2
            + (E 4 : ℚ) / d) * t 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  simp only [show (4 : ℕ) - 0 = 4 from rfl, show (4 : ℕ) - 1 = 3 from rfl,
    show (4 : ℕ) - 2 = 2 from rfl, show (4 : ℕ) - 3 = 1 from rfl,
    show (4 : ℕ) - 4 = 0 from rfl]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.p4NumericalVariety_satisfiesHRR

  rankOneNumericalVariety_satisfiesHRR 4 1 fourfoldRank p4Chi (fourfoldChCoeff 1) p4Todd
    (fourfoldChCoeff_zero 1) (fourfoldChCoeff_add 1) rfl (fun E => by
    rw [fourfoldChi_sum]
    show ((E 0 + E 1 + E 2 + E 3 + E 4 : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = 1 * ((E 0 : ℚ) * 1 + (E 1 : ℚ) * (25 / 12)
        + (-(E 1 : ℚ) / 2 + (E 2 : ℚ)) * (35 / 12)
        + ((E 1 : ℚ) / 6 - (E 2 : ℚ) + (E 3 : ℚ)) * (5 / 2)
        + (-(E 1 : ℚ) / 24 + 7 * (E 2 : ℚ) / 12 - 3 * (E 3 : ℚ) / 2
            + (E 4 : ℚ) / 1) * 1)
    push_cast
    ring)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.p4ChCoeff_lineBundle_four
statement:
theorem p4ChCoeff_lineBundle_four (m c e f : ℤ) (hc : 2 * c = m * (m + 1))
    (he : 6 * e = m * (m + 1) * (m + 2))
    (hf : 24 * f = m * (m + 1) * (m + 2) * (m + 3)) :
    fourfoldChCoeff 1 ![1, m, c, e, f] 4 = (m : ℚ) ^ 4 / 24
proof:
:= by
  show -(m : ℚ) / 24 + 7 * (c : ℚ) / 12 - 3 * (e : ℚ) / 2 + (f : ℚ) / 1 = (m : ℚ) ^ 4 / 24
  have hc' : (2 : ℚ) * (c : ℚ) = (m : ℚ) * ((m : ℚ) + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hc
  have he' : (6 : ℚ) * (e : ℚ) = (m : ℚ) * ((m : ℚ) + 1) * ((m : ℚ) + 2) := by exact_mod_cast he
  have hf' : (24 : ℚ) * (f : ℚ)
      = (m : ℚ) * ((m : ℚ) + 1) * ((m : ℚ) + 2) * ((m : ℚ) + 3) := by exact_mod_cast hf
  field_simp
  linarith [hc', he', hf']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.sexticNumericalVariety_satisfiesHRR
statement: theorem sexticNumericalVariety_satisfiesHRR : sexticNumericalVariety.SatisfiesHRR

    rw [fourfoldChi_sum]
    show ((2 * E 0 - 4 * E 1 + 11 * E 2 - 9 * E 3 + E 4 : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = 6 * ((E 0 : ℚ) * (1 / 3) + (E 1 : ℚ) * 0
        + (-(E 1 : ℚ) / 2 + (E 2 : ℚ)) * (5 / 4)
        + ((E 1 : ℚ) / 6 - (E 2 : ℚ) + (E 3 : ℚ)) * 0
        + (-(E 1 : ℚ) / 24 + 7 * (E 2 : ℚ) / 12 - 3 * (E 3 : ℚ) / 2
            + (E 4 : ℚ) / 6) * 1)
    push_cast
    ring)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.pointPiece_isInternal
statement: theorem pointPiece_isInternal : DirectSum.IsInternal pointPiece
proof:

  rw [DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top]
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst hi

        iSup_eq_bot.mpr fun j => iSup_eq_bot.mpr fun hj => pointPiece_eq_bot hj
      rw [h]
      exact disjoint_bot_right
    · rw [pointPiece_eq_bot hi]
      exact disjoint_bot_left

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.threefoldChi_sum
statement:
theorem threefoldChi_sum (d : ℚ) (t : ℕ → ℚ) (E : ThreefoldNum) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (3 + 1), threefoldChCoeff d E i * t (3 - i))
      = (E 0 : ℚ) * t 3 + (E 1 : ℚ) * t 2
        + (-(E 1 : ℚ) / 2 + (E 2 : ℚ)) * t 1
        + ((E 1 : ℚ) / 6 - (E 2 : ℚ) + (E 3 : ℚ) / d) * t 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  simp only [show (3 : ℕ) - 0 = 3 from rfl, show (3 : ℕ) - 1 = 2 from rfl,
    show (3 : ℕ) - 2 = 1 from rfl, show (3 : ℕ) - 3 = 0 from rfl]
  rfl

    rw [threefoldChi_sum]
    show ((E 0 + E 1 + E 2 + E 3 : ℤ) : ℚ)
      = 1 * ((E 0 : ℚ) * 1 + (E 1 : ℚ) * (11 / 6)
        + (-(E 1 : ℚ) / 2 + (E 2 : ℚ)) * 2
        + ((E 1 : ℚ) / 6 - (E 2 : ℚ) + (E 3 : ℚ) / 1) * 1)
    push_cast
    ring)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Numerical.Examples.p3ChCoeff_lineBundle_three

  have he' : (6 : ℚ) * (e : ℚ) = (m : ℚ) * ((m : ℚ) + 1) * ((m : ℚ) + 2) := by exact_mod_cast he

proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.rationalSectionsRes_mem_fractionalSections
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun s _ ↦
    rationalSectionsRes X h s ∈ fractionalSections D V) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hs
  · intro s hs
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hs
    rw [rationalSectionsRes_inverseSection]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨f, hf.mono h, rfl⟩
  · exact map_zero (rationalSectionsRes X h) ▸ Submodule.zero_mem _
  · intro s t _ _ hs ht
    rw [map_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hs ht
  · intro r s _ hs
    rw [rationalSectionsRes_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.equationHom_app_one
statement:
private lemma equationHom_app_one (D : CartierDivisor X) (U : X.Opens)
    (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f)
    (V : (Over U)ᵒᵖ) :
    (equationHom D U f hf).app V
        (show (PresheafOfModules.unit
          (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj).obj V from
            (1 : (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj.obj V)) =
      (show fractionalSections D V.unop.left from
        ⟨inverseSection V.unop.left f,
          Submodule.subset_span
            ⟨f, hf.mono (leOfHom V.unop.hom), rfl⟩⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let s : (overPresheaf (fractionalPresheaf D) U).sections :=
    { val := fun W ↦ ⟨inverseSection W.unop.left f,
        Submodule.subset_span
          ⟨f, hf.mono (leOfHom W.unop.hom), rfl⟩⟩
      property := fun g ↦ by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact rationalSectionsRes_inverseSection (leOfHom g.unop.left) f }
  have hs := (overPresheaf
    (fractionalPresheaf D) U).unitHomEquiv.apply_symm_apply s
  have hsV := congrArg
    (fun q : (overPresheaf (fractionalPresheaf D) U).sections ↦ q.val V) hs
  change (equationHom D U f hf).app V _ = _
  exact hsV

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.equationHom_app_injective
proof:
:= by
  let e : RationalSections X V.unop.left := inverseSection V.unop.left f
  have he : e ∈ fractionalSections D V.unop.left :=
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨f, hf.mono (leOfHom V.unop.hom), rfl⟩
  change Function.Injective (fun a : Γ(X, V.unop.left) ↦
    (⟨a • e, Submodule.smul_mem _ a he⟩ : fractionalSections D V.unop.left))
  intro a b hab
  by_cases hV : Nonempty V.unop.left
  · letI : Nonempty V.unop.left := hV
    have hab' := congrArg
      (fun s : fractionalSections D V.unop.left ↦ (s.1 : RationalSections X V.unop.left) ⟨hV⟩)
      hab
    change X.germToFunctionField V.unop.left a * ((f.toMul : X.functionField)⁻¹) =
      X.germToFunctionField V.unop.left b * ((f.toMul : X.functionField)⁻¹) at hab'
    apply X.germToFunctionField_injective V.unop.left
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ (inv_ne_zero f.toMul.ne_zero) hab'
  · haveI : IsEmpty V.unop.left := not_nonempty_iff.mp hV
    have hbot : V.unop.left = ⊥ := by
      apply Opens.ext
      apply Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp
      rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
      exact hV ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
    exact @Subsingleton.elim _
      (CommRingCat.subsingleton_of_isTerminal
        (X.sheaf.isTerminalOfEqEmpty hbot)) _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.equationHom_isLocallyInjective
statement:
private lemma equationHom_isLocallyInjective (D : CartierDivisor X) (U : X.Opens)
    (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (equationHom D U f hf))
proof:
:=
  Presheaf.isLocallyInjective_of_injective _ _
    (fun V ↦ equationHom_app_injective D U f hf V)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.exists_local_section_eq_equation_div
statement:
private lemma exists_local_section_eq_equation_div (x : X)
    (f g : Additive X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hfg : localCartierClass X x f = localCartierClass X x g) :
    ∃ (A : X.Opens) (hxA : x ∈ A) (a : Γ(X, A)),
      letI : Nonempty A
proof:
:= ⟨⟨x, hxA⟩⟩
      X.germToFunctionField A a =
        (f.toMul : X.functionField) * (g.toMul : X.functionField)⁻¹ := by
  have hq : f - g ∈ localUnits X x :=
    (localCartierClass_eq_iff X x f g).mp hfg
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hq
  obtain ⟨A, hxA, a, ha⟩ := X.presheaf.exists_germ_eq (u : X.presheaf.stalk x)
  refine ⟨A, hxA, a, ?_⟩
  letI : Nonempty A := ⟨⟨x, hxA⟩⟩
  rw [← X.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField hxA, ha]
  change ((localUnitHom X x u : X.functionFieldˣ) : X.functionField) = _
  rw [hu]
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.imageSieve_inverseSection_mem
statement:
private lemma imageSieve_inverseSection_mem (D : CartierDivisor X) (U : X.Opens)
    (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f)
    (V : Over U) (g : Additive X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hg : IsEquationOn D V.left g) :
    Presheaf.imageSieve
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (equationHom D U f hf))
      (show fractionalSections D V.left from
        ⟨inverseSection V.left g, Submodule.subset_span ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩⟩) ∈
      ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U) V
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrothendieckTopology.mem_over_iff]
  intro x hxV
  obtain ⟨A, hxA, a, ha⟩ := exists_local_section_eq_equation_div x f g
    ((hf x (leOfHom V.hom hxV)).symm.trans (hg x hxV))
  let W : X.Opens := A ⊓ V.left
  have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨hxA, hxV⟩
  let i : W ⟶ V.left := homOfLE inf_le_right
  let Y : Over U := Over.mk (i ≫ V.hom)
  let j : Y ⟶ V := Over.homMk i
  refine ⟨W, i, ?_, hxW⟩
  rw [Sieve.overEquiv_iff]
  change ∃ b : Γ(X, W), _
  let aW : Γ(X, W) := X.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op a
  refine ⟨aW, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext hW
  letI : Nonempty A := ⟨⟨x, hxA⟩⟩
  letI : Nonempty W := hW.down
  change X.germToFunctionField W aW * (f.toMul : X.functionField)⁻¹ =
    (g.toMul : X.functionField)⁻¹
  rw [show X.germToFunctionField W aW =
      X.germToFunctionField A a by
    exact germToFunctionField_res X inf_le_left a hW]
  rw [ha]
  field_simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.equationHom_isLocallySurjective
statement:
private lemma equationHom_isLocallySurjective (D : CartierDivisor X) (U : X.Opens)
    (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (equationHom D U f hf))
proof:
:= by
  let K := (_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U
  let φ := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (equationHom D U f hf)
  constructor
  intro V z
  change fractionalSections D V.left at z
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun s hs ↦
    Presheaf.imageSieve φ (show fractionalSections D V.left from ⟨s, hs⟩) ∈ K V)
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ z.property
  · intro s hs
    obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := hs
    exact imageSieve_inverseSection_mem D U f hf V g hg
  · have hzero : Presheaf.imageSieve φ (φ.app (.op V) 0) ∈ K V := by
      rw [Presheaf.imageSieve_app]
      exact K.top_mem V
    have hz : (⟨0, Submodule.zero_mem _⟩ : fractionalSections D V.left) = 0 := rfl
    simpa only [hz, map_zero] using hzero
  · intro s t hs ht hsc htc
    apply K.superset_covering
      (S := Presheaf.imageSieve φ (show fractionalSections D V.left from ⟨s, hs⟩) ⊓
        Presheaf.imageSieve φ (show fractionalSections D V.left from ⟨t, ht⟩))
    · intro W j hj
      refine ⟨Presheaf.localPreimage φ (show fractionalSections D V.left from ⟨s, hs⟩) j hj.1 +
        Presheaf.localPreimage φ (show fractionalSections D V.left from ⟨t, ht⟩) j hj.2, ?_⟩
      rw [map_add, Presheaf.app_localPreimage, Presheaf.app_localPreimage]
      exact (map_add _ _ _).symm
    · exact K.intersection_covering hsc htc
  · intro r s hs hsc
    apply K.superset_covering
      (S := Presheaf.imageSieve φ (show fractionalSections D V.left from ⟨s, hs⟩))
    · intro W j hj
      let rW : Γ(X, W.left) := X.presheaf.map j.left.op r
      let t : Γ(X, W.left) := Presheaf.localPreimage φ
        (show fractionalSections D V.left from ⟨s, hs⟩) j hj
      refine ⟨rW * t, ?_⟩
      change (equationHom D U f hf).app (.op W) (rW • t) = _
      rw [map_smul]
      dsimp only [t]
      have ht := Presheaf.app_localPreimage φ
        (show fractionalSections D V.left from ⟨s, hs⟩) j hj
      change (equationHom D U f hf).app (.op W)
          (Presheaf.localPreimage φ
            (show fractionalSections D V.left from ⟨s, hs⟩) j hj) =
        (overPresheaf (fractionalPresheaf D) U).map j.op
          (show fractionalSections D V.left from ⟨s, hs⟩) at ht
      rw [ht]
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (rationalSectionsRes_smul X (leOfHom j.left) r s).symm
    · exact hsc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.equationHom_mem_W
statement:
private lemma equationHom_mem_W (D : CartierDivisor X) (U : X.Opens)
    (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f) :
    ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (equationHom D U f hf))
proof:
:= by
  letI := equationHom_isLocallyInjective D U f hf
  letI := equationHom_isLocallySurjective D U f hf
  exact ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).W_of_isLocallyBijective _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.isIso_sheafification_map_equationHom
statement:
private lemma isIso_sheafification_map_equationHom (D : CartierDivisor X) (U : X.Opens)
    (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f) :
    IsIso ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).map (equationHom D U f hf))
proof:
:= by
  apply Localization.inverts
    (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj))
    (((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).W.inverseImage
      (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj))
  exact equationHom_mem_W D U f hf
