name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.rationalMul_mem_fractionalSections
statement:
private lemma rationalMul_mem_fractionalSections (D E : CartierDivisor X) (U : X.Opens)
    {s t : RationalSections X U} (hs : s ∈ fractionalSections D U)
    (ht : t ∈ fractionalSections E U) :
    rationalMul U s t ∈ fractionalSections (D + E) U
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem s hs =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hs
      induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem t ht =>
          obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := ht
          apply Submodule.subset_span
          refine ⟨f + g, hf.add hg, ?_⟩
          funext h
          simp [rationalMul, inverseSection]
          exact mul_comm _ _
      | zero =>
          rw [show rationalMul U (inverseSection U f) 0 = 0 by
            funext h; simp [rationalMul]]
          exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      | add t₁ t₂ _ _ ht₁ ht₂ =>
          rw [show rationalMul U (inverseSection U f) (t₁ + t₂) =
            rationalMul U (inverseSection U f) t₁ +
              rationalMul U (inverseSection U f) t₂ by
                funext h; simp [rationalMul, mul_add]]
          exact Submodule.add_mem _ ht₁ ht₂
      | smul r t _ ht =>
          rw [show rationalMul U (inverseSection U f) (r • t) =
            r • rationalMul U (inverseSection U f) t by
              funext h
              letI : Nonempty U := h.down
              change ((f.toMul : X.functionField)⁻¹) *
                  (X.germToFunctionField U r * t h) =
                X.germToFunctionField U r *
                  (((f.toMul : X.functionField)⁻¹) * t h)
              ring]
          exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r ht
  | zero =>
      rw [show rationalMul U 0 t = 0 by funext h; simp [rationalMul]]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add s₁ s₂ _ _ hs₁ hs₂ =>
      rw [show rationalMul U (s₁ + s₂) t =
        rationalMul U s₁ t + rationalMul U s₂ t by
          funext h; simp [rationalMul, add_mul]]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ hs₁ hs₂
  | smul r s _ hs =>
      rw [show rationalMul U (r • s) t = r • rationalMul U s t by
        funext h
        letI : Nonempty U := h.down
        change (X.germToFunctionField U r * s h) * t h =
          X.germToFunctionField U r * (s h * t h)
        rw [mul_assoc]]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.rationalSectionsRes_rationalMul
statement:
private lemma rationalSectionsRes_rationalMul {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (s t : RationalSections X U) :
    rationalSectionsRes X h (rationalMul U s t) =
      rationalMul V (rationalSectionsRes X h s) (rationalSectionsRes X h t)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.tensorEquationHom_eq_tensor
statement:
private lemma tensorEquationHom_eq_tensor (D E : CartierDivisor X) (U : X.Opens)
    (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f)
    (g : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hg : IsEquationOn E U g) :
    tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg =
      (λ_ (PresheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).inv ≫
        (equationHom D U f hf ⊗ₘ equationHom E U g hg)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorEquationHom]
  apply (overPresheaf
    (fractionalPresheaf D ⊗ fractionalPresheaf E) U).unitHomEquiv.injective
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  ext V
  letI : CommRing ((X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj.obj V) :=
    inferInstanceAs (CommRing Γ(X, V.unop.left))
  change _ =
    ((equationHom D U f hf).app V ⊗ₘ (equationHom E U g hg).app V)
      (((λ_ (PresheafOfModules.unit
        (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).inv.app V)
          (show (PresheafOfModules.unit
            (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj).obj V from
              (1 : (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj.obj V)))
  erw [PresheafOfModules.leftUnitor_inv_app,
    ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_inv_apply,
    ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_tmul]
  rw [equationHom_app_one D U f hf V,
    equationHom_app_one E U g hg V]
  change
    (show fractionalSections D V.unop.left from
        ⟨inverseSection V.unop.left f,
          Submodule.subset_span
            ⟨f, hf.mono (leOfHom V.unop.hom), rfl⟩⟩) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, V.unop.left)]
      (show fractionalSections E V.unop.left from
        ⟨inverseSection V.unop.left g,
          Submodule.subset_span
            ⟨g, hg.mono (leOfHom V.unop.hom), rfl⟩⟩) = _
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.unitHomEquiv_symm_comp'
proof:
:= by
  apply N.unitHomEquiv.injective
  rw [N.unitHomEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  ext V
  change p.app V ((M.unitHomEquiv.symm s).app V
    (1 : (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj.obj V)) = p.app V (s.val V)
  have hs := M.unitHomEquiv.apply_symm_apply s
  exact congrArg (fun q ↦ p.app V q)
    (congrArg (fun q : M.sections ↦ q.val V) hs)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.multiplicationHom_comp_tensorEquationHom
statement:
private lemma multiplicationHom_comp_tensorEquationHom (D E : CartierDivisor X)
    (U : X.Opens) (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f)
    (g : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hg : IsEquationOn E U g) :
    tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg ≫
      (PresheafOfModules.pushforward
        (F := Over.forget U) (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).map
          (multiplicationHom D E) =
    equationHom (D + E) U (f + g) (hf.add hg)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorEquationHom, unitHomEquiv_symm_comp']
  rw [equationHom]
  change (overPresheaf (fractionalPresheaf (D + E)) U).unitHomEquiv.symm _ =
    (overPresheaf (fractionalPresheaf (D + E)) U).unitHomEquiv.symm _
  congr 1
  ext V
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext h
  dsimp [PresheafOfModules.sectionsMap, equationHom, multiplicationHom,
    rationalMul, inverseSection]
  change (f.toMul : X.functionField)⁻¹ * (g.toMul : X.functionField)⁻¹ =
    ((f + g).toMul : X.functionField)⁻¹
  simp
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.tensorEquationHom_isLocallySurjective
statement:
private lemma tensorEquationHom_isLocallySurjective (D E : CartierDivisor X)
    (U : X.Opens) (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f)
    (g : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hg : IsEquationOn E U g) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg))
proof:
:= by
  let K := (_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U
  let φD := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (equationHom D U f hf)
  let φE := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (equationHom E U g hg)
  let φT := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg)
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective K φD := equationHom_isLocallySurjective D U f hf
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective K φE := equationHom_isLocallySurjective E U g hg
  constructor
  intro V z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
      have hzero : Presheaf.imageSieve φT (φT.app (.op V) 0) ∈ K V := by
        rw [Presheaf.imageSieve_app]
        exact K.top_mem V
      simpa only [map_zero] using hzero
  | add z₁ z₂ hz₁ hz₂ =>
      apply K.superset_covering
        (S := Presheaf.imageSieve φT z₁ ⊓ Presheaf.imageSieve φT z₂)
      · intro W j hj
        refine ⟨Presheaf.localPreimage φT z₁ j hj.1 +
          Presheaf.localPreimage φT z₂ j hj.2, ?_⟩
        rw [map_add, Presheaf.app_localPreimage, Presheaf.app_localPreimage]
        exact (map_add _ _ _).symm
      · exact K.intersection_covering hz₁ hz₂
  | tmul s t =>
      apply K.superset_covering
        (S := Presheaf.imageSieve φD s ⊓ Presheaf.imageSieve φE t)
      · intro W j hj
        let a : Γ(X, W.left) := Presheaf.localPreimage φD s j hj.1
        let b : Γ(X, W.left) := Presheaf.localPreimage φE t j hj.2
        refine ⟨a * b, ?_⟩
        have ha := Presheaf.app_localPreimage φD s j hj.1
        have hb := Presheaf.app_localPreimage φE t j hj.2
        change (equationHom D U f hf).app (.op W) a =
          (fractionalPresheaf D).map j.left.op s at ha
        change (equationHom E U g hg).app (.op W) b =
          (fractionalPresheaf E).map j.left.op t at hb
        change (tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg).app (.op W) (a * b) =
          (fractionalPresheaf D ⊗ fractionalPresheaf E).map j.left.op (s ⊗ₜ t)
        change (tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg).app (.op W) (a * b) =
          (fractionalPresheaf D).map j.left.op s ⊗ₜ
            (fractionalPresheaf E).map j.left.op t
        change (a * b) •
            ((show fractionalSections D W.left from
                ⟨inverseSection W.left f, Submodule.subset_span
                  ⟨f, hf.mono (leOfHom W.hom), rfl⟩⟩) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, W.left)]
              (show fractionalSections E W.left from
                ⟨inverseSection W.left g, Submodule.subset_span
                  ⟨g, hg.mono (leOfHom W.hom), rfl⟩⟩)) = _
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
        rw [mul_smul]
        rw [show a • b •
            (show fractionalSections D W.left from
              ⟨inverseSection W.left f, Submodule.subset_span
                ⟨f, hf.mono (leOfHom W.hom), rfl⟩⟩) =
            b • (a •
              (show fractionalSections D W.left from
                ⟨inverseSection W.left f, Submodule.subset_span
                  ⟨f, hf.mono (leOfHom W.hom), rfl⟩⟩)) by
          rw [← mul_smul, ← mul_smul, mul_comm]]
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
        change (equationHom D U f hf).app (.op W) a ⊗ₜ
          (equationHom E U g hg).app (.op W) b = _
        rw [ha, hb]
        rfl
      · exact K.intersection_covering
          (Presheaf.imageSieve_mem K φD s) (Presheaf.imageSieve_mem K φE t)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.tensorEquationHom_isLocallyInjective
statement:
private lemma tensorEquationHom_isLocallyInjective (D E : CartierDivisor X)
    (U : X.Opens) (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f)
    (g : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hg : IsEquationOn E U g) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg))
proof:
:= by
  apply Presheaf.isLocallyInjective_of_injective _ _
  intro V a b hab
  apply equationHom_app_injective (D + E) U (f + g) (hf.add hg) V
  change (tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg).app V a =
    (tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg).app V b at hab
  have hcomp := multiplicationHom_comp_tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg
  let m := (PresheafOfModules.pushforward
        (F := Over.forget U) (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).map
          (multiplicationHom D E)
  have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ m.app V q) hab
  change (tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg ≫ m).app V a =
    (tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg ≫ m).app V b at h
  rw [hcomp] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.tensorEquationHom_mem_W
statement:
private lemma tensorEquationHom_mem_W (D E : CartierDivisor X)
    (U : X.Opens) (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f)
    (g : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hg : IsEquationOn E U g) :
    ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg))
proof:
:= by
  letI := tensorEquationHom_isLocallyInjective D E U f hf g hg
  letI := tensorEquationHom_isLocallySurjective D E U f hf g hg
  exact ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).W_of_isLocallyBijective _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.restrictedMultiplicationHom_mem_W
statement:
private lemma restrictedMultiplicationHom_mem_W (D E : CartierDivisor X)
    (U : X.Opens) (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f)
    (g : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hg : IsEquationOn E U g) :
    ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
        ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward
          (F := Over.forget U) (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).map
            (multiplicationHom D E)))
proof:
:= by
  let K := (_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U
  let t := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg)
  let m := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
    ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward
      (F := Over.forget U) (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).map (multiplicationHom D E))
  let e := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
    (equationHom (D + E) U (f + g) (hf.add hg))
  have hfac : t ≫ m = e := by
    exact congrArg (fun q ↦ (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map q)
      (multiplicationHom_comp_tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg)
  have ht := tensorEquationHom_mem_W D E U f hf g hg
  have he := equationHom_mem_W (D + E) U (f + g) (hf.add hg)
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective K t := ht.isLocallyInjective
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective K t := ht.isLocallySurjective
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective K e := he.isLocallyInjective
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective K e := he.isLocallySurjective
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective K m :=
    Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_of_isLocallySurjective_fac K hfac
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective K m :=
    Presheaf.isLocallyInjective_of_isLocallyInjective_of_isLocallySurjective_fac K e hfac
  exact K.W_of_isLocallyBijective m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.commonEquationOpen_coversTop
statement:
private lemma commonEquationOpen_coversTop (D E : CartierDivisor X) :
    (_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop (commonEquationOpen D E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.Opens.coversTop_iff]
  change ⨆ p : X × X, localEquationOpen D p.1 ⊓ localEquationOpen E p.2 = ⊤
  rw [← iSup_inf_iSup]
  have hD : ⨆ x, localEquationOpen D x = ⊤ :=
    (_root_.Opens.coversTop_iff (X : Type u) (localEquationOpen D)).mp
      (localEquationOpen_coversTop D)
  have hE : ⨆ x, localEquationOpen E x = ⊤ :=
    (_root_.Opens.coversTop_iff (X : Type u) (localEquationOpen E)).mp
      (localEquationOpen_coversTop E)
  rw [hD, hE, inf_top_eq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.multiplicationHom_mem_W
proof:
:= by
  let K := _root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X
  let p := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (multiplicationHom D E)
  let Y := commonEquationOpen D E
  have hY : K.CoversTop Y := commonEquationOpen_coversTop D E
  have hlocal (q : X × X) : (K.over (Y q)).W
      (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget (Y q)).op p) := by
    let f := localEquation D q.1
    let g := localEquation E q.2
    have hf : IsEquationOn D (Y q) f :=
      (localEquation_isEquationOn D q.1).mono inf_le_left
    have hg : IsEquationOn E (Y q) g :=
      (localEquation_isEquationOn E q.2).mono inf_le_right
    have hw := restrictedMultiplicationHom_mem_W D E (Y q) f hf g hg
    change (K.over (Y q)).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
        ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward
          (F := Over.forget (Y q)) (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over (Y q)).obj)).map
            (multiplicationHom D E)))
    exact hw
  exact Presheaf.W_of_coversTop p Y hY hlocal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.isIso_sheafification_map_multiplicationHom
proof:
:= by
  apply Localization.inverts
    (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj))
    ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).W.inverseImage
      (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj))
  exact multiplicationHom_mem_W D E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.equationToAssociatedHom_mem_W
statement:
private lemma equationToAssociatedHom_mem_W (D : CartierDivisor X)
    (U : X.Opens) (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f) :
    ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
        (equationToAssociatedHom D U f hf))
proof:
:= by
  let K := _root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X
  let η := (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).unit.app (fractionalPresheaf D)
  let F := PresheafOfModules.pushforward
    (F := Over.forget U) (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
  have hη : K.W ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map η) := by
    dsimp only [η]
    rw [PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf_map_sheafificationAdjunction_unit_app]
    exact K.W_toSheafify (fractionalPresheaf D).presheaf
  have hFη : (K.over U).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (F.map η)) := by
    change (K.over U).W
      (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget U).op
        ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map η))
    letI : Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective K
        ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map η) := hη.isLocallyInjective
    letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective K
        ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map η) := hη.isLocallySurjective
    letI : Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (K.over U)
        (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget U).op
          ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map η)) :=
      Presheaf.isLocallyInjective_whisker (K.over U) K (Over.forget U) _
    letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (K.over U)
        (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget U).op
          ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map η)) :=
      Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_whisker (K.over U) K (Over.forget U) _
    exact (K.over U).W_of_isLocallyBijective _
  rw [equationToAssociatedHom, Functor.map_comp]
  exact (K.over U).W.comp_mem _ _ (equationHom_mem_W D U f hf) hFη

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.associatedTensorEquationHom_mem_W
statement:
private lemma associatedTensorEquationHom_mem_W (D E : CartierDivisor X)
    (U : X.Opens) (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f)
    (g : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hg : IsEquationOn E U g) :
    ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
        (associatedTensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg))
proof:
:= by
  let K := (_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U
  let aD := equationToAssociatedHom D U f hf
  let aE := equationToAssociatedHom E U g hg
  have haD : K.W ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map aD) :=
    equationToAssociatedHom_mem_W D U f hf
  have haE : K.W ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map aE) :=
    equationToAssociatedHom_mem_W E U g hg
  letI : SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u}
      (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)) :=
    SheafOfModules.instIsInvertibleUnit.{u, u, u}
  letI : SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u}
      ((associatedSheaf D).over U) :=
    SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.ofIso
      (M := SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U))
      (N := (associatedSheaf D).over U) (equationIso D U f hf)
  letI : SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u}
      ((associatedSheaf E).over U) :=
    SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.ofIso
      (M := SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U))
      (N := (associatedSheaf E).over U) (equationIso E U g hg)
  obtain ⟨qI, hqI, hrankI⟩ :=
    SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.exists_rankOneData
      (M := SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U))
  obtain ⟨qE, hqE, hrankE⟩ :=
    SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.exists_rankOneData
      (M := (associatedSheaf E).over U)
  letI : qI.IsLocallyFreeData := hqI
  letI : qE.IsLocallyFreeData := hqE
  have hleft : K.W ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
      (PresheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj ◁ aE)) :=
    SheafOfModules.W_whiskerLeft_of_rankOneData
      (S := X.sheaf.over U) qI hrankI aE haE
  have hmid : K.W ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
      (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
        (associatedSheaf E)) U ◁ aD)) :=
    SheafOfModules.W_whiskerLeft_of_rankOneData
      (S := X.sheaf.over U) qE hrankE aD haD
  have hright : K.W ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
      (aD ▷ overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
        (associatedSheaf E)) U)) := by
    have hbraid : aD ▷ overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
        (associatedSheaf E)) U =
        (β_ (PresheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
          (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
            (associatedSheaf E)) U)).hom ≫
            (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
              (associatedSheaf E)) U ◁ aD) ≫
          (β_ (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
              (associatedSheaf D)) U)
            (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
              (associatedSheaf E)) U)).inv := by
      calc
        _ = (aD ▷ overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
              (associatedSheaf E)) U) ≫
              (β_ (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
                  (associatedSheaf D)) U)
                (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
                  (associatedSheaf E)) U)).hom ≫
              (β_ (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
                  (associatedSheaf D)) U)
                (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
                  (associatedSheaf E)) U)).inv := by simp
        _ = _ := by
          have h := congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫
              (β_ (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
                  (associatedSheaf D)) U)
                (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
                  (associatedSheaf E)) U)).inv)
            (BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_left aD
              (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
                (associatedSheaf E)) U))
          simpa only [Category.assoc] using h
    rw [hbraid, Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp]
    have hb₁ : K.W ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
        (β_ (PresheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
          (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
            (associatedSheaf E)) U)).hom) := K.W.of_isIso _
    have hb₂ : K.W ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
        (β_ (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
            (associatedSheaf D)) U)
          (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
            (associatedSheaf E)) U)).inv) := K.W.of_isIso _
    have htail := K.W.comp_mem _ _ hmid hb₂
    exact K.W.comp_mem _ _ hb₁ htail
  have htensor : K.W ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (aD ⊗ₘ aE)) := by
    have hfac : aD ⊗ₘ aE =
        (PresheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj ◁ aE) ≫
          (aD ▷ overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
            (associatedSheaf E)) U) := by
      simpa only [MonoidalCategory.id_tensorHom, MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_id,
        Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] using
          (MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom
            (𝟙 (PresheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)) aE aD
              (𝟙 (overPresheaf ((Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).obj
                (associatedSheaf E)) U))).symm
    rw [hfac, Functor.map_comp]
    exact K.W.comp_mem _ _ hleft hright
  rw [associatedTensorEquationHom, Functor.map_comp]
  exact K.W.comp_mem _ _ (K.W.of_isIso _) htensor

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.tensorEquationHom_comp_fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom
statement:
private lemma tensorEquationHom_comp_fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom
    (D E : CartierDivisor X) (U : X.Opens)
    (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f)
    (g : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hg : IsEquationOn E U g) :
    tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg ≫
      (PresheafOfModules.pushforward
        (F := Over.forget U) (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).map
          (fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom D E) =
    associatedTensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorEquationHom_eq_tensor, associatedTensorEquationHom]
  simp only [equationToAssociatedHom, fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom]
  ext V
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.restrictedFractionalToAssociatedTensorHom_mem_W
statement:
private lemma restrictedFractionalToAssociatedTensorHom_mem_W
    (D E : CartierDivisor X) (U : X.Opens)
    (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D U f)
    (g : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hg : IsEquationOn E U g) :
    ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
        ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward
          (F := Over.forget U) (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).map
            (fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom D E)))
proof:
:= by
  let K := (_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U
  let t := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
    (tensorEquationHom D E U f hf g hg)
  let c := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
    ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward
      (F := Over.forget U) (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).map
        (fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom D E))
  have ht : K.W t := tensorEquationHom_mem_W D E U f hf g hg
  have htc : K.W (t ≫ c) := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp,
      tensorEquationHom_comp_fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom]
    exact associatedTensorEquationHom_mem_W D E U f hf g hg
  exact K.W.of_precomp t c ht htc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom_mem_W
statement:
private lemma fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom_mem_W (D E : CartierDivisor X) :
    (_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
        (fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom D E))
proof:
:= by
  let K := _root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X
  let p := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
    (fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom D E)
  let Y := commonEquationOpen D E
  have hY : K.CoversTop Y := commonEquationOpen_coversTop D E
  refine Presheaf.W_of_coversTop p Y hY (fun q => ?_)
  exact restrictedFractionalToAssociatedTensorHom_mem_W D E (Y q) (localEquation D q.1)
    ((localEquation_isEquationOn D q.1).mono inf_le_left) (localEquation E q.2)
    ((localEquation_isEquationOn E q.2).mono inf_le_right)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.isIso_sheafification_map_fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom
statement:
private lemma isIso_sheafification_map_fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom
    (D E : CartierDivisor X) :
    IsIso ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map
      (fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom D E))
proof:
:= by
  apply Localization.inverts
    (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj))
    ((_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).W.inverseImage
      (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj))
  exact fractionalToAssociatedTensorHom_mem_W D E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.restrictGlobalEquationHom
statement:
private lemma restrictGlobalEquationHom (D : CartierDivisor X)
    (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D ⊤ f) (U : X.Opens) :
    (PresheafOfModules.pushforward
      (F := Over.forget U) (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).map
        (globalEquationHom D f hf) =
      equationHom D U f (hf.mono le_top)
proof:
:= by
  ext V
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.globalEquationHom_mem_W
statement:
private lemma globalEquationHom_mem_W (D : CartierDivisor X)
    (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ) (hf : IsEquationOn D ⊤ f) :
    (_root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
        (globalEquationHom D f hf))
proof:
:= by
  let K := _root_.Opens.grothendieckTopology X
  let p := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (globalEquationHom D f hf)
  let Y : PUnit.{u + 1} → X.Opens := fun _ ↦ ⊤
  have hY : K.CoversTop Y := by
    rw [_root_.Opens.coversTop_iff]
    change ⨆ _ : PUnit.{u + 1}, (⊤ : X.Opens) = ⊤
    simp
  have hlocal : (K.over ⊤).W
      (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget ⊤).op p) := by
    change (K.over ⊤).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
        ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward
          (F := Over.forget ⊤) (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over ⊤).obj)).map
            (globalEquationHom D f hf)))
    rw [restrictGlobalEquationHom]
    exact equationHom_mem_W D ⊤ f hf
  exact Presheaf.W_of_coversTop p Y hY (fun _ => hlocal)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.isIso_sheafification_map_globalEquationHom
statement:
private lemma isIso_sheafification_map_globalEquationHom
    (D : CartierDivisor X) (f : Additive X.functionFieldˣ)

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.nonemptyOfLE
statement: private theorem nonemptyOfLE {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) : Nonempty V → Nonempty U

:=
  fun hV ↦ ⟨⟨hV.some.1, h hV.some.2⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.germToFunctionField_res
statement:
lemma germToFunctionField_res {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (r : Γ(X, U)) (hV : PLift (Nonempty V)) :
    letI : Nonempty U
proof:
:= nonemptyOfLE X h hV.down
    letI : Nonempty V := hV.down
    X.germToFunctionField V (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op r) =
      X.germToFunctionField U r := by
  letI : Nonempty U := nonemptyOfLE X h hV.down
  letI : Nonempty V := hV.down
  let x : X := hV.down.some.1
  let hxV : x ∈ V := hV.down.some.2
  have hxU : x ∈ U := h hxV
  rw [← X.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField hxV,
    ← X.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField hxU]
  rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.rationalSectionsRes_smul
statement:
lemma rationalSectionsRes_smul {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (r : Γ(X, U)) (s : RationalSections X U) :
    rationalSectionsRes X h (r • s) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op r • rationalSectionsRes X h s
proof:
:= by
  ext hV
  letI : Nonempty U := nonemptyOfLE X h hV.down
  letI : Nonempty V := hV.down
  change X.germToFunctionField U r * s ⟨nonemptyOfLE X h hV.down⟩ =
    X.germToFunctionField V (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op r) *
      s ⟨nonemptyOfLE X h hV.down⟩
  rw [germToFunctionField_res X h r hV]

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.im_nonneg_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane
statement:
theorem im_nonneg_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane) : 0 ≤ z.im
proof:
:= by
  rcases hz with him | ⟨him, _⟩
  · exact him.le
  · exact him.symm ▸ le_rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.add_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane
statement:
theorem add_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane {z w : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane)
    (hw : w ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane) :
    z + w ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane
proof:
:= by
  have hz_im := im_nonneg_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hz
  have hw_im := im_nonneg_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hw
  by_cases hz_pos : 0 < z.im
  · exact Or.inl (by simpa using add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hz_pos hw_im)
  by_cases hw_pos : 0 < w.im
  · exact Or.inl (by simpa using add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hz_im hw_pos)
  right
  have hz_zero : z.im = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hz_pos) hz_im
  have hw_zero : w.im = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hw_pos) hw_im
  have hz_re : z.re < 0 := by
    rcases hz with h | ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact absurd hz_zero h.ne'
    · exact h
  have hw_re : w.re < 0 := by
    rcases hw with h | ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact absurd hw_zero h.ne'
    · exact h
  exact ⟨by simp [hz_zero, hw_zero], by simpa using add_neg hz_re hw_re⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.neg_sum_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane_of_im_eq_zero_of_re_pos
statement:
theorem neg_sum_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane_of_im_eq_zero_of_re_pos
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (z : Fin n → ℂ)
    (him : ∀ i, (z i).im = 0) (hre : ∀ i, 0 < (z i).re) :
    -(∑ i, z i) ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane
proof:
:= by
  have him_sum : (∑ i, z i).im = ∑ i, (z i).im := by
    simpa only [show ∀ w : ℂ, Complex.imAddGroupHom w = w.im from fun _ ↦ rfl] using
      map_sum Complex.imAddGroupHom z Finset.univ
  have hre_sum : (∑ i, z i).re = ∑ i, (z i).re := by
    simpa only [show ∀ w : ℂ, Complex.reAddGroupHom w = w.re from fun _ ↦ rfl] using
      map_sum Complex.reAddGroupHom z Finset.univ
  refine Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Complex.neg_im, him_sum]
    simp [him]
  · rw [Complex.neg_re, hre_sum]
    exact neg_neg_of_pos
      (Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ ↦ hre i) ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.phaseCross_eq_norm_mul_sin
statement:
theorem phaseCross_eq_norm_mul_sin (z w : ℂ) :
    phaseCross z w = ‖z‖ * ‖w‖ * Real.sin (arg w - arg z)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [phaseCross]
  rw [← norm_mul_cos_arg z, ← norm_mul_sin_arg z,
    ← norm_mul_cos_arg w, ← norm_mul_sin_arg w, Real.sin_sub]
  ring

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.phaseCross_nonneg_of_arg_le
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : 0 < ‖z‖ * ‖w‖ :=
    mul_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hz) (norm_pos_iff.mpr hw)
  rw [phaseCross_eq_norm_mul_sin, mul_nonneg_iff_right_nonneg_of_pos hnorm]
  exact Real.sin_nonneg_of_mem_Icc
    ⟨sub_nonneg.mpr harg,
      by linarith [arg_le_pi w, arg_nonneg_iff.mpr hz_im]⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.arg_le_of_phaseCross_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : 0 < ‖z‖ * ‖w‖ :=
    mul_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hz) (norm_pos_iff.mpr hw)
  rw [phaseCross_eq_norm_mul_sin, mul_nonneg_iff_right_nonneg_of_pos hnorm] at hcross
  by_contra h
  have hneg : arg w - arg z < 0 := sub_neg.mpr (lt_of_not_ge h)
  have hneg_pi : -Real.pi < arg w - arg z := by
    linarith [arg_le_pi z]
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hcross)
    (Real.sin_neg_of_neg_of_neg_pi_lt hneg hneg_pi)

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.phaseCross_pos_of_arg_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : 0 < ‖z‖ * ‖w‖ :=
    mul_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hz) (norm_pos_iff.mpr hw)
  rw [phaseCross_eq_norm_mul_sin]
  exact mul_pos hnorm (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (sub_pos.mpr harg)
    (by linarith [arg_le_pi w]))

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.arg_lt_of_phaseCross_pos
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : 0 < ‖z‖ * ‖w‖ :=
    mul_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hz) (norm_pos_iff.mpr hw)
  rw [phaseCross_eq_norm_mul_sin] at hcross
  have hsin : 0 < Real.sin (arg w - arg z) :=
    ((mul_pos_iff.mp hcross).elim id
      (fun h => absurd h.1 (not_lt.mpr hnorm.le))).2
  by_contra h
  have hwz : arg w ≤ arg z := le_of_not_gt h
  rcases hwz.eq_or_lt with heq | hlt
  · rw [heq, sub_self, Real.sin_zero] at hsin
    exact (lt_irrefl 0) hsin
  · have hneg : arg w - arg z < 0 := sub_neg.mpr hlt
    have hneg_pi : -Real.pi < arg w - arg z := by
      linarith [arg_le_pi z]
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (Real.sin_neg_of_neg_of_neg_pi_lt hneg hneg_pi).le) hsin

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.arg_add_le_max
statement:
theorem arg_add_le_max {z w : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane)
    (hw : w ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane) :
    arg (z + w) ≤ max (arg z) (arg w)
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 := semiClosedUpperHalfPlane_ne_zero hz
  have hw0 := semiClosedUpperHalfPlane_ne_zero hw
  have hsum := add_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hz hw
  have hsum0 := semiClosedUpperHalfPlane_ne_zero hsum
  rcases le_total (arg z) (arg w) with h | h
  · rw [max_eq_right h]
    apply arg_le_of_phaseCross_nonneg hsum0 hw0
      (arg_pos_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hw)
    have hcross := phaseCross_nonneg_of_arg_le
      (im_nonneg_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hz) hz0 hw0 h
    simp only [phaseCross, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im] at hcross ⊢
    linarith
  · rw [max_eq_left h]
    apply arg_le_of_phaseCross_nonneg hsum0 hz0
      (arg_pos_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hz)
    have hcross := phaseCross_nonneg_of_arg_le
      (im_nonneg_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hw) hw0 hz0 h
    simp only [phaseCross, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im] at hcross ⊢
    linarith

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.min_arg_le_arg_add
statement:
theorem min_arg_le_arg_add {z w : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane)
    (hw : w ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane) :
    min (arg z) (arg w) ≤ arg (z + w)
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 := semiClosedUpperHalfPlane_ne_zero hz
  have hw0 := semiClosedUpperHalfPlane_ne_zero hw
  have hsum := add_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hz hw
  have hsum0 := semiClosedUpperHalfPlane_ne_zero hsum
  rcases le_total (arg z) (arg w) with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h]
    apply arg_le_of_phaseCross_nonneg hz0 hsum0
      (arg_pos_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hsum)
    have hcross := phaseCross_nonneg_of_arg_le
      (im_nonneg_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hz) hz0 hw0 h
    simp only [phaseCross, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im] at hcross ⊢
    linarith
  · rw [min_eq_right h]
    apply arg_le_of_phaseCross_nonneg hw0 hsum0
      (arg_pos_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hsum)
    have hcross := phaseCross_nonneg_of_arg_le
      (im_nonneg_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hw) hw0 hz0 h
    simp only [phaseCross, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im] at hcross ⊢
    linarith

name: CategoryTheory.Triangulated.arg_add_lt_max
statement:
theorem arg_add_lt_max {z w : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane)
    (hw : w ∈ semiClosedUpperHalfPlane) (hne : arg z ≠ arg w) :
    arg (z + w) < max (arg z) (arg w)
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 := semiClosedUpperHalfPlane_ne_zero hz
  have hw0 := semiClosedUpperHalfPlane_ne_zero hw
  have hsum := add_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hz hw
  have hsum0 := semiClosedUpperHalfPlane_ne_zero hsum
  rcases hne.lt_or_gt with h | h
  · rw [max_eq_right h.le]
    apply arg_lt_of_phaseCross_pos hsum0 hw0
      (arg_pos_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hw)
    have hcross := phaseCross_pos_of_arg_lt
      (arg_pos_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hz) hz0 hw0 h
    simp only [phaseCross, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im] at hcross ⊢
    linarith
  · rw [max_eq_left h.le]
    apply arg_lt_of_phaseCross_pos hsum0 hz0
      (arg_pos_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hz)
    have hcross := phaseCross_pos_of_arg_lt
      (arg_pos_of_mem_semiClosedUpperHalfPlane hw) hw0 hz0 h
    simp only [phaseCross, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im] at hcross ⊢
    linarith

name: CategoryTheory.semiClosedUpperHalfPlane_ne_zero
statement:
theorem semiClosedUpperHalfPlane_ne_zero {z : ℂ}
